tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā sdu tsashā//9 'jiciX 0ji0ji ji 5055'acu 7 bci kho migaX 5075sto

rtsa du mtsho sngon /༷ ༷༷/ 'dape tshogs/ —/ — 4 5 ci ri —— ——shrī thosamabye du rte rnyi1༷ji 6 ——— — —— — ༷ ༄ tshotsha pa sde 73spyoX cha ——— ṭā du tsho 7) ༄ pa ⑫ ༷hwa shi wawal )0 )parnyi wa)sgen / ——ji saX wa ༷ ca ༷khro ༷༷ du 4 mi ring rteX/ spre (ske sdo rtere zi debye byedu — —zhirno je ༷༵ — dz+wa pyi ——4 ca) treX rtoho —— — — — — —ra༄ri ri ji 4༷ ༷ bye rtse ༷ sna / zlogaX sdo mā dpe skrun khang / rdo pro ——
mtshosngonanangabaskadaper rjo rngo lo khe skyi// sa sathe sa /ga sa sgo

mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal sgron/blo 'byi ///sa med phun tshogs 'byung gnas/gter chen mchog gyur gling ba/mkhas dbang khro ru tshe rnam/ 'bal tsha dul mo chos rje/ mkhas dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhas dbang pad+ma dam chos/ lā mo yongs shāsbyin/ a lags shar gdong / lho drung rin po che/ skyed tshal rin rtsom byu chen mo/ girtsom ṭ+wāṃ sna pas / rtso marten/rtsom /lhan yu po/ rje/rkarma gu ru/ sngags 'chang gu ru/ dge legs nyi ma/ mkhan dam chos zla ba/ mkhan skal ldan tshe ring / mkhan 'chi med tshe dbang /'jigs med theg mchog sangs rgyas don grub/ phun tshogs legs grub/

mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/glegs bam bzhi pa/sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal sgron/mkhan bo rdo rjes bsgrigs/lce sngon ri bsta dpe mas/rngo 47 nges/ ru/ du zhang rkang then mā dpe skrun kung zi/
mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs/thegs bam bzhi pa/sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal sgron/mkhan po rdo rjes bsgrigs/zhang nang then mā dpe skrun kung zi/

par skrun gsal bshad/rang cag kha ba ri bo'i ljongs la bstan pa yang dar gyi nyi gzhon slar yang shar nas/go la zlum po'i khyon na rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par bstan pa'i nying khu bod brgyud nang bstan du grags pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i go mtshams 'dir/ btsan gyis bcir zhing zur nas bshus pa'i rang 'dod rnams re zhig ba'ag ste/ mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi sasung rab rin thang bral ba ngom rin chog pa rnams par skrun 'grem spel byed rgyu do gol shin tu che ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub la/ khyad par dam pa gong ma rmams kyis gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun par grub mtha'i srol gtod pa rnam sa dgos dbang cam dang bstan pa la byi dor rmi dzad pa las don la tha dad til 'bru cam yang med kyang / da lta snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus skabs su rjes 'jug blo gsal rnams kyis/rig pa rno mdog gis rtsod gleng byas na/chags sdang rang rgyud par shor nas bstan pa rin po che dkrug nyen che bas kun gyis de la dogs zon mdzad nas bka' dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs don thams cad rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs zhi ba'i gnyen po thar pa thob pa'i man ngag nyag cig tu rtogs shing 'khor lo gsum kyi bya ba gang brtsam yang rgyal bstan rnam dag zhig tu 'gro gi yod pa mkhyen dgos la/ de ltar shes dgos na grub mtha' dang gzhung phyogs re tsam la sbyangs pas gnad de mkhyen par dka' bas sa dge bka' rnying bzhi'i dam pa bong ma'i gsung tshad mar gyur pa don 'dus la bo bde ba/ bar do ngos 'dzin thos grol chen mo/ dal 'byor don yod dpal dge'i khrid yigabashes gnyen bsten thabs lam 'bras bla brgyud/ ma nor lam ston sa skya'i sngon 'gro/ nges 'byung gnad skyal dwags po'i thar rgyan/ rnal 'byor nyam sa len chas 1

med ri chos/ shes bya mthar byed rwa bsdus bse bsdus/ blo sbyong nyams len lam rim khrid yig kun gyi spyi chings rgyal sras lag len/dal rten 'tsho byed zin tig ma bu sogs dpe tshogs tu bsgrig na/ sbyang brtson pa rnams la blta tshol bde zhing /'ga' zhig gis grub mtha' thams cad rta mog mog gi spu ltar 'gal 'dur mthong ba dang / the tshom gyi drwa bar tshud pa rnams lhag med du zhi nas gnad kyi babs so dgongs don gcig tu rtogs pa'i thabs khyad 'phags tu 'gyur ba dang / zhib 'jug pa rnams la'ang rgyal bstan ris med gcig tu zlum par ston pa sogs dgos gal che bar mthong la/ 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i dam pa du ma'i bka' lung legs so'i me tog bcas la brten/mtsho sngon nang bstan dpe tshogs 'di bsgrigs bskrun zhus pa yin/ bsgrigs bskrun gyi cha la nor 'khrul srid kyang gong zhus gyis gnad der smin nas rgyal bstan ril po gcig tu bskyang na/'dzam bu'i gling na radri shāg gi bstan pa sdude dar brtan yu/ gnas kyi stobs shā/kā dṛ /shā ༵ /dri ṅge je /sna zlo spyi/ /sdo tsang / rang gzhan d+ngha rgyud la thar pa mdor ril gyis dril na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rjes 'jug yongs rdzogs kyi phan tshun 'gal 'du'i bsam blo yongs su spang nas theg pa gong 'og dang sa dge bka' rnying sogs grub mtha' smra ba'i mthar thug dgongs don thams cad 'gal med gcig tu rtogs te/ dgongs pa mnyam gzhigs dang mdzad phrin mnyam skyong mdzad nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling na dang bstan ril po gcig tu dar brtan yun gnas 'ong ba bya rgyu de ma bskos dbu la babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin pa kun gyi thugs dbyings nas mi bor bar zhu zhu/zhes dang bstan rtsom sgrig khang gi mkhan ming rdo rjes bod yul mdo khams zi ling mkhar nang bstan chos kyi lding khang nas/

dkar chagartsom pa po'i lo rgyus/ (1)sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal sgron/mchod brjod/ (1)gleng gzhi/ (2)lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul/dang po/ bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ (4)gnyis pa/ bla slob kyi 'brel ba brtag pa/ (5)gsum pa/ slob mas bla ma bsten tshul/ (12)bzhi pa/ bla slob 'chad nyan bya tshul/ (40〉lam thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i skor/dang po/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ (46)gnyis pa/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/ (104)gsum pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ (119)bzhi pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ (110)lnga pa/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ (189)

lam thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i skor/kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyas bshad/ (231)dang po/ skyabs 'gro/ (232)gnyis pa/ sems bskyed/ (260)gsum pa/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ (262)bzhi pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ (286)lnga pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ (310)zab lam gzhan gyi skor so sor bshad pa/dang po/ na ro mkha' spyod ma'i sngon 'gro/ (328)gnyis pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngon 'gro/ (342)gsum pa/ spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi sngon 'gro/ (349)bzhi pa/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len 'bring po/ (350)swāhākā d+dhi trī/na tshi ga /////kha skong tshogs gnyis sprin chen/ (379)nyin zhag phugs gcig sge nyams len rgyas pa/ (391)nyin zhag phrugs gcig bi nyams len bsdus pa/ (426)zhal gdams slob bu'i re skong / (437)

rje btsun bla ma ngag blo rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar dad pa'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄7ོ/ /o suste/ byams mgon gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje'i/ /ring lugs spel slad rje btsun ngag gi dbang / /blo gros mtshungs med dam pa'i skur snang ba/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gang gi gsang gsum rnam thar ji snyed pa/ /bdag 'dras brjod par mi nus de ltar na'ang / /mthong thos sgro skur bral ba'i yon tan 'ga'/ /dad pa'i gsos su 'god la gnang ba stsol/ zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pas lam yangs par byas te 'dir dpal sa skya'i sngon 'gro'i khrid yig chen mo 'di nyid mdzad pa po shrī nā len+d+ra'i mkhan chen/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa/ nges pa don gyi mkhas grub chen po7skyabs rje bla ma ngag blo rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi gsang gsum yon tan bkod pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa las/ 'dir snying po bsdus te rags tsam 'god pa la/ 'khrungs pa'i yul dus ni/ mdo stod nang chen chos rgyal chen po'i mnga' ris dngul rdza zal mo sgangagi sgang stod ke rgyal ne bro chen po'i nye zhol dpal smad zo chung lung par/ gdung rus ki la zhes pa'i rigs su yab ki la dbang rgyal dang / yum rgyar bza' dpal skyid chos 'dzoms gnyis kyi sras su/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu 'brug 1892 lor ngo mtshar ba'i rtags bcas sku 'khrungs/ 'khrungs ma thag yid du 'ong zhing mgrin pa la sme ba dkar po 'o ma thigs pa 'dra ba yod pa dang / gso bar sla zhing skye stobs che/ sku gzugs shin tu mdzes/ gshis rgyud bzang / rtsed mo gang mdzad chos spyod kyi rnam par mdzad pa sogs tha mal byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pas/ yab kyis 'di byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra zhes gtsang spra chen pos nang mi rnams la yang 'al 1

phor mi bsre/ khyim mtshes yul mi rnams kyis kyang / 'di sprul sku zhig yin nges red ces kun gyis bla mar 'dzin/ ngor khang gsar mkhan chen ngag dbang blo gros snying po 'khrungs khyim du gdan drangs nas gtsug phud phul/ mtshan ngag dbang blo gros zhes gnang/ dgung lo lnga drug tsam la kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'i mdun nas phur pa'i dbang chen gsan/ bla ma de'i sku'i rnam pa dang thugs dgyes dgyes kyis phyag dbang mdzad pa thams cad phyis su'ang gsal po dran gsungs/ yab kyis ka kha nas brtsams te yi ge sbyor klog bslabs pas tshegs med du mkhyen/ khu bo sngags 'chang rig 'dzin gyis kyang mdos chog phyag len sogs yon tan mang po bslabs/ dgung lo brgyad dgu'i skor la chos sgar du tshogs sgrig la zhugs/ lo shas ring 'don chog thams cad thugs 'dzin dang de dag gi phyag len phra rags ma lus pa dang gar 'chams sogs kyang khungs dang ldan pa gsan sbyangs byang 'dren 'pher ba mdzad/gdan sa tsong mda' dgon du bshad grwar zhugs nas mkhan po bla sprul du ma'i mdun nas chos mang du gsan/de skabs 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po skye rgu dgon du bzhugs pa'i mdun du zhabs thang khur po bsnams nas phebs/ thugs shin tu dgyes pa chen pos thub pa'i dgongs gsal sogs mdo phyogs dang / rgyud sde kun btus nang gi dus 'khor/ mkha' spyod/ spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs sogs yi dam mang po'i dbang khrid/ mgon po gur lha brgyad/ dmar po skor gsum/ dzam bha la sogs kyi rjes gnang mang pos gtsos gsang sngags kyi chos mang po zhus/ tsong mda' dgon du phebs nas lo gsum gyi ring dbyar bdag mdzad nas dbyar chos gsungs pa dang / rgyun par ma ṇi lha khang du sku 'tshams su bzhugs/ phur bla rin chen bzang po'i mdun nas phur pa'i dbang chen/ dkar bdud gnyis kyi rjes gnang sogs gsan/ tsong mda' dgon gyi mkhan po gdong ru dam chos/mala' spyod dngos grub rnal 'byor pa skya su'i brtson 'grus sogs las kyang sum 2

rtags dag gsum sogs rig gnas dang / sgrub btus kyi dbang rjes gnang lung sogs mang po gsan/ mkhyen rab dang brtson 'grus kun spyod tshang ma kun gyi yid smon gyi gnas su gyur te ki la mkhas pa ngag blo zhes mtshan snyan rgyas/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu'i nang nā len+d+ra'i gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin khams phebs gnang ste tsong mda' dgon du lam 'bras kyi dbang khrid lung bcas gnang ba gsan pa dang / dge tshul bsgrubs/ be'u ru bla chen dgon du bka' 'gyur ljags lung gnang ba gsan/ de dus gzim 'og rin po ches mkhan po mdzad/ gzhan yang las slob sogs dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ de nas bzung ste ston pa'i sku dang chos gos lhung bzed gding ba bcas 'bral spangs dang / phyi dro'i kha zas mi bzhes/ 'dul ba'i lag len gyi phyag dpe zhig 'bral med du bsnams te bslab bya rnams bsngo bgrang gis rgyun du dus dran bsten pa dang / phyir bcos dus thog tu mdzad/ spyod lam thams cad kyang dran shes bag yod kyi ngang las mi 'da' bas tha na zhal khrus gnang dus 'dag rdzas kyang sug pa dang bul tog las yi tsi sogs mi spyod/ zhal snum yang mar kho na las rdzas sbyor dri zhim rigs gtan nas mi byugs/ rgyun du na bza' grwa chas dang ma bral bar zhabs skyil krung gis sku drang por bsungs te bzhugs pa las nyin mo mnal gzims pa dang / sku 'gyel te bzhugs pa dang / zhabs pus bsnol ba'am zhabs brkyangs nas bzhugs pa tsam yang rang lo dgu nas nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar zhabs pad bsten pa'i ring mjal myong med/ dgos nges ma gtogs don med kyi gsung gleng mang po dang / ku re bzhad gad sku rtsed sogs gtan nas mi gnang / sku mdun du gzhan med na phyag dpe gzigs pa'am zhal 'don mdzad pa las rang gar mi bzhugs/ dus rtag tu sku lus dang / na bza'/ rgyun du phyag gis 'chang ba'i sku chas yo byad thams cad la tshul khrims kyi dri zhim 'bral mi phod pas khyab pa kun 3

la mthun snang du grub/ mdor na chos 'dul ba'i dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bcas mtshams las nam yang mi 'da' bar spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gces spras su mdzad pas gangs can 'dul 'dzin mchog gi mig dper gyur nas phyis su dge tshul slong brgya phrag mang po'i mkhan slob mdzad pa yin/ de nas gzim 'og rin po ches bka' ltar lhan du dbus su phebs shing nā len+d+ra la grwa sa'i sgrig zhugs mdzad/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi zhal slob rig gnas la mkhas shing / zhal bzhi'i snyan brgyud kyi bdag po dge slong snyan grags 'gyur med kyi mdun nas dag yig ngag sgron/dbyangs can sgra mdo'i sa ris/sdeb sbyor/mngon brjod sogs dang / snyan ngag me long gsan sbyangs rtsom rgyugs phul/ gzhan yang rtsis dkar nag la wartu sogs yig rigs du ma'i bris rgyun bcas dang / thun mong rig gnas spyi yi dgongs 'grel sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo rtsa 'grel legs par bslab cing mkhyen pas mtshan 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros zhes gsol/ bco brgyad khri chen gong ma rin chen mkhyen brtse dbang po'i zhal snga nas lam 'bras slob bshad dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang sogs gsan/ bla ma de nyid kyis bla ma rin po che dgon pa gzhan dang bla ma gzhan la chos gsan par phebs dus khyed kyis dpe cha shes nas nā len+d+ra blos mi gtong bar rjes ma tshur phebs dgos zhes zhal bzhes mdzad du bcug ma 'ongs pa na bla ma ngag blos nā len+d+ra la phan thogs chen po yong zhes pa'i lung bstan/ mkhan chos rje tshang dang / gzim 'og phyag mdzod kun dga' bsam gtan sogs khong gi zhal slob du ma la gnang / gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas lam 'bras slob bshad tshar gsum dang /sgrub thabs kun btus tshar gnyis/sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum/mkha' spyod skor gsum/ 'jigs byed/ dmar po skor gsum/ rnam sras/ gur zhal/ dud sol/ rab brtan ma/ dur bdag be〉/las gshin sogs snyan brgyud zab la dkon pa mtha' dag bi dbang byin rlabs/4

rjes gnang / bka' gtad/ khrid chen rnams dang / de dag gi be'u bum pod gang bzhugs thams cad kyi lung bcas sku ngal la ma 'joms par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang ba ni ma 'ongs pa na sa ngor tshar gsum gyi bstan rgyun la mdzad rjes chen po 'byung ba mkhyen pas mngon sum du gzigs par nges/ de bzhin du rin chen gter mdzod dang gi mkhyen brtse'i bka' babs bdun dang / g.yu thog snying thig thugs sgrub/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus sogs rnying ma'i chos skor shin tu mang po gsan/ rdzogs chen gzhan dga'i zhal slob brag g.yab mkhas pa ngag dbang thub bstan rgyal mtshan mdun nas sa 'jam sbags sgrub kyi byin rlabs sogs dang / rgya 'grel gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhung chen nyi shu rtsa drug gi bka' khrid gsan pa dang /rgyugs 'bul mdzad/gzhung chen mang po'i rtsa ba dang /thub pa'i dgongs gsal/dbu ma lta ba ngan sel/sher phyin sbas don rab gsal/sbas don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed sogs rang lugs kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung / gzhung gi dka' 'grel mtha' dpyod mang po blo 'dzin byang chub par mdzad/ nyid kyi zhal nas nga la 'dzin rig dang go rig gnyis ka skyon med tsam yod ces pa las cher mi gsungs kyang nyin rer ldeb ring mda' tshad mang po zin pa'i bgros 'dug pa dang / 'bras yul skyed tshal du brag g.yab thub bstan mdun nas sher phyin sbyangs rjes bla ma'i bka' ltar yon bdag grags pa'i khyim du 'bum bklags pas mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dngos po brgyad/don bdun cu'i rtsa tshig rnams 'bum la thad kur sbyar thub pa 'dug gsungs/ gzim 'og zhabs drung rtse sprul rin po che ngag dbang snyan grags 'od zer gyi drung nas sa skya bka' 'bum/ ngor chen bka' 'bum/ zhu chen bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs gsan/ nā len+d+ra'i mkhan chos rje'i mdun nas sman skor 'ga' dang / yongs 'dzin gu ṇa'i bka' 'bum dang / gzim thog ya she'i bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs gsan/mtshur phu'i rtsis pa 'od zer rab brtan gyi mdun nas rtsis dkar nag dbyangs 5

gsum sogs rig gnas 'ga' zhig gsan/ ngor mkhan chen dam pa rin po che ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po'i mdun nas blo gter dbang po las gsan ma grub pa'i rgyud btus kyi dbang khrid lung rnams lo rer gang thob lo du ma'i bar du gsan pa dang / lam 'bras tshogs bshad tshar gsum/ sgrub btus tshar gcig sa gcod kyi smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa/ gur zhal gyis gtsos snyan brgyud mang po sogs gsar rnying gi chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ sga bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyi sku mched bla ma dge 'dun drung nas mkha' spyod kyi skor sogs chos mang du gsan/ sa skya'i lha khang mkhan chen 'jam dpal bzang po'i mdun nas dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang po gsan/ grub pa'i dbang phyug snye mo rdo dgon pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i mdun nas klong chen snying thig yongs rdzogs/ mi pham bka' 'bum lung /mchog gling gi bar chad lam gyi las tshogs cha tshang sogs rnying ma'i chos skor mtha' yas pa gsan/ sa skya'i rje btsun pad+ma grin las rdo rje bdud 'dul dbang mo'i mdun nas/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang khrid sogs gsan/ se ra sgrub sde'i grub chen rig pa'i rdo rje'i mdun nas rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi yab bka' yum bka'i dbang / zhag bdun snyan brgyud kyi khrid man ngag rgyab rten dang bcas pa dang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba chig brgyud zab mo zhus pas chos gral de nyid du bla ma rin po che'i dbu'i steng du zil pa phrom me dbu gtsug skrangs pa sogs rtags gsal po de ma thag thon/ de'i sku tsha 'khrul zhig 'jigs bral seng ge'i mdun nas rig pa'i rdo rje'i bka' lung ltar rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor cha tshang dang yang tig gser 'bru smin grol cha lag dang bcas pa gsan/ grang mo che'i mkhan zur rnal 'byor 'jam dpal chos bzang rgya mtsho'i mdun nas ni gu chos drug gi dbang khrid lung sogs mang po gsan/'di dus rmi gu chos drug gi khrid 'chad thabs mdzad/ sa skya'i 'bul bla ngag 6

dbang legs pa'i zhal slob yin pa bla ma bshad sgrub mdun nas 'jigs byed ra skyo gnyis kyi pod rnams dang /las gshin sgrub skor gyi pod rnams kyi lung gsan/chos sde byang gi dbu mdzad chen mo'i mdun nas sa lugs rang gi phyag len rgyud sde yongs kyi dkyil 'khor thog thig rtsa/ cho ga phyag len dbyangs rol spyi dang /mgon po'i nang bskang dang zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gso'i bca' gshom/ 'don sgrig dbyangs rol/ gur zhal sogs kyi mdos dkris sna tshogs sbyangs/ 'argo log grub chen ri rked rin po che mchan dngos gzhan phan thugs rje'i myu gu'i zhal nas/thang stong snyan brgyud kyi dbang khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ 'phags mo'i snying thig dang / kur gling zhi khro'i dbang chen sogs chos mang po gsan/ de dus bla ma'i bka' ltar thang stong snyan brgyud kyi bstan rgyas smon lam mdzad/ mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros mdun nas sa 'jam sbags sgrub kyi byin rlabs dang / 'jam dbyangs dkar po sogs kyi rjes gnang mang po gsan pa sogs 'di dag ni mtshon pa tsam ste re re'i mdun nas gsan pa yang grangs med/ mdor na sngon khrid kyi mdzad byang du/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma bcu phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyi gsung gi bdud ji myong zhing 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs zhes gsungs pa ltar gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma tshad ldan thams cad las brgyud pa rnam par dag pa'i chos tshul mtha' dag la thos bsam phyogs med mdzad pas gangs can gyi rig gnas spyi dang / bshad brgyud 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu/ sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi chos thams cad kyi bang mdzod du gyur te mkhas pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ chos zhus pa'i bla ma mchog dman thams cad la mnyam 'grogs mi mdzad par mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog bsgrub/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan brjod pa dang gsan pa tsam gyis phyag thal mo sbyar/ rdo rje 'chang / bka' drin can zhes pa'i che brjod dang spyan dmigs bcas skyabs su mchi gsung bar ma dzad/ 'al slob rnams la yang rtag tu chos byed mkham zhis yin phyin chad lam 7

gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul de gal shin tu che/ de la rten 'brel 'chugs na gang yang yong gi ma red ces dang / yang bla ma la mos gus ma thob na chos dang nyams rtogs skye ba'i rgyu med/ci mdzad skyon du mi rtog pa'i mos gus thob na byin rlabs myur du 'jug nyams rtogs bzang po skye ba la tshegs med ces yang yang gsungs/ dam pa 'di bla ma 'tshol zhing bsten pa dang / chos phyir dka' spyad shin tu bzod pa zhig ste/sngon blo gter dbang po'i mdun du phebs pa dang /bla ma thub bstan gyi drung du gzhung chen sbyangs par phebs dus nā len+d+ra nas lha sa/rong chung / 'bras yul bskyed tshal/zha lu/ngor/sa skya gong /lha rtse/rta nag sogs su sku rkyang zhabs thang khur po bsnams nas phebs/ rang gi yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul du dbus khul dang gtsang du zhabs phyi grwa pa gcig rang khrid nas zhabs thang kho nas ri khrod dang dgon gnas rnams su phyag mchod dang bla ma gang bzang la chos gsan bzhin phebs/ 'khrul zhig 'jigs bral seng ge de chos bka' shin tu dog pas snod brtag pa'i ched lta bu'i yun ring mjal kha ma gnang bar slar yang zhu yig phul ba'i nang khyed kyi zhal nas chos ma thob bar du lo gsum sogs sgrug dgos kyang sgug gi yin zhus pas thugs mnyes te 'phral du mjal kha gnang /gong gsal gdams pa zab mo rnams thob/de phyin chad slob ma gzhan la yang chos sgo de tsam mi dog par mdzad/ gzhung chen sbyangs skabs zas gos ngan ngon la brten nas slob sbyong kho na brtson 'grub mdzad pa'i tshul rje bla ma nyid kyi zhal nas/ sngon nga tshos ngor du dpe cha sbyangs dus bla ma thub bstan rin po che rta nag thub bstan dgon du zla shas 'gor bar phebs/ dge bshes bsod rgyal lags/ grags rdor lags sogs nged bdun dpe mtshams la bsdad/ ngor dgon de ri khrod yin rkyen 'bud shing dang za ma btsal sa med pas dang po nas za ma dkon po las med/ rtsam pa cung zad yod pa chu grang mos skyo ma kho na bldags te ji ltar bsris kyang rtsam pa chad/ ngor gyi bla brang gnyis nas 8

tshogs thug tsha gzugs la phul pa/ rtsam thug sdor med sla se ba zo ba re gnang byung ba grang mo kho na nyin rer phor pa gang do re 'thung / de dus za ma gzhan lta zhog rtsam pa mig gi ma mthong bar nyin ma bdun brgyad red kyang dpe mtshams ma bzhag 'gyangs tsam na rta nag nas bla mas rtsam pa snye gang bskur gnang ba 'byor dus/ grags rdor lags kyi rtsam pa lags/ zhal ma mjal bar nyi ma de tsam song ba de ring mjal dus phyag 'bul zhu dgos kyi ma red dam/ zhes sku rtsed gsung bar nga tsho tshang ma bgad/sngar bla ma thub bstan rin po ches phyag dpe sbyangs dus sto gos skya hrul mdzad de tha na zhabs lham yag tsam zhig kyang bzhes rgyu med par dbyar dgun ltos med du sa cha dben sa rer bzhugs nas slob sbyong kho na gnang bas sku lus nyi lhags kyis gdungs pas sag ris khyab/ phyag ser khar song / dgun dus zhabs 'khyid/ lo du ma de 'dra'i dka' spyad kyis sbyangs/skabs shig khyim tshang zhig gis dpe mtshams la nyar te gsol chas bcud can legs par phul bas sku las har sos thebs pas zla ba gcig tsam nas sag ri rnams dag zhabs kyi phyi long gi steng nas phyi sag ri la nang skyi mo lta bu yod pa rgya tshigs kyi dbyibs can 'phang lo'i rus pa 'dra ba zhig gog byung gsungs zhes phyag thal mo sbyar/ spyir dka' spyad snying rus med na chos dang 'jig rten gang yang grub kyi ma red ces yang yang gsung ngo //sku btsun pa'i yon tan gyi dbang du byas na chung ngu'i dus dgon pa'i tshogs sgrig 'grim pa'i skabs kyang tshul dang kun spyod legs shos kyi gras yin pa dang / dge tshul slong bsgrubs nas gong du bkod pa ltar bstan pa spyi yi dmigs rkyen/ phyi so sor thar pa'i kun spyod gtso che bar dgongs nas chos 'dul ba las ji ltar bstan pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi bslab bya rgyu tshogs dang bcas pa mkhyen cing / nyes cing phra mo tsam yang khyad du mi gsod par tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / nang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ snga phyir bla 9

ma rnams kyi spyan sngar theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems bskyed dbu sems lugs gnyis so so dang / gsang sngags lugs kyi brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed phyag len dang bcas pa yang yang zhus shing bslab bya mtha' dag tshul bzhin du thugs nyams su bzhes/ khyad par blo sbyong gi mthar thug bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la nyams len gyi snying por mdzad pa goms pa'i stobs kyis sdug bsngal can gyi sems can gzigs pa dang gsan pa'i skabs su mi bzod pa'i sgo nas thugs mi bde ba 'byung / slong mo ba nyam thag gzigs na gang yod phangs med gnang bas chos grogs rnams kyis bla ma sprang dga' lags zhu bar grags/ nya sogs sems can mang po srog blu mdzad/ gsang ba sngags kyi sdom pa ni mtshan ldan gyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams las cho ga rnam par dag pa'i dbang bzhis smin par mdzad nas dbang srog dam tshig gi rnam bzhag la shin tu mkhas shing byang chub par mdzad nas lam rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad de nā len+d+rar kye rdor sku mtshams bzhugs pa nas mtshan mo gzim dus sku chings mi bkrol bar bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis dus 'da' ba dang / nyal ldang kha zas kyi rnal 'byor nas zag pa sbyin pa gtong ba yan chad kyi spyod lam thams cad kyang tha mal du mi gtong bar rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyis rtsis zin par mdzad pa sogs d+dha/dor na sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len thams cad rje nyid kyis sku tshe'i ring la nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu mnyam rjes gnyis su ji ltar nyams bzhes mdzad pa ltar rjes 'jug blo gros mchog dman la dgongs pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi cho ga rgyas bsdus gnyis mdzad pa da lta sngon khrid kyi cha lag tu bkod pa kho na bzhin phyag len du mdzad pa yin no//bzang po'i mdzad pas bstan 'gro skyong ba'i tshul ni dus kun tu bstan pa dang sems can la ci phan mdzad pa ste/ phyogs kun tu mtshan slan grags kyes 10

khyab/ dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan chen yin pa dang / bco brgyad khri chen rin po che dang / sa skya bdag chen yab sras lta bu'i dbu bla mdzad/ dbus gtsang gi che rgu mang pos gtsug tu mchod kyang / grwa rkyang dkyus ma'i dman sa 'dzin pa las bla brang bca' ba dang / gnyer pa phyag mdzod sogs 'khor mang bsdus pa'i che tshugs mi mdzad/ 'bas phyi yang nā len+d+ra'i mkhan po gnang tshun nas gsol chas 'bul mkhan mkhyen rab 'phags mchog lags dang / ma byan chab ril lags gnyis kho na yin/ dbang chos rgya chen gnang dus mchod g.yog grwa pa re gnyis nyar gnang las med/ phyag dpe po ti stong phrag gnyis tsam las gzhan mchod ca dang sku chas thams cad gnas skabs bed chod tsam gyi ngan ngon kho na las rin thang che ba gang yang med/ gzhan legs pa 'dra 'bul mkhan byung na bla ma rnams dang /dgon pa khag la 'bul ba las bdag 'dzin gyis nyar tshags mi gnang /tshong dang bu lon gtong len sogs ni sku tshe'i ring mjad myong med/ rgyun gyi gsol chas kyang zhogs pa dang / nyin gung gnyis la zhal zas spyir gtang re las rgyas spros gang yang mi dgos/ 'khor dang slob ma drag zhan thams cad la 'dra mnyam lta bu 'grogs bde gshibs bde thams cad la zhal 'dzum mul le mdzad pa las/ phyag 'bebs lta ci zhal nag po ston pa dang / spyan log dang / bka' bkyon dang / thugs khros te bzhugs pa sogs mi srid pa yin/ slob ma rnams kyis bya ba nyes kyang thugs mi 'khrugs par bka' khrid kyi dbu la sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong gi dang nas bka' slob gnang ba las rtsub bcos gtan nas mi mdzad pa 'di 'dra ba'i thugs rgyud 'jam po can ni gang du yang mjal bar dka'/ yon bdag gson gshin rnams kyis phul ba'i dad rdzas chang ma sku gsung thugs rten bzhings pa dang mchod sbyin sogs chos phyogs kho nar gtong ba las gnas min du chud zos cung zad kyang mi mdzad/ de yang zhib par smos kyis mi lang yang rags tsam mtshom na/ dzā len+d+ra'i tshogs chen du ngagu gtor skabs bshams rgyu 11

gur lha brgyad dang / zhal bzhi gtso 'khor la 'dod lha bsnan pa'i zhal thang gnyis/ mtho tshad 'du khang gi rgya mthongs thog brtsegs gnyis dang mnyam pa me long bri gzhi gos chen dkar 'jam la gong sham rgya se dang / zhal kheb sman tse/thang tog rgya dngul tshags ris can shin tu spus legs phul/ mtshan nyid grwa tshang la bal rkyang las grub pa'i grum tse gdan ring drug dang / khri gdan kha gang ma bcu gcig shing gi ja khra rag shan ma drug phul/ a mdo khang tshan la gtso bo tshem bu lugs kyi ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi rten du dmigs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa mi tshad tsam dang / tshe lha rnam gsum mda' tshad re/ mgon dkar phyag drug mda' tshad ma bcas sku lnga sku rgyu rgya dngul la rgyan cha zangs gser las grub pa/gzi byur g.yu dang mu tig sogs rin chen sna tshogs kyi phra tshom can dang / grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i sku gser zangs las grub pa mtho brgyad kyi tshad can/ de thams cad kyi nang gzungs la dpal sa skya'i rten sgam nas byung ba'i sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i ring bsrel/ rgya bal paṇa grub du ma dang / gong ma lnga dang /g.yag rong / tshar chen sogs kyi ring bsrel/ gdung rus/ na bza'/ dbu lo sogs sku bal ring bsrel rtsa chen gyis gtsos ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams shing gzungs sgrub rab gnas tshad ldan can bzang gos kyi na bza' bcas phul/ gzhan yang tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa'i tshar lugs 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs rdzogs kyi sku khru phyed lhag tsam bzhengs te bco brgyad khri chen rin po cher phul ba dang / nyid kyi thugs dam gyi rten du dngul las grub pa'i gur mgon dang /mgon dkar mtho re tsam pa/kye rdor/'jigs byed/gu ru rin po che/ sa paṇa sogs kyi zhal thang mang po bzhings pa dang / thang rgyal gyi tsha spar mtho gang gi tshad sogs sku rten che chung mang po dang / rang lugs gong ma'i gsung rab du ma spar du bskos pa dang / gzhung chen mchan 'grel 'ga' zhig gzab bris dang / ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje'i gsung skor mang pos gtsos 12

mkhas pa'i gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon pa du ma bri bshu phyag bltar gnang ba yang pod du ma byung / 'jigs byed be'u bum pod gsum dpe ris dang bcas pa pa sogs yig mkhan la yon sbyar te bzhengs pa ni mang po bzhugs/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su 'khrungs yul du yab kyi dgongs rdzogs sogs mchod rten gsum bzhengs pa da lta yang bzhugs skad/ dbus su phebs nas bco brgyad gong ma'i bka' ltar nā len+d+ra'i 'bum chen ma'i nub tu rigs gsum mchod rten dang / lho kha rnam rab dwags grwar dri med rnam gnyis kyi mchod rten chen po bzhengs nas skor tshad phan yon dang bcas pa ljags rtsom gnang ba dang / thub bstan rwa ba smad du gser kong gi rgyur gser sgor mo bcu gsum gnang ba dang / lo ltar kye rdor sgrub mchod dang / sgrol ma'i g.yul mdos/ mgon po khro bcu'i gtor zlog rgyun 'dzugs gnang rogs bskyangs/ de dag gis mtshon dgon khag mang por rten 'jog gnang sbyin dang mang 'gyed phul ba grangs kyis mi chod/ gnas chen rnams kyi rten gsum gyi spyan sngar tshogs 'bum/chu 'bum/mar me khri mchod/zhal zas stong mchod mang po 'dul gnang mdzad/gzhan dpe cha ba'i 'tsho gos dang /dpe cha'i mthun rkyen/ rgyug sprod legs zhan la dpag pa'i gtang rag dang /brngan pa/ nad pa dang slong mo ba la gnang ba sogs/ mdor na rgyun du bzhugs grwa 'grig tsam las gsog 'jog ci yang mi mdzad do//'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i chos sbyin gyis bstan dang 'gro ba la/ 'chad nyan gyi bshad rgyud gtso bor spel ba'i tshul ni 'khrungs yul du bzhugs dus kyang sku yon sbyangs pa dang mnyam du gzhan la spyod 'jug dang / thub pa'i dgongs gsal sogs 'chad nyan 'ga' zhig mdzad/ nā len+d+ra la phebs nas lo du ma'i ring dbus gtsang gang sar gsan sbyangs gtso bor mdzad/de nas bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa sbrul lo'i(1929)dpyid kur nā len+d+ra'i bla ma thub bstan rin po ches bshad grwa btsugs par slar yang lha sa nas gdan drangs/ bla ma de'i sku rjes 13

su 'brangs pa bla ma rin po che dang / mkhan chen 'jam dpal bzang po rin chen bzang po/ 'phags pa lha/ bsod rgyal lags sogs dge bshes bzhi bcu skor dang / gsar zhugs bcas chos ra gsar rnying gnyis bar gang ba'i slob tshogs 'dus pa la spyod 'jug dang / dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum sogs gzhung bshad tshugs/ de skabs 'jam dpal bzang po dang / bla ma rin po che rnam gnyis skyor dpon gtso bo gnang bas slob ma'i go stobs bskyed pa la gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa byung / 'di skabs bco brgyad gong mas bla ma thub bstan phebs pa yag po red/ byin gyis brlabs pa tsam 'byung / nga rang tshos dgon pa la ngag blos phan thogs che ba yong gi red ces lung bstan gnang ba ltar/ bla ma thub bstan rin po che phrin las shin tu rgyas kyang bstan pa'i gegs chag kyis lo phyi ma rta lo'i zla ba dang po na mgul cham lta bu cung zad bsnyan/ de skabs slob ma drag gras rnams la tshad ma rigs gter khrid bzhin par/ nangs cig bla mas mdang nga'i rmi lam du sa paṇa gyi bla mtsho red zer ba'i mtsho chen po zhig 'dugangs de yin na lhag ma med pa 'thung dgos bsams nas hub kyis drangs pas lhag ma cung zad lus song / da rigs gter 'di mjug mi 'khyol bar 'dug pas mjug rdzogs par ngag blo lags kyis khrid dgos gsungs pa dang / tshes dgu'i nyin bla ma rin po che bla ma'i sku mdun du shog gsungs nas bcar dus/khyed rang nā len+d+ra la sdod dgos/ 'jam dpal bzang po sa skya gong / rin chen bzang po bsam yas/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin rta nag 'phags pa lha skyed tshal bcas su gtong gi yin gsung bar/ bla ma rin po ches/ ngas nā len+d+ra la thugs phan sod pa i yong the tshom che ba sogs zhus pas/da lan u tshugs ma byed/ khyed min pa 'os pa 'dra mi 'dug mi skyon/ ngas bskor ba yang yang brgyab yong /sems skyo mi dgos gsungs nas nā len+d+ra'i 'chad nyan gyi bstan rgyun skyong ba'i rgyal tshab tu don gyis basmos/ de nas bla ma rin po che bshums te 'bas pad 14

brtan par gsol ba btab kyang tshes bcu'i nam langs la kha ba chen po babs pas sa phyogs thams cad dkar 'jam du gyur pa'i rtags bcas skyil krung mnyam bzhag du bzhugs nas sku gshegs/ 'das mchod dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba thams cad zhal slob dang yon bdag rnams kyis rgyas par bsgrubs/ khyad par gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gi bka' slob tu da res bla ma gzhan rnams ltar gshegs rjes kyi bya ba gzhan mi dgos par dgongs rdzogs su 'chad nyan kho na mdzad dgos pa'i dgongs don ltar/ bla ma rin po ches tshad ma rigs gter gyi mjug bskyangs/ rjes dpag rnam gnyis kyi le'u nas khrid grub rjes dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ 'jam dpal bzang pos bzhi brgya pa/ rin chen bzang pos dbu ma 'jug pa sogs skyor dpon rnams las bgos kyis gzhung chen bcu gsum cha tshang khrid/ dgong mo bla ma rin po che dang / bzang r+pā rnam gnyis sogs slob ma'i gtso bo rnams gdung tshwa'i mdun du sa paṇa bla mchod 'bul/ gzhan gzhis byes kyi dge 'dun brgya phrag lhag gis spyod 'jug dang / rgyan 'jug gnyis kyi rtsa ba sogs gsungs pa rnams dgung zhag zhe dgu'i bar bsgrubs/ de nas chos grogs rnams kyang bla ma'i zhal chems bka' bkod mdzad pa ltar phyogs so sor phebs pas bla ma rin po che thugs sems shing tu skyo bas bzhugs mi tshugs par/ re zhig gtsang ngam lho kha 'dra la phebs snyam nas khur po bsdogs chas mdzad skabs nā len+d+ra'i grwa shes rab don yod dang / mkhyen rab mchog grub gnyis kyis nā len+d+ra rang la bzhugs dgos pa'i re ba nan zhu byas pas re zhig mkhyen rab mchog grub shag la sku mtshams bzhugs/ rang dgon gyi grwa pa so so'i re ba ltar rtsis dkar nag sogs rig gnas dang 'dod chos mang po gnang / dgung grangs zhe gnyis chu bya1933lo nas mtshan nyid mkhan po lo gsum mdzad pa'i ring /gzhung chen bcu gsum cha lag dang bcas pa gzhan dga'i mchan 'grel gyi steng nas 'chad nyan legs par grub/ rgyun gyi rtsod pa dang tshogs langs bgro gleng 15

sogs kyang sngar yod 'dzin grwa gsum la rgyun stong yig cha/ 'dzin grwa 'og mar sa skya'i bsdus grwa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo/bar pa la sa lam dang / grub mtha'/ gong ma la gzhung bka' pod drug dka' 'grel mtha' dpyod rnams rong ston yab sras kyi gsung rab gzhi 'dzin byed rgyu gtan la phab/grub mtha' gzhung lugs legs bshad dang / sbas don rab gsal dngos brgyad don bdun cu'i skabs so sor rgyan gyi rtsa ba dkyus su bcugs pa spar du brkos/ 'chad nyan shin tu smar bas slob ma yang dge bshes dpal mchog don grub/tshe mchog lags/tshe sgog lags/dge 'dun lags/ khams pa tshe dbang sogs mdo phyogs la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang po thon/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga me khyi1946lor gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gis sngar yod mtshan nyid grwa tshang la gzhung chen bshad grwa gsar btsugs skabs bla ma'i bka' ltar bshad grwa'i mkhan po lo brgyad gnang ba'i ring / spyod 'jug mchan 'grel tshar bcu dang / dbu ma 'jug pa lan du mas gtsos gzhung chen bcu gsum cha lag dang bcas pa/ sdom rigs gnyis/ sdom gsum 'jam dbyas bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/bshes thing /sa skya legs bshad/ sum rtags sogs gzhung che chung mang po 'chad nyan rgyun 'dzugs gnang bas zhal slob kyang / gzhung chen bco brgyad gyi rtsa ba blo rgyugs dang / 'grel pa rnams bla ma dbu chos/grwa nga bcas pa'i tshogs dbus su bshad rgyugs dang rtsod rgyugs tshad lon byung ba'i dge bshes lha rams pa kha shas dang / gzhung drug bdun gyi rtsa 'grel rgyugs sprod tshad lon byung ba'i dge bshes tshogs ram pa mang po thon/ 'di skabs rgyun grwa bzhi bcu'i khar sa lugs dgon pa gzhan nas phebs pa'i grwa rgyun yang du ma yod/gzhan rgyud sde gong 'og gi lhag lha rnams kyi dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang dang /khyad par nā ro mkha' spyod/'jigs byed/dmar po skor gsum/ gur zhal sogs dpal skya'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i chos skor rnams kyi byin rlabs rjes gnang bdun khrid/ be'u bum gyi lung sogs gsar ma dang /rnying ma'i skor la 'jam 16

sogs kyang sngar yod 'dzin grwa gsum la rgyun stong yig cha/ 'dzin grwa 'og mar sa skya'i bsdus grwa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo/bar pa la sa lam dang / grub mtha'/ gong ma la gzhung bka' pod drug dka' 'grel mtha' dpyod rnams rong ston yab sras kyi gsung rab gzhi 'dzin byed rgyu gtan la phab/grub mtha' gzhung lugs legs bshad dang / sbas don rab gsal dngos brgyad don bdun cu'i skabs so sor rgyan gyi rtsa ba dkyus su bcugs pa spar du brkos/ 'chad nyan shin tu smar bas slob ma yang dge bshes dpal mchog don grub/tshe mchog lags/tshe sgog lags/dge 'dun lags/ khams pa tshe dbang sogs mdo phyogs la mkhas pa'i slob ma mang po thon/ dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga me khyi1946lor gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gis sngar yod mtshan nyid grwa tshang la gzhung chen bshad grwa gsar btsugs skabs bla ma'i bka' ltar bshad grwa'i mkhan po lo brgyad gnang ba'i ring / spyod 'jug mchan 'grel tshar bcu dang / dbu ma 'jug pa lan du mas gtsos gzhung chen bcu gsum cha lag dang bcas pa/ sdom rigs gnyis/ sdom gsum 'jam dbyas bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/bshes thing /sa skya legs bshad/ sum rtags sogs gzhung che chung mang po 'chad nyan rgyun 'dzugs gnang bas zhal slob kyang / gzhung chen bco brgyad gyi rtsa ba blo rgyugs dang / 'grel pa rnams bla ma dbu chos/grwa nga bcas pa'i tshogs dbus su bshad rgyugs dang rtsod rgyugs tshad lon byung ba'i dge bshes lha rams pa kha shas dang / gzhung drug bdun gyi rtsa 'grel rgyugs sprod tshad lon byung ba'i dge bshes tshogs ram pa mang po thon/ 'di skabs rgyun grwa bzhi bcu'i khar sa lugs dgon pa gzhan nas phebs pa'i grwa rgyun yang du ma yod/gzhan rgyud sde gong 'og gi lhag lha rnams kyi dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang dang /khyad par nā ro mkha' spyod/'jigs byed/dmar po skor gsum/ gur zhal sogs dpal skya'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i chos skor rnams kyi byin rlabs rjes gnang bdun khrid/ be'u bum gyi lung sogs gsar ma dang /rnying ma'i skor la 'jam 16

dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i bka' babs bdun dang / mchog gling thugs sgrub/ rig 'dzin srog sgrub/ rdzogs chen snying thig zhi khro sogs dang / ni gu chos drug sogs bka' rgyud de/ grub mtha' so so'i 'dod chos zhu ba rnams la yang so so'i phyag len phra mo'i tshun ma 'dres par gnang / bco brgyad khri chen legs bshad rgya mtsho mchog la yang snga phyir gzhung chen gyi bka' khrid cha tshang dang / yang tig gser 'bru'i dbang khrid lung bcas rdzogs par phul/ dus rgyun du dgon grwa cho ga mkhan rnams kyis bca' gshom/ thig tshon/phyag rgya sogs/mtshams sgrub mkhan rnams kyis bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs gnad/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi phyag len sogs bka' 'dri gang zhus thams cad la lan gsung chog chog yod la/ tshang ma khungs dang ldan zhing gsal la go bde bas the tshom gcod/ lha bzo ba rnams kyi lha zhi drag sogs sku gsung thugs rten kyi cha tshad/ri mo sna tshogs kyi khungs dang /mtshon don/ dgos pa/ tha na chos klog mkhan rnams kyi sngags 'don stangs yan chad la dag bcos legs par mdzad pas dgon pa 'di yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su bsgrubs pa'i bka' drin ni bsam gyis mi khyab/de bzhin phyogs gzhan du bka' chos gnang ba yang / 'jad yangs can dgon du sdom gsum 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs rgyan dang / spyod 'jug bka' khrid/ mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang / khrid zhag bdun sogs dang / ngor du khang gsar zhabs drung ngag dbang ma' brtse thub bstan snying po sogs la spyod 'jug dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs gzhung mang po'i bka' khrid gnang /mdar grang mo cher lam 'bras slob bshad/ mkha' spyod sogs zab chos du ma dang / 'bras yul skyed tshal du sgrub thabs kun btus cha tshang / mkha' spyod/ dur bdag mgon po'i khrid sogs mang po gnang / lho kha thub bstan ra ba smad du bshad grwa btsugs/snga phyir spyod 'jug tshar gsum/'jug pa/sor mdo/sher phyin sogs gzhung mang po'i bka' khrid dang / lam 'bras slob bshad/ kye rdor rgyud 17

gsum gyi bshad pa/rlung dang /lus sbyong /'khrul 'khor bcas cha tshang ba gnang /gzhan sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang / mgon po'i rjes gnang /khrid zhag bdun ma/dmar po skor gsum/thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod/sgrol ma nyer gcig rnam 'joms/tshe lha rnam gsum sogs kyi rjes gnang /gnas brtan bcu drug gi dbang sogs mang po gnang / dwags po grwa tshang la lam 'bras tshogs bshad dang / sa gcod kyi dbang lung cha tshang / bshad grwa tshugs nas spyod 'jug sogs gzhung mang po khrid/ ban rtsa bka' 'gyur lha khang du ra smad dang rnam rab dwags grwa'i dpe cha ba lhan cig dge tshul slong sum cu so lnga tsam dbyar gnas btsugs te mkhan po gnang /de dus tshul shing smon lam mdzad/de skabs 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/sher phyin sogs bka' khrid mdzad/rdo phud chos 'khor dgon du sgrub thabs kun btus cha tshang dang /byams chos sde lnga'i bka' khrid mdzad/ 'dam gzhung chu ma'i mdor the ra khang ser rin po che/ 'khor slob yon bdag bcas par sgrub thabs kun btus cha tshang gnang ba dang / khang ser rin po cher dus 'khor rgyud bshad kyang phul/ khyad par du dpal sa skya'i gdung sras rin po cher kye rdor bka' babs bzhi/ mgon po bka' babs bzhi/ gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ tshar lugs 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen dang / rjes 'brel rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud/ rwa pod yongs rdzogs kyi lung / dmar po skor gsum/ dmar mo skor gsum/mgon po gur zhal rnam gnyis kyi rjes gnang thun mong thun min rnams dang /gsang khrid/ rta mgrin yang gsang /be〉/dur bdag rnam sras bcas kyi dbang /rjes gnang /rgyab rten pod rnams kyi lung dang / shangs chos ni gu chos drug sogs sngags gsar rnying gi gdams zab mang po dang / sa skya'i legs bshad kyi bka' khrid sogs mang po 'bul thub pa ni rgyal bstan sbyi dang bye brag gi bstan rgyun la mdzad rjes bla na med pa ste/zhal snga nas/gdung sras rin po ches snyan brgyud gsan rgyur bar chad 18

gang yang med par 'bul thub song / rgyu bdag po la 'phrod pa'i dpe ltar da ni ban rgan blo bde/ rig gnas dang mdo phyogs ni mkhan chen sogs gang nas gsan gsan red gsungs thugs dgyes kro chen po gnang /des na bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa/ dang po rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa'i gdung du spyan drangs/ bar du sku tshe'i las rtsis zhib rgyas su gnang nas rkyen sel du bsnyen sgrub dang / gto rim sna tshogs pas bar chad bsal/ tha ma chos kyi ma mo ngo sprod phul ba nas snying po'i bstan pa snyan brgyud thams cad kyi bdag por mnga' gsol te/ chos srid phrin las thams cad gegs med 'grub phyir legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter gyi phyogs ston phul ba ni bka' drin che zhing rnam thar thams cad kyi nang nas ngo mtshar che'o /de yang bla ma rin po ches gzhung gang khrid kyang / sems bskyed gsal 'debs/ blo sbyong chos bshad bcas kyi mthar/ mdzad pa po'i rnam thar dang /gzhung de'i sbyi don rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa re gsungs nas bshad pa dngos la sa bcad bsdus tsam dang / tshig 'grel shin tu zhib pa 'bru gnyer nas go bde bar bshad/ lung mang po 'dren par mdzad/ rgyugs sprod skabs kyang lung mang po 'jog rgyu yod na thugs shin tu mnyes/ mkhas pa so sos bshad tshul gtan nas mi 'dra ba'i dka' gnad 'ga' tsam la bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad gsung ba las/ 'di 'thad dang 'di mi 'thad kyi rtsod pa sogs ci yang mi gsung / zhal nas dpe cha gang bltas kyang rang gi nga rgyal gyi snon ma dang / grub mtha' chags ldang gi rgyur ma song ba zhig gal che zhes gsungs/ dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang / khrid dang lung sogs gang yang gsung snyan cing brjid pas dal brel snyoms la dag cing gsal bas don go bar mdzad pa las bskyar zlos dang /nag nog tshig lhad mang po sogs med cing phyag len gang la'ang sla chos mi gnang ba 'di yang bstan pa'i dmigs rkyen dam pa yin/ mdor na de/ sdu bu'i

tshul gyis bla ma'i bka' ltar sku tshe'i ring 'chad nyan gtso bor mdzad de gzhung chen bcu gsum cha lag dang bcas pa cha tshang tshar lnga/spyod 'jug nyi shu rtsa grangs/dbu ma 'jug pa/ bshes spring / rgyal sras lag len/ zhen pa bzhi bral sogs gzhung chung ba rnams ni tshar mang po 'chad/lam 'bras tshogs slob tshar gsum/sgrub thabs kun btus tshar gsum/ ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun dang / sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho sogs lan mang gis mtshon gang zag mchog dman la ma bltos par dad ldan don gnyer thams cad chos kyi sbyin pas re ba yongs su skong bar mdzad do//gsung rtsom skor ni/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas thams cad la ni mkhas/brgyud pa rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i gdams ngag gis ni phyug lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i mtshan ma ni brnyes/ des na bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu tshogs thams cad tshang zhing /de yang 'ga' zhig ltar rtsom sgo dog po ma yin par shar mar bri chog pa yod kyang dam pa gong ma'i gsung rab kyi phrin las la gnod par dgongs nas rang gis gsung rtsom mi mdzad/ gzhan gyis bskul kyang deng sang lta mkhan gyis phongs pa ma gtogs blta rgyu'i phongs pa med/ blun tshig yi ger bris pas ci phan/sa paṇa gyis/tshig kyang sgrig legs mi shes na//don bzang smos kyang ci dgos pa'i/ /spun po rnams kyis rang dga'i tshig /'brel med yi ger bris pa la/ /bstan bcos yin zhes nyan bshad byed/ /blun po dga' ba bskyed nus kyi/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /dus dang blo gros gron du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i lung 'dren par mdzad pa des na gsung 'bum mang po med/sngon snyan ngag gsan pa'i rtsom rgyugs kyang nyid kyis bdag 'dzin ma gnang bas gzhan gyis khyer nas gyar/ gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis mdzad pa'i mtshan nyid smon lam gyi 'grel pa legs po/ khri chen rin po che'i yongs 'dzin/mkhan zur kun chos kyis mdzad rogs zhus pa/ ston pa dang rgya bal bstan 20

'dzin mang po'i rnam thar dang / thun mong rig gnas tshang ma'i lo rgyus/ gzhung pod chen drug re re bzhin gyi spyi don yod pa/ bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad thams cad snyan ngag yid 'phrog pas brgyan pa bris ma ldeb 'bring nyis brgya lhag yod pa ni dus 'gyur skabs gyar ba ma rnyed/ gzhan phran tshegs yod pa rnams phyogs bsdus spar du 'khod/khyad par sngon 'gro'i khrid chen 'di ni mdzad byang du/khrid de dag kyang mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal nas nyams khrid lan du ma thob cing / rang gis kyang brtson pas 'dris par byas te/ zhes 'khod pa dang / zhal nas kyang /snga phyir sngon 'gro 'bum lnga lan du ma bsags/phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sogs la dka' spyad snying rus chen po byas/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dka' spyad brtson 'grus drag pos nyams len thugs rgyud la smin par mdzad pa'i myong chos thugs kyi nying khu khyad par can yin la/ de sngon sa skya'i phyogs la lhag lha du ma'i thun mong thun min gyi sngon 'gro'i spyi chos phyogs bsgrigs 'di 'dra med pas 'jug bder dgos gal che bar brten/ yongs 'dzin kun chos mchog dang / thugs sras gtso bo dge bshes dpal mchog don grub lags/gus phran bcas nas lan mang gsol ba btab pa dang / lha dang srung mas kyang 'od gsal gyi snang char bskul te brtsam par mdzad cing / 'di nyid dus 'gyur gyi gong nas spar bsgrun grub pas rjes su spar shing nyams kyang dad slob rnams kyis gces nyar gnang —bas da cha dpe rgyun dang lung khrid bcas ma nyams par bstan 'gro'i dpal du khyab dar du 'phel bzhin pa 'di lags so//thos don nyams su len pas sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i tshul ni/ gogadu bkod pa ltar sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rten la sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khri rnam par dag pas gzhir gzung / bsnyen sgrub mdzad pa yang / 'khrungs yul du bzhugs dus / 'byung 'dul/ kye rdor/ mkha' spyod/ phur pa/ kun rig 'jal dbyangs rigs du ma/ dbyangs can dkar dmar/ sa 'jam sbags sgrub sogs 21

kyi sku mtshams mang po mdzad tshul zhal nas thos/ bod du phebs nas bco brgyad gong ma'i mdun nas lam 'bras gsan 'phral kye rdor gzhi bsnyen mdzad/'jigs byed bsnyen chen thengs gsum/nā ro mkha' spyod bsnyen pa thengs bzhi/gur mgon phyi dang gsang sgrub thengs bzhi/ zhal gyi bsnyen sgrub thengs bzhi/gzhan dmar po skor gsum/ mgon dkar/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum phal che ba'i bsnyen pa/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ yang gsang / 'phags ma'i snying thigathugs sgrub/rig 'dzin srog sgrub/yang tigathang stong snyan brgyud/ni gu chos drugage sar rdo rje tshe rgyal rnams bzhugs pa gsol dpon lags kyis dngos dran la/rgyun du chos gnang ba'i bar gseng rnams la dus thung sku mtshams mang po bzhugs pa dang / sku tshe'i smad du dgun dus phal cher sku mtshams la bzhugs pas gsar rnying gdams zab rnams kyi lhag lha mang po'i dus grangs rtags kyi bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan mang po grub pa ni smos ma dgos kyang re re nas bri ba rngo ma thogs/ rgyun du thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad pa ni/ rang gis zhabs pad bsten pa'i ring gsung las thos pa dang zhal 'don phyag dpe mjal ba sogs shes tshod bri na / phran sa skya gong du snyan brgyud zhu bar bcar dus/ nyin cig bka' las/ nga'i kha 'don nyams len gtso bo ni lam dus thun bzhis gtsos/sa skya pa'i yab chos snyan brgyud zab mo rnams yin/ bla ma rnams kyi zhal nas thob pa'i rnying ma bka' brgyud sogs kyi gdams ngag kyang nyams su ci lon dang /'chad spel gyi zhabs tog gang grub byed kyi yod/ snga mo nas badz+ra gu ru phreng skor re ni chag med yin gsungs/ de yang thog mar tho rengs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor rjes/ bla ma rgyang 'bod/ ngag byin rlabs/ rdor bzlas bum can lnga bcu re mdzad pa nas nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi cho ga rgyas bsdus stabs bstun chag med gzhir bzung /bar mtshams rnams su zhal 'don/lam dus rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang /lam zab bla ma/thar srung /sa 'jam sbags sgrub/'jigs byed/mkha' spyod ma/22

mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum/ zhal gsang sgrub/ mgon dkar/ rig byed ma/dbyu gu mched gsum dang / rta mgrin/ phur pa/ 'phags ma'i snying thig yang tig gser 'bru/ ni gu chos drug sogs kyi bdag skyed rnams go rim skabs bstun/bar seng skabs 'gar rlung dang / lus sbyong / 'khrul 'khor mdzad/ 'char can snga dro gtor ma brgya rtsa/ nyin gung kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ dgong mo gtor bsngo/srod kyi dus su gcod kyi lus sbyin sogs kyi mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa khor yug tu mdzad/ thugs dam dang / cho ga gsung bskang sogs zhal 'don gang gsungs kyang / sku drang por bsrangs te dal brel snyoms shing / thugs dmigs rtse gcig gis 'don sgom sbrags ma mdzad pa las/thugs mi gtod par tshig ris shar 'don tsam nam yang mi mdzad/ gzhan gyis sngags dang 'don pa brel ches pa rnams la bka' slob kyis legs bcos mdzad/gzim dus bal thul bzhes te tsog pur bzhugs pa las sku chings bkrol nas mi gzim/ khri chen rin po che'i zhal nas nga tsho ni gar song yang nyal chas rta rgyab re bkal nas 'gro ba red/ bla ma rin po che ni gzim chas lhag po gang yang mi dgos par de gar tsog pur bzhugs nas mtshan gang zhal 'don gnang gi red/ skyabs su mchi zhes bdag cag la lan du ma gsungs myong / gsol dpon lags kyis bla ma rin po che mtshan mo chu tshod gsum las lhag pa mi gzim/ gzim khug pa'i tshe yang tsog bu las sku 'gyel ba dang / thar pa sogs med/mnal shin tu srab pa nga tsho 'gul tsam byas na yang lam sang tshor gnang gi red gsungs/ rgyun du na bza' ras dang snam bu las pags rigs mi bzhes/ si pan thog tsong rlung 'gal gyi zas spyod mi bsten pa sogs nyams su blang bya thams cad gzhung bzhin phyag len du dngos su 'debs par mdzad do//tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa'i yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba ni/spyir thun mong ma yin pa ches gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa dpag tu meX ༵

mgon po phyi nang gsang gsum/ zhal gsang sgrub/ mgon dkar/ rig byed ma/dbyu gu mched gsum dang / rta mgrin/ phur pa/ 'phags ma'i snying thig yang tig gser 'bru/ ni gu chos drug sogs kyi bdag skyed rnams go rim skabs bstun/bar seng skabs 'gar rlung dang / lus sbyong / 'khrul 'khor mdzad/ 'char can snga dro gtor ma brgya rtsa/ nyin gung kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ dgong mo gtor bsngo/srod kyi dus su gcod kyi lus sbyin sogs kyi mthar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa khor yug tu mdzad/ thugs dam dang / cho ga gsung bskang sogs zhal 'don gang gsungs kyang / sku drang por bsrangs te dal brel snyoms shing / thugs dmigs rtse gcig gis 'don sgom sbrags ma mdzad pa las/thugs mi gtod par tshig ris shar 'don tsam nam yang mi mdzad/ gzhan gyis sngags dang 'don pa brel ches pa rnams la bka' slob kyis legs bcos mdzad/gzim dus bal thul bzhes te tsog pur bzhugs pa las sku chings bkrol nas mi gzim/ khri chen rin po che'i zhal nas nga tsho ni gar song yang nyal chas rta rgyab re bkal nas 'gro ba red/ bla ma rin po che ni gzim chas lhag po gang yang mi dgos par de gar tsog pur bzhugs nas mtshan gang zhal 'don gnang gi red/ skyabs su mchi zhes bdag cag la lan du ma gsungs myong / gsol dpon lags kyis bla ma rin po che mtshan mo chu tshod gsum las lhag pa mi gzim/ gzim khug pa'i tshe yang tsog bu las sku 'gyel ba dang / thar pa sogs med/mnal shin tu srab pa nga tsho 'gul tsam byas na yang lam sang tshor gnang gi red gsungs/ rgyun du na bza' ras dang snam bu las pags rigs mi bzhes/ si pan thog tsong rlung 'gal gyi zas spyod mi bsten pa sogs nyams su blang bya thams cad gzhung bzhin phyag len du dngos su 'debs par mdzad do//tshul bzhin nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa'i yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba ni/spyir thun mong ma yin pa ches gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa dpag tu meX ༵

rnams ni/ rje nyid dang rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i rgyal sras dam pa rnams nang phan tshun kho na'i mngon sum gyi spyod yul las/ so skye phal pa'i yul ma yin zhing /mdo sngags lam gyi bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod cing lhag par rdo rje theg pa'i pha rgyud kyi rim lnga/ ma rgyud kyi chos drug gnyis med rgyud kyi sbyor ba yan lag drug dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo'i nyams len gyi gnad la rang byan chud par/ rtag tu nyams bzhes mdzad pas rang rang gi gzhung gi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor dang mthun pa'i mngon rtogs/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob pa'i mtshan ma mngon du gyur pa mtha' yas kyang / dam pa 'di nyid rang bzhin sbas tshul du bzhugs shing thugs sgam pas bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags mtshan sogs ci yang mi gsung zhing / gzhan gyis zur tsam dris na yang / nga la de 'dra ga nas yong gsungs nas gsang ba rang mdzad/ der brten nang ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams kyi snang ba'i rnam thar ni mang po bri ba rngo ma thogs/ 'on kyang rje nyid kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la zhus pa gsol dpon sogs kyis thos pa dang /kun la thun mong du gyur pa 'ga' zhig 'bri na/ sngon bco brgyad gong ma mkhyen brtse'i mdun nas lam 'bras gsan grub phral kye rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa stan thog gcig tu mdzad pa'i tshe/ bskyed rim gsal snang la brtan pa thob cing / res srod thun skabs phyag phreng dang sku lus las me stag chen po yang yang 'phro ba dang / res 'ga' mtshan mo yang mun pas mi bsgribs par nyin mo ltar gyur pa sogs 'od gsal gyi snang ba khor yug tu shar/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la tha mal du mi rtog par sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes 'khrungs/ yang chos rdzong nub mkhyen rab mchog grub kyi gzim shag tu tshar lugs 'jigs byed kyi sku mtshams dam por bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dkong thun bskyed rim sems 'dzin gnang ba'i skabs/ thog brgyab ste bzhugs sgrom gtor kyang sku lus dang na bza' la skyon ci yang med pa'i ngo mchar byung / bla ma nyid kyi 'al 24

nas kyang de dus glog me khra 'khyug ge sgra drag po bcas thog gzugs po rang la babs pa 'dra ste nga rang la ni skyon gang yang ma byung gos tshig pa yang byung mi 'dug gsungs/ nā len+d+ra'i ri khrod du rta mgrin yang gsang gi sku mtshams bzhugs dus nub cig nam mkha' nas rta skad thengs gsum grag pa'i rjes ma de khang pa'i nang nas grag pa lta bu zhig byung zhes gzim 'og rin po cher zhus pa gsol dpon lags kyis thos 'dug de phyin chad ri khrod der rta mgrin gyi sku mtshams bzhugs mkhan tshang ma la rtags ngo mtshar can re thon pa byung ba red/yang bdag khri rin po che'i rang rnam du gsal ba ltar sa skya sgrol ma pho brang gi gdung rgyud chad la nye ba'i skabs bla ma rin po ches srid sgrub gnang bas da lta'i bdag chen 'di 'khrungs pa yin te/ de yang bu sgrub gnang ba'i tshe dang po nub cig 'od gsal gyi ngang du nam mkha' la nyi zla skar gsum dus gcig tu shar ba la 'od zer che chung khyad par mi 'dug zer nas mi mang po ltad mo lta ba'i mtshan ltas byung ba dang / yum la yang 'phur rta ngang ser zhig nam mkha' nas thugs kur thim pa'i gzim lam bcas sras lhums su zhugs pa'i mngon rtags je gsal byung ba dang / de nas lhums kyi sras pho mo gang yin dang / lte bsgyur gyi man ngag phyag len gnang dgos min the tshom 'khrungs pa'i skabs/ tho rangs khar nam mkha' nas gzugs gang yang med par/ da bu yi ming btags chog ces thugs nyams dang mnal lam lta bu ma yin par dngos su sgra gsal po byung /de'i zhogs par gdung sras bu rang 'khrungs pa yod ces yab bdag chen la zhus pa yin zhes dam pa rin po che la zhus pa gsol dpon mkhyen 'phags kyis thos pa red/ gdung sras rtse gdong la 'khrungs nas dam pa rin po ches rta nag nas phyag bris gnang don bzhin bla ma rin po che rta nag thub bstan la gcar/ de skabs dam pa rdo rje 'chang bcad rgyar bzhugs yod kyang bla ma rin po che phebs nyin thun mtshams ba'ag ste sku dngos rtso mas kyi mdun bar du phebs bsu ra 25

zhabs bcags/ zhal mjal ma thag dgyes pa chen pos khyed kyis sa skya pa'i bstan pa la de las lhag pa'i mdzad rjes ci dgos/ nga rgad po shi khar blo shin tu bde ba 'di khyed kyi bka' drin shin tu che bas thugs rje che zhes gsungs nas mjal dar rtse sprod du phul/ dbu gtugs gnang / gzim chung du gdan drangs/zhag bdun ring bla slob lhan rgyas srid sgrub mdzad tshul/ rtags thon lugs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rtags mang po dang bcas sku 'khrungs tshul/ 'khrungs nas kyang rtsis 'bras ltar sri zlog gto bcos gnang tshul sogs gsung gleng zhib par mdzad cing dgyes spro'i ngang bzhugs/ dam pa mchog gis bla ma rin po cher gtang rag mjal dar nang mdzod dang /dngul ṭam dkar brgya tham pa gnang / gdung sras rin po cher maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang / bdag chen yab yum la gtang rag rgya cher 'bul bskur mdzad/ sa skya'i gdung rabs myur 'byon gyi srid spel cho ga ji ltar mdzad pa dang zhabs rim la sku ngal 'dzem med gnang tshul rnam thar rgyas par gsal zhing / sa skya tsam du ma zad bstan pa spyi'i srog shing dam pa bdag khri yab sras 'di lta bu rigs gsum sems dpa'i ye shes/ lha sngags ting 'dzin zab mo'i thabs 'phrul gyis mtshan mchog gsum ldan gyi rigs su gdan drangs te gdung rabs dri ma med pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i gzhi tshugs pa dang / dus 'gyur bstan pa'i nyams chag de tsam zhig byung yang deng sang sa skya pa'i yab chos snyan brgyud zab mo thams cad kyi rgyun ma nyams par bzhugs pa ni bla ma 'di kho na'i sku drin yin pa sa skya pa yongs kyis mkhyen 'tshal/ srid sgrub mdzad pa nas ge sar lhag par bsgrub cing mo bdar rgyas bsdus gnyis mdzad de gal che'i skabs kun tu pra dang mda' mo phyag len gnang ba thog mtha' bar gsum du brtag lung rno thig byung ba'i gtang rag tu sgrol ma pho brang nas ge sar gtso 'khor gyi zhal thang chen po rje nyid kyis zhal bkod gnang ste bris pa rnam 'gyur cha lugs gzhan dang gtan mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa ni nyid kyi gzigs 26

snang yin pa gor ma chag nā len+d+ra'i bshad grwa'i mkhan po mdzad de mthong smon grwa tshang gi mtshan nyid chos ra'i nang gzim 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi gzhugs khri'i steng nas thog mar spyod 'jug dbu 'dzugs gnang dus bka' khrid gnang bzhin pa'i skabs/ nam mkhar sprin thar thor las 'thibs pa sogs gang yang med par kha sib lta bu nam mkha' nas lding bzhin du babs pa thams cad kyi na bza'i steng du skya chig chig yod tsam byung / tshang mas lta bzhin 'dugabaltas pas re re bzhin du 'dab ma drug re sha stag dog che se ba dmar mdangs cung zad can ngang pa lta bu rkyang par 'dug pa thams cad kyis me tog gi char red ces ngo mtshar chen po byung ba/ dus phyis kyang dge bshes ngag dbang tshul khrims lags kyis/ sngon nga tsho bshad grwa thog mar tshugs/ bla ma rin po ches spyod 'jug dbu btsugs nyin me tog gi char ngo mtshar can de 'dra babs pa yin sang zhes yang yang gsungs/ lo gcig lho khar char zhod chen po byung nas gtsang po kha lud de skyid gshong sogs su chu nyen shin tu che ba'i skabs mgon po'i shwa zlog gis chu sgyur mdzad pas 'phral du bzlog pa dang / lo gcig than pa chen po byung dus mgon po la klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i char 'beb mdzad pa dang / lo gcig sgrol ma nyer gcig gi las tshogs bcu gnyis pa char 'beb mdzad pas gnyis ka la nyid brtsad mar char chen babs pa dang / yar 'brog stong ra rgan por mgon dkar g.yang skyob dang tshogs 'bum mdzad pas khyim der lo de'i ba yi be'u thams cad dkar po sha stag skyes nas de phyin ba lug 'phel rgyas mngon gsal byung ba thos/ sgrol ma pho brang gi bdag chen yab yum snga phyir gshegs pa dang gdung sras ming sring rnam gnyis la yang sku gegs kyi mtshan ma byung ba na bla ma rin po ches 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa zhag bdun mdzad pa grol ma thag tu gtor sgrub zhag bdun mdzad de/ thugs shin tu tu khros pa'i nyams kyis las gshin la bka' bsgo bcol gtad drag po bcas las gshin 27

dang / 'jigs byed kyi gtor zor rim bzhin 'phen par mdzad pas gtor ma gnyis ka phal cher sa la nub nas lhag ma cung zad las mi mthong ba lta bu red 'dug pas mthong tshad ngo mtshar dad pa'i gnas la bkod/ de nas gtang rag gi tshogs 'khor rgya chen po phul nas da phyin chad sgrol ma pho brang la byad khas tshugs pa med ces gsungs byung zhes gsol dpon lags kyis gsungs/ de bzhin du bdag chen kun dga' rin chen nā len+d+rar phebs nas bla ma rin po che dang lhan rgyas kyis bco brgyad bla brang du phur pa'i gtor zlog gnang dus gtor sgrub skabs zor chen las khrag rgyun sim thon gyis lcags slang nang du 'khyil ba'i rtags byung ba yang bla ma rnam pa gnyis ma'i che ba los yin/ yang sa skya bzhi thog pho brang gi yang thog tu zhal bzhi'i sku mtshams bzhugs skabs dgong thun gtor bsngo gsungs dus gzim chung thog kha nas khyi rgya bo chen po zhig gis mar blta ba thengs gnyis gsum byung / dang po do snang cher ma byas/ rjes ma thog brtsegs mang po 'di'i rtse de yang bla ma rin po che'i gzim chung gi thog kha la ni 'gro sa med/ 'di ga 'dra byas nas slebs pa yin snyam nas thog brtsegs bzhi pa'i skas la 'dzegs te gzim chung thog khar tshur bltas pas gang yang mi 'dug 'di nges par zhal bzhi pa'i rtags yin par the tshom med ces ma byan chab ril lags kyis gsungs byung / sa 'jam sbags sgrub kyi dmigs khrid nam gnang yang zhal dngos kyis/ a sdug nga lta bu la yang shes bya ma 'bum phrag bzhi tsam gyis gsol ba btab pas kyang 'jam dbyangs rigs gzhan gyi bsnyen sgrub byas pa las rigs pa 'phel rtags che ba byung / dpe cha ba rnams kyis thog mar shes bya ma 'bum phrag re bton na shes rab 'phel ba dang / bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa yong / lag tu blangs pas yid ches par 'gyur zhes gdeng dang ldan pa'i gsung zur yang yang 'byon/ bad rtsa bka' 'gyur lha khang du mgon po'i sku mtshams bzhugs skabs snga thun gyi bdag bskyed nga rgyal la sems 'dzin gnang 28

ba'i sgang / glo bur du gzim chung sgo yol ling nge btegs nas ban gzugs dbyug pa thogs pa zhig khro nyams kyis shor byung ba/ mgon po ri tsam gyi nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas mgo zhal du bcug nas mche ba gcigs pas mgo gas pa'i snang ba byung ma thag yal nas song / de rjes bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la yun ring du gnas pa byung bas nga'i rjes 'jug la rgyal gdon gyis gnod pa mi 'byung gsungs/ zhes gsol dpon lags kyi zin bris su 'dug lho kha spre zhing du sngon 'gro'i khrid yig mdzad 'phro bshol rgyu thugs la 'khrungs pa'i nub mo 'phags pa klu sgrub bsnang zhing mi dgyes pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa sogs kyi mnal lam byung nas mtha' rdzogs par rtsom 'bri byas pa yin gsungs zhes dad ldan slob ma skal bzang phrin las lags kyis bkod 'dug des na chu thigs gcig myong bas rgya mtsho chen po'i ro shes pa ltar/'di tsam gyis kyang lhag pa'i lha rab 'byams kyi zhal gzigs rgyun chad med pa sogs sa lam gyi yon tan mtshan nyid pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs pa'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por grub ste/ sa paṇa gyis/ mchog sgrub ye shes lha rnams ni/ /gcig bsgrubs thams cad 'grub 'gyur te//rgyal ba thams cad ye shes kyi//klong du dbye ba med phyir ro//zhes dang /kun mkhyen rong ston chen pos/ skye med kyi don rtogs na lhag pa'i lha'i zhal ston pa yin/de'i tshe na lha la mang nyung med/ces gsungs pa ltar ro//sku tshe'i smad lo shas phal cher lho khar bzhugs/ de khul gyi sa dgon spyi dang khyad par ra smad dang /dwags po grwa tshang gnyis nas dad dam 'gyur ba med pas zhabs tog bsgrub cing bshad sgrub spel ma'i phrin las shin tu rgyas/ de dus phran nā len+d+ra nas lho khar bcar ba dwags po grwa tshang gi bshad grwa la bzhugs 'dug pas bdag la zhal chems bcas sdom gsum rang mchan gyi phyag dpe rtsa chen de gnang / khyad par sa 'jam sbags sgrub kyi tshe sgrub zab mo de ched du brtsams gnang dang de'i byin rlabs/dmigs rim/lung sogs gnang /tshe rabs kun tu 29

rjes su 'dzin pa'i gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes/ phran la chos kyi bdud rtsi gnang ba'i tha ma yang gdams zab 'di nyid yin no/ /mthar mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ni/ de nas dgung lo drug cu re brgyad bzhes pa sa phag1959lor ljongs gang sar dmag zing che bas dus 'gyur gyi nyen tshabs 'byung dogs phyi phyogs su phebs na zhus par/ da bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi sku glud du song na de ga red gsungs nas phebs bzhed ma gnang / de nas nyen che'i mtshams su slebs dus de gar bzhugs blos ma bzod par phyi phyogs su nyen g.yol du gdan 'dren zhu rtsis byas/ de skabs shig la nyin gcig dpon g.yog gnyis kho na bzhugs skabs khang thog tu mi stobs chen zhig rgyug yong ba 'dra ba/rig sgra bcas khang pa 'ber yom chen po byung / gsol dpon lags kyis dngangs skrag gi ngang bla ma la mjal dus bla ma rin po che krong nge bzhugs te zhal grag rgyu med pa lta bu mthong nas/ de ma thag sku grib 'dra yin nam snyam nas sku la 'jus te/ bla ma rin po che/ zhes lan gnyis bos pas spyan khor re gzigs byung bar/bla ma rin po che la ci byung /zhus par thugs sems yengs pa'i ngang nas /nga nag po chen pos shog gsungs/ gsung ma thag thugs dran sos pa lta bus ci yang mi gsung / bsnyung gi 'dug gam zhus par mi 'dug gsungs/ da cis de ci yin nam zhus pas/ gang yin nam ma gtogs mi gsungs/ zhal ras dang /gsung dang / sku gzugs dang / gsol chas bzhes pa gang la yang rgyun ldan las skyon ci yang mi 'dug nyin shas nas re ba lam du ma phyin par bla ma dpon g.yog dang gzhan yang rogs pa kha shas bcas dmag mis gdan drangs/ bla ma dang gsol dpon so sor 'phral/ bla ma rin po che dang / rab brtan mkhan po sogs che gras mang po sne gdong rdzong du nyar/ gsol dpon lags sogs gzhan du khrid/ de nas zla gcig tsam song ba sa phag bod zla drug pa nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i nyi shu brgyad kyi nyin skad sgyur zhig gi gtam bshad gsan rjes/ btson 30

grogs thugs nang gtsang ba 'ga' zhig la/ da nga tsho bsdad ma bsdad ci yod kyi ma red gsungs/ bsnyung gzhi gang yang med par sang nyi shu dgu yi nam langs dus bla ma rin po che gzims sa'i nang la krong nge bzhugs nas sku gshegs 'dugimi des de 'dra ma bshad na bla ma 'das sa med ces de dus kyi 'o brgyal rogs mkhan chen thub bstan mtshan can gyis gsungs/ 'di skor gyi gtam mang du yod kyang re zhig smra bsam brjod med kyi dbyings su sa mā snyi/ de'i nub mo sa g.yo ba yang byung zhes de dus der yod 'ga' yi ngag las rjes su thos/ de yang rnam smin gyi lus 'dor len la dbang thob pa ni rgyud las/ rtogs pa mthon po la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi spyod yul yin par gsungs pas na/ nad dang dug la sogs pa'i phyi nang gi gnod rkyen gang yang med par gsang chen zab mo'i nyams len la rang byad chud pa'i ngang nas sku lus sbrul shun brjes pa ltar bzhag ste dag pa'i zhing du byon pa ni/ shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar te zhing 'dir sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs shing / rtag 'dzin can rnams dge ba la bskul ba dang/ mdzad pa des 'dul ba'i skye bo rnams kyi ched du dus mkhyen par gzigs nas gzim khri tha ma'i mdzad pa bstan pa yin no/ 'di dag ni gsol dpon lags dang / de dus mngon sum du gyur pa'i bla dpon dag gis bshad pa khungs ldan rnams bris pa yid ches pa'i gnas lags so/ /de lor bdag kyang dus zing gis bskyod de 'brog khul du gyar bar bod zla brgyad pa'i nang mi snyan pa'i gtam de thos 'phral/ bla ma'i yon tan dang bka' drin dran zhing / bdag nyid kyi sdug bsngal la bsam pa'i mya ngan gyis mnar bzhin par bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs rjes 'dzin thugs rje skul ba'i pho nya zhes pa gang dran bris/tshogs kyi mchod pa phul zhing gsol ba btab pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma bzang po mthong nas gdung ba'i dbugs 'byin chen po thob par gyur to//slar smras pa/mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor phrin las 'od stong can//'gro ba'i 31

lam ston rgyal bstan pad+mo'i gnyen/ /mkhas grub bshes gnyen mchog gi nyi ma gang / /dus 'gyur chu lha'i phang par glo bur gzims/ /de tshe khyed la lhag par re ba rnams/ /mya ngam thang du mtshan mo lam stor bzhin/ /blang dor phyogs bslad nyam nga'i g.yang sa ru/ /mgon bral gdung ba'i tshor bas ring zhig mnar/ /de ltar na yang brtse ldan mgon khyed kyi/ /gsang gsum rnam rol yang sprul nyin mo'i mgon/ /slar yang gdul bya'i bsod nams shar ri'i rtser/ /thugs bskyed shing rtas drangs 'di yid kyi gsos//sngar yang gdams zab thugs kyi nying khu bstsal//gnas lugs don gyi bla ma rang ngo sprad//rjes 'dzin zhal bzhes dus las mi yol ba'i/ /tshul 'di mthong nas sems la ngal gso thob/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can//khyed kyi bzhed don bstan 'gro'i phan bde ste//bka' drin gsob phyir sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal du/ /nam yang khyed rjes slob pa'i yid dam bca'/ /'di na gang gi rnam thar cha shas tsam//rang gi yid la ji ltar nges pa'i don//sdeb legs tshig sgros lhur len ma byas par/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngag gis yi ger bris/ /'di la bdag gi sgro skur yong med de/ /dbyings nas gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan ldan dang / /da dung rdo rje'i mched lcam mang zhig bzhugs/ /khyed rnams bdag gi tshig 'di'i dpang mdzod cig /'di sbyar dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du/ /skyes nas rnam thar phrin las kun 'dzin cing / /'gro kun bla ma'i lam gyis grol bar shog /ces rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thun mong snang ngo'i rnam thar bsdus pa 'di yang nang chen tsong mda' dgon gyi mkhan po rdo rje lags nas sngon khrid chen mo'i mdzad pa po'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig dgos zhes gsung bskul gnang ba'i ngor rje btsun bla ma yab sras kyis thugs brtses lhag parabaskyangasapa'i snyigasung skyes slob ma'i gral mtha' bra tshul khrims rgyal mtshan /kā /sdu // // // // chang bsdus te sbyar bas drin can bla ma'i phrin las mkha' khyab 32

bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rim thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /mchod brjod/༄༄ོ//skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//ye shes lnga ldan zag med bde la rol/ /sku lnga yan lag bdun gyi zlos gar gyis//gang 'dul der ston rtag khyab lhun grub pa'i//zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang la mchod cing bstod/ /gdod ma'i mgon po'i thugs bcud gsol bas ngoms/ /snyan brgyud zab lam bdud rtsi'i skyes sbyin mkhan/ /birlu pa dang nā ro la li ta/ /tshem bu pa sogs mkhas grub brgyud bcas bsngags/ /mdo sngags mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs gong ma lnga//mdo sngags bstan 'dzin rong ston tshar pa rje/ /mdo sngags bstan 'dzin sras slob brgyud par bcas/ /mdo sngags bstan 'dzin 1

yongs la bdag blo dad//bdag rgyud dkyil 'khor bzhi yi zhing sa la//zab gsang bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebs mdzad pa'i//'dren mchog bla ma legs bris dbang po rnams//bka' drin dran pas lan brgyar gtsug na mchod//thabs dang shes rab gnyis med kye rdo rje//rnal 'byor ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang //thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs bcas kyis//bdag sogs 'gro la mchog thun dngos grub stsol//nyams len dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs me tog bkra//'bras bu sku bzhi lhun grub 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /thun mong thun min sngon 'gro 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /legs par bstan gyis skal ldan gus pas longs//gleng gzhi/de la 'dir rang re rnams dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che las lhag pa thob/dge sdig blang dor gyi gnad shes pa'i blo rig gsal/ chos ldan gyi yul du skyes/rang la rang dbang yod pa'i dus 'dir 'dun ma gtan gyi legs nyes rang lag tu yod pas gtan nyes khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te/'dun ma gtan gyi bde ba thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched du dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig sgrub dgos te//rgyas sras zhi ba lhas/ mi'o cog gi lus 'di ni/ /dge bar bkol ba nyid du zad//ces dang / mi yi gru la brten nas su//sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol//gru 'di phyi nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces gsungs pa ltar ro//dam chos dge ba sgrub tshul de yang mdo sngags gnyis su yod kyang gang ltar yang thog mar bla ma dge 2

ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la thos bsam tshul bzhin ma byas na dngos gzhi nyams len dang sgom pa'i rim pa rnams kyang mi shes shing rnam dag mi yong ste/ mdo sdud pa las/ slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu brten par bya/ /ci'i phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes dang / sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/zhes dang / skyes rabs las/ thos chung dmus long sgom pa'i tshul mi shes//shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa yin/zhes dang / sa paṇa gyis/ bsgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes//blun po blo rgya chung ngu smra//thos pa med par bsgom pa tsam/ /'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags kyi nyams len gang yin yang thos bsam rnam dag sngon du song nas dngos gzhi nyams len bsgom pa la 'jug dgos te/ mdzod las/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas//sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor//zhes pa ltar las da lam gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgom pa nyams len gyi rim pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ da lam sngon 'gro'i khrid kyi rim pa 'chad pa la/lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul/ lam thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / lam thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro ste gsum las/ dang po lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul de la yang bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/bla slob 'brel brtags te so so'i mtshan nyid nges par bya ba/ /slob mas bla ma ji ltar bsten tshul//bla slob 'chad nyan bya tshul te bzhi las/3

lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul/dang po/ bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/dang po long khrid sman pa me shel te dpe gsum gyis bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa ni/ bla ma dge ba'i bzhes gnyen ma bsten zhing dam pa'i chos thos bsam sogs ma byas pa'i gang zag rnams ni shes rab kyi mig dang bral ba yin pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bsgrub mi shes shing /der ma zad dge sdig gi rnam dbye tsam yang mi shes pas long ba bshes med thang stong du lus pa lta bu yin la/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni mngon mtho lha mi dang thar pa nyan rang dang /thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi sa mkhan dang long khrid mngon sum yin pas long khrid med par long bas rang stobs kyis 'gro 'dod pa'i ri bo dang khang bzang sogs la phyin par mi nus pa bzhin yin pas/ bla ma bsten dgos te/ de kho na nyid la 'jug pa las/ kun mkhyen gyis bsngags bla ma bsten//slob mas rang gar ma yin no//long bas rang gar ri bo la//'dzig par nus pa ma yin no//zhes gsungs la/ yang blang dor la rmongs pa'i ma rig pas bskyed pa'i las nyon gyi nad kyis btab pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdungs pa rnams kyis 'tsho byed kyi sman pa mkhas pa dang 'dra ba'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten te sman mchog dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar te/ thar pa thams cad 4

mkhyen pa'i gtan bde brgyab dgos te/ sdud pa las/ nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya//zhes gsungs/ yang nyi ma'i 'od zer ji ltar tsha yang /me shel dang spra ba gsum ma 'dzoms na me mi 'byung la/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs ji ltar che yang / bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang pos rjes su bzung ste gdams pa ma gnang na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs/ slob ma'i rgyud la 'jug mi nus te/ sa paṇa gyis/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang //me shel med par me mi 'byung //de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang / /bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gnyis pa/ bla slob kyi 'brel ba brtag pa/gnyis pa bla slob kyi 'brel brtag pa la'ang / 'brel brtag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/bla slob so sor brtags te mtshan nyid nges par bya'o//dang po ni/bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa la yang /thog mar bla slob kyi 'brel brtag dgos shing / /ma brtags na bla slob gnyis ka dam tshig nyams te//dmyal ba'i rgyur yang 'gyur te//bla ma lnga bcu pa las//bla ma dang ni slob ma dag /mtshungs par dam tshig nyams 'gyur bas//dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang //slob ma'i 'brel ba brtag par bya//zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa la'ang /slob mas bla ma brtag pa/bla mas slob ma brtag pa'o//dang po slob mas bla ma brtag pa de la'ang /brtag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa/ bsten bya'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ spang bya'i 5

bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jig rten 'di yi nyin gcig gi skyel ma dang / tshe gcig gi gnyen grogs sogs bya ba cung zad la'ang gzhan la 'dri zhing mo rtsis sogs byed pa'i sgo nas brtag dpyad dgos na/ tshe 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar gyi legs nyes dang bde skyid ci 'byung bla ma kho na la rag las pas bla ma brtag dgos te/'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/nyin gcig gi ni skyel ma'am//tshe gcig gi ni gnyen 'brel la'ang //'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong / /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi//sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don//bla ma mchog la rag las mod/ /'on kyang rtog dpyod mi byed par/ /tshong dus ngan pa'i zong bzhin du/ /su phrad rnams las len par mthong / /kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar//'bad mi dgos la 'bad pa byed//'bad dgos chos dang bla ma ni//ci yang rung bas tshim par snang / /zhes gsungs pas/ /bla ma legs par brtags dgos so/ /gnyis pa bsten bya'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa la 'dul ba theg chen gsang sngags gsum gyi bla ma'i mtshan nyid rim bzhin bstan pa ni/ de la dang por bla ma'i yon tan dang mtshan nyid shes dgos pas de la bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/'dul ba las/ lnga phrugs nyer gcig gang rung gi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig dgos par gsungs la/ de nyid mdor bsdus pa ni/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa las/ tshul khrims ldan zhing 'dul ba'i cho ga shes//nad par snying brtse 'khor ni dag pa dang / /chos dang zang zing phan 'dogs brtson pa dang //dus su 'doms pa de ltar bla mar bsngags//zhes gsungs shing / theg chen byang sems kyi slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid kyang / /mdo sde'i rgyan las/bshes gnyen dul ba zhi zhing 6

nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa smra mkhas ldan//brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten//zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni//theg chen don la mkhas pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog/srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo //zhes dang /rin chen phreng ba las//chog shes snying rje tshul khrims ldan//nyon mongs sel ba'i shes rab can/ /de dag la ni khyod brten na//khyod kyis mkhyen gyi gus par mdzod//ces gsungs la/mdor bsdu na/tshul khrims rnam par dag pas lus ngag gtsang ba/ shes rab dag pas mdo rgyud rig gnas bcas la mkhas shing lhag par gang bshad bya'i chos de'i tshig don la mkhas pas/ slob ma'i the tshom gcod nus pa'i lung rigs la mkhas pa/ zang zing la mi blta zhing chos de nyon mongs kyi gnyen por gyur nas sems can thams cad byang chub chen por 'grod 'dod kyi snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i lhag bsam dag pas phan par 'dod pa ste mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa zhig nges par dgos te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal nas/gtsang mkhas gzhan la phan par 'dod//ces gsungs so/ /khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ rdo rje gur las/dal zhing zab mo'i chos dang ldan//rig pa thams cad mkhas par bcas//sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing //rab gnas gtor ma'i pha rol son//de nyid bcu ni rnam par rig/ces sogs gsungs pa dang /bla ma lnga bcu pa las/brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med//sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes//snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas//de 7

nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /zhes gsungs so//de nyid bcu la yang / phyi dang gsang ba'i de nyid bcu bcu sogs mang po gsungs kyang / dus kyi dbang gis de thams cad ma tshang yang /dbang thob pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan zhing rnam par dag pa/ rgyud don mkhyen pas nyams len thams cad rgyud sde dang mthun pas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nas/ dbang bzhi'i dam tshig mchog ste srog ltar bsrung zhing / rgyud dang mthun pa'i rtsa rlung rmi lam sogs man ngag du mas brgyan pa/byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud brlan zhing / mdo rgyud kyi bka' bstan bcos du ma mkhyen pa zhig ni nges par dgos te/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog srung man ngag du mas brgyan/ /snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes//de yi zhabs bstan gsol ba du ma gdab//ces gsungs shing / sa paṇa gyis/theg pa sna tshogs tshul bstan nas/ /gnad rnams sangs rgyas gsung bzhin du/ /yang dag ston mdzad bla ma de//sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gis gzung //zhes gsungs/de lta bu'i bla ma ni phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje dang ye shes kyi rang gzugs gdul bya sems can gyi don du gang zag mi yi gzugs su byon pa yin pas/ bsten par bya ba'i bla ma yin te/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir//ji skad du/mtha' yas yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma ni//sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje ye shes khams//gdul bya'i yul la skyes bu'i gzugs kyis byon//dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba bla na med//ces gsungs so//gsum pa ni/de las gzhan du/ spang bar bya ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ sangs 8
