rgyas bstan bzhin mi gsungs na/ /bla ma yin yang btang snyoms bzhag /ces gsungs la/ de don bzhin dpal sprul rin po ches 'di ltar gsungs te/ rang rgyud la thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan cung zad med kyang / nga ni bla ma de dang de lta bu'i sku skye'am rgyal sras sam dbon po sogs yin pas gzhan las lhag cing /da dung nga'i brgyud pa rnams kyang de ltar yin no snyam du bram ze ltar cho rigs kyis srung ba'am/ thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan cung zad yod kyang / de nyid phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i kun slong rnam dag gis ma bsgrubs par rang nyid gang du bste ba'i bla ma'i gdan sa lta bu nyams kyis dogs pa'i tshe 'di'i ched du byas pa rnams ni shing gi rang 'thag lta bu zhes bya ste slob ma'i rgyud 'dul mi nus/ rang rgyud so skye phal pa rnams dang khyad thon pa'i yon tan cung zad med kyang gzhan blun pos dad pa byas pas/ma brtag par go sa mthon por gyur cing rnyed pa dang bkur stes rgyud sbos te rang rgyud nga rgyal gyis khengs shing dam pa'i yon tan ma mthong ba khron pa'i sbal pa lta bu zhes bya ste/ sngon khron pa zhig na sbal pa rgan po zhig rtag par sdod pa'i drung du rgya mtsho chen po'i sbal pa zhig 'ong la/ khron pa'i sprul pa des khyod gang nas 'ong byas/ nga rgya mtsho chen po nas 'ong byas/ khyod kyi rgya mtsho ji tsam yod dris pas/ rgya mtsho shin tu che zer/ 'o na nga'i khron pa 'di'i bzhi cha yod dam zer/ mi tshad do/ 'o na phyed tsam mam/ mi tshad do//'o na khron pa 'di tsam yod dam/ mi tshad do zer bas/ de 'dra yod thabs med pas blta dgos so zer nas/ gnyis ka 'grogs te phyin pas rgya mtsho mthong bas khron pa'i sbas pa brgyal nas mgo gas te shi skad/ mkhas pa'i bla ma ma bsten cing / /mdo rgyud kyi 9

sbyangs brtson med pas thos pa nyung ba/ /rgyud nyon mongs rags shing dran shes bzhin med pas sdom pa dang dam tshig 'chal ba/ rgyud tshod so skye las dman yang grub pa'i mdzad spyod ltar byed pas kun spyod gnam du gshegs pa/ khong khro dang zur za che bas byams snying rje'i dpyang thag chad pa de lta bu ni smyon pa'i lam mkhan lta bu'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ste/ lam log par khrid/ khyad par rang las lhag pa'i yon tan cung zad kyang med cing / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba ni/ long ba'i lam mkhan zhes/ spang blang gi mig bye mi shes pa yin zhes gsungs so//de rnams ni spang bar bya ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ dad pa can gyi tshe gcig gi dge tshogs chud gzan zhing / da res dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob pa'ang chus zos su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//gnyis pa bla mas slob ma brtag pa la'ang ji ltar brtag pa'i tshul/ bsten bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ spang bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid do//dang po ni/ rab paṇa chen ga ya dha ras mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba lha rtse'i brag la bzhugs pa la dam chos sgo skyel du byon nas rjes su bzung ba lta bu dang / 'bring rig shes kyi sgo nas rtags mtshan ma sogs la brtag pa dang / tha ma dri ba dris lan gyi sgo nas brtag pa ste/ gang rung gi sgo nas brtag dgos te/ting 'dzin rgyal po las/'phral du brjod par mi bya yi//snod la brtag pa byas nas bya/ /gal te snod ni shes gyur na//gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ji ltar rin chen brdar ba dang / /gser ni bsreg dang bcad pas brtag /de bzhin du ni slob ma yang / /lo ni bcu gnyis bar du brtag /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 10

sbyangs brtson med pas thos pa nyung ba/ /rgyud nyon mongs rags shing dran shes bzhin med pas sdom pa dang dam tshig 'chal ba/ rgyud tshod so skye las dman yang grub pa'i mdzad spyod ltar byed pas kun spyod gnam du gshegs pa/ khong khro dang zur za che bas byams snying rje'i dpyang thag chad pa de lta bu ni smyon pa'i lam mkhan lta bu'i bshes gnyen zhes bya ste/ lam log par khrid/ khyad par rang las lhag pa'i yon tan cung zad kyang med cing / byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral ba ni/ long ba'i lam mkhan zhes/ spang blang gi mig bye mi shes pa yin zhes gsungs so//de rnams ni spang bar bya ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid yin te/ dad pa can gyi tshe gcig gi dge tshogs chud gzan zhing / da res dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob pa'ang chus zos su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro//gnyis pa bla mas slob ma brtag pa la'ang ji ltar brtag pa'i tshul/ bsten bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ spang bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid do//dang po ni/ rab paṇa chen ga ya dha ras mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba lha rtse'i brag la bzhugs pa la dam chos sgo skyel du byon nas rjes su bzung ba lta bu dang / 'bring rig shes kyi sgo nas rtags mtshan ma sogs la brtag pa dang / tha ma dri ba dris lan gyi sgo nas brtag pa ste/ gang rung gi sgo nas brtag dgos te/ting 'dzin rgyal po las/'phral du brjod par mi bya yi//snod la brtag pa byas nas bya/ /gal te snod ni shes gyur na//gsol ma btab kyang bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ji ltar rin chen brdar ba dang / /gser ni bsreg dang bcad pas brtag /de bzhin du ni slob ma yang / /lo ni bcu gnyis bar du brtag /ces gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 10

bsten bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /'dul ba sum brgya par/ slob dpon la gus tshul khrims yongs dag dang / /bsam gtan dang ni 'don la rtag brtson dang / /grims shing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ni/ /sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan shes par bya//zhes dang /dbu ma bzhi brgya pa las/gzur gnas blo ldan don gnyer ba'i/ /nyan po snod ces bya bar bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /mdor bsdu na rang bzhin gyis blo gsal zhing skyes stobs kyi blo gros dang ldan pas tshig lob skyen zhing don go sla ba dang / brtson pas shes par 'dod pa sbyor byung gi don gnyer yod na yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / dad pas bla ma la mos gus yod na rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug cing chos kyis phan thogs par 'gyur bas/chos de gsum dang ldan pa zhig ni nges par dgos te/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i mkhas 'jug las/ /blo gsal shes 'dod bla mar gus//zhes gsungs so/ /gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dkon mchog gsum la dad dang ldan/ /sdig la 'jigs shing shin tu bsdams/ /dad dang dang ba phun sum tshogs//de la dam tshig sdom pa sbyin//zhes gsungs pa dang /rje btsun rin po ches/blo chen sbyangs pa zab mo dag la mos//rdo rje 'chang chen myur du thob 'dod pa//de la rdo rje theg pa sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /gsum pa spang bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ spyir sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dag las ldog phyogs su gyur pa/ bla ma dang chos la dad pa med pa/tshul khrims 'chal ba/ shes rab dang brtson 'grus chung ba sogs yin zhing /khyad par bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ blo ldan slob mas bla mar ni/ /snying rje med cing khro la 11

gdug /khengs shing chags la ma bsdams ba/ /skyon dang bcas la'ang mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams ni spang bya'i slob ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /snod min la chos bshad mi rung ba yang / rdo rje phreng ba las/ ji ltar seṅge'i 'o ma ni/ /sa yi snod du bzhag mi bya//de bzhin rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud//snod min rnams la sbyin mi bya//zhes gsungs so//gsum pa/ slob mas bla ma bsten tshul/gsum pa slob mas bla ma ji ltar bsten tshul la'ang bsam pa dad pas kun nas bslang ba/ phan yon rjes su dran pa/ sbyor ba ji ltar bsten tshul dngos so/ /dang po bla slob kyi 'brel brtags te slob mas bla ma brtag pa de'ang / sngar chos kyi 'brel ba ma zhus pa'i gong du brtags nas/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid tshang bar 'dug na bsten zhing / ma tshang na mi bsten pa yin gyi/ chos 'brel zhus te bsten tshar nas bla mas ci mdzad thams cad legs par mthong ba'i sgo nas/ rgyu pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas lta bur gsungs la/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur zhus pa'i bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos yin par gsungs te/'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs las/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bu ru/ /blta bar bya zhes gsungs mod kyi/ /sangs rgyas dngos su gsungs pa med/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos yin zhes/ /bya ba dbang bskur thob nas yin/ /zhes gsungs so//des na dbang chos zhus pa'i bla ma dam pa ni/ gdul bya thabs kyis drang ba'i ched du 'phral gyi mdzad spyod sogs rang bzhin gyi mi kun dang 12

mtshungs pa ltar snang yang / nges pa'i don du dgongs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i rang bzhin/ dkon mchog gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na rang gi bla ma de dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang dkon mchog gsum dngos yin snyam pa'i dad pa bcos min 'phrog tu med pa dang ma bral ba byed pa ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin pas gal che ste/ dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde ba'i grong khyer mtshon pa yin/ /sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /bla ma sangs rgyas su ma rtogs na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs mi 'byung ste/ rgyud rdor phreng las/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad nyid du gang rtog pa/ /de yis de nyid dngos grub ni//tshogs pa'i bdag nyid can mi thob//ces gsungs so//gzhan yang / bla ma byang sems nyan rang nas so skye'i bar gang du mthong zhing mos pa de dang de'i byin rlabs las mi 'byung bar gsungs shing / de dag gang du'ang mos pa'i dad pa med na ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gang gi'ang byin rlabs mi 'jug cing / dkar po'i chos gang yang mi skye ste/chos bcu pa'i mdo las/dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la//dkar po'i chos ni mi skye ste//sa bon me yis 'tshig pa la//myu gu sngon mo ji bzhin no//zhes gsungs pas/ des na spyir dkon mchog dang bden bzhi blang dor rgyu 'bras la dad pa dang / khyad par bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa'i dad pa ni shin tu gnad che'o/ /13

gnyis pa bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i phan yon rjes su dran pa ni/mdo sdong po bkod pa las/ gzhon nu nor bzang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yang dag par zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ngan 'gror mi lhung ngo //chos mnyam pa nyid rtogs par byed pa'o//lam bde ba dang mi bde ba ston pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas 'doms pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer gyi lam ston pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas su skyel ba'o/ /sogs mang du gsungs la/dkon mchog sprin las/bla ma bsten na dge ba 'phel zhing mi dge ba 'grib par byed pas mkhan po thos pa che ba'am/ mtshungs pa'am/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am/tshul khrims 'chal ba la yang ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed do//zhes dang / yang sdong po bkod pa las/ 'phags pa dpal 'byung gis bstan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bya ba ma yin pa khong du chud par byed pa'o/ /bag med pa'i gnas las yang dag par zlog pa'o/ /'khor ba'i grong khyer nas 'don pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar yid la bya ba rgyun ma chad pas bshes gnyen rnams kyi drung du 'gro bar bya'o//zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ gang phyir bskal pa bye ba ni/ /grangs med par yang rnyed dka' ba'i//sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan la//tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed//ces gsungs so//gsum pa la'ang / bsten tshul dngos dang /sgo gsum gyi kun slong dang bya ba ji ltar sgrub tshul/ rnyed dang bkur ste sgrub pa'i mchod pa bya tshul/mdzad spyod ma nges pa sogs la ma dad pa spong ba'o//dang po bsam pa dad pas kun nas bslangs te phan yon rjes su dran nas/ sbyor bas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul la'ang / 'dul ba las/ dge 14

tshul slong gi sdom pa zhus nas zhag gis ma chod par lo bcu'i bar du lnga phrugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pas 'dul ba'i gnang bkag phra zhib mkhyen pa'i gnas kyi slob dpon bsten dgos par gsungs te/ mdo rtsa bar bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu ma lon par mkhan po nyid dang gnas nyid dang / mi gnas par 'dug par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i gnas kyi slob dpon bsten tshul yang /yul gyi rkang pa'i sgyid pa la 'jus pa'i phyag byas te sngags lan gsum brjod pas gnas kyi slob dpon du 'gyur bar gsungs la/ theg chen la ni phyag dang gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du 'gro bas bsten dgos te/ting 'dzin rgyal po las/chos kyi sbyin pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /gal te khyod la gsol 'debs na/ /rab rgyas bdag gis ma bslabs zhes//thog mar tshig de brjod par bya//zhes gsungs la/bla mar gsol ba ma btab pa'am/ btab kyang khas ma blangs na chos kyi rigs su mi skye zhing slob mar mi 'gyur te/ rdo rje gur las/ gang gis bla mar gsol ma btab//de ni rigs su skye ba med/ /ces gsungs pa/ des na phyag dang spyod lam gus pas gsol ba lan gsum gdab ste bla mas gnang ba byin nas bla mar bsten dgos te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ mdun du dul bar 'dug pa dang / /gos sogs tshul ni bsdam pa dang / /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba dang / /nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab//ces dang / yang de nyid las/ mchog tu dad pas dus gsum du/ /dkyil 'khor me rtog bcas thal mos/ /ston pa bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing / /zhabs la spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni sdong po bkod pa las/ /rnam pa dgus dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul gsungs pa 15

bzhin/ bla ma'i bya ba'i khur thams cad bskur bas mi skyo bas sa lta bu'i sems kyis bla ma bsten par bya'o/ /bdud dang sdig grogs kyis mdza' ba'i bsam pa mi phyed pas rdo rje lta bu'i sems dang / sdug bsngal thams cad kyis mi bsgul ba'i phyir khor yug lta bu/ las thams cad nyams su blangs pa la mi smod pas 'jig rten gyi bran lta bu/ nga rgyal dang che ba'i nga rgyal spangs pas phyag dar ba lta bu'i sems dang / khur lci ba khur bas theg pa lta bu'i sems dang / bka'abakyon dang phyag 'beb sogs la mi khro bas sgo khyi lta bu'i sems dang / rang gis chos zhu ba dang bla ma'i bya ba'i ched du 'gro zhing 'ong bas yongs su mi skyo bas gru lta bu'i sems dang / rang dbang gis mi 'jug par dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ngor blta zhing / de'i dbang du btang nas bka' bzhin byed pas bu mdzangs pa lta bu'i sems kyis bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub dgos la/ gnyis pa kun slong dang 'du shes ji ltar bya tshul ni/mdo de las/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis bdag la ni/las nyon gyis na bas na nad par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni sman pa'i 'du shes dang / chos rjes su bstan pa la ni sman gyi 'du shes dang / chos de rang gis nan tan nyams su blangs pa la ni nad 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'i 'du shes bzhag pa sogs te/ mdor na bla ma bsten pa'i dus su tsha grang bkres skom ngal dub sogs dka' ba thams cad khyad du bsad nas bla mas ci gsungs bka' bzhin sgrub/ dad gus kyis gsol ba 'debs/ 'phral rang gi bya spyod thams cad kyang bla ma la zhus te bla mas bka' 16

ji ltar bstsal ba ltar nyams su blangs/ yid khyed shes kyi dad pa'i sgo nas bsten dgos so/ /gsum pa la gsum las/ dang po rnyed pa'i mchod pa 'bul zhing bla ma bsten tshul ni/ rang gis chos spyi dang khyad par dam tshig ste dbang bskur tshul bzhin thob pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de la ni/ sbyin dka' blos mi thongs ba'i bu dang chung ma rang gi lus srog kyang yon du 'bul ba'i sgo nas bsten cing mnyes par bya dgos na/ rta glang gser dngul ja dar sogs phyi rol gyi longs spyod g.yo ba te mi rtag pa'i zang zing gi yo byad gzhan dag 'bul dgos pa ni smos ci dgos te//bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ rang gi dam tshig slob dpon ni/ /sbyin dka' bu dang chung ma dang //rang srog gis kyang bsten bya na//longs spyod g.yo bas smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs la/kha sbyor las/bdag gi dngos po thams cad kyis//blo dang ldan pas bla mar 'bul/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i bla mar mchod pa 'bul dgos par bshad pa de yang / bla ma la dbul phongs dang bkres skom sogs yod nas de dag bsal ba'i phyir 'bul ba ma yin la/ byang sems sogs lam gzhan dang gzhan du zhugs pa dag gis bskal pa grangs med mang por thob dka' ba'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed pa'i thabs bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad ston pa'i bla ma la mchod na/ rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs thabs dkon mchog gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing / sangs rgyas thams cad la'ang mchod par 'gyur bas/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du yin te/ gsang ba 'dus par/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi 17

bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam par bsnyen bkur ba bas/ gang gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la snum gyis byugs pa byas pa ches bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so//zhes dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa las/rtag tu bla ma la yang 'bul//'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra/ /zhes dang / de sbyin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu sbyin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de phyir bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur//zhes gsungs la/ klu sgrub kyis kyang /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni//bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam//de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni 'thob par 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//yang gang zag 'ga' zhig gis rang gi bla mar dang po dngos po 'di dang 'di lta bu zhig 'bul bar bya bsams te/phyis ser snas ma phul ba'am/ yang na yo byad 'di dang 'di 'dra ba 'bul bar bya'o/ /zhes khas blangs nas ma phul na/ nyes pa shin tu che bas yi dwags dang dmyal ba gnyis su nges par skye ste sdug bsngal bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ blo ldan rdo rje slob ma yis/ /ci ste bde ba kun 'dod nas/ /dad mos sems kyis phul bar bya/ /yid la gang bsams ma phul ba'am/ /khas blangs de ni ma phul na/ /yi dwags dmyal ba rnam gnyis su/ /nges par skye ste brlag par 'gyur//zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa bkur sti'i mchod pa 'bul zhing bla ma bsten pa'i tshul ni/ lus kyis gus pas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bla ma'i zhabs dang sku lus sogs bkru zhing chu gtsang 'bul ba/dril phyis dang bsku mnye bya ba/gdan dang na bza' 'bul ba/ gsol ja 'bul ba sogs mdor na bla ma mnyes pa'i bya ba'i 18

las thams cad la phral mngon sla chos le lo med par dwang 'dod yid ches kyis sgrub pa yin te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/rkang bkru ba dang lus bkru dang //dril dang mnye ba la sogs la//phyag ni sngon du 'gro bar bya//de bzhin mthar ni ci bder bya//zhes gsungs la/ ngag gi sgo nas kyang bla ma'i mtshan brjod pa'i tshe mtshan gyi mthar zhal snga nas zhes/ zhe sa dang ldan par brjod dgos la/ skye bo gzhan gus par bya ba'i phyir khyad par can gyi bsngags pa brjod pa/ dper na rje btsun kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas zhes pa lta bur brjod dgos te/de nyid las/de yi mtshan smos brjod nas ni//ming mthar zhal snga ldan par bya//gzhan dag gus par bya ba'i phyir/khyad par gyi ni tshig dag brjod//ces gsungs so/ /yid kyis nga rgyal spang ba'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes pa'i bya ba gang dang gang bgyid dgos pa lag pas thal mo sbyar te/ bka' spyol bar zhu zhes zhu la/'di dang 'di gyis gsungs pa'i lan du/bka' bzhin bgyid do//zhes spro ba dang bcas pas brjod cing / bka' bstsal pa ma yengs par nyan nas gang bsgo ba'i bya ba bsgrubs zin nas/lus pa lta bu ma yin zhing /bdag gis 'di lta bu sgrub pa dang /'bul ba 'di lta bu phul bas bla ma 'di la kho bo drin che'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gtan nas med par 'jam pa'i tshig gis 'di ltar bgyis lags so/ /zhes go zhing brda 'phrod par zhu ba dang / gzhan yang mi mnyes pa dang ma gus pa'i bya thams cad spang dgos par bstan pa ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/bla ma la ni bka' stsol zhu//bka' bzhin bgyid ces brjod par bya//thal mo sbyar nas ma yengs par// 19

bla ma'i bsgo ba nyan par bya//dgod dang lu ba la sogs pa//lag pas kha ni dgab par bya/ /bya ba zin nas 'jam po yi/ /tshig dag gis ni bzla bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma'i drung du lud pa lu ba dgod pa sogs la/ mi mjos pa dang ma gus pa'i rnam pa spong ba'i phyir/lag pas kha bkab la mi mngon par bya zhing /gzhan yang mi rigs shing ma gus pa'i spyod lam/ bla ma'i drung du mal stan mthon por 'dug pa dang / mdun du thog mar 'gro ba dang / thor tshugs bcings pa dang /zhwa gyon pa dang /bla ma sa rjen la bzhugs pa'i tshe/rang nyid stan la rkang pa snga bar 'jog pa dang /rked par lag pa gnyis bzhag nas gru mo brgyangs te rked pa mnye bar mi bya'o//bla ma bzhengs pa'i tshe/rang nyid nyal ba dang 'dug pa dang /bzhugs pa'i tshe nyal bar mi bya la/ bla ma stan las bzhengs na rang nyid kyang 'dud pa'i tshul gyis stan las ldang ba dang / bla ma'i drung du stan la sdod pa'i tshe'ang gya tshom du mi sdod par gus pas 'dug par bya'o/ /gong du bla ma'i sngon du mi 'gro bar bshad pa'i dmigs bsal ni mtshan mo mun nag 'thibs pa'i tshe dang / chu dang gcong rong dang / chom rkun sogs 'jigs pa yod pa'i lam du song zhig ces sgo ba thob na mdun du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang bla mas mthong bar slob mas lus phan tshun gcu ba dang / ka ba dang jig pa sogs la rgyab brten par mi bya zhing / sor mo'i tshigs mnyed cing bgrang bar mi bya'o//tshogs 'khor gyi dus lta bu dgos pa khyad par can med par glu len pa/ glo bur du rol mo sgrogs pa/dmag dang /tshong dang /zhing la sogs pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba mang po bla mas thos pa'i nyes 'khor du mi bya'o/ /mchil ma dang snabs dang lud pa dor 20

bla ma'i bsgo ba nyan par bya//dgod dang lu ba la sogs pa//lag pas kha ni dgab par bya/ /bya ba zin nas 'jam po yi/ /tshig dag gis ni bzla bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma'i drung du lud pa lu ba dgod pa sogs la/ mi mjos pa dang ma gus pa'i rnam pa spong ba'i phyir/lag pas kha bkab la mi mngon par bya zhing /gzhan yang mi rigs shing ma gus pa'i spyod lam/ bla ma'i drung du mal stan mthon por 'dug pa dang / mdun du thog mar 'gro ba dang / thor tshugs bcings pa dang /zhwa gyon pa dang /bla ma sa rjen la bzhugs pa'i tshe/rang nyid stan la rkang pa snga bar 'jog pa dang /rked par lag pa gnyis bzhag nas gru mo brgyangs te rked pa mnye bar mi bya'o//bla ma bzhengs pa'i tshe/rang nyid nyal ba dang 'dug pa dang /bzhugs pa'i tshe nyal bar mi bya la/ bla ma stan las bzhengs na rang nyid kyang 'dud pa'i tshul gyis stan las ldang ba dang / bla ma'i drung du stan la sdod pa'i tshe'ang gya tshom du mi sdod par gus pas 'dug par bya'o/ /gong du bla ma'i sngon du mi 'gro bar bshad pa'i dmigs bsal ni mtshan mo mun nag 'thibs pa'i tshe dang / chu dang gcong rong dang / chom rkun sogs 'jigs pa yod pa'i lam du song zhig ces sgo ba thob na mdun du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang bla mas mthong bar slob mas lus phan tshun gcu ba dang / ka ba dang jig pa sogs la rgyab brten par mi bya zhing / sor mo'i tshigs mnyed cing bgrang bar mi bya'o//tshogs 'khor gyi dus lta bu dgos pa khyad par can med par glu len pa/ glo bur du rol mo sgrogs pa/dmag dang /tshong dang /zhing la sogs pa'i gtam gyi sbyor ba mang po bla mas thos pa'i nyes 'khor du mi bya'o/ /mchil ma dang snabs dang lud pa dor 20

ba dang / stan la 'dug pa'i tshe rkang pa brkyang ba dang / phan tshun 'cham 'cham por 'chags pa dang / rtsod pa smra ste shag 'gyed pa'ang bla ma'i drung du mi bya'o/ /rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa'i gnas su rab gnas sbyin sreg dbang bskur slob ma sdud pa/ chos 'chad pa rnams kyang bla ma las gnang ba zhus te/ bla mas gnang na bya'i ma gnang bar bya mi rung bar gsungs la/ yul der bla ma mi bzhugs na gnang ba zhu mi dgos la/ de dag sogs las byung ba'i yon ci dang ci thob pa de kun rang gi bla ma la dbul lo/ /bla mas kyang phul ba de'i nang nas ci rigs shig blangs nas lhag ma slob ma rang gis longs spyod par bya'o//bla ma'i mdun du rang nyid la gzhan gyis gos g.yogs pa sogs kyi bsnyen bkur dang / stan las ldang ba phyag la sogs pa byed par snang na de ltar ma byed ces bzlog par bya'o/ /bla ma'i sku'i grib ma la 'gom ste rkang pas brdzis na mchod rten bshig pa dang 'dra ba'i nyes pa yod par gsungs pas grib ma tsam yang 'gom mi rung na/ zhabs lhum dang bzhugs gdan dang na bza' 'gom pa dang / nges pa'i chibs rta zhon pa sogs mi rung ba lta ci smos/ gal te yul dus kyi dbang gis mi 'gom mi rung ba lta bu byung na/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags rgyas btegs te/ de'i 'og nas 'jug par bsam mo/ /bla ma'i nor rdzas rnams la rang nyid kyi ma yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ji mi snyam du mi bzhag par rang gi srog bzhin du gces par bya zhing /bla ma khyim pa yin na bu dang phyag rgya ma la sogs pa la'ang gus par bya zhing / bla ma'i sku 'khor rnams la rang gi gnyen bzhin du brtse ba'i sems kyis mnyam par bzhag pa dang / gal te bla mar smod pa dang sdang bar byed pa'i gang zag gzhan 21

yod na/de dang rang nyid bshes par mi bya zhing /gal te rang gi nus pas ma dad pa dang smod pa sogs zlog nus na de ltar bya/ mi nus na de dang phag phebs nas gtam smra bar mi bya'o/ /khang pa'i sgo yang drag tu dbye ba dang shugs kyis deb pa sogs mi bya bar/dal bus dbye gcod bya zhing /bla mas mar gnang ba/ rang gis yar dngos po 'bul ba thams cad la gus pas lag pa gnyis nas 'bul blang bya dgos la/ yang sngar bstan pa'i sgrub dgos par bshad pa la/ rang na ba sogs kyis sgrub mi nus kyang / sems kyis de byed pa la yi ma rangs shing ma dad pa ma yin par/ phyis sgrub 'dod yod na bcas pa'i sdig pa mi 'gyur bas ma bsgrubs kyang nyes pa med cing / bla mas rjes su gnang ba la yang nyes pa med pa yin no/yang bya ba de gtan nas sgrub mi nus pa dang /sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa dang 'gal ba lta bu sgrub mi rung ba dag la/bla mas nan gyis bskul ba byung na/bya ba de sgrub mi nus pa dang / mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan brda 'phrod pa'i tshig gis bshad sbyangs byas nas ma bsgrubs na yang nyes pa med do//de las gzhan bla mas ji ltar bsgo ba de rab tu dga' zhing / 'bad pa chen pos sgo gsum rtse gcig tu dril te nyan cing bsgrub par bya dgos la/ gal te bka' bcag cing ma bsgrubs na/ bla ma'i bka' bcag rdo rje'i dmyal bar nyung / zhes pa ltar nyes pa che bas/des na ci gsungs bka' sgrub/ci mdzad legs mthong gi sgo nas/ bla ma'i mdun du bag med kyi spyod pa 'dzem pa'i ngo tsha shes pas/ bla ma la mig che bas blta ba tsam yang spangs te gus pa'i sgo nas rang gi sgo gsum gyi kun spyod tshul dang mthun par gnas par bya'o/ /de dag rnams ni bla ma lnga bcu pa dang / rdo rje snying 22

yod na/de dang rang nyid bshes par mi bya zhing /gal te rang gi nus pas ma dad pa dang smod pa sogs zlog nus na de ltar bya/ mi nus na de dang phag phebs nas gtam smra bar mi bya'o/ /khang pa'i sgo yang drag tu dbye ba dang shugs kyis deb pa sogs mi bya bar/dal bus dbye gcod bya zhing /bla mas mar gnang ba/ rang gis yar dngos po 'bul ba thams cad la gus pas lag pa gnyis nas 'bul blang bya dgos la/ yang sngar bstan pa'i sgrub dgos par bshad pa la/ rang na ba sogs kyis sgrub mi nus kyang / sems kyis de byed pa la yi ma rangs shing ma dad pa ma yin par/ phyis sgrub 'dod yod na bcas pa'i sdig pa mi 'gyur bas ma bsgrubs kyang nyes pa med cing / bla mas rjes su gnang ba la yang nyes pa med pa yin no/yang bya ba de gtan nas sgrub mi nus pa dang /sdom pa gsum gyi bslab pa dang 'gal ba lta bu sgrub mi rung ba dag la/bla mas nan gyis bskul ba byung na/bya ba de sgrub mi nus pa dang / mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan brda 'phrod pa'i tshig gis bshad sbyangs byas nas ma bsgrubs na yang nyes pa med do//de las gzhan bla mas ji ltar bsgo ba de rab tu dga' zhing / 'bad pa chen pos sgo gsum rtse gcig tu dril te nyan cing bsgrub par bya dgos la/ gal te bka' bcag cing ma bsgrubs na/ bla ma'i bka' bcag rdo rje'i dmyal bar nyung / zhes pa ltar nyes pa che bas/des na ci gsungs bka' sgrub/ci mdzad legs mthong gi sgo nas/ bla ma'i mdun du bag med kyi spyod pa 'dzem pa'i ngo tsha shes pas/ bla ma la mig che bas blta ba tsam yang spangs te gus pa'i sgo nas rang gi sgo gsum gyi kun spyod tshul dang mthun par gnas par bya'o/ /de dag rnams ni bla ma lnga bcu pa dang / rdo rje snying 22

po'i rgyan sogs nas bstan pa bzhin yin la/ 'di dag dang 'dra ba ni 'dul ba mdo sde'i bka' bstan rnams las kyang gsungs mod/ so so'i lung ni yi ge mang gi dogs pas ma bris so//gsum pa sgrub pa'i mchod pa bya ba'i tshul ni/bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas chos gang dang gang zhus pa de dang de nyams len rnam par dag pa zhig byed pa yin la/ de yang dang po/ dge tshul slong gi sdom pa zhus pa zhig yin na/ dge slong la khrims nyis brgya dang nga gsum/ dge tshul la blang 'das so gsum/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus pa zhig yin na/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun te rtsa ba bzhi chang 'thung ba bcas lnga dang / dus khrims bsnyen gnas tsam zhig blangs na'ang / snga ma lnga'i steng du mal stan che mtho gnyis gcig tu byas/sgeg chos rgyan phreng spos byug gcig tu byas/phyi dro'i kha zas bcas brgyad/ de rnams so so'i sdom pa gang blangs dang mthun par srung sdom shes nas tshul bzhin srung sdom byas na tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhes mngon mtho lha mi dang / nges legs byang chub gsum po rnams thob pa'i rtsa ba dang /yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs//zhes dang / 'jug pa las/ yon tan tshul khrims zhing du rnam 'phel na//'bras bu nyer spyod chad pa med par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ de lta ma yin par/ blang ba dge slong bar gyi sdom pa blangs pa la srung rgyu sne gcig kyang srung thub bam/ mi thub pa la nye ba ni tshul khrims 'chal ba zhes bya ba yin la/ de ni ji skad du//tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gror de 'gro ste//de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus//zhes dang /23

'jug pa las/ sbyin pas longs spyod dag ni 'gro ngan na'ang / /skye bo tshul khrims rkang pa nyams las byung / /zhes gsungs la/de lta bus shi gson gyi dad rdzas mang por bag med spyod pa ni/ lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba gyur mid byed pa'i sdug bsngal las ches che ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin te/ ji skad du/ tho lum me rtse 'bar ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi//tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas//yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min//zhes pa dang /gzhan yang /mdo sde las/ mi sdig can zhig gis nyin re bzhin mi stong phrag re bsad pa las kyang / tshul khrims 'chal bas dkor la spyod pa nyes pa che ba dang / mi dge ba bcu'i las lam lo brgya yi bar du rgyun ma chad par bsags pa las kyang / tshul khrims 'chal bas dad rdzas la zhag gcig la longs spyod pa nyes dmigs che ba sogs gsungs pas bag yod par bya dgos so/ /de dag rnams ni dgag pa'i bslab bya'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ sgrub pa'i bslab bya'i dbang du byas na/ dge tshul slong gis ni bslab pa yongs sbyong gi gzhi gsum gyi nyams len dang 'brel bar zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong la/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa/ gti mug gi gnyen por rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog rnam rtog gi gnyen por dbugs bgrang rngub/ nga rgyal gyi gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye bsgoms pas zhi gnas bsgrubs nas/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi'i steng du/bden bzhi mi rtag bcu drug bsgoms pas lhag mthong sgrub pa'i nyams len sogs byed dgos pa yin la/ byang sems dbu sems gnyis ku'am gang rung gi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob pa zhig yin na/dbu ma'i lugs la nam snying gi mdo 24

dang / bslab btus sogs las bstan pa'i rgyal blon las dang po'i byang sems sogs la 'byung nye ba'i rtsa nyung bcu bzhi/ nyes byas brgyad cu dang / sems tsam lugs la byang sa'i dgongs pa sdom pa nyi shu par bshad pa'i pham 'dra bzhi dang nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug gsungs pa rnams shes nas/ mig 'bras bzhin du bsrung ba ni/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / smon 'jug gi bslab bya spyi dang bye brag par phyin drug bcas bsgrub pa ni/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang /sbyin dang snyan smra don spyod don mthun te/bsdu dngos bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa ni/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims te tshul khrims gsum gyi dang du byang sems kyi bslab bya thams cad 'dus pas brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed thob pa yin na yang bslab bya de dag la slob dgos la/ gzhan yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems zhi gnas dang lhag mthong rnams sgom pa ste/ de rnams ni byang chub sems bskyed kyi sdom pa thob pa rnams kyi nyams len yin la//gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na spyir rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la yang so sor bsrung bya dang bsgrub bya yod mod/ gtso che ba bla med kyi dbang du byas na/ dang por dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig thob rjes/ dbang srog dam tshig yin pas/ dbang bzhi so so'i mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' sung mi 'bral ba ste dam tshig nyi shu/ bum dbang gi srung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan yang rigs lnga spyi dang / so so'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin shes nas srog ltar srung sdom bya zhing /de nas man ngag dang mthun par lta ba rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung nas dbang bzhi'i lam gyi rim pa bskyed rdzogs 25

kyi rnal 'byor brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su len pa ste/des na slob mas bla ma bsten te/ chos gang dang gang thob cing gnang ba de dang de slob mas nyams len yang dag pa zhig byed dgos la/des na bla ma bsten nas chos zhus pa'i don ni/chos de rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs kyi gnyen por gyur te/ spang blang gi gnad shes nas gnyen po theg pa so so'i lam gyi khyad par shes shing nyams su len pa zhig byed dgos pa yin la/ de ma byung na tshogs gral la bsdad de chos thos lo dang go lo tsam gyis ni/ bla mas chos gnang ba'i don yang ma byung / slob mas chos zhus pa'i don yang ma byung ba yin te/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las nga yis rab tu bzang ba'i chos bstan kyang / /khyod kyis thos nas yang dag ma spyad na/ /nad pa sman gyi rkyal pa thogs pa dag/rang gi nad ni gso bar mi nus bzhin//zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ /lus kyis 'di ltar spyad par bya//tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig 'grub/ /sman dpyad bklags pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na bla mas chos gang gnang yang mdor bsdu na sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len dang de'i yan lag tu ma gyur pa'i chos ni med de/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ sdom pa med la dge rgyun med/skyabs 'gro med na chos pa min/ /zhes dang / de phyir pha rol phyin pa la/ /sems bskyed min pa'i chos gzhan med//rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas//dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do//zhes dang /sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa yi//rim gnyis zab mo'i gnad shes na/ /de ni tshe 'di'am bar do'am//skye ba bcu drug tshun chad na//'grub par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gsungs//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob mas kyang de dang mthun pa'i chos gang 26

dang gangathob pa de dang de gong du bstan pa bzhin nyams len tshul bzhin byed cing / thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan bla ma la gang mnga' ba thams cad slob ma rang gi rgyud la spar btab pa bzhin ldan par byas na ni/bla mas chos gnang zhing slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i don yang byung / slob mas bla ma bsten te chos zhus pa'i don yang byung zhing /mchod pa kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa sgrub pa'i mchod pa'ang de yin te/mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa ji skad bstan pa sgrub pa des//de yi sems ni yang dag mgu bar byed//ces dang /skyes rabs las/phan pa'i lan du mchod pa bya ba ni/ /bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su len pa yin//zhes gsungs so//mdor na slob ma'i rgyud la yon tan sna gcig skye ba/ skyon sna gcig 'grib pa yan chad kyi srid zhi'i bde legs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin pas/ sngar bstan pa'i rnyed dang bkur ste sgrub pa'i mchod pa gsum gyis mnyes par byas nas/ mi mnyes par byed pa'i rgyu gang yin pa de kun spangs te sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi 'du shes skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas bsten dgos pa yin te/ ji skad du/ srid pa kun tu bla ma'i zhabs bsten cing / /rnyed dang bkur ste sgrub pas mchod byas te//ston pa'i 'du shes skad cig mi 'bral zhing / /skyon gyi rtog pas gos par ma gyur cig /ces dang /mdo sde rgyan las/ bkur ste rnyed pa dag dang rim gro dang / /sgrub pa'i sgo nas bshes gnyen bsten par bya//zhes gsungs la/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las kyang //'dir mang smos pas ci zhig dbos/ /bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya//mi mnyes byed kun 27

spangs nas ni//de dang de la 'bad de bya//dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang zhes//rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs par/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya//zhes dang /rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ /de bas thabs ni thams cad kyis//rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma mchog /rjes su mthun pas mnyes par bya//de mnyes sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes//zhes gsungs so//bzhi pa mdzad spyod ma nges pa sogs la ma dad pa spong ba ni/ /rang gis dbang chos zhus te bla mar bsten tshar nas bla mas mdzad spyod ma nges pa rang gi sems la mi 'bab pa lta bu ci mdzad ci mthong yang gdul bya sna tshogs kyi ngor thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad spyod kho na yin mod/ nga rang las ma dag pa'i dbang gis 'di ltar snang ba yin/des na don du sangs rgyas dngos kyi mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i dag snang kho na bya dgos te/ sngon drang srong skar ma la dga' bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mu stegs byed kyi drang srong du mthong ba dang / slob dpon thogs med kyis mgon po byams pa spyi bor bzhag nas bstan pas las ma dag pa gzhan sus kyang ma mthong la/ /las cung zad dag pa'i rgan mo zhig gis khyi mor mthong ba dang /slob dpon mtsho skyes zhabs kyis yan lag med pa'i rdo rje phag rdzir mthong ba dang / jo bo nā ro ta pas slob dpon te lo pa nya gson sreg byed pa sogs mi 'tsham pa byed pa'i smyon pa lta bur mthong ba dang / slob dpon mi tri bas/ sha ba ri ba ri dwags dang bya la sogs pa gsod pa'i rngon par mthong ba dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal khyim bcun chang nyo ba zhing las byed par mthong ba lta bu ste/ de yang slob dpon sangs rgyasaye shes rang sa blam b.ling 28

ta'izhal nas/ khyod kyi the tshom de rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar 'jam pa'i rdo rje bzhugs pa'idrung du zhus shig gsungs pa bzhin byon pa'i lam khar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs su khang pa zhig gi drung na bud med cig dang khyi mo zhig gnas pa dang / de dang nye bar bad btsun zhig chos gos kyis mthang gos byas nas zhing rmod cing 'dug pas/kye ma rab tu byung pa bud med dang bcas zhing rmo ba 'di 'dra 'byung bas bstan pa nyams so snyam du dgongs nas thugs skyo bar gyur te/ de ltar na yang snyigs ma'i dus la babs pas yin snyam/ der byon nas bsod snyoms mdzad par dgongs pa dang / btsun pa des bud med la rab tu byung ba 'di la dro drongs shig ces bsgos song ba dang / bud med des nya rgya khyer nas chu phran zhig la nya bshor te/ de btsos nas khyi mo'i mdun du shing lo la bzhag nas chos ston drongs zhes bsgos pas khyi mo skyug pa dang / de dang sngar gyi nya bcas drangs byung bas/slob dpon gyis ched du dmigs pa'i sha dang / mi gtsang bar dgongs nas ma gsol lo/ de nas btsun pa na re/ kye 'dzam bu gling pa la phal ba'i zas drongs shig ces bsgos pas 'bras chen zho dang bcas pa drangs pa dang slob dpon gyis gsol nas gshegs par dgongs pa na/ btsun pa na re/da 'di nas phar song yang / do nub sdod sa mi rnyed kyi sang song zer bas der bzhugs so/der slob dpon gyis gsang ba 'dus pa zhal 'don du bton pa dang gang du slob dpon gyis ma shes sar/ bud med de mi mgu ba dang / ma rangs pa'i rnam 'gyur re byed pa dang / slob dpon gyi thugs la 'di yis the tshom chod par 'dug dbongs nas phyag btsal te gsol ba btab pa dang / bud med de na re/ 29

ngas mi shes/ da ci'i btsun pa de shin tu mkhas pa yin pas de la zhus zer ro /de gang song dris pas/ chang nyor song zer/ bsgugs pas 'phyi mo red pa na chang gis bzi nas 'khyor bzhin 'ong ba gzigs pas/ ma dad kyang nga rgyal bcag nas phyag btsal te bdag la gsang ba 'dus pa bshad par zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur longs shig ces gsungs/ bdag gis dbang thob ces brjod pas/ nga nyid kyis dbang bskur dgos gsungs nas/ ston zla ra ba'i tshe brgyad kyi mtshan mor spyil po gzhal med khang du gyur/ /de'i dbus su 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bstan nas der dbang bskur zhus/ de lta bu'i 'jam dpal dbyangs la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gsang 'dus dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor rnams gsan pa yin/ des na 'jam dpal dbyangs la zas kyis phongs te zhing rmo dgos pa dang /chang la sred de chang nyo nas bzhes dgos pa med mod/ 'on kyang gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du de dag bstan pa yin la/ slob dpon yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chen po yin yang sgrib pa'i dbang gis 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos su mjal yang de lta bu las ma mthong ba yin/ des na rang gi snang ba dag pa dang ma dag pa'i dbang gis sangs rgyas la yang bzang ngan sna tshogs su mthong la sangs rgyas kyis kyang gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa de dang der mthun par ston pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas nyi ma gdul bya yi//ri la ji ltar 'os pa 'bab//ces gsungs pa ltar ro//des na ngas bla ma mi phal par mthong ba yang rab yin/ nga yi bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang gsol 30

'debs zhe thag pa/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas byas pas sangs rgyas yin pa'i nges shes dang / dad mos bcos ma ma yin pa skyes nas nyams rtogs dang sa lam gyi rten 'brel rnams rang 'grigs su 'gro ba yin te/ slob dpon dril bu pas/bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni//skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin//zhes gsungs so/ /yang sngar bshad pa'i bsten bya'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la dbang dang chos zhus tshar nas/ 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ba/ brtson 'grus zhan pa/ rmongs pa'o sogs snyam du sems kyis brnyas par byed na sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas par 'gyur bas/ dus ring po'i bar du sdug bsngal 'thob par 'gyur te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ de 'dra'i mgon la bsams byas nas//slob mar gyur pas brnyas na ni//sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pas na///des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob/ /ces dang / der ma zad slob dpon la ngag gis smod pa'i nyes dmigs gzhan yang / de nyid las/ slob dpon la ni smod pa na/ /yams dang 'tshe ba'i nad rnams dang / /gdon dang rims dang dug rnams kyis//rmongs chen de ni 'chi bar 'gyur//rgyal po me dang sbrul gdug dang / /chu dang mkha' 'gro rkun po dang / /gdon dang log 'dren rnams kyis ni/ /bsad nas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / yang sgo gsum gyis slob dpon gyi thugs dkrugs na myong nges kyi las/ dmyal ba mnar med du skye nas sdug bsngal myong dgos te/ de nyid las/ nam yang slob dpon dag la ni/ /kun tu sems dkrugs mi bya'o/ /gal te rmongs pas byas gyur na//dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /mnar med la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /dmyal ba bstan pa gang 31

yin pa/ /slob dpon la ni smod pa rnams/ /der ni gnas par yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs la/ dbang chos rgya chen zhus pa ma zad tshigs bcad gcig tsam gyi chos 'brel zhus pa la yang / bla mar mi 'dzin na nyes pa 'di ltar gsungs te/shārnyi pas dgra nag gi dka' 'grel du drangs pa las/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam nyan pa la/ /gang gi bla mar mi 'dzin na/ /khyi yi skye gnas brgyar skyes nas//the sha can du skye bar 'gyur//zhes gsungs so/ /yang bla ma'i mdun du rdzun phra mo tsam zhus kyang nyes pa shin tu lci ste/ sngon grub thob chen po zhig gi slob mas 'khor mang po bsdus te/ chos 'chad pa'i skabs su bla ma sprang po'i tshul gyis phebs byung bas khrom gyi dbus su phyag 'tshal ba la ngo tsha nas ma mthong ba ltar mdzad/ phyi dro tshogs pa grol 'phral mjal nas phyag phul bas/ da ci'i phyag mi 'tshal ba ci yin gsungs par/ ma mthong lags zhus pas/ de ma thag spyan gnyis sa la brul/ slar bzod par gsol nas drang por zhus pas bla mas byin rlabs mdzad pas/ spyan sor chud pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar dbang chos zhus tshar nas bla mar mi 'dzin zhing brnyas smod byed pa sogs la sngar smos pa'i nyes dmigs de ltar yod pa des na bla ma la brtag dpyad mi byed par gang byung byung la dbang chos zhus nas/ gcig la'ang bla ma bsten tshul cung zad tsam yang mi shes shing mi byed pa rnams la de ltar ma byed ces brtse bas gdams pa sbyin pa ni/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis//rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che//dge ba rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bla mas rang la bka' bkyon dang phyag 'bebs sogs dang thugs mi dgyes pa'i rnam pa lta bu 32

sogs gang gnang yang nga rang gi las sgrib sbyong ba'i ched du 'di lta bu gnang ba bka' drin che snyam du phan pa'i 'du shes bskyed de dad mos lhag par bya dgos te/ji skad du/ bla ma'i mdzad pa ji ltar bstan na yang //ngo mtshar mos pa rab tu 'phel 'gyur zhing //bya ba kun la gzhan du mi rtog par//phan pa'i 'du shes rtag tu rnyed gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /mdor na bka' drin 'khor med rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung rganas su shes pa'i sgo nas/ zas skom gyi phud thams cad kyis bla ma la mchod/gos gsar pa zhig yod na'ang lha rdzas su byin gyis brlabs te dang por bla ma la mchod par mos/ snang ba'i dngos po me tog mdzes pa/ chu dwangs pa yan chad kyi bzang legs gang byung ba thams cad bla ma la mchod/ rang gi lus sems la bde skyid dang dpal 'byor sogs gang byang yang bla ma'i bka' drin yin pas bla ma la mchod/ rang gi lus sems la na tsha sogs mi 'dod pa gang byung yang / bla ma'i bka' drin gyis sngon gyi las ngan thams cad dag 'gro ba yin/ bla ma mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs shing / bla ma mjal du 'gro ba'i tshe lag pa stong par mi 'gro ba rten 'brel gyi gnad yin la/ khyad par bla ma des dbang bskur ba dang chos 'chad pa sogs kyi dus su/ dus gsum gyi phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad bla ma dam pa de la zhugs nas sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa yin pas/ dus gzhan du brgya 'bul stong 'bul mang po byed pa las kyang / de dus zas kham gcig tsam drangs pa bsod nams che ba yin/ bskyed rim bskom pa'i dus su'ang rnam pa lhag pa'i 33

lha de dang der snang ba las ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma las gzhan du med par shes na byin rlabs 'jug cing / khyad par bskyed rim bsgom pa'i lha yi rigs bdag de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer du ma shes na dngos grub thob pa med de/'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug pa/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung / /rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin/ /'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na//dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs//zhes so/ /rdzogs rim gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yang bla ma'i mos gus dang byin rlabs kho na'i mthus thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skyes pa yin pa'i gnad rnams shes dgos la/khyad par bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi 'phral gyi mngag gzhug dang bang chen du 'gro ba sogs dang / tha na bzhugs khang la phyags dar byas pa tshun chod kyang tshogs kyi lam nor ma ba yin par shes par byas nas rang gi sgo gsum gyi dngos po thams cad kyis bla ma rdo rje slob dpon de nyid mnyes shing tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad pa chen pos brtson par bya zhing / ma dad pa dang 'phya smod byed pa sogs/ bla ma mi mnyes pa'i rgyu gang yin pa rnams sngar bstan pa'i nyes dmigs rnams shes shing dran pa'i sgo nas spong ba la sgo du ma nas 'bad par bya'o//de ltar bla ma bsten pa'i spang blang gi gnad rnams shes pa'i sgo nas/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rnyed nas de nyid dka' ba dang du blang / ngal ba khyad du bsad/ lus srog la mi lta ba'i sgo nas bsten dgos pa yin te/de yang sngon byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi drung du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhu ba'i phyir du ngal dub dang bkres skom gnyid 34

thugs nyin mtshan sogs yid la ma byas par shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de nam thob snyam du sems shing byon nas sher phyin thob pa'i tshe bkur ste bya ba'i ched du rang gi sha tshil khrag rnams btsong ste sku lus la mtshon rnon pos/ lag pa g.yas pa phug ste khrag gzar/ brla g.yas pa sha med par btogs nas rus pa gcog tu rtsig pa'i drung du byon pa sogs kyi dka' ba spyad de byon nas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi drung du phyin kyang / byang sems chos 'phags lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs la de'i tshe'ang nyal 'dug gi spyod lam spangs nas 'greng 'chag gi spyod lam kho nas sher phyin de nam ston par 'gyur snyam du sems shing 'khod do/ /de ltar lo bdun zad nye ba'i 'ag bdun na byang sems chos 'phags ting 'dzin las bzhengs nas chos ston par 'gyur ro zhes rtag tu ngus lha las thos nas chos ston pa'i sa phyogs dpag tshad gcig tshun chad phyags dar byas nas rdul mi ldang ba'i ched du chag chag gdab par rtsom pa na/ bdud kyis chu mi snang bar byas pas/ rtag tu dus rang gi lus kyi rtsa thams cad phug nas khrag gis chag chag btab pas/ brgya byin gyis tsan dan dmar por byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rtag tu ngu 'khor bcas kyis seng khri bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa bshams pa la/byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags byon nas khri la bzhugs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bstan pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya stong phrag drug cu thob/sangs rgyas grangs med pa'i zhal mthong / de nas bzung ste mi lam na yang sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ma bral zhing / da ltar yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgra dbyangs mi 35

zad sgrogs pa'i drung du bzhugs par gsungs so/ /yang paṇa chen nā ro pas/ te lo pa bsten pa'i dus su yang / bla ma'i bka' bsgrub pa'i ched du/ mkhar gyi rtse nas mchongs pas lus brdabs te na tsha dang sdug bsngal dpag med byung ba dang /smyug gshags ring po mang po snum gyis byugs me la bsros nas ngar btags te rkang lag gi sems bar nas drangs pas lus kyi lhu tshigs thams cad brgyangs/na tsha dang sdug bsngal bzod glags med par byas nas zhag mang por sdod bcug pa dang / zhing las byed mi la slongs pas thug pa thod phor gang byin pa bla mar drangs pas thugs shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul bstan pas/yang slong du phyin pas/ ma thob nas 'thung lhag brkus te bros pas zhing pa rnams kyis 'chi la thug pa brdung ba sogs/ de lta bu'i dka' ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi spyad nas mthar bla mas mchil lham nā ro pa'i dpral bar brgyab pas brgyal song / de sangs pa na bla ma'i thugs rgyud kyi yon tan thams cad nā ro pa'i rgyud la skyes nas bla slob dgongs pa dbyer med du gyur pa yin/ de yang dka' ba khyad du bsad de/ bla mas ci gsungs bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas sgrib pa dag cing tshogs rdzogs pa'i stobs kyis de ltar gyur pa yin pas/ bla ma'i dka' sgrub pa las lhag pa'i chos med cing phan yon de tsam che zhing / bla ma'i bka' zur tsam bcag kyang nyes pa che ste/ te lo pas nā ro pa la khyod kyis bi kra ma sh+lau la'i sgo srung ma byed gsungs pas phyis sgo srung mdzad dgos byung bas mu stegs kyi rtsod pa ma thub pas/ bla ma te lo pa byon nas rtsod pa zlog thabs mdzad dgos byung ba lta bu'o/ /yang slob dpon mtsho skyes zhabs la/ /bla mas lus la brdung btag dang / mi'i grong khyer 36

dbus su dma' phab pa sogs kho na mdzad par dad pa ma log cing / dad mos lhag par 'phel bas sgrib pa dag nas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas grub pa thob pa dang / yang bla ma 'brog mi lo tsā ba la/ se mkhar chung bas rang gi nor skal 'bri g.yag sum cu dang / gser la sogs pa'i dngos po gang yod phul te lo bcu gsum la zhing las byed pa sogs kyis bla ma yab yum gyi las ka dka' ba chen pos bgyis shing gre ba bde bas glu sgrung sogs kyis bla ma dgyes te lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ste bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas brtson 'grub chen pos sgrub pa mdzad pas/ grub pa'i dbang phyug se ston kun rig ces grags pa byung ba yin/ yang mar pa lo tsā la/ rje btsun mi la ras pas lus ngag yid gsum phul te chos zhus kyang ma gnang bar/ yar 'brog stag lung pa sogs la ser ba 'beb tu bcug/lho brag la kha ba la mthu byed du bcug yang mkhar skum po zla gam gru gsum rnam brtsigs su bcug nas thams cad phyed tsam grub pa dang / bka' bkyon dang bcas bshigs nas sa rdo rnams rang mal du bskyal bcug pas rgyab chad nas sgal pa yang byung / de nas da lta mjal du yod pa lha mi'i bsod nams gsog pa'i rten mchog mi la'i sras mkhar dgu thog ces pa de bzhengs su bcug /de'i tshe sku lus la skal pa yang mang po byung ba sogs/ de lta bu'i dka' ba spyad de bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs pas sgrib pa dag cing tshogs rdzogs nas bla mas kyang rjes su bzung ste/ dbang gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs par gnang zhing /dbang dus su bde mchog gi lha tshogs mngon sum du bstan/de nas dka' spyad drag pos nyams su blangs pas mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob 37

pa yin/ des na sngon byon rgya bod kyi mkhas grub ji snyed cig yod pa de thams cad kyis kyang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten nas mdzad spyod la log par mi lta zhing / g.yo sgyu dang zol zog med pas bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas/ dka' ba dpag med spyad pas mkhas grub chen po sha stag tu gyur song ba yin pas/ de rnams kyi rjes su slob par byed pa rnams kyis kyang bla ma bsten tshul de lta bur byed dgos pa yin// da lta rang cag rnams ni/ sngon byon sangs rgyas byang sems grub brnyes dpag med byon yang / rang gi las nyon kho na'i dbang du song ba'i nyes pas/ de dag gi thugs rjes gzigs pa'i yul du ma gyur te//zhal tsam yang mjal ba'i skal ba ma byung ba yin te/spyod 'jug las/sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i//sangs rgyas grangs med 'das gyur kyang ///bdag ni rang gi nyes pas des//gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur to//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na da lta mi lus tsam thob kyang snyigs ma lnga bdo/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i mthar thug sdig pa'i grogs dang mi dge ba'i gzhan dbang 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas/ blang dor gyi gnas la mongs pa'i skabs 'dir/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje tshad med pas nye bar dgongs te rang gi skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i gang zag mi'i gzugs su byon nas mdzad spyod rang rgyud dang bstun te thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas rjes su bzung / yang dag pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi sgor bcug /blang dor gyi mig phye/ thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam mchog nor 'khrul med par ston pas/ don du sangs rgyas yin yang bka' drin sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pas bskyangs pa yin pas/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du 38

dad pagasum gyis kun nas bslangs te mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas legs par bstenanas/ ji skad du/ji ltar ma la ya yi nags klung du//rnam par 'khyams pa'i sdong dum phal pa yang / /yal 'dab brlan pas tsan dan dri bsung ltar//gang la brten pa de yi rjes su 'gro /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma bzang po'i kun spyod dngachos kyi tshig don go bas/ de dag gi dri bzang pos gos pa lta bu tha na'ang spang blang dang sgo gsum gyi kun spyod thams cad snga ma las bzang du 'gro ba'i thabs la nges par 'bad dgos pa yin no/ /yang bla ma ma bsten pa 'i nyes dmigs ni/ sngar bla ma bsten dgos pa 'i rgyu mchan dang phan yon sogs kyi ldos phyogs rnams yin pa sa smo sa mi dkos la/ 'ar byung mi dbe ba'i bshes gnyen dang sdig grolas bsten na yon tan rnams 'grib cing / nyes pa thams cad 'phel nas mi 'dod pa thams cad bskyed pas spang bar bya dbos par bstan pa ni/mdo dran pa nyer ba'ag las/ 'dod chags dang /zhe snang dang / gti mug thams cad kyi gzhir gyur nga rmi sdig pa'i grogs po ste/ de ni dus gi sdong po lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / myang 'das las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni grogs ngan pa la 'jigs pa ltar/ glang chen myos pa la sogs pa la 'jigs pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / mdza' bshes kyi tshor/sa las kyang / dad pa med cing 'jungs pa dang / /rdzun du smra dang phra ma can/ /mkhas pas bshes par mi bya zhing / /sdig can mi dang 'grogs mi bya/ /zhis dang / thogs med rin po che'i 'al nas/ sang dang 'grogs na dug gsum 'phel 'gyur zhing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyam sa 'gyur la/ /byam sa dang snying rje me da nga/ra sgyur byed nga 'i/ /grogs ngan spo nga ba rgyal sras las snyo/9

len yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi nyes pa thams cad bskyed cing / yon tan thams cad nyams par 'gyur zhing / log lam la khrid pas grogs ngan pa sdig grogs dang mi 'grogs par spong ba gces so//bzhi pa/ bla slob 'chad nyan bya tshul/bzhi pa bla slob 'chad nyan bya tshul mdor bsdus sheg brjod na/ de'ang bla slob 'brel brtags te/ bla slob mtshan nyid dang ldan pas mdo sngags kyi chos la 'chad nyan ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ dang po bla mas ji ltar 'chad na/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ /sgo gsum kun spyod rnam dag pas/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gus pas bsgrubs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ slob dpon gyis chos gos gsum sogs legs par bgos nas lus nyal ba dang 'khris pa dang / rkang pa brkyang ba sogs spangs nas/ lus drang por bsrangs te/ shākya'i rgyal pos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul du bya//ngag sgra mang po dang / zlos pa dang / skad gdangs zhan pa dang / sgra mtho dman can sogs spangs te/ dbyangs kyi yan lag phun sum tshogs pas gsal la dag par bshad do/ sems kyis rnyed dang bkur ste la ma chags shing nga rgyal phrag dog chags snang sogs spangs te/ yi dam lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pas sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis phan bde la dgod pa'i bsam pas chos kyi char chen dbab par bya snyam pas bshad par bya ste/ bslab btus las/ chos kyi sbyin pa zang zing med/ /bsod nams 'phel ba'i rgyu yin no//zhes gsungs so//slob mas ji ltar nyan pa'i tshul ni/yang 40

'jam mgon bla mas/ nyan pa'i skyon rnams spangs nas ni/ /shes par 'dod pas legs par mnyan//zhes gsungs te/de la chos nyan pa'i skyon gsum//dri ma drug spangs shing byang chub sems bskyed dang ldan zhing lha yi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ bla ma dang chos la dad mos rtse gcig pas nyan dgos la/ de las skyon gsum ni/ rna ba mi gtod kha bub lta bu'i skyon/ /yid la mi 'dzin zhabs rdol lnga bu'i skyon/ /nyon mongs dang 'dres dug can lta bu'i skyon/ /zhes pa ltar dang / dri ma drug ni/ rnam bshad rig pa las/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang / /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang / /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang du sdud/ skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bshad nyan bya ba'i chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /'jam mgon bla mas/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ /mkhas pa las brgyud/ grub thob kyis bsgoms/paṇ+ḍi tas bshad/ /lo tsā bas bsgyur/ rgya gar dang bod kyi sde snod 'dzin pa'i malas pa thams cad la legs par grags pa'i chos la nyan bshad byed dgos/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/rjes la slob dpon gyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab pa'o//slob ma'i bya ba la/gtang rag gi phyag bya ba/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba/ dran shes bzhin gyi rgyun bsten pa'o/ /bsten tshul gru chen dad mos dri bzhin gyis//legs bskyod srid pa'i dug mtsho las bsgral te/ /sku gsum rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa'i/ /bshes sanyen ded dpon mchog de cis mi bsten/ /lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi khrid do//gnyis pa la'ang khyad par dang / thun mong gnyis/ dang po la bla mar gsol ba gdab pa/ kun slong bcos pa/ rlung dang ngag byin gyis brlab cing 41

'gyur sngags bzla ba'o/ /dang po nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor ni dngos gzhi so so'i khrid gzhung las 'byung ba bzhin/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsal btab rjes rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs dgos te/rje btsun grags pa'i zhal nas/thog mar bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te//zhes dang /sa paṇa gyi sdom gsum las/gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin//des na de la gsol btab pas/ /dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub//ces dang /rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las//lam zab mo bla ma'i lam//zhes dang / lam 'bras las kyang / /thog mar rang nyid la gdams ngag ston pa'i bla ma tshad mar bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir du/ /bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus rnam thar la sogs pa legs par mnyan te/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la mos gus tshud tshud du bsgoms shing / gsol ba drag tu gdab pa dang / zhis gsungs la/ gso la ba 'debs pa'i tshul yang / 'jam margon sa paṇa gyi zhal nas/des na dbar bskur thob pa'i mis//dkon mchog gsum po bla ma ru//'dus par mthong nas bla ma la//gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'jug /ces gsungs pa ltar/ phyag 'tshal na mdun gyi nam mkhar ram/ de min rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rang gi yi dam dges pa rdo rje'am/ rnal 'byor ma sogs gang yin dang dbyer med du gsal btab ste/ de nyid bla ma brgyud pa solas skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa 'i ngo bor mos te dad mos shugs drag pos/ bla mam khyen no//zhis grangs ma nga skad gsang sto sdo+od pos brjod cing gsol ba gdab/ sa'an yang tshis rjes ngon dran gyis ming nas ma che ma 12

'khrugs par mos gus drag pos 'di phyi bar do kun tu skyid sdug legs nyes gang byung yang bla ma khyed las re sa gzhan na med pas khyed mkhyen snyam pas/skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po cher/ /skyabs su mchi'o gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol//bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs//dam chos lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phrog med dad pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs//byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyi rlobs//tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs / /zhes ci nus kyis gso la ba btab pas bla mas mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzisas/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes dbongs/ skyob pa'i nus mthus srung ba dang skyob pa dang / byin gyis rlobs par mdzad pa yin snyam du mos la/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang bi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par mos la cung zad mnyam par gzhag rgo /gnyis pa kun slong bsam pa rgya che ba byang chub kyi sems ni/spyod 'jus las/dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni//'bras bu bskyed nas zad pa ra 'gyur pa nyid//byang chub sems kyi ljon zhing rtag par yang / 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel par 'gyur//zhes dang / srid pa 'i sdug bsngal brgya phras gzhom 'dodacing /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bange mang brgya phyas spyod ri/ra 'dod nga sa kyang / /byang chub sem sa nyid rtas tu 43

gtang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi phan yon dang ldan pa'i kun slong byang chub kyi sems ni 'di ltar/ 'khor bar gnas pa rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi thog ma med pa'i dus nas pha ma ma byas pa ni gcig kyang med/pha ma byas pa'i dus su drin chen pos bskyangs/zas kyi phud byin/gos kyi rtse g.yogs shin tu byams pas bskyed bsrings pa'i drin chen sha stag yin la/ drin can de dag thams cad 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang bde ba'i rgyu chos dge bcu sogs sgrub mi shes/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang de'i rgyu mi dge ba bcu spong mi shes par zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song nas lam log mgo rmongs su gyur pa long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i ma rgan sems can 'di rnams snying re rje/ bdag gis da res dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig nyams su blangs te/ pha ma sems can 'di rnams kyi rigs drug so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral te rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa 'di yin/ 'dis ni dge ba che chung ci sgrub kyang byang chub tu sgyur bar byed cing /der ma zad sems bskyed de'i rtsis zin na mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan yang dge ba rdzogs byang gi rgyur sgyur bar byed de/'phags pa lhas bzhi brgya pa las/ bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge rung / /thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te//gang phyir sems de gtso ba'i phyir//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge rtsa de thabs kyis zin par byed pa sbyor ba sems bskyed dam pa/ dge rtsa rkyen gyis mi bshig par byed pa dngos gzhi dmigs pa me da pa dam pa/ dge ba gong nas song du 'phel bar byed pa mjug 44

bsngo ba'i rgyas yongs su thebs pa'i dam pa ste dam pa gsum gyi rtsis zin pa 'di chos 'chad nyan lha bsgom pa sngags bzla ba phyag bskor sogs dge rtsa che phra gang byed kyang ma brjed par bya dgos so//gsum pa ni lus gnad dang ldan pas rlung ro dgu'am gsum sangs kyis bus pas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad phyir bton par bsam/ de nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci 'grub byas pas rlung byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang gi lce pad+ma 'dab ma gcig pa'i steng du āḥyig gi mthar dbyangs gsal gyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus te thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag par bsams te/ oṃ a ā sogs nas i maḥka kha sogs nas ha k+ṣa swāhā/ ye dharma sogs lan sasum brjod la ā ༷yig dbyangs gsal sogs rtse la thim pas ngag nus ldan du bsams la/ bdag gi rtse yi dbang po la//bde gshegs spobs pa ldan par shog /tsheg gi gzi brjid mthu des mi/ / sams can thams cad 'dul bar shog /bdag gis tshig ni ci smras pa'i//don de thams cad 'grub par shog /ces brjod/ 'gyur sngags ni/ oṃ sa ra sa ra bi ma na sā ra mahā dza wa r+ghaṃ/ sngags 'di tshar gcig brjod na sngags gang bzlas brgya stong du 'gyur ro/ /oṃ sma ra sma ra bi ma na sā ra mahā dzam+bha ye swāhā/ lan bdun brjod na dge ba gang byas thams cad 'bum du 'gyur ro//oṃ dha re dha re bharnya re swāhā/lan gcig brjod na dge ba gang byas grangs med du 'gro'o//zhes gsungs so// 45

lam thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i skor/gnyis pa thun mong gi sngon 'gro la go rim spyir jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa skyes bu chung ngu'i lam/ bar du 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pa skyes bu 'bring gi lam/tha mar byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa skyes bu chen po'i lam/zhes bo rim/ de ltar 'chad mod/'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa'i man ngag gi gnad kyis so rim 'di ltar ston te/ yid 'byung bskyed de chos la 'jug phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmisas ston pa'i khrid/ chos la brtson 'grus bskyed phyir dal 'byor rnyed dka'i khrid/chos la myu ra du 'ju phyir 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i khrid/spang blang tshul bzhin shes phyir dkar nag las 'bras ston pa'i khrid/rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i khrid dang lnga las/dang po/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/dang po 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston pa'i man ngag gi gnad ni/ de'ang 'khor ba spangs te thar pa thob pa ra byed pa la 'khor bar zhen pa bzlog dgos/de bzlog pa la 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes dgos te/ rje btsun grags pa'i zhal /rdo/mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/lams gsum la zhin pa spong yang 'tshal/ /

'khor ba la zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran par 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo las kyang / 'dod pa'i khams ni skyon dang bcas pa ste/ /gzugs kyi khams kyang skyon dang bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin gzugs med khams kyang skyon dang bcas//mya ngan 'das pa 'ba' zhig skyon med mthong / /zhes so/ /des na 'di man gyi nyams len thams cad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin te/ thar pa thob byed kyi lam du bsgrub pa'i gnad kyis so/ /'o na 'khor ba na sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod ce na/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams//yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams/ /dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams/ /mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams/ /lha min 'thab cing rtsod pas nyams/ /lha dag bag med pa yis nyams/ /'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la//bde ba nam yang yod ma yin//zhes so/ /de dag gi sdug bsngal so sor bsam pa la/ skyo ba skye phyir sdug bsngal sdug bsngal bsgom/zhen pa spong phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom/ /thar 'dod skye phyir 'du byed sdug bsngal bsgom pa'o//dang po ni/ rje btsun rin po che'i mgur las/ dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin/ /de legs par bsam na skyi sha 'bung / /thog tu babs na bsran thabs med//spong ba'i dge ba mi ba ba par//ngan song gi so nam byed byed po//de gang na 'dug kyang the le le//zhes dang / bra ston zhus lan las kyang / sdug bsngal sdug bsngal ngan song gsum gyi gnas/ /mdze nad shu ba'i steng du rma 'bras bzhin/ /legs par bsam na bsran par ga la nus//de bsams mi dge'i las las ldog par bya//zhes gsungs 47

pa ltar/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin te/ de yang spyir 'khor ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin pa'i steng du'ang 'di rnams sdug bsngal ches lci bas nyis lngab lta bur song ba'i cha nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ba yin la/ /dpe nad mdze drag po'i khar shu ba dang rma 'bras phog pas mtshon pa ste/ de la'ang dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro ste gsum/ dang po la grang dmyal/tsha dmyal/ nye 'khor/ nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa las/ thog mar grang dmyal gyi sdug bsngal ston pa ni/ sa skya pa'i lam 'bras rang gi bzhed pa la/ gang zag 'ga' zhig thog mar sdug bsngal che shos tsha dmyal bshad na dbugs stod du 'tshang ba dang / kha nas khrag skyug pa la sogs pa 'byung srid pas/ thog mar sdug bsngal chung shos grang dmyal nas rim bzhin 'brid cing bshad pa dang / tsha dmyal re re'i phyogs bzhi na nye 'khor ba rnams yod pa dang / nyi tshe ba rnams kyang de ma thag tu ston pas des na 'brel chags su 'chad pa la dgongs pa yin gsungs/ de la'ang / chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can//a chu kyi hud so tham byed pa dang //ut+pal ltar gas pad+ma ltar gas dang //pad+ma chen po ltar gas grang dmyal brgyad/ /ces pa ltar brgyad yod la/ de dag tu ji ltar skye ba'i tshul ni/ rang rang so so'i tshe las bsod nams gsum zad pa na mar me snum zad gang gis kyang mi bzlog pa ltar thim gyis 'chi ba'i tshe 'od gsal ngo ma shes par dran med du brgyal/ /de las 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung du bar srid du langs nas/ bar dor zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu sogs sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bzhin pa'i ngang nas bar dor zhag du sdod pa de'i 48

phyed phyi ma phan chad gang du skye 'gyur gyi bar srid du 'char bas dmyal bar skye ba de sdong dum mam phyar ba lta bu nag ling nge ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ bsnam bya'i 'od kyang nag po la zin pas snang ba thams cad nag 'thom me pa'i khrod nas las kyi gshin rje dang lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre la sogs pa 'jigs su rung ba la las zhags pa nag pos mdun nas khrid/ la las sod sod rgyob rgyob kyi sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs shing rgyab nas mtshon cha me 'bar bas deg bzhin pas ded nas rang dbang med par g.yang sa chen po la lhung ba bzhin du byi'u tshugs su nag na ra ra song nas gang du skye ba'i gnas der slebs pa na dran med du brgyal te shi ba lta bur song / de las sad ma thag sngar las ngan ji ltar bsags pa'i dbang gis dmyal ba so so'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa las/ dang po chu bur can ni las dbang gis lus bongs che la gzhon sha chags pa grang bsran shin tu chung ba zhig tu brdzus te skye bar byed do/ /de'ang 'og gzhi thams cad kha ba'i thang dang 'khyags pa'i gcong rong chen po mtha' thams cad gangs ri'i phreng bas go mtshams med par bskor ba/ mun pa mun nag gi gling steng nas kha ba bu lug gi 'tshubs ma rlung drag po dang bcas 'u ru ru 'bab pa/ yib pa'i skyibs byi'u shong ba tsam yang med pa/ dro ba'i gos lhan pa'i dum bu tsam yang med la/ snang ba'i dngos po skar ma'i 'od tsam yang med pa/ pha 'bod ma 'bod byas kyang skyob pa'i grogs byi'u tsam yang med par rang gcig pur grang pa'i rkyen gyis lus la chu bur grangs med pa skya rog ge ba'i ngang nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos la/ chu bur rdol pa can ni/ de bas kyang grang ba'i reg bya nyis 'gyur 49

gyis che bas chu bur thams cad kyang thag sgra dang thog sgra dang bcas te gas/rnag khrag zags pa rnams kyang 'khyags gong du gyur/ chu bar rdol ba de dag gi nang nas kyang lcags kyi 'bu mchu rnon can don nas rus pa thams cad thal byung du phug ste dmyal tshe 'khyol dus med pa'i bar du sdug bsngal la spyod dgos pa dang /a chu zer ba ni/grang ba'i sdug bsngal che drags pas gzhan bya thabs ye med par a chu zer ba'i sdug skad lhang lhang 'don pa dang / kyi hud zer ba ni grang drags pas skad ngan yang 'don mi thub par kye hud ces shib shib por 'don pa tsam la brten pa dang / so tham tham pa ni skad shib shib po de'ang 'don mi nus par so khrig khrigaskog ma tham tham pa dang /ut+pal ltar gas pa ni/rlung chen pos grang ba'i ngad chen po de brgyab nas rnag khrag gi gong bu rnams kyang yud kyis bshus/pags pa sngo thing nge ba de lhag ge thon/ de'ang thag sgra dang bcas te tshal ba brgyad dam bcu drug la sogs par gas nas mdog ut+pal ltar sngo ba'i cha nas ut+pal ltar gas pa dang / pad+ma ltar gas pa ni/ rlung grang ba'i ngad kyis pags pa sngon po de yud kyis bshus pa'i 'og nas sha'u dmar po dmar lhag ge thon/de'ang tshal ba bcu drug nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs par gas pa dang / pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ni/ tshal pa de dag kyang grangs med par 'thor zhing gas/ lus kyi nang khrol don snying thams cad tsheg sgra dang bcas te gas/ lus phyi dang log pa'i tshul du song yang las ma zad pas 'chi mi nus pa yin no/ /mdzod las/ chu bur can sogs grang brgyad gzhan//zhes gsungs la/ de lta bu'i grang dmyal brgyad kyi tshe tshad ni/ mdzod las/til rdzang nang nas lo brgya zhing /til gcig phyung bas zad 50

gyur pa//chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shus 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ yul ma gad+ma'i bre bo che'i til khal brgyad cu yod pa'i snod gcig ni til rdzang gcig yin la/ de nas mi lo brgya brgya nas/ til re re phyir dor bas til de thams cad zad par gyur pa'i dus kyi mtha' ni chu bur can gyi tshe tshad yin la/gzhan bdun gyi tshe tshad ni snga ma snga ma las nyi shur 'gyur te/mdo las/chu bur can gyi tshe nyi shu ji lta ba bzhin du chu bur rdol ba can gcig go /zhes pa nas pad+ma ltar gas pa nyi shu ji lta ba bzhin pad+ma ltar cher gas pa gcig go /zhes gsungs so/ /grang dmyal de rnams su skye ba'i las ni/ bla ma dkon mchog gi dkor zos pa dang / mar me'i 'bar 'phro bsad pa dang / lha'i na bza' dang thang sku'i gong sham bshus pa dge 'dun spyi shing 'phrog pa na bza' 'phrog pa ja dang tshod ma sogs dron mo mi ster ba sogs dkon mchog la brten pa dang / che ba mi rta glang po sogs nas chung ba shig sro yan chad kyi sems can chur bskyur ba/gangs dang 'khyags rong du 'phangs pa sogs mdor na grang ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa de thams cad ni rnam pa 'dra bas 'dra ba bskyed pa zhes bya ba yin la/mdor na zhe snang gtso bor gyur ba'i dug gsum drag pos bskyed pa'i las mi dge ba mtha' dag yin la/ des na sngar bstan pa de dag kyang dpe ltas lta bu'i sgom yol du ma bzhag par nyams len byed dgos/ de yi tshul yang kye ma bdag bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol zhig nas dus da ltar gyi bar du 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir 'khyams shing sdug bsngal gyi chu bo grangs med pas sdug bsngal bar gyur la/ da dung yang gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul 'khor 'di ma zhig gi bar du 51

'gro drug gi gnas su rang dbang med par skye zhing sdug bsngal grangs med pa myong dgos par 'dug de yi nang nas kyang grang ba'i dmyal bar skyes na gnas ni de lta bu/ ngo bo sdug bsngal ni de lta bu/ tshe tshad ni de lta bur 'dug snyam du chu bur can nas pad+ma ltar cher gas pa'i bar rim bzhin bsam/ de lta bu'i gnas su skyes na bzod cing bsran thub pa'i yul ni med de/ da lta mi yul du dgun 'khyags khrod du rkang pa'am lag mgo tsam bcug nas zhag gcig kyang tshugs thabs med la/grang dmyal gyi gnas de lta bur mi skye ba'i gdeng ni med cing / skye nges pa'i las dug gsum drag pos nyin re la'ang gang byas dang 'di byas med pa byas yod pas skye thag chod/ skyes na de 'dra'i sdug bsngal la bzod thabs dang thar dus mi 'dug pas ci nas kyang der mi skye ba zhig byed dgos/ de la dam pa'i chos nyams su len dgos/ des na da lta 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba dgra 'dul gnyen skyong / dkor grong chog tshong so nam sogs la dka' ba dang du blangs/ ngal ba khyad du bsad de 'bad kyang 'grub dus dang ngoms tshims med pa nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon la thob re byas pa lta bu'i snying po med pa rnams blos btang ste/ dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig bsgrub par bya'o snyam du dam bca' ba dang / dam chos rnam dag 'grub par bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / sdig pa byas pa la 'gyod sems drag pos bshags sdom bya zhing grang dmyal der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje yang yang du bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ ji ltar skye ba'i tshul gi/ sngar bshad pa ltar gnas der skye 52

ba'i las bsags pa de'i bar srid gshin rje'i pho nyas sdigs bzhin par khrid/spyi'atshugs su nag na ra ra song ste gnas der slebs pa na dran med du brgyal/de las sad ma thag dmyal ba'i lus dbyibs sogs sngar bstan pa rnams dang 'dra ba las/ lus bongs che zhing gzhon sha chags pa/ sha'u ltar tsha bsran chung ba zhig tu brdzus te skye'o/ /de'ang / yang sos thig dag bsdus 'joms dang //ngu 'bod du 'bod chen po dang / /tsha ba rab tsha mnar med brgyad//ces gsungs pa ltar brgyad yod cing / de dag gi gnas ni mdzod las//'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na tsha dmyal bdun/ /zhes pa ltar/'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na mnar med yod la/de'i steng na rim bzhin yang sos kyi bar yod la/ de thams cad kyi byi khyab kyi gnas ni/ 'og gzhi thams cad lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me 'bar bzhin pa dang bcas pa/mtha' thams cad lcags bsregs kyi 'obs dang ra bas bskor ba/steng 'og kun tu me rtse rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i nang der dmyal ba pa de skyes ma thag lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi me 'bar bas 'tshig cing skrag pas phyogs thams cad du 'bros shing mgon skyabs tshol ba'i bsam pas 'tshig bzhin du rgyug kyang bros sa dang mgon skyabs med pa'i khar dgra mi sha bo lta bu'i dmyal srung gi gshin rje khro zhing rngam pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa mang pos bskor zhing / rgyob sod kyi nga ro drag po dang bcas te/ thag ring nas lcags bsregs kyi mda' dang mda' bo che la sogs pa 'phen/ de bas nye ba na mdung dang mdung thung la sogs pa dang / 'khris su slebs pa rnams kyis ral gri dang sta re la 53

sogs pa'i mtshon cha du ma bsnun pas lus thams cad thal byung du phug ste lus dum bur gtubs shing mes gzhob thul du song nas dran med du brgyal ba na/bar snang stong pa nas yang sos par gyur cig /ces sgra lhang gis grag pa dang mnyam du rlung grang mo zhig sir gyis byung bas rkyen byas lus sngar bzhin grub ste langs/ yang sngar bzhin du gyur te mun pa mun nag chen po'i gnas de na sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad par myong dgos pa ni yang sos pa yin te/spyod 'jug las/gshin rje'i skyes bus pags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing / rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zungs zhun lus la blugs gyur la//'bar ba'i ral gri mdung byung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar lhag cing / /shin tu 'bar ba'i lcags kyi sa gzhir lhung ba mi dge mang pos 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /thig nag ni gzhan thams cad snga ma bzhin las/ der skyes pa'i dmyal ba pa de dmyal srung rnams kyis bzung nas lus la dkyus dang phred la sogs par thig nag po brgyad dang bcu drug so gnyis la sogs pa btab/ lcags bsregs kyi sog le me 'bar bas sbyi bo nas bshags te lte bar slebs pa na stod kyi rma thams cad rjes med par sos/yang mgo mjug ldog ste gshags pas sog le stod du slebs pa na smad kyi rma thams cad rjes med du sos te/ de lta bu'i dal med du gshogs pa dang / lcags kyi ste'u me 'bar bas gzhog pa dang /gzong gis 'bug pa la sogs ji tsam byas kyang las ma zad kyi bar du 'chi ba'i skabs med pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos te/bshes thing las/ kha cig sog le 'dra ste de bzhin gzhan/ /sta re mi bzad so rnon rnams kyis gshags/ /zhes so//bsdus 'joms ni dmyal ba pa de lcags bsregs 54

sa gzhi la bros pa'i tshe ra lug g.yag la sogs pa rang gis gang bsad pa de'i gdong pa can gyi lcags bsregs kyi ri dmar ye re ba phan tshun brgyugs byung ba na/ nga pha gi'i dbrag tu ma shor ba 'ong ngam snyam ste bros pa dang / de gnyis thug gis 'phrad pa'i bar du btsir bas rgyu sto thams cad phyir lud lus thams cad thal ba bun bun gzhob thul du song /ri gnyis phyir gyes ma thag lus sngar bzhin grub/ yang sngar bzhin bcir ba'i sdug bsngal dang des mtshon pa'i lcags kyi phyar ba me 'bar ba'i nang du btums te kha bcings te bzhag pas lus thams cad gzhob thul du song / kha byes pa na lus sngar bzhin grub/ yang kha bcings pa dang / lcags kyi zhib ma me 'bar ba'i nang du bcug ste/ lcags kyi gtun me 'bar bas brdung ba sogs mdo so so'i dgongs par gsungs so/ /bshes spring las/ kha cig til bzhin 'tshir te de bzhin gzhan/ /phye ma zhib mo bzhin du phye mar rlog/ces so//ngu 'bod pa ni/ de ltar lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi sogs sdug bsngal de dag gis 'jigs shing skrag nas bros pa na/ khang pa dkar po zhig mthong pha gir phyin na bde ba yod snyam ste phyin pas lcags bsregs kyi khang pa me 'bar ba zhig gi nang du tshud cing sgo rang 'grigs su song ste sdug bsngal gyis nyen pas a tsha dang / ngu 'bod lhang lhang byed pa las thabs gzhan med pa'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags bsregs kyi khang pa me 'bar ba nyis rim gyi nang du tshud pas lus sreg pa'i sdug bsngal dang /sems la khang pa nang ma las thar kyang phyi ma las mi thar ro snyam du sdug bsngal ches lci bas ngu 'bod snying gi dkyil nas phyung ba lta bu cher sgrogs pa'o/ /tsha ba pa ni dmyal ba pa de dmyal srung rnams kyis 55

bzung nas lcags bsregs kyi gsal shing ral gri so gnyis ma lta bu me 'bar bzhin pa bshang lam nas btsugs te spyi bor bton pas lus kyi nang khrol don snying thams cad gzhob thul gyis 'tshig kha sna thams cad nas me rtse dang du ba 'dres pa nyug nyug thon/spyi bo nas kyang gsur khag dang du ba 'dres pa bun gyis thon gsal shing phyir phyung ba na lus sngar bzhin grub/ de lta bu'i 'byin 'jug skad cig kyang dal ba med par byed pa dang / rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags kyi gsal shing rtse gsum pa bshang lam dang 'phongs tshos gnyis nas brgyab te spyi bo dang phrag pa gnyis su phug ste sngar bzhin du bsregs pa yin te/ de nyid las/ kha cig lcags kyi gsal shing me 'bar ba/ /tsher ma can la kun tu brgyud par bgyid/ /ces gsungs la/ yang mdo sde las brgya par/ lcags kyi phru ba gcig tu 'tshed pa dang phru ba sum thog byas pa la rim bzhin 'tshed pa la tsha ba dang rab tu tsha ba'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /mnar med ni lcags bsregs kyi thab ka dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu yod pa'i nang du dmyal ba pa de bcug ste phyogs mtshams kun nas lcags bsregs kyi me 'bar bas me dang lus tha mi dad pa la ngu ba sogs kyi skad ngan las sems can yod par shes pa tsam ma gtogs lus mi mngon pa'i sdug bsngal drag po bzod dka' bas dus rtag tu mnar ba ste/ de nyid las/ bde ba kun gyi nang na sred zad pa/ /bde ba'i bdag por bgyid pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang na ni/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi bzad/ /ces gsungs te/ mdor na srid gsum na 'di las che ba'i sdus bsngal med cing sdug bsngal dras pos bar mtshams med par mnar ba'o/ 'di rnams byi tshe tshad 56
