ni/mdzod las/mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la//'dod pa dag gi lha rnams kyi//'og ma rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig /des na tshe lo lnga brgya 'o//gong ma gnyis ka nyis 'gyur ro/ /yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don mi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya ni rgyal chen ris bzhi pa'i tshe tshad yin zhing / /de nyid zhag gcig tu rtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya yang sos pa'i tshe tshad do/ /de bzhin du mi lo brgya la zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo stong ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe tshad/ de 'ag tu byas pa'i rang lo stong thig nag pa'i tshe tshad/ mi lo nyis brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong 'thab bral ba'i tshe chad/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo nyis stong bsdus 'joms pa'i tshe tshad/ mi lo bzhi brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo bzhi stong dga' ldan pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag gcig tu byas ba'i rang lo bzhi stong ngu 'bod pa'i tshe tshad/ mi lo brgyad brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong 'phrul dga' ba'i tshe tshad/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo brgyad stong ngu 'bod chen po pa'i tshe tshad/ mi lo stong drug brgya la zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad/ de zhag tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong tsha ba pa'i tshe tshad//rab tu tsha ba bar bskal phyed dang /ma nar med pa sa bar bskal gcig thub bo/ /tsha dmyal de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu rmi spyir zhi sdang drag pos kun nas bslangs pa'i srog gcod sogs mi dbe ba mtha' 5 /

dag dang / khyad par mnar med du skye ba'i las ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku la bsdos pa mtshams med lnga byas pa rnams der skye ba yin zhing mar gyi zang thal zhes pa'ang de yin no/ /de nas kye ma 'khor ba 'di ni shin tu sdug bsngal gyi gnas te khyad par yang sos nas mnar med kyi bar gyi tsha dmyal rnams kyi gnas ni de lta bu/ ngo bo ni de lta bu/ tshe tshad ni de lta bur 'dug snyam ste/ dmyal gnas de rnams su rang la dngos su sdug bsngal de dag myong byung bsams te yun ring du sgom par byed/ de nas da lta bdag gi lus la mtshon phra mo phog pa dang / me lce phra mos reg pa dang / me stag phra mos phog pa'i sdug bsngal tsam yang mi bzod na tsha dmyal gyi sdug bsngal de lta bu thog tu babs na ci ste bzod ces sogs sngar grang dmyal gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin chos sgrub 'dod dang / snying rje bsgom pa sogs bya'o/ /gsum pa nye 'khor dang / nyi tshe'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la gnyis las/ dang po nye 'khor ba ni/ me mur ro myags spu gri'i lam//ral gri shal ma li dang chu/ /zhes spu gri dang ral gri'i nags dang shal ma li gsum ni mtshon cha'i rigs su gcig pas grangs gcig tu byas nas gzhan gsum dang bcas pa'i bzhi ni tsha dmyal brgyad po kun gyi mtha' bskor nas phyogs bzhi na bzhi bzhi tshang bar yod de/mdzod las/brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags 'dam/ /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /zhes dngos su bzhi smos shing sogs khong nas ral gri'i nags dang shal ma li gnyis bstan to/ /de la dang po me ma mur ni tsha dmyal dngos gzhi myong dgos kyi las zad pa na dmyal ba'i sems can de dmyal srung gshin rjes ded cing 58

skrag nas bros pa na shar phyogs su sngar med pa'i lam gyi rnam pa zhig thal gyis shar/ /de bzhin du thang skya thal le ba zhig mthong bar/ /sngar yun ji snyed kyi bar du lcags bsregs me 'bar ba kho na las ma mthong / der lam zhig dang thang skya thal le ba zhig mthong bas sems bde ba'i khul dang / rgyab nas ded pa'i dbang gis myur bar phyin pa na me ma mur gyi 'obs kha thal skya mas chod pa lta bu de'i thog tu slebs/ rkang pa gang nub tshad thams cad sha nus bral te rus pa dkar sangs kyis thon/ zug ma bzod par 'gyel lus thams cad me ma mur bzod dka' ba des 'tshig cing sha thams cad bral/ rus pa dkar thal gyis song yang las ngan gyi dbang gis 'chi mi nus par steng du thon pa na lus skyon med sngar bzhin grub/ yang sngar bzhin 'obs su bying ba na 'tshig de'i mtha' phan tshun nas dmyal srung rnams kyis sdigs bzhin par bsrungs te thar sa med par mi lo brgya tsam gyi bar du bzod glag med pa'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ro myags kyi 'dam ni/ de las thar pa na/ yang de'i pha gi na 'bab chu sngo seng nge ba zhig byung snyam pa 'byung / /der 'gro 'dod kyi bsam pa drag pos bros pa'i tshe dmyal srung rnams kyis lam btang ste rgyab nas ded bzhin du phyin pas ro myags kyi 'dam zhes pa ngo bo ni dmyal ba'i sems can shi ba'i ro rul myags pa'i ljan ldin las grub pa/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba skyug bro zhing mi gtsang ba'i rang bzhin dri tshor ba tsam gyis brgyal nas srog 'gag nus pa zhig yod/des na phyi yi lcags ri 'di 'dzam bu gling pa spyi yi bsod nams las grub pa ste/ 'dis bsgribs pa ma gtogs dmyal ba ro myags kyi dri tshor na sems can rnams de ma thag 'chi ba 59

yin mod/ dmyal ba'i sems can de las ngan gyi dbang gis 'chi mi thub par 'dam rdzob de'i gting du bying kha sna sogs dbang po'i sgo thams cad mi gtsang bas 'gags/'dam rdzob de'i khrod nas lcags kyi 'bu mchu rnon can grangs med pas rkang pa'i rus pa thams cad thal byung du phug zug gis ma bzod par 'gyel bubs lus 'tshig myags de lta bu'i ngang la mi lo brgya tsam la gnas dgos pa'o/ /gsum pa spu gri'i lam ni/ de lta bu'i myong dgos kyi las zad pa na/yang dmyal sung rnams kyis shar phyogs kyi lam de mi srung bar 'bros su 'jug /der phyin pas de'u gsing lta bu sngo ting nge ba zhig mthong / pha gir skyid po yod snyam mgyogs par phyin pas thang de ni spu gri gcod pa'i rno ngar dang ldan pa/ che ba byang shing tsam nas chung ba mtho gang tsam/ tshon gang tsam gyi bar gyis go mtshams med par gtams pa de 'dra ba zhig tu slebs/ rkang pa bzhag ma thag nyal nyal gtubs/zug gis ma bzod par 'gyel/spu gri che ba rnams kyis 'gyel ma thag lus thams cad dum bu brgya stong du nyal nyal gtubs/ yang langs ma thag lus sngar bzhin grub/ yang gtub pa de lta bu'i ngang la mi lo brgya tsam gyi bar du sdod dgos pa yin/ de las thar ba na nags tshal mthug po sngo jibs se yid du 'ong ba zhig mthong / der mgyogs par phyin nas grib ma la sdod pa'i khul byas ma thag /dus ma yin pa'i rlung drag po 'ur sgra dang bcas te langs/des shing de rnams bskyod pa'i dbang gis de dag gi yal ga dang lo ma thams cad ral gri dang sta re la sogs pa mtshon cha rno ngar dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa char bzhin babs/ lus thams cad dum bu brgya stong grangs med par 60

bcad cing gtubs kyang 'chi bar mi nus par de lta bu'i ngang la mi lo brgya tsam gnas dgos pa ni ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal yin/ de lta bu'i myong dgos kyi las zad pa na/ de nas thar te bros phyin pas spang ri sngo sang nge ba zhig mthong ste der phyin pas rtsa bar slebs pa na khyi sre bo chen po dang /se rgod ma la sogs pa'i gcan gzan gtum po ma rungs pa mang pos rub ste gsod por zos lus thams cad zad rgyu sto thams cad byung ste sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong bzhin pa'i ngang la ri de'i rtse nas sngar rang gi chags yul du gyur pa'i skyes pho mo gang rung gis ming nas lhang lhang 'bod cing khyod gang na yod 'di ru shog zer 'bod pa'i skad byung / de thos ma thag de yid la 'dod pa'i chags sems dang gcan gzan de dag la 'jigs sems lhan cig pas mgyogs par 'dzegs pa na lcags kyi tsher ma rnon po sor bcu drug gi tshad tsam pa go mtshams med par skyes pa de dag kha thur du phyogs pas lus thams cad khrol tshags ltar phug khrag chu 'babs par byed pa'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin ri rtser slebs pa na chags yul du gyur pa de dag ni yod pa lta ci byung ba'i shul tsam yang mi 'dug pas yi mug cing ga chad la ci bya zad pa na yang bya 'dam zan zhes bya ba gshog pa dpag tshad bcu drug tsam yod pa/ des mtshon pa'i bya ma rungs pa mang po thib thib slebs de dag gis klad pa 'bru mig phyung lus thams cad dum bur byas shing zos pa na lus rim gyis sngar bzhin grub ste sdug bsngal 'di'o zhes brjod du med pa myong / yang ri'i rtsa ba nas sngar bzhin bos thur la chags sems dang 'jigs sems kyis mchongs shing 'gril gyin phyin pas lcags kyi tsher ma thams 61

cad kha gyen la phyogs pas lus thams cad phug rtsa bar slebs tsa na chags yul grogs sogs ni rjes tsam yang med khyi sogs kyis za ba ste de lta bu'i 'bab 'jog gi ngang la mi lo brgya tsam sdod dgos pa'o//de skad du bshes spring las/ kha cig lcags kyi mche ba ldan pa'i khyi/ /gtum pos dbad cing lag pa gnam du bsgring //dbang med gzhan dag lcags mchu rnon po dang / /sen mo mi bzad ldan pa'i khu rnams 'thog /ces so//bzhi pa chu bo rab med ni/yang bye ma'i thang lta bu zhig mthong nas rgyug phyin pa na thal tshan nam 'gyur byed kyi chu bo rab med ces bya ba dbyibs spang me lta bu'i me tshabs chen gyi khrod du chu blug na shin tu tsha zhing 'phyur ba de lta bu bzod dka' ba'i nang du lhung ma thag sha thams cad rjes med du 'tshig rus pa dkar lhag ger gyur kyang 'chi bar mi nus pa de'i mtha' dmyal srung mtshon cha thogs pa rnams kyis sdigs bzhin pas bsrungs te 'bros sa dang thar sa ni ci'ang yang med cing 'tshig cing mi thar bzhin du brgal dgos pa de lta bu'i ngang la mi lo brgya tsam sdod dgos pa yin/ de nas kyang dmyal srung rnams kyis kha nang du bltas te ded pas 'jigs bzhin du lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhir phyogs bslad pa bzhin du slebs par gyur/ der sngar shin tu nyam nyes pa'i sdug bsngal myong ba de dran te rings par lho phyogs su bros pas sngar me ma mur nas chu bo rab med kyi bar myong ba ji lta ba/ nub dang byang du'ang de kho na bzhin myong dgos par gsungs so/ /de nas de dag gi so so'i gnas dang sdug bsngal rnams rang la dngos su skyes pa yun ring du bsgom/ de nas sdug bsngal de dag sems thog tu blangs pa tsam la sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag de 62

tsam 'dug na/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyang rang gi skye ba snga ma'i pha ma sha stag yin pa dang / da lta'i pha ma mdza' bshes shi ba rnams kyang der ma skyes pa'i nges pa ni med la/ dmyal gnas de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu yi gtso bo ni zhe sdang gis bsags pa'i las yin/ rang res kyang tshe rabs 'di dang 'khor ba thog med nas zhe snang gi las ni dpag tu med pa zhig bsags yod pas der skye nges/des na da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal gdams ngag zab mo thob rang gis rang ma bslus na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub tu yod pa'i skabs su/ dmyal gnas de dag tu skye ba'i las phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' drag po bya zhing / dam pa'i chos kha chos tsam ma yin par don chos rnam par dag pa zhig bsgrub snyam pa dang / de ltar 'grub par bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba yang yang 'debs shing / der skyes pa'i pha mar gyur ba'i sems can de rnams la snying rje bsgom zhing / sems can de dag thams cad gnas ngan pa de las da lta nyid du thar bar gyur cig snyam pa'i smon lam gdab pa sogs la brtson par bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ gong ma de dag la ltos na sdug bsngal med tshod yin pas nyi tshe ba zhes btags pa yin la/de'ang rnam grangs 'di tsam mo zhes nges pa med mod/'on kyang mdo sde brgyad cu tsam gyi don bsdus nas rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab btus su rnam grangs bco brgyad tsam gsungs pa las/ dang po tshe dang ldan pa dpal ldan zhes bya ba bya rgod phung po'i ri la yar byon pa dang /'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu ri rtse nas mar byon pa lam bar du mjal ba na/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus nam mkha' la 63

gzigs te 'dzum par mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes dpal ldan gyis zhus pa na nyi tshe'i dmyal ba mo'u 'gal gyi bus rdzu 'phrul gyis bstan pa dpal ldan gyis gzigs pa ni bya rgod phung po'i ri nas par tsam gyi bar snang stong pa la/ mi dbyibs lus tshad khang pa gnyis tsam byas pa la/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad me 'bar ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba zhig 'dug /de bshad pa phyugs mang po gsod pa der skyes pa dang / de nas tshur tsam gyi bar snang la yang mi'i rnam pa lus kyi sha pags thams cad phyir lug nas rked pa man chad keng rus la chu rgyus brang breng gis sgrol ba lta bu yod/ de bshan pa'i slob dpon zhes bya ba phyugs bshan pa la gtod mkhan dang / de nas tshur tsam gyi bar snang la mi'i rnam pa lus bongs che ba zhig la 'bras bu ri'i gtos tsam thur du 'phyang ba lus dang 'bras bu'i bar sha'i thag pa rta rnga tsam gyis sbrel nas sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong ba zhig 'dug pa ni rta bong sogs phyugs bya gcod pa'i rnam par smin pa de ltar myong ba ste gsum/dge 'dun sung gi rtogs brjod las byung ba ni/dge 'dun gyi gzhong pa sogs ma rung bar byas pa dang / rang gi don du spyad pa sogs kyi rnam smin gzhing pa lta bu dang phru ba lta bu dang / phyags shing lta bu dang / gtun ril lta bu dang / gtsug lag khang gi ka ba dang jig pa gral gdan sogs la mi gtsang ba byugs pa'i rnam smin ka ba rtsig pa thag pa gral gdan lta bu'i dmyal ba zhes pa de dang de lta bu'i rnam pa rtag tu bkol zhing spyod pa'i gzugs su 'du shes pas sdug bsngal de dag myong dgos pa dang / dge 'dun la zhabs tog byed mkhan gyis ser sna'i dbang gis de ring byed rgyu sang lta bur 'gyangs pa'i rnam smin 64

mi'i dbyibs la stod smad kyi bar chad la khad pa lta bur song nas nyam thag pa dang / dge 'dun la bsngos pa'i lo ma rang gi nye du sogs la byin pa'i rnam smin sdong po/ yal ga me tog 'bras bu lta bu'i dmyal ba zhes bya ba rnam pa shing sdong sogs su snang yang /ngo bo sems can yin pas gzhan gyis gcod pa dang /za ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa dang / rna ba bye ba nyi shu pa las gsungs pa ni/ smad tshong ma sogs kyis nyin mo bsnyen gnas bsrungs/nam la 'dod log spyad pa'i rnam smin/ nyin mo rin po che'i gzhal med khang na lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod cing bde skyid mtha' yas par 'dug pa la/nyi ma rgas tsam na gzhal yas khang lcags bsregs kyi khang pa me 'bar bar gyur/lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyang lcags kyi spyang ki me 'bar bar gyur te 'tshig bzhin du za ba dang / 'drad pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa la nam langs pa na sngar bzhin gyur te bde bar gnas pa dang /bshan pas nyin mo srog bcad mtshan mo bsnyen gnas bsrungs pas/ gong las go ldog te sdug bsngal myong ba dang / de bzhin du rgya mtsho'i 'gram na dge 'dun gyi sde zhig 'dug pa der byon pas/ gung tshigs kyi gaṇ+ḍi brdungs nas dge 'dun gyi rnam pa can mang po 'dus byung ba na/ khong la'ang gung tshigs sngon la byin nas ma legs pa ma mthong ba la rgyugs zer phud/ khong gis ga ler gzigs pas/ de dag chos ston drangs ma thag phan tshun khro zhing 'khrugs pas cing bzed la sogs pa bdeg res byas pas thams cad mas/ thams cad 'thab cing rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal de lta bu myong /re zhig nas gyes song / de'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/dge 'dun 'di 65

rnams chos ston bzhes khar 'thab mo shor/ de'i rnam par smin pas nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba 'di lta bur skyes nas las ma zad kyi bar du nyin re bzhin sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin zer ba dang / de bzhin du paṇ+ḍi ta thi ti'i yum dbus kyi phyug po nyin nub med par me gtong ba'i thab ku'i nang du 'bu ru skyes pas paṇ+ḍi tas lo mang por phyug po de'i g.yog byas/ gla rnams dus la ma blangs par lan cig rtsis byas pas mang po byung 'dug pa thams cad khong la phul/ nga'i glar snyed bu 'di dgos gsungs pas/ a tsa ra bya ba gzhung ma ngan skyed bu nor bu yin nyen yod zer yum gyi las ma zad pa'i nus pas ster du ma nyan/ der gla rnams blangs ma'i sdig sbyong mang du mdzad/ mthar snyed bu brkus te bros nas 'byon dgos pa byung ba dang / gzhan yang dpal sprul chos kyi dbang pos kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ nyi tshe ba'i gtam rgyud gsungs pa ni/ de yang sngon grub chen gling rje ras pas yar 'brog g.yu mtsho'i nang na dar cig gzigs nas bshum a kha kha dkor ma za dkor ma za zhes gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ mtsho nang 'dir bla ma dkor zan zhig gi rnam shes nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes te sdug bsngal mang po myong gin 'dug gsungs/ de ston par zhus pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyis mtsho de skad cig la bskams tsa na nya chen po zhig gi lus kyis mtsho des gar sleb tu sleb pa la srog chags grangs med pas go mtshams med par gtams te zos pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par 'gre ldog byed kyin 'dug /'di lta bu'i las ngan pa su zhig gi skye ba lags zhus pas/ 'di gtsang bla rta nag can gyi skye ba yin gsungs/gtsang bla rta nag can bya ba ngag nus dang byin rlabs shin tu che zhing / 66

'dre gdon gyis nyen pa rnams la lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis phan pa byung bas dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i mchod gnas su gyur te/ gshin po'i 'bul ba byas pa sogs la phaṭa shar re bsgrags rta zog mang po blang 'gro ba zhig yod pa de yin gsungs/ yang grub thob thang stong rgyal pos rdo pha bong chen po zhig gi steng du rtsa rlung gi 'phrul 'khor mdzad pas rdo de phyed tshal du gas pa'i nang na sbal pa chen po zhig gi lus la srog chags chung ngu grangs med pa 'byar nas zos pas sdug bsngal mi bzod par kha nag deng deng 'dug pa 'di ci lags zhus pas/ 'di dmar chog byed pa'i bla ma gcig gi skye ba yin gsungs/ da lta bla ma rnam pa tsho yang yon bdag gi bsha' lug tsho ba dang rgyags pa re bshas nas mid pa dang mtsher pa sogs sha khrag gis g.yos/ tshang brang dang rtsib sha 'dar cum me ba'i steng du bzhag nas drangs tsa na/ mnabs gzan de dbu la 'then nas/ nang sha rnams byis pas nu ma nu nu mdzad phyag shan de kha zhig blangs nas phyi sha rnams dal bus gsol/bzhes zin tsa na zhal snum chil le/dbu rlangs pa phal le/ sngar gyi de ma yin pa'i rgya dmar go ge ba zhig byas te dbu bteg 'ong bar 'dug ste/tshe 'dir gsol gsol ba'i bu lon phyi ma sku lus kyi steng nas 'jal dgos byung tsa na/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal gnas su 'o brgyal chen po yod par 'dug /de bzhin du ngor mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong sde dge na bzhugs skabs nyin gcig de ring jul mda'i chu nang 'dir gang byung yang gtong mi nyan zhes grwa pa mang po sgug tu bcug phyi dro tsam na shing sdong dum chen po zhig chus khyer byung ba de blangs nas de las gzhan pa gang yang ma byung zhus pas de yin sdong dum de gshog dang 67

gsungs/ sdong dum gshags pa'i nang na sbal pa chen po zhig la srog chags mang pos za gyin 'dug pa de la khrus dang byang chog cig mdzad/sde dge'i gnyer pa bo rgyas bya ba zhig gi skye ba yin gsungs/ des na mi dpon kha drag sde za ba rnams kyang da lta dbang che yang dmyal gnas 'di dag la bsams nas stabs gzab byed dgos par 'dug ces gsungs so/ /de dag rnams kyis mtshon pa deng sang chu tshan sogs kyi gseb tu 'bu ye 'tshig mi thub la tsha bas nyen pa 'di dag kyang /dud 'gro gzhan yin na yud tsam la 'chi rung / nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba yin pas 'chi mi thub pa yin/ 'di dag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung shos yin yang / da lta mi'i lus thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal ches cher che ba las brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis lhag pa yin te//bshes spring las/'di na nyin gcig mdung thung sum brgya yis//rab tu drag btab sdug bsngal gang lags pa/ /des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chung ngu yi//'ol yang mi bgyid char yang mi phod do//zhes gsungs la/dmyal ba'i gnas de rnams su dngos su skyes na mi bzod pa smos ci dgos//thos pa dang bris pa'i gzugs tsam mthong bas kyang 'jigs shing skrag par byed de/de nyid las/ dmyal ba bris pa mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran dang bklags dang gzugs su bgyis pas kyang / /'jigs pa skye bar 'gyur na mi bzod pa'i//rnam smin nyams su myong na smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ des na der mi skye ba'i dge ba sgrub 'dod/ sdig pa spong blo/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje bsgom pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /ngan song gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa la/ skye ba'i rgyu ni ser snas kun nas bslangs pa'i las 68

ngan bsags pa las/ 'bras bu yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal myong bkren la/ de la'ang byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba dang gnyis las/ dang po la phyi'i sgrib pa can dang / dang gi sgrib pa can/ sgrib pa can gyi sgrib pa can nam kha zas kyi sgrib pa can te gsum yod/ de dag gi gnas ni gtso che ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya na yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba shin tu nyams mi dga' zhing mthong ba tsam gyis snying rlung ldang ba/ bye ma'am gsog ma'i thang lta bu kha dog skya zhing chu la sogs pa gtan nas med pa'i sar rigs mthun du las bsags pa du ma lhan cig tu skye la/ de'ang kha cig ni mngal skyes/ kha cig brdzus skyes so//der skyes pa'i lus rten ni/ bshes spring las/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyes ma thag nas mgo bo ri rab tsam du che ba/kha khab mi tsam/mgrin pa gzhu rgyud tsam/sto ba ri'i gtos tsam/ gsus pa yul ljongs tsam yod pa/ rkang lag byi thur ltar phra ba/ sha pags thams cad bskams te rus mig tu thim pas ta la'i yang tog skam po lta bur gyur kyang / bkres skom gyi dbang gis dal bar 'dug pa'i skabs med par lus shing rta gog po drangs pa bzhin khog sgra tshag du ma 'byin bzhin du song song ba las tshigs mig rnams phan tshun 'thab ste/ mer 'bar ba lta bu'i zug rngu drag po dang bcas/zas skom ji tsam btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing /brgya lam na cung zad tsam zhig rnyed par gyur na'ang / rang las dbang che zhing dpung che ba gzhan gyis mtshon cha thogs nas sung zhing brdeg pa dang bcog pa 69

ngan bsags pa las/ 'bras bu yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal myong bkren la/ de la'ang byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba dang gnyis las/ dang po la phyi'i sgrib pa can dang / dang gi sgrib pa can/ sgrib pa can gyi sgrib pa can nam kha zas kyi sgrib pa can te gsum yod/ de dag gi gnas ni gtso che ba 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya na yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba shin tu nyams mi dga' zhing mthong ba tsam gyis snying rlung ldang ba/ bye ma'am gsog ma'i thang lta bu kha dog skya zhing chu la sogs pa gtan nas med pa'i sar rigs mthun du las bsags pa du ma lhan cig tu skye la/ de'ang kha cig ni mngal skyes/ kha cig brdzus skyes so//der skyes pa'i lus rten ni/ bshes spring las/ kha cig kha ni khab kyi mig tsam la/ /lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyen/ mi gtsang gyi nar bor ba cung zad kyang / 'tshal ba'i mthu dang ldan pa ma lags so/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skyes ma thag nas mgo bo ri rab tsam du che ba/kha khab mi tsam/mgrin pa gzhu rgyud tsam/sto ba ri'i gtos tsam/ gsus pa yul ljongs tsam yod pa/ rkang lag byi thur ltar phra ba/ sha pags thams cad bskams te rus mig tu thim pas ta la'i yang tog skam po lta bur gyur kyang / bkres skom gyi dbang gis dal bar 'dug pa'i skabs med par lus shing rta gog po drangs pa bzhin khog sgra tshag du ma 'byin bzhin du song song ba las tshigs mig rnams phan tshun 'thab ste/ mer 'bar ba lta bu'i zug rngu drag po dang bcas/zas skom ji tsam btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur zhing /brgya lam na cung zad tsam zhig rnyed par gyur na'ang / rang las dbang che zhing dpung che ba gzhan gyis mtshon cha thogs nas sung zhing brdeg pa dang bcog pa 69

la sogs par byas te/ cung zad tsam yang longs spyod du med cing / yang 'bras sam zan gyi ri bo chen po mthong / phyogs der yi dwags thams cad mi shong ba tsam du brgyugs pa na/ dbang che ches chung chung mnan/ bsnyel brdabs/ ske gzhu rgyud tsam des mgo mi theg rkang lag byi thur tsam des lus mi theg par 'gyel brdabs/ lus thams cad nyar nyor du song sdug bsngal de tsam spyad de phyin pas 'khris su slebs tsa na/ sa'am dkar gong lta bu'i phung por gyur nas zan la sogs pa byung ba'i shul tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ngu zhing /'gre ldog pa dang /brang brdung ba sogs mya ngan dang sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong / des mtshon chu chen po dal gyis 'babs pa mthong nas phyin pas gram pa skya thal gyis song ba de 'dra ba mthong ba dang / sngon shing yal ga 'bras bu dang bcas pa mthong nas phyin pa'i tshe shing sdong skam po yi mug par mthong ba sogs mi 'dod pa 'ba' zhig 'byung ste sdug bsngal myong ba'o//nang gi sgrib pa can ni/ gong ltar bza' btung btsal bas mi rnyed cung zad rnyed pa'ang bshang gci dang / snabs lud lta bu tsam rnyed kyang za mi nus par tshags byas pa na/lag pa'i dug gis bskam par 'gyur ba dang / zos pa'i tshe dngos po chung ngu de thog mar kha khab mig tsam de las mi thar bar ral ba dang / khar tshud nas 'gram phugs shin tu yangs par gar song cha med du song / mid pa'i tshe gre ba phra drags pas mi thar/ sto bar sleb tsa na yul ljongs tsam de khengs rgyu med pa'i khar slar rngab slangs pa ltar song nas shin tu ltogs pa dang skom par gyur te ngu ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa yin la/ sgrib pa can gyi sgrib pa can ni/zas 70

cung zad khong par song ma thag me 'bar te nang khrol don snying thams cad 'tshigs/kha sna thams cad nas me lce dud pa dang bcas nyug nyug 'bar te/lus sa la bdeb cing ngu ba dang / yi dwags kyi rigs kha cig sba ba shin tu che ba lus sba ba btags pa lta bur song / de dag smin pa'i rnag khrag kha zas su bsams te za ba dang /yi dgas gzhan mang po gdong du tshogs te/sba ba'i rnag khrag rtsod pa bcas te za ba dang / bye ma tsha mo za dgos pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal yod de/bshes spring las/ kha cig mtshan zhing kha nas 'bar ba ste/ /zas su 'bar ba khar babs bye ma 'tshal//smad rigs 'ga' ni rnag dang phyi sa dang / khrag sogs mi gtsang ba yang mi rnyed de///phan tshun gdong du 'tshog cing mgrin pa nas//sba ba byung ba smin pa'i rnag 'tshal lo//zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang yi dwags rnams la spyi mthun du sos po'i dus zla ba'i 'od kyis kyang tsha ba'i grogs byed cing /dgun gyi dus nyi ma'i 'od kyis kyang grang ba'i grogs byed pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes byung las/ yi dwags rnams la sos rka'i dus su ni/ /zla ba'ang tsha la dgun ni nyi ma'ang grang / /smon shing 'bras bu med 'gyur 'di dag gis//bltas pa tsam gyis klung yang bskam par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong dgos te/sngon gro zhun skyes yi dwags kyi yul du byon pas/yi dwags kyi ser sna'i dug gi tshad pas phog ste khong zhal shin tu skom pas/lcags mkhar chen po'i sgo na skyes bu mdog nag pa mi dmar ba zhig 'dug pa la chu gar yod dris pas/ yi dwags sdong dum mes 'tshig pa 'dra ba mang po 'dus nas/skyes bu chen po chu stsol zer/ khong gis ngas kyang chu ma rnyed pa yin chu stsol byas 71

pas/ khyed ci zer nged rnams lung pa 'dir skyes nas lo grangs bcu gnyis yin kyang / chu'i ming tsam yang de ring las thos ma myong zer ba lta bu/ ser sna'i las ngan gyis zas skom phar zhog chu yi ming tsam yang mi thos pa dang / yang slob dpon dze tā ri ljongs rgyur byon pas/ yi dwags mo gzugs mi sdug pa phru gu lnga brgya'i a mar gyur pa zhig gis slob dpon la/ nga yi khyo bo rdo rje gdan du zas tshol ba la song nas lo bcu gnyis yin kyang ma byung /khyed der byon na/ khyod myur du ma 'ongs na phru gu rnams bkres nas 'chi'o gsungs shig zer khyod kyi khyo pho de ji lta bu yod/ yi dwags thams cad 'dra bar 'dug pas ngas shes sam gsungs pas/nor sa med/kha che ba sna nyag pa/mig zhar ba gzugs mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma dgus brgyan pa zhig yod zer/khong rdo rje gdan du byon pas/dge tshul zhig gis gtor chu dang gtor zan mang po zhig dor nas song ba la/yi dwags mang po rub rgyab pa'i khrod du kho rang 'dug /chung ma'i 'phrin bskur rnams bskyal bas ngas lo bcu gnyis su nyul yang / skor gcig dge slong yang dag cig gis snabs lud cig dor ba la nged yi dwags mang pos rub brgyab pas cung zad las gang yang ma rnyed zer/ kho rang snabs lud la rtsod sa nas yi dwags gzhan gyis lus la rma mang po btod 'dug gsungs/yang ba ri lo tsā ba rgya gar nas bod la 'byon khar bas mtha' zhig tu skyo bsangs la byon pas yi dwags mang po ngu yi 'dug pas/khyed rnams ci la ngu ba yin gsungs pas/ khyed bzhugs na nged rnams la gtor ma mang po sbyin pas mi bkres par 'dug pa la/ khyed bod la byon na gtor ma gtong mkhan med pas nged rnams bkres skom gyis sdug bsngal bar 'gyur bas 72

ngu ba yin zer/ lo tsā bas de dag gi ched du 'bras mi khur bcu nyos nas yi dwags la gtor ma'i rgyun chen po btsugs shing de'i chas la gser mang po'i rten yang bzhag go/gsungs so/ /tshe tshad ni mdzod las/yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ zhes gsungs pas/ mi'i zla ba gcig la yi dwags kyi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub la/ de la mi ltar na lo khri gcig dang stong phrag lnga yod/ des na mi la sogs par zas med par zhag bdun du song na 'chi mod/ las ngan tshabs che bas lo brgya stong du zas skom gyi ming tsam ma tshor yang 'chi mi nus pa yin/ /kha 'thor ba ni/lha mi'i 'jig rten na ci rigs par gnas pa'i/ lha btsan rgyal po shi 'dre 'byung po/ ma mo the'u rang la sogs pa rnams yin la/ 'di dag la'ang mi bsod nams can dang / nus pa can sogs mthong na srog 'gag pa tsam du 'jigs shing skrag pas gar 'gyu med pa dang / bkres skom kho nas gdungs pas zas chang sogs khar char pa 'bab 'bab 'thung yang tshims pa'i dus med pa dang /rtag tu bsam pa ngan pa la gnas nas sems can gzhan gyi srog dbugs la rngam pas gnod pa gang thub byed/ sngon gyi mdza' bshes dang nye du la sogs pa'i drung du dga' bas phyin kyang / de dag la nad dang smyo 'bog la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung / sngags pa nus pa can gyis mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum byas pas/ sa 'og mun pa'i gnas su bskal pa'i bar du mnan pa dang / sbyin bsreg gi me la bsreg pa dang / yungs thun dang rdo bye sogs kyis brab pa dang brgyab pa na mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing lus dum bu stong du 'gro ba sogs sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag gis dub 73

ngu ba yin zer/ lo tsā bas de dag gi ched du 'bras mi khur bcu nyos nas yi dwags la gtor ma'i rgyun chen po btsugs shing de'i chas la gser mang po'i rten yang bzhag go/gsungs so/ /tshe tshad ni mdzod las/yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ zhes gsungs pas/ mi'i zla ba gcig la yi dwags kyi zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub la/ de la mi ltar na lo khri gcig dang stong phrag lnga yod/ des na mi la sogs par zas med par zhag bdun du song na 'chi mod/ las ngan tshabs che bas lo brgya stong du zas skom gyi ming tsam ma tshor yang 'chi mi nus pa yin/ /kha 'thor ba ni/lha mi'i 'jig rten na ci rigs par gnas pa'i/ lha btsan rgyal po shi 'dre 'byung po/ ma mo the'u rang la sogs pa rnams yin la/ 'di dag la'ang mi bsod nams can dang / nus pa can sogs mthong na srog 'gag pa tsam du 'jigs shing skrag pas gar 'gyu med pa dang / bkres skom kho nas gdungs pas zas chang sogs khar char pa 'bab 'bab 'thung yang tshims pa'i dus med pa dang /rtag tu bsam pa ngan pa la gnas nas sems can gzhan gyi srog dbugs la rngam pas gnod pa gang thub byed/ sngon gyi mdza' bshes dang nye du la sogs pa'i drung du dga' bas phyin kyang / de dag la nad dang smyo 'bog la sogs pa mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung / sngags pa nus pa can gyis mnan bsregs 'phangs gsum byas pas/ sa 'og mun pa'i gnas su bskal pa'i bar du mnan pa dang / sbyin bsreg gi me la bsreg pa dang / yungs thun dang rdo bye sogs kyis brab pa dang brgyab pa na mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing lus dum bu stong du 'gro ba sogs sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag gis dub 73

bzhin gzhan gyi srog 'phrog gang thub byed pa sogs las ngan kho nar spyad pas/mthar dmyal ba thar med du skyes nas sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin/ des na da lta rang re rnams kyi nyin gcig tsam la lto ma myong na sdug mi sdug ji tsam 'ong /de 'dra ba'i gnas su skyes na lo brgya stong mang por zas skom gyi ming tsam yang thos rgyu med pa'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba sran zhing bzod pa'i skabs mi 'dug la/gnas 'di lta bur mi skye ba'i gdeng ni ye med cing / skye nges pa'i las ser sna 'jur gegs kyis mtshon pa'i mi dge ba ji snyed nyin re la'ang 'di byas/ 'di ma byas kyi sa mtshams med pa byas yod pas nges par skye bar 'dug /da cis kyang der mi skye ba zhig bya dgos bsam pa sogs gong ltar bsam mo/ /ngan song gi gnas gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la'ang / byings na gnas pa dang kha 'thor ba gnyis/ de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs pa blang dor mi shes pa'i gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i mi dge ba'i las las 'bras bu dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal myong ba yin la/ de la dang po byings na gnas pa ni/ phyi yi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na/ che ba chu srin la sogs pa nas/ chung ba nya dang sbal lhong gi bar chang 'gag gi sbang ma bzhin cig cig yod pa la/ che ba sbrul dang chu srin la sogs pas ri rab la lan mang po'i bar dkris pa dang / chung ba rdul phran dang khab rtse lta bu'i bar yod cing che ches chung chung khyur mid byed/chung chung gis chen po rnams thal mar 'bigs shing srog chags che ba re re'i lus la chung ba du mas tshang bcas nas za bar byed pa dang / rgya mcho'i rlabs kyis bskyod pa'i tshe shar pa nub/ nub pa shar lta bu'i gar 'gro dang 'dir sdod med pas gnas 74

grogs la nges pa med pa'i sdug bsngal dang / gling bar nyi ma mi 'char ba'i gnas su skyes pas rang gi lag pa brkyang bskum yang mi mthong bar/ dud 'gro che chung med par skye sa gnas sa 'chi sa thams cad de gar byed cing / blun zhing gti mug pas spang blang gi gnas thams cad la rmongs te sdug bsngal mtha' med pa'i gnas su skye ba yin/ gnyis pa kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro ni/ lha mi'i yul na yod pa rnams kyang blun rmongs dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal la spyod/ khyad par mi yul gyi dud 'gro bdag tu ma bzung ba'i ri dwags la sogs pa rnams ni/ rtswa sogs zas kham re za na'ang bya ra byed dgos pa dang /gcig gis gcig za zhing gsod pa dang / sngon pas rgya dang rnyi dang me mda' la sogs pas 'phral du gsod pa dang /mche ba dang rus pa'i ched du glang chen/ pags pa'i ched du stag gzig wa sum/ sha khrag gi ched du 'brong g.yag ra lug gsod pa sogs rang gi lus nyid kyang rang gsod pa'i rgyur skyes pas shin tu sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag snying tsha hob be ba dus rtag tu yong la/ mis bdag byas pa rnams ni/ khal 'gel ba/spu breg pa/zho bzho ba/ bya gcod pa/ sna 'thag pa/ blos rmo ba sogs bkol spyod kyi rnam pa grangs med pa'i sdug bsngal yod la/ spun zhing rmongs pas gsod pa'i gshed mas ral gri thogs te drung du slebs kyang mig sngo ce re lta ba las/ bros pa tsam yang mi shes/ rta khal sogs rgyab thams cad rmar song yang da dung khal 'gel ba dang / zhon nas 'gro ba sogs byed/ 'gro ma nus tsa na/ lcag gis brab cing / rdos bdeg de rnams la dka' tshegs dang na tsha yod snyam tsam yang mi byed/ 'bri g.yag ra lug rnams ni bed bcad nas gos tsa na rang gis 75

gsod pa'am/ gzhan la tshong ba gang rung gi sgo nas thams cad bshas su phab nas gsod pa las/ rang bzhin gyis 'chi ba ni gcig kyang med pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod de/ bshes spring las/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas na yang gsod pa dang / /bcings dang brdeg sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa/ /zhi 'gyur dge ba spangs pa rnams la ni/ /gcig la gcig za shin tu mi bzad pa/ kha cig mu tig bal dang rus pa khrag /sha dang pags pa'i ched du 'chi bar 'gyur//dbang med gzhan dag rdog pa lag pa dang / lcag dang lcags kyu gdab pas btab ste bkol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshe tshad ni mdzod las/ dud 'gro rnams/ mchog ring bskal pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas tshe ring bas bskal pa'i bar du thub pa dang /thung ba lo zla'i bar skad cig re re'i bar skye 'chi byed pa ste nges pa med pa yin no//de nas dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i sems can de rnams kyi gnas ni de lta bu/sdug bsngal ni de lta bu/ tshe tshad ni de lta bu 'dug des na dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal byi dang / sems can sdug bsngal can mthong na de rang nyid yin ba'i blo bzhag nas sdug bsngal ji tsam 'dug la sogs pa zhib tu bsam/ da lta rang cag rnams rgyab khur khyer ba dang / gzhan gyis brdung deg byas pa dang / lus la na tsha byung ba sogs la sdug bsngal ci 'dra 'dug /des na bdag dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes na de 'dra'i sdug bsngal ci ste bzod/ der skye ba'i rgyu gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las ni grangs med pa zhig bsags nas yod pas sdug bsngal de thog tu 'bab nges/ des na ma rig pa de'i gnyen por da res gsung rab la thos bsam sgom gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyi sgron mes sems can 76

thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad kyang bdag gis bsol bar bgyi'o//de ltar bsal nus pa bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa dang /dud 'gror skyes pa'i sems can spyi la snying rje drag po bsgom zhing /rang la brten pa'i dud 'gro rnams la byams brtses skyong ba dang / tha na srog chags phra mo 'bu sbrang shig sro tshun chad la'ang bde sdug gi tshor ba med pa ni gcig kyang med la/ de thams cad kyang rang gi pha ma ma byas pa ni med pas thams cad la byams dang snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar ngan song gi gnas gsum po ni/ gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs mang zhing dos drag la rgyun ring ba/ blun zhing rmongs la chos kyi snang ba med pas/ slar ngan song gi rgyu sgrub pa kho na las med/ de dag tu skyes na phyis nas thar dka' zhing / rang cag rnams kyi rgyud la ngan song de dag tu skye nges pa'i las ni tshe rabs 'di dang gzhan du byas pa du ma yod pa yin pas/ sngar byas kyi las ngan la 'gyod sems dang bshags sdom/ phyin chad dug gsum drag po'i las srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' sogs la snying thag pa nas 'bad/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje drag po bsgom/ da res bdag gis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos dang mjal nas/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas sgrub na/rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mthar phyin bsgrub tu yod pa'i skabs 'dir chos phyir dka' spyad dang brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blangs te/ ngan song gi sems can gyis gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang / nge ltar byed nus par bla ma dang dkon mchog 77

gis byin gyis rlobs shig snyam du gsol pa 'debs pa dang / des mtshon rang gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad kyang sems can thams cad rdzogs byang thob phyir 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi sgo nas bsngo smon bya ba ste dam pa gsum gyis zin par nyams su blang ngo / /de yan gyis skyo ba skye phyir sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsgom pa'i tshul bstan zinato//gnyis pa zhen pa spong phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom pa la/ gal te ngan song gsum du skyes na sdug bsngal yod pa bden mod/ mtho ris gsum du skyes na bde ba 'ba' zhig ma gtogs sdug bsngal med pa yin no snyam na/ de ni blos zhib tu ma brtags pa yin te/ mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ 'dod pa thams cad mi rtag brtan pa med/ /ther zug ma yin mi lam 'dra ba ste/ /smig rgyu dang 'dra sgyu ma'i grong khyer 'dra/ /glog dang dbu ba 'dra zhing 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pas brtags na mtho ris gsum gyi zag bcas kyi bde ba ltar snang ba thams cad mi rtag cing mi brtan la 'gyur zhing 'gro bas nges par bslu ba'i chos can sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin la/ 'di bsam pa la spyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ bye brag mi yi 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ lha dang lha min gyi 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin du skyes kyang mi rtag ste slar sa steng du yang lhung / mi'i dbang po 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur kyang mi brtan te 'khor bar bran du skye/ tshangs pa chen por skyes kyang yid brtan med par mnar med du yang skye/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla bar skyes kyang mi phan te/ slar gling bar gyi mun par yang 'jug pa sogs mtho ris 78

kyi bde ba gang thob kyang yid brtan mi rung ste/bshes spring las/brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni/ /las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng lhung / /'khor los sgyur ba nyid du gyur nas kyang / /'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur//zhes dang /lha yul 'dod bde shin tu chen po dang //tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar//mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi/ /sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma zla ba nyid thob rang lus kyi//'od kyis 'jig rten mtha' dag snang byas te//slar yang mun nag mag tu phyin gyur nas/ /rang gi lag pa brkyang pa'ang mi mthong 'gyur//zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /mtho ris ngan 'gror 'gro ba yod/ /brgya byin tha mal du skye ba yod/ /nyi zla mun par 'gro ba yod//bsgyur rgyal bran du skye ba yod/ /de lung la brten nas yid ches kyang / /phal pas rtogs par mi nus pas//rang snang mi yi 'gyur ba stos//zhes so//gnyis pa bye brag mi yi 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ rang re mi rnams kyi gnas skabs la brtag na/ grwa bu slob g.yog 'khor 'bangs sogs mi mang po yod pa rnams kyang rang gcig pur 'gro ba dang /kha drag dbang che dang ldan pa khas zhan dbang chung du 'gro ba/ nor phyug cing longs spyod dang ldan pa la nor phyugs dgras ded pa/ khang gzhi mes 'tshig pa sogs kyis 'phral du dbul por 'gro ba dang / zas kyis 'grangs gos kyis dro ste skyid par yod 'phro la nad gdon drag po glo bur du byung ba'am/ phyi rol gyi gtam ngan thos pa sogs kyis 'phral du sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba dang /tshe stod la dgra yin pa tshe smad la gnyen du 'gro ba/ tshe stod la gnyen 'bral mi phod tsam 79

yod pa/ tshe smad la dgra bo gshed ma lta bur 'gyur ba sogs rang gi nye 'brel yul mi khyim mtshes kyi mi la brtags te zhib tu bsam na thams cad kyang sngar gyi sar med pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la snying po med cing bslu ba'i chos can/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa yin te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ mi rgyug po sprang por 'gro yin 'dug /kha drag po zhan por 'gro yin 'dug /mi mang po gcig tu 'gro yin 'dug /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab/ ces gsungs so//der ma zad skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhis rtag tu rang dbang med par sdug bsngal te/ de la dang po skye ba'i sdug bsngal la/ 'dzam gling gi mi rnams mngal skyes kyi dbang du byas na pha ma'i khu khrag gi dbus su dri za nyer len gyi rnam shes zhugs te mer mer po dang / nur nur po sogs 'gyur ba'i gnas skabs kyi sdug bsngal nyams su myong / yan lag sogs dang dbang po rdzogs pa'i skabs ma'i mngal gyi nang dog cing dri nga ba mun nag gi nang btson khang du tshud pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal/mas kha zas tsha mo zos pas me nang du bsregs ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal/grang mo zos pas chu grang du bskyur ba lta bu/ nyal ba na ris non pa lta bu/'grangs pa na brag gi bar du bcir ba lta bu/bkres pa na g.yang la lhung ba lta bu/'gro 'dug sgul bskyod byas pa na rlung gis khyer ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal sogs yod de/ slob spring las/ shin tu mi bzad dri nga mi gtsang bcer bas 'gags/ /rab tu dog pa mun nag 'thib por 'dug pa yi//mngal gnas dmyal ba lta bu'i nang du de zhugs nas/ /lus yongs bskums la sdug bsngal chen po brnag dgos so//zhes gsungs so/ /de nas zla grangs rdzogs nas btsa' ba'i dus srid pa'i 80

rlung gis mgo mjug bsgyur te btsa' sgor drangs pa na mi stobs chen gyis jig ngor brgyab pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/ /rus pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi bar nas 'byung ba'i tshe lcags kyi 'jur mig nas drangs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod/btsa' sgo dog pa rnams btsa' mi thub par de nyid du 'chi ba'am/ yang na ma bu gnyis ka 'chi ba dang / min kyang shi la thug pa'i sdug bsngal myong ste/smo rgyan chen pos/ ma bu gnyis ka gshin yul gom byed bor//ma yi kha rus ma gtogs rus tshigs bye//zhes gsungs/btsas nas kyang stan la lhung dus tsher ma'i dong du lhung ba lta bu/ rgyab kyi phru ma bshus pa na gson por pags pa bshus pa lta bu/ mi gtsang ba byi dor byed dus tsher mas brab pa lta bu/ mas pang du blangs pa'i dus byi'u khras khyer ba lta bu/ spyi bor mar byug dus bkyigs nas dong du 'phang ba lta bu la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod/de nas tsog bur bsnyal te 'jog pa'i dus su/mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du tshud/stogs skom na tsha la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ci lta bu byung yang ngu ba kho na las med/ de ltar skyes nas lang tsho la smon pa'i tshe na/ re zhig 'phel ba ltar snang yang don du tshe ni nyin re bzhin zad cing 'chi ba la je nyer 'gro/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya gzhag grub pa dang zin pa'i dus ni med pa chu'i gnyer ma lta bu gcig rjes su gcig 'byung ba la spyod/ de dag thams cad kyang sdig pa 'ba' zhig dang 'brel bas ngan song gi rgyu byed pa las med pas des na skye ba'i sdug bsngal spong ba'i thabs la brtson dgos te/slob spring las/de nas rim gyis til mar bcir spyad sra ba yis/ /btsir ba ltar byas de nas ci zhig ltar te btsas//'on kyang mod la de srog mi 'dor gang yin pa//sdug bsngal 81

nye bar spyad pa'i rnam par mtho brtsam mod/ /mi gtsang de nang gnas bcas 'gro ba'i lus de ni/ /mngal gnas rlon pas dkris shing dri ma mi zad ldan/ /gzer bas gnod pa bdo ste rnam smin smin pa ltar/ /skyug la thug pa bzhin du sngon gyi dran pas spong / /zhes gsungs so//de nas rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni de ltar 'khor ba'i bya gzhag snying po med cing zin pa'i dus med par spyod pa'i ngang du ma tshor bzhin du rgas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gtugs/ sngar gyi de las 'gyur te lus sgur zhing kyog /skra dkar dang khyi ther sogs 'byung /lus stobs nyams pas zhim por zos pa'i zas mi 'ju/ dbang po thams cad nyams pas mig gis thag ring dang chung ba'i gzugs mi mthong / rna bas sgra skad rnams ji bzhin mi thos/ rtses bza' btung gi ro mi tshor zhing smras pa'i sdeb mi thon/ yid zongs shing brjed ngas bying 'thib che/kha'i so phreng lhung bas sra ba'i zas mi chom zhing tshig ldab ldib tu smra/ lus kyi drod shor bas gos srab na mi dros shing / 'degs byed kyi stobs nyams pas wi na mi theg 'dod pa'i longs spyod la dga' yang spyod pa'i mthu med//lus kyi rtsa rlung rgud pas blo srab cing bzod bsran chung /rang gi bu tsha yan chad kun gyis brnyas bcos byed pas yi mug lus kyi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas nad dang gnod pa mang / ldang pa'i tshe 'phral du ldang mi nus par lag pa gnyis ka sa la btsugs nas sa sra ba las phur pa 'don pa ltar ldang / 'gro ba'i tshe rked pa sgur bas mgo bo bteg mi nus shing gom pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang myur du byed mi nus par dal bus byis pa bya la 'jab pa ltar 'gro /sdod pa'i tshe rkang lag gi lhu tshigs thams cad na bas dal bus sdod mi nus par lus kyi ljid phab 82

ste sa rdo lung chad pa ltar sdod/lus kyi sha zad bkrag nyams pags pa'i skyi 'dus te lus dang kha ngo thams cad gnyer mas gang ste mi sdug pa'i khro gnyer ston/ sha khrag bri bas rus pa'i tshigs thams cad mngon te 'gram rus dang lhu mgo thams cad phyi la 'bur ba sogs yin zhing / rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par 'chi bar smon yang / don du 'chi ba la nye bas shin tu skrag pa sogs rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ngan song gi 'gro ba dang 'dra bar myong ba yin te/rgya che rol pa las/nas pas gzugs sdug gzugs ni mi sdug byed/ /rgas pas mthu stobs nyams shing gzi brjid nyams//rgas pas mdangs 'phrog ges pas 'chi bar byed//rgas pas bde ba 'phrog cing sdug bsngal skyed/ces dang /rje btsun grags pas/ skra dkar gyi mche bas mgo bzung nas/ /pags pa la gnyer ma'i rol gyis bris/ kha la so med rnyil la thug /lus la stobs med 'khar bar brten/ /na tshod dar ma kun gyis brnyas//lus rgas pa 'chi ba'i rtsa nas brten//rgas kyang da dung rtag blo can//zhes gsungs so/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal ni lus 'di nyid 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin pas/ de dag phan tshun ma mnyam pa las rlung mkhris bad kun sogs nad kyis gzir bas stobs dang gzi mdangs rgyas pa'i mi rgod cig yin yang na ba'i zug gzer phog ma thag byi'u la rdo phog pa bzhin lus stobs shor/mal gyi gting du lhung / lus skul bskyod tsam byed pa yang dka'/ khyed ci na zhes dris pa'i lan tsam yang myur du bshad pa'i nus pa med par khong pa'i gting nas skad mi thon bzhin du smra/ g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab gang du nyal yang bde ba'i dus med/zas skom gyi zhin pa dang bral/ mtshan mo gnyid mi 'ong /nyin par 83

nyin ring / mtshan mo mtshan ring / sman gyi kha tsha skyur gsum dang / gtar sreg gi sdug bsngal la sogs mi 'dod bzhin du spyod dgos/ na ba la brten nas 'chi ba yang glo bur du thong snyam nas 'jigs shing skrag/gdon bgegs sogs kyi dbang gis sems la rang dbang mi 'dus 'khrul snang las kyang 'khrul snang la spyod/rang gis rang gsod pa dang lceb pa sogs kyang byed/ mdze dang gza' sogs kyis nyen na gson pa nyid nas shi ba dang 'dra/ mi yi khyu nas bud/ rang ro rang gis mthong / spyir nad pa thams cad rang g.yog rang gis mi nus/ nad tshigazos pas gzhan gyi bya ba thams cad mig sngar mi 'bab/ rgyud sngar las gyong /nad yun ring na nad g.yog byed pa yang sun nas ji bzhin mi nyan/ dus rtag tu na ba'i tshor bas nyen nas sdug bsngal ba ste de dag zhib tu bsam dgos te/rgya che rol pa las/ nad brgya mang dang nad thebs sdug bsngal gyis/ /'gro ba gtses te mi yi yi dwags bzhin/ /zhes dang / de ltar nad 'dis 'gro ba'i mdangs 'phrog cing / /dbang po gzugs dang stobs ni nyams par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ sngon chad tshe 'dir yun ring du sdod pa'i shom ra kho na byed pa las 'chi ba 'ong snyam pa yid la med pa zhig /'chi nad drag po zhig gis ni thebs/ rim gro dang rkyen zlog gis ni ma phan/ sman dang dpyad ni ma zug /'chi bar ni shes/'chi ba blos ni mi thong /phan pa'i thabs ni med/zas skom mthong yang yi gar ni mi 'ong / 'chi ba'i tshor bas gdungs pas snying ni mi dga'/'khrul snang gi sun mas ni gtugs//gshin rje'i pho nyas ni 'jigs/mal gyi tha mar ni nyal/ gnyen bshes kyis mtha' bskor kyang bshol ni mi thebs/ 84

gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal ni rang gcig pus myong /gtam gyi tha ma ni smra/ zas kyi tha ma ni thur mas bstod/ skom gyi tha ma chu thigs re ni 'thung / brtsigs pa'i mkhar du sdod dbang ni med/ bsags pa'i longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod kyang khyer dbang ni med/blos ni mi thong /rjes su ni mi 'brang / bskyangs pa'i gnyen 'khor dang ni 'grogs dbang ni med/ phyi ma gar 'gro dang 'dir 'gro'i gtol med/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa dran pas 'gyod pas ni gdung / ngan song gi sdug bsngal dran nas 'jigs shing skrag /lus kyi 'byung ba sdud/dbugs ni ngar/yan lag ni g.yob/mig skya log ge tshe pha rol du 'gro gshin rje'i sun mas slebs//bar do'i snang ba shar/ mgon skyabs ni med/ gcig pur lag stong du rgyus med pa'i sa phyogs su 'gro ba'i dus/ de ring gi nyi ma tsam la'ang mi 'ong ba'i gdeng ni med/ de'i dus su phan nges pa'i dam pa'i chos bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du bsam mo/ /yang mi sdig can 'chi ba'i tshe/ ji skad du/ mi sdig can 'chi ba mthong tsa na/ /las rgyu 'bras ston pa'i slob dpon yin//zhes pa ltar/ ngag gis rkyang 'brong / rna dgo ra lug sogs kyis nga brdzis byung / rdung byung ded byung 'di tsho par rgyob ces pa sogs spre ngag drag po 'don zhing / dmyal ba'i gshin rje 'jigs su rung ba rnams mthong zhing / dmyal ba'i sems can sdug bsngal can rnams kyi ngu 'bod kyi sgra rnams thos pas shin tu skrag ste mig mchi ma tsa re thad pa'i dkyil du bgrad nas/ mi gtsang ba rang dbang med par shor te lus la gos shing / brang lag 'thab cing brang sen rjes kyis bkang nas 'chi ste/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di ni ma byas brtsams pa dang / /'di phyed byas par gnas pa la/ /glo bur 85

'chi bdag 'ongs nas ni//kyi hud bcom zhes sems par 'gyur//mya ngan shugs kyis skrangs pa yi/ /mig dmar gdong las mchi ma 'dzag /nye du re thag chad pa dang / /gshin rje'i pho nya'i bzhin la blta//rang sdig dran pas gdung ba dang / /dmyal ba'i sgra ni thos pa yis/ /spag pas mi gtsang lus gos shing / /myos par 'gyur tshe ci zhig bya//zhes gsungs so//des na da lta phan chad 'chi ba ma dran pas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gnas mal dang zang zing la phyi jus/ nye du dang 'brel can la sogs pa'i don du chags snang rmongs gsum gyis dus 'da' ba 'di mtshang re che snyam du bsam mo//gzhan yang yod pa gsog srung gi sdug bsngal ni/dang po rgya dkar dag sogs la tshong la 'gro nas khe spogs sogs mi 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal/la chu 'phrang gsum dang brlag stor byung dang 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal/so nam byed pa rnams kyang dang po so nam bya ba'i dus su lus kyis dka' tshegs ngal dub chen pos sgrub/ de la sad ser ba sogs 'byung ba'i sdug bsngal/ grong chog pa rnams kyang la chu 'phrang dang dgra jag sogs la mi 'dzem par 'gro dgos pa sogs longs spyod gsog pa'i dus su sdug bsngal kho nas bsags dgos la/bar du bsrung ba'i ched du/nyin dal rgyu med pa'i bya ra/ mtshan gnyid rgyu med pa'i mel tshe/rgyun gyi 'tsho skyong sogs 'bad pa chen pos brtson na yang /longs spyod gong 'phel du mi 'gro ba dang / nyams su dogs pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod la/ de bzhin du nor dang longs spyod ji tsam che ba de tsam gyi sdug bsngal yang che ste/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ dper na rta gcig yod kyang / de dgras khyer dogs/ rkun mas rku dogs/ rtswa gzan ma 'khyong gis 86

dogs pa sogs sdug bsngal rta tsam mang po yod/ de bzhin du lug gcig yod kyang sdug bsngal lug tsam/ tha na ja 'khor zhig yod kyang sdug bsngal ja 'khor zhig tsam nges par yod/ ces gsungs pa ltar yin la/ tha mar ni 'byor pa ji tsam che ba de dgra yang che ste longs spyod dang 'byor pa thams cad dgra dang thun mong du 'gyur/rang ma yin pa thams cad dgra ru ldang /nyin gyi jag pa/mtshan gyi rkun ma/ 'phar spyang dang gcan gzan sogs glo bur du 'ongs nas 'phrog pa/dpon po dbang chen sogs kyis mthus 'phrog pa/ nye 'brel sogs kyis g.yar skyin gyis 'phrog pa/ nor gyi ched du srog kyang 'chor ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/spyod 'jug las/bsags dang bsrung dang brlag pas gdung ba yi//nor ni phung khrol mtha' yas shes par bya/ /nor la chags pas g.yeng bar gyur pa rnams//srid pa'i sdug bsngal las grol skabs med do//zhes dang /rje mi las kyang /nor dang po bdag skyid gzhan smon po/ /ji tsam yod kyang chog shes med/ /bar du ser sna'i mdud pas bcings//dge ba'i phyogs su gtong mi phod/ /dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab mo yin//rang gis bsags pa mi yi spyod/ /tha ma srog gi bdud du 'ong / /dgra bos nor gnyer sems la gzan//'khor ba'i bslu rdo spangs pa yin//bdud kyi mgo skor de nga mi 'dod//ces gsungs so/ /des na longs spyod dang nor gyi chags zhen spangs na gsog bsrung gi sdug bsngal med cing / dgra dang bral bas skyid pa yod pas sngon byon dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar ltar/ 'tsho ba bya tshol byi'u tshol la brten nas dam pa'i chos kho na sgrub dgos snyam du bsam mo /med cing phongs pa rnams la 'tshol 'bru'i sdug bsngal gi/ 'ga' zhig gis ni/ rtswa 87

shing 'thu ba sogs gzhan gyi g.yog byas nas lus kyi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad nas dka' tshegs chen pos btsal bas cung zad rnyed pa de yang khral 'u lag sogs la 'chor/ rkun mas 'phrog pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal/ de las dman pa rnams ni dang zas dang mi rnyed/ nub zas nub mi rnyed/ skar ma la zhwa byas/ ba mo la lham byas/byin pa rtar zhon/snal mas lcag tu byas/byin sha khyi la byin/ngo sha mi la byin/ zhu 'bul dang ngo bstod sna tshogs byas nas btsal kyang / nyin za rgyu mi rnyed/ mtshan gyon rgyu mi rnyed pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal yod de/ bzhi brgya pa las/mchog la sems kyi sdug bsngal dang / dman pa rnams la lus kyi ste/ /sdug bsngal gnyis kyis 'jig rten 'di//nyin re nyin re 'joms par byed//ces gsungs so//dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa dang phrad kyis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal ni sngar bstan pa'i longs spyod gsog srung sogs kyi sdug bsngal gyi nang du bstan zin la/gnyen byams pa dang bral ba dang 'bral du dogs pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'jig — rten pa thams cad rang gi gnyen grogs 'khor 'bangs kyi phyogs su chags/rang dang de dag la gnod par byed pa sogs la sdang / de dag gi ched du sdug bsngal du ma la spyod/nye du dang gnyen bshes su 'brel ba dag kyang 'bral ba'i chos can mi rtag pa yin pas phal cher shi ba'am/yul gzhan du 'khyar ba/nad na ba/dgra gdon gyis nyen pa na sdug bsngal shin tu che/ lhag par pha ma ni rang gi bu la brtse gdung che ste/ de dag la 'khyags ltogs na shi sogs byung na rang shi ba las kyang thu ba'i sdug bsngal ba'i byams brtse yod/ de ltar gnyen byams pa dang bral ba dang 'bral gyis dogs pa'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa de dag ni byams brtse phyin ci 88

log tu gyur nas phugs su gnod pa bskyal ba yin par dpal sprul chos kyi dbang pos gsungs te/ pha mas bu phrug la rgyu zas dang longs spyod thams cad byin/ gtan grogs kyi chung ma bsus nas 'khor ba'i 'ching thag dang sgrol/ dgra 'dul lugs/ gnyen skyong lugs longs spyod spel lugs sogs mi dge ba'i las thabs du ma bslabs/ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig byed pa yin pas de dag las gnod tshabs che ba med/bu dang bu mo la sogs pa yang /dang po lus kyi bcud 'phrog bar du kha yi zas 'phrog tha ma lag gi dor 'phrog phar la brtse bar byas kyang tshur la rgol/ rang gi tshe gang sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad de bsags pa'i rgyu zas longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par byin kyang ngo so cung zad kyang med/ mi phal pa zhig la ja 'debs gcig byin pa'i dga' rjo tsam rang gi bu la rgya dngul rdil tshad byin kyang med de/ nga rang gi a pha'i rgyu rdzas nga rang gis longs los spyod snyam pa las med/ bu sring dang bu mo sogs kyang rang rnar la hab thob byed/ byin pa la ngo so med/ yang byin kyang yang slong /tha na phreng ba'i grangs 'dzin gyi sngo de legs po zhig yod kyang bslangs nas khyer/ legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed cing rang phyogs la phan pa med/ nyes na gi pha ming gi go khar lhung nas sdug la sbyor/ gnyen gzhan thams cad kyang / rang 'byor zhing skyid la phun sum tshogs pa'i dus na ni thams cad kyang lha bzhin du blta/ phan ji thogs byed/ mi dgos kyang rgyu zas dang longs spyod ster/ rang rgyad par gyur na ni nyes pa cung zad kyang ma byas kyang tshur la dgra bzhin du blta/phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel/ /de ltar bu dang bu mo gnyen nye 'brel 89

log tu gyur nas phugs su gnod pa bskyal ba yin par dpal sprul chos kyi dbang pos gsungs te/ pha mas bu phrug la rgyu zas dang longs spyod thams cad byin/ gtan grogs kyi chung ma bsus nas 'khor ba'i 'ching thag dang sgrol/ dgra 'dul lugs/ gnyen skyong lugs longs spyod spel lugs sogs mi dge ba'i las thabs du ma bslabs/ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig byed pa yin pas de dag las gnod tshabs che ba med/bu dang bu mo la sogs pa yang /dang po lus kyi bcud 'phrog bar du kha yi zas 'phrog tha ma lag gi dor 'phrog phar la brtse bar byas kyang tshur la rgol/ rang gi tshe gang sdig sdug gtam ngan thams cad khyad du bsad de bsags pa'i rgyu zas longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par byin kyang ngo so cung zad kyang med/ mi phal pa zhig la ja 'debs gcig byin pa'i dga' rjo tsam rang gi bu la rgya dngul rdil tshad byin kyang med de/ nga rang gi a pha'i rgyu rdzas nga rang gis longs los spyod snyam pa las med/ bu sring dang bu mo sogs kyang rang rnar la hab thob byed/ byin pa la ngo so med/ yang byin kyang yang slong /tha na phreng ba'i grangs 'dzin gyi sngo de legs po zhig yod kyang bslangs nas khyer/ legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed cing rang phyogs la phan pa med/ nyes na gi pha ming gi go khar lhung nas sdug la sbyor/ gnyen gzhan thams cad kyang / rang 'byor zhing skyid la phun sum tshogs pa'i dus na ni thams cad kyang lha bzhin du blta/ phan ji thogs byed/ mi dgos kyang rgyu zas dang longs spyod ster/ rang rgyad par gyur na ni nyes pa cung zad kyang ma byas kyang tshur la dgra bzhin du blta/phan btags pa'i lan du gnod pa skyel/ /de ltar bu dang bu mo gnyen nye 'brel 89

rnams la snying po cung zad kyang med pa yin te/ rje mi las/ bu dang po lha bu yid 'ong po/ /snying brtse ba'i sems la bzod glags med/ /bar du bu lon 'ded drags po//thams cad byin kyang mgu dus med//mi yi bu mo dang du bcug /drin chen pha ma phyi ru phud/ /pha yis bos kyang lan mi ster/ /ma yis bos kyang ang mi khug /tha ma khyim mtshes snying ring po//khram pa'i kha chos byas pas phung //rang skyes kyi dgra bo sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bshal thag spangs pa yin/ /'jig rten gyi bu tsha nga mi 'dod//ces dang / bu mo dang po lha phrug 'dzum kha mo/ /nor gang dmar khyer ba'i dbang mo che/ /bar du lan chags 'khor med ma//pha la dngos su bslangs nas khyer/ /ma la lkog tu brkus nas khyer/ /byin pa la ngo so mi byed ma/ci/drin chen pha ma snying rlung slong / /tha ma srin mo gdong dmar ma//legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed ma/ /nyes na rang gi byur sdud ma/ /'phung byed kyi srin mo sems 4 gzan/ /sangs med kyi mya ngan spangs pa yin/ /'phung gzhi'i bu mo nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang /gnyen dang po 'phrad dga' mthong 'dzum po//'dir byon dang 'dir bzhugs kyis lung pa 'gengs//bar du sha chang gi zas lan can/ /par gcig lan du tshur gcig ster//tha ma chags sdang gi gyod gzhi can//sdug grogs kyi rgyad rtsa sems la gzan//skyid tshe'i za grogs de spangs pa yin//'jig rten gyi nye du nga mi 'dod//ces gsungs pa lta bu yin no//de bzhin du 'dod pa thog tu mi 'khel ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rang bde skyid mi 'dod pa gcig kyang med mod/ de ltar 'dod pa ltar 'ong ba ni su yang med/ skyid du re nas cha/khar brtsigs kyang zhig nas rang bsad pa dang / 'grangs su re nas zas 90

rnams la snying po cung zad kyang med pa yin te/ rje mi las/ bu dang po lha bu yid 'ong po/ /snying brtse ba'i sems la bzod glags med/ /bar du bu lon 'ded drags po//thams cad byin kyang mgu dus med//mi yi bu mo dang du bcug /drin chen pha ma phyi ru phud/ /pha yis bos kyang lan mi ster/ /ma yis bos kyang ang mi khug /tha ma khyim mtshes snying ring po//khram pa'i kha chos byas pas phung //rang skyes kyi dgra bo sems la gzan/ /'khor ba'i bshal thag spangs pa yin/ /'jig rten gyi bu tsha nga mi 'dod//ces dang / bu mo dang po lha phrug 'dzum kha mo/ /nor gang dmar khyer ba'i dbang mo che/ /bar du lan chags 'khor med ma//pha la dngos su bslangs nas khyer/ /ma la lkog tu brkus nas khyer/ /byin pa la ngo so mi byed ma/ci/drin chen pha ma snying rlung slong / /tha ma srin mo gdong dmar ma//legs na gzhan gyi dpal skyed ma/ /nyes na rang gi byur sdud ma/ /'phung byed kyi srin mo sems 4 gzan/ /sangs med kyi mya ngan spangs pa yin/ /'phung gzhi'i bu mo nga mi 'dod/ /ces dang /gnyen dang po 'phrad dga' mthong 'dzum po//'dir byon dang 'dir bzhugs kyis lung pa 'gengs//bar du sha chang gi zas lan can/ /par gcig lan du tshur gcig ster//tha ma chags sdang gi gyod gzhi can//sdug grogs kyi rgyad rtsa sems la gzan//skyid tshe'i za grogs de spangs pa yin//'jig rten gyi nye du nga mi 'dod//ces gsungs pa lta bu yin no//de bzhin du 'dod pa thog tu mi 'khel ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'di na rang bde skyid mi 'dod pa gcig kyang med mod/ de ltar 'dod pa ltar 'ong ba ni su yang med/ skyid du re nas cha/khar brtsigs kyang zhig nas rang bsad pa dang / 'grangs su re nas zas 90

zosapa yang nad du gyur nas srog la rgo'/ ba dang / rgyal du re nas g.yul ngor phyin pas 'phral du bsad pa dang / khe spogs 'dod pa sa tshong la phyin pa na dgras bcom ste sprang por gyur pa sogs tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang longs spyod 'byung du re nas 'bad rtsol dang rtsol sgrub ji tsam byas kyang rang la sngon gyi las dbang zhig med na 'phral du lto 'grangs pa tsam yang mi 'ong zhing rang gzhan sdug la sbyor/ grub nges pa ngan song gi gting nas mi thar ba zhig grub pa ma gtogs ci yang med/ des na 'bad rtsol ri bo tsam byed pa las/ bsod nams me stag tsam bsags pa dga' ba yin pas grub dus med pa'i 'khor ba'i bya byed kyis ci bya/ de lta bu'i las la 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus nas ji tsam 'bad pa yin kyang 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na las mi 'dug de sngon 'jig rten tshe 'di'i ched du mi tshe gcig gi stod smad la 'bad pa tsam dam pa'i chos la 'bad na/ da tsam sangs rgyas pa'am/ min kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gtan nas myong mi dgos pa zhig ni grub nges te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'dod ldan byang chub spyod pa bas/ /sdug bsngal che la byang chub med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ da res spang blang gi gnad shes pa'i skabs 'dir 'grub dus med pa 'khor ba'i bya gzhag la mi brtson par/ 'grub par nges pa'i dam pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig bsgrub dgos snyam du bsgom mo//mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab pa'i sdug bsngal ni/de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs de dag thams cad 'dod pa'i gang zag ni gcig tsam yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na med kyang / mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal de dag kho na la longs spyod/ sngon gyi las dbang las rgyal po'i mnga' ris 91

dang / phyug po'i bran lta bu ni rang dbang skad cig kyang med par mi 'dod bzhin du de dag gi dbang du gyur/ nyes pa cung zad re'i phyir sdug bsngal du ma gtad kyang bya thabs bral/ da lta gsod sar khrid kyang 'gro ba las 'bros pa tsam yang mi nus pas mtshon mi 'dod pa kho na thog tu 'bab ste/kun mkhyen klong chen pas/bza' tshang nye 'brel 'di dang dus rtag tu//mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral bar nges//bzang po'i gnas mal 'di ru dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'dug par 'dod kyang 'gro bar nges/ /bde skyid longs spyod 'di dang dus rtag tu//mi 'bral spyod par 'dod kyang bor bar nges//dal 'byor mi lus mchog 'di dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral rtag par 'dod kyang 'chi bar nges/ /bzang po'i bla ma 'di dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral chos nyan 'dod kyang 'bral bar nges/ /dam pa'i grogs bzang rnams dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral nges pas/ /de ring nyid nas brtson pa'i go bgos te//'bral med bde chen gling du bgrod re ran/ /skyo shas gting nas skye ba'i grogs rnams la/ /chos med sprang po bdag gis de skad bskul//zhes gsungs so//des na nor longs spyod bde skyid snyan grags sogs 'byung ba'i rgyu rang la sngon bsags kyi dge 'bras shig yod na ni mi 'dod kyang shugs kyis 'byung / de med na ni ji tsam 'bad — cing rtsol sgrub byas kyang 'dod pa mi 'grub cing mi 'dod pa kho na 'du bas/rnar zad pa med pa chog shes kyi nor la brten nas yang dag pa 'i dam pa'i chos ma bsgrubs na chos sgor zhugs nas 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ga'agre sgrub pa ri rang nyid sdug la dam pa rnam/sa kyis khrel ba'i rgyu yin te/ rje btsun rim po che grags 92

pa'i 'al nas/tshe 'di'i 'du shes ma log par//chos sgor zhugs pas ci la phan//skye shis 'jigs pa med pa la/ /gdams ngag bstan pas ci la phan/ /rnam rtog skra lo ma breg par/ /mgo spu breg pas ci la phan/ /tha mal 'du shes ma bsgyur bar/ /gos mdog bsgyur bas ci la phan/ /bla ma dam pa ma bsten par//rang yul spangs pas ci la phan//gdams ngag nyams su ma blangs na/ /thos bsam byas pas ci la phan//'chi ba'i dus la babs pa na//chos min phan par mi gda'o//zhes gsungs la/rje mi las/spyir rgyal ba mi yi dbang po des//chos rnams chos brgyad 'joms phyir gsungs/ /da lta'i mkhas par rlom pa rnams//chos brgyad che ru ma song ngam//rgyal bas tshul khrims bsrung ba de/ /'jig rten bya ba spang phyir gsungs/ /da lta'i khrims bsrung btsun pa rnams//bya gzhag mang du ma song ngam//sngon dus drang srong cha lugs de//nye du'i 'brel thag gcod phyir gsungs//da lta'i drang srong cha lugs rnams/ /ngo srung che ru ma song ngam//mdor na 'chi ba ma dran pa'i//dam chos ci byed gyi nar gda'//zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa lha dang lha min gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ 'o na mi la sdug bsngal de lta bu yod mod/ lha dang lha min la sdug bsngal med dam snyam na/ de med pa ma yin te/ 'dod khams kyi lha rnams ni bsod nams kyi dbang gis 'dod pa'i yon tan 'bad med du 'byung ba de dag gis khengs shing / de dag la chags nas nyin mtshan du bag med par longs spyod pa ma gtogs dge ba bya ba'i bsam pa skad cig kyang mi tshol/ sdom bzhi ston pa lha'i rnga bo che zhes bya ba nam mkha' las 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa sogs kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs kyang / khong rngams 'dod yon kho na'i dbang du gyur 93

pas cung zad kyang yid mi 'jug pa/de 'dra zhig gi ngang la las de zad pa na/da ste zhag 'di tsam na 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes sgra lhang gis bar snang stong pa nas sgrogs pa thos pa na sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing / der ma zad lha la rtsa ba'i 'chi ltas lnga/ nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga 'byung ba'i tshe/dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal 'byung ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i 'chi ltas lnga ni/sngon gyi lus shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba de 'gyur ba dang /sngar phan chad gang la 'dug pa der 'dod yon la g.yengs nas lhod de gnas pa la da 'dug sa gcig tu mi tshugs par stan la sdod snying mi 'dod pa dang /sngar lus la btags pa'i me tog rnams sal le zil pa phrom mer gnas pa la/da snga dro btags pa nyin gung / nyin gung btags pa dgong mor song ba na rid cing rnyid par 'gyur ba dang / sngar lus la rgyal 'byung rgyu med pa la da lus la rdul 'byung ba dang / de la brten nas sngar phan gos la dreg pa mi 'ong ba la/ da dreg pa nag 'jag gis 'byung ba dang lnga yin te/ bshes spreng las/ lus kyi kha dog mi sdug 'gyur ba dang / /stan la mi dga' me tog phreng rnying dang //gos la dri ma chags dang lus la ni/ /sngon chad med pa'i rdul 'byung zhes bgyi ba//mtho ris 'chi 'pho sgron bgyid 'chi ltas lnga//zhes gsungs so//nye ba'i 'chi ltas lnga ni/ lus kyi 'od chung du song ba dang / khrus byas pa'i chu lus la chags pa dang / gos rgyan las sgra mi snyan pa 'byung ba dang / mig gi rdzi ma 'khrab pa dang / g.yo ba'i bdag nyid can yang yul gcig la chags pa rnams yin par drang srong rgyal bas zhus pa'i mdo las 'byung ngo /de lta bu dag byung ba na/ grogs yid gcugs pa dang nye 94

'brel rnams kyis kyang spangs te phyogs la nye mi nus par ring po nas me tog gtor ba tsam byed pa dang /zag bcas kyi mngon shes kyis bltas pa na sngar byas kyi dge ba rnams ni zad/ dug gsum gyi dbang gis 'dod yon bag med du spyad pa'i rnam smin gyis dmyal ba sogs su skye ba shes nas dmyal ba yang sos sogs kyi sdug bsngal las ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang /de nas shi 'phos nas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong dgos te/dran pa nyer bzhag las/lha rnams 'chi bar 'gyur pa'i tshe//sdug bsngal 'byung ba gang yin pa/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba yis/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do//zhes gsungs so/ /gzugs dang gzugs med kyi lha rnams la de lta bu'i sdug bsngal mngon gyur pa med kyang / bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba myur du sa la 'bab dgos pa ltar/ kho rang gi ngos skal du gyur pa'i ting 'dzin la yun ring du 'byams/ de las sad pa na ngas ting nge 'dzin yun de tsam la bsgoms pas da 'khor ba las grol yod snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang bcas te mngon shes kyis bltas pa na/ dmyal ba la sogs par skye ba mthong nas/ 'a 'i ngas yun de tsam du ting 'dzin bsgoms kyang 'khor ba las mi thar ba 'dug pas/ 'jig rten na thar pa dang grol ba zhes pa rtsa ba nas mi 'dug snyam du log lta chen po skye/des mtshams sbyar nas/ de nas 'phos te ngan song gi sdug bsngal 'di'o zhes tshad gzung du med pa myong dgos pa yin/lha ma yin du skyes pa rnams ni/ der skyes pa tsam gyis khong khro dang rgyud 'khrugs pa 'ba' zhig gis nyin mtshan dal ba med pa'i tshul du 'thab rtsod kho nas dus 'da' ba dang / khyad par dpag 95

bsam gyi shing / lha'i bu mo sogs mdor na lha'i dpal 'byor la phrag dog gi dbang gis lha dang 'thab pa'i tshe lha bsod nams che/ lha min bsod nams chung bas phal cher lha min kho na pham ste bsad bcom 'jigs skrag kho nas dus 'da' ba dang / lha min gyi yul na mtsho kun snang zhes bya ba la bltas pa'i tshe/ lha yul du bsad bcom gang byas me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar mthong / ngu zhing brang brdung ba sogs sdug bsngal kho nas dus 'da' bzhin pa'i ngang nas/der skyes pa'i las rnams zad pa dang tshe 'phos te/ dmyal ba yang sos la sogs par skyes nas sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin te/ bshes thing las/ lha min dag na'ang rang bzhin gyis lha yi/ /dpal la sdang phyir yid kyi sdug bsngal che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na mi dang lha lha min gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas 'khor ba las thar nges pa'i chos shig bsgrub par bgyi'o sogs snga ma bzhin du bsgom mo/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsgom pa'i khrid do// gsum pa thar 'dod skye phyir 'du byed sdug bsngal bsgom pa ni/skyes bu rang rgyud kyi zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po lnga blang tsam nyid nas gnas ngan len gyi sgo nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin la/ de la las la zin pa med pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/'dod yon gyis tshim pa med pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/skye shi la sun pa med pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni 'khor ba'i gnas gang du skyes kyang / de'i bya ba za zir ji snyed nyin mtshan dal dus med par rgas rgas shi shi las byas kyang tshar ba'am zin pa'i dus med par byed 'phro kho na la 'chi/yang tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'jug dgos pa ste/mdor na sngar 96

phan sgo gsum gyi las 'di byas dang 'di ma byas med pa zhig byas kyang de thams cad ngal ba don med tsam du ma zad/ phal cher 'bras bu log pa kho nar song nas 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams dgos pa yin te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /bya ba'i las la zin pa med/ /mi mang yang sdug la nyung yang sdug /dor phyug kyang sdug la stogs kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad//grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi//shi yang grabs la zin pa med//tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'jug /'khor ba sdug bsngal phung po la//zhen pa byed rnams the le le//zhes dang /bzhi brgya pa las/las ni 'bad pas byed 'gyur zhing //byas zin 'bad pa med par 'jig /de ltar gyur kyang khyod la ko /las la chags bral 'ga' yod min/ /zhes pa ltar tshe 'di yi don med kyi bya byed snying po med pa 'di dag blos ling gis btang nas chog shes byed do snyam pa sogs bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'dod yon la tshim pa med pa ni/ rang re rnams thog mar 'di'o zhes tshad gzung du med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ lhar skyes nas bdud rtsi 'thung ba nas bzung ste/dmyal bar skyes nas lcags bsregs zos pa/yi dwags su skyes nas rnag khrag zos pa/ /'bur skyes nas lud zos pa'i bar bza' btung la 'di byas dang 'di ma byas med de/ mya ngan bsal ba las yang dang yang du dmyal ba na//zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung ba//rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ khyi dang phag tu gyur pa na/ /mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa/ /ri yi rgyal po lhun po yi/ /tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /mdza' bshes rab tu bral ba yis//'khor ba'i gnas su gang ngus pa/ /mig gi 97

phan sgo gsum gyi las 'di byas dang 'di ma byas med pa zhig byas kyang de thams cad ngal ba don med tsam du ma zad/ phal cher 'bras bu log pa kho nar song nas 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams dgos pa yin te/ rje btsun rin po ches/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /bya ba'i las la zin pa med/ /mi mang yang sdug la nyung yang sdug /dor phyug kyang sdug la stogs kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad//grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi//shi yang grabs la zin pa med//tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'jug /'khor ba sdug bsngal phung po la//zhen pa byed rnams the le le//zhes dang /bzhi brgya pa las/las ni 'bad pas byed 'gyur zhing //byas zin 'bad pa med par 'jig /de ltar gyur kyang khyod la ko /las la chags bral 'ga' yod min/ /zhes pa ltar tshe 'di yi don med kyi bya byed snying po med pa 'di dag blos ling gis btang nas chog shes byed do snyam pa sogs bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'dod yon la tshim pa med pa ni/ rang re rnams thog mar 'di'o zhes tshad gzung du med pa nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe/ lhar skyes nas bdud rtsi 'thung ba nas bzung ste/dmyal bar skyes nas lcags bsregs zos pa/yi dwags su skyes nas rnag khrag zos pa/ /'bur skyes nas lud zos pa'i bar bza' btung la 'di byas dang 'di ma byas med de/ mya ngan bsal ba las yang dang yang du dmyal ba na//zangs zhun bskol ba gang 'thung ba//rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ khyi dang phag tu gyur pa na/ /mi gtsang ba ni gang zos pa/ /ri yi rgyal po lhun po yi/ /tshad las shin tu lhag par 'gyur/ /mdza' bshes rab tu bral ba yis//'khor ba'i gnas su gang ngus pa/ /mig gi 97

mchi ma'i thibs pa yi/ /snod du rgya mtsho rung ma yin//phan tshunadag tu rtsod pa'i phyir//mgo bo gcod pa gang yin pa/ /spungs na de ltar mtho ba ni//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal//srin bur gyur cing rab bkres pas/ /sa lud zos pa gang yin pa//'o ma'i rgya mtsho che nang du/ /de yis bkang na shin tu 'gengs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de tsam phar zhog skyes nas da lta'i bar du bza' btung rab 'bring ci rnyed zos 'thung yang ngoms shing tshims nas blo kha rdzogs pa'i dus cung zad kyang med de/ /phar phyin bsdus pa las/ 'dod pa de dag thob pa dang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bsten pa dang / /mang du bsags pas mi ngoms na/ /de las nad chen gang zhig yod/ /ces gsungs/ der ma zad 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba kho na yin te/ ja dang rtsam pa lta bu la mtshon na/ ja rgya yul du sa bon 'debs pa dang / lo ma breg pa sogs kyi dus srog chags bsad pa grangs kyis mi chod/ dar rtse mdo man chad nas mi yi khur brda byas nas mi re re'i khag drug bcu gnyis re mgo la brten nas khur bas dpral ba'i pags pa zad de rus pa skya seng nge mthong yang da dung khur/ dar mdo yan chad mdzo g.yag dre'u sogs la bkal nas 'ong bas rgyab chad glo bug sru byi ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtad/ ja de nyo tshong gi dus kyang mna' dang khrel la mi brtsi g.yo sgyu dang rtsod pa kho nas tshong byas/ tshong zong yang pal cher lug gi bal dang tsha ru sogs la byas/ bal breg pa'i dus lug shig dang tre le sogs srog chags dang spu nyag mang nyung med pa yod pa la/de dag las phal cher ni gris bregs te/ mgo bcad rked pa rdum/ nang cha phyung ste bsad/ma shi ba rnams 98

mchi ma'i thibs pa yi/ /snod du rgya mtsho rung ma yin//phan tshunadag tu rtsod pa'i phyir//mgo bo gcod pa gang yin pa/ /spungs na de ltar mtho ba ni//tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal//srin bur gyur cing rab bkres pas/ /sa lud zos pa gang yin pa//'o ma'i rgya mtsho che nang du/ /de yis bkang na shin tu 'gengs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de tsam phar zhog skyes nas da lta'i bar du bza' btung rab 'bring ci rnyed zos 'thung yang ngoms shing tshims nas blo kha rdzogs pa'i dus cung zad kyang med de/ /phar phyin bsdus pa las/ 'dod pa de dag thob pa dang / /nyin gcig bzhin du bsten pa dang / /mang du bsags pas mi ngoms na/ /de las nad chen gang zhig yod/ /ces gsungs/ der ma zad 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba kho na yin te/ ja dang rtsam pa lta bu la mtshon na/ ja rgya yul du sa bon 'debs pa dang / lo ma breg pa sogs kyi dus srog chags bsad pa grangs kyis mi chod/ dar rtse mdo man chad nas mi yi khur brda byas nas mi re re'i khag drug bcu gnyis re mgo la brten nas khur bas dpral ba'i pags pa zad de rus pa skya seng nge mthong yang da dung khur/ dar mdo yan chad mdzo g.yag dre'u sogs la bkal nas 'ong bas rgyab chad glo bug sru byi ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa gtad/ ja de nyo tshong gi dus kyang mna' dang khrel la mi brtsi g.yo sgyu dang rtsod pa kho nas tshong byas/ tshong zong yang pal cher lug gi bal dang tsha ru sogs la byas/ bal breg pa'i dus lug shig dang tre le sogs srog chags dang spu nyag mang nyung med pa yod pa la/de dag las phal cher ni gris bregs te/ mgo bcad rked pa rdum/ nang cha phyung ste bsad/ma shi ba rnams 98

kyang bal dang lhan du gcus/dbugs 'thum la ngan gsod kho na byas pa yin/tsha ru yang lug gu 'phral du skyes pa de dbang po thams cad rdzogs pa sogs kyi dus su 'ga' zhig gis bsad pa sogs/ de lta bu'i rgyu rtsas nyos pa sogs la bsams na kham gcig tsam btung yang ngan song gi rgyu byed pa las mi 'dug /rtsam pa yang dang po zhing la slog brgyab pa'i gnas skabs/ sa 'og gi 'bu thams cad sa steng du phyung / sa steng gi 'bu thams cad sa 'og tu mnan/ rmod glang gi rjes la bya rog dang byi'u sogs kha dal khom med par 'bu sgrum gyin 'gro ba de yin/de bzhin du zhing la chu 'dren skabs/ rlan la gnas pa'i srog chags thams cad skam la bkram/skam la gnas pa'i srog chags thams cad gsher gyis bsad/de bzhin du sa bon 'debs pa 'breg pa brdung ba sogs kyi dus bsad pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod/ de dag la bsams na 'bu sbrang kho na phye byas pa 'gam pa dang 'dra/ de bzhin du mar dang 'o ma sogs kyang dkar gsum mngar gsum zhes sdig pa med par brtsi yang rtol le dang be'u lu gu sogs phal che ba ni bsad/ma bsad pa rnams kyang skyes ma thag nas ma 'o mngar mo kham gang yang nu long med par ske la thag pa bzhag/sdod na gdang la btags/'gro na phan tshun thel/de thams cad kyi zas skal dang 'thung skal 'o ma kham gang yod pa de phrogs nas nying khur byas/ma'i lus kyi bcud/ bu'i srog gi zungs phrogs pas/ ma shi ma gson tsam du gyur te/ma 'bri rgog po dag kyang dpyid ku'i dus nyal na mal nas ldang mi nus pa tsam du zungs zad/ be'u lug rnams kyang phal cher ni mu ge kho nas stogs grir 'chi/ ma shi ba rnams kyang skem skem pa nyam chung ba/ 'gros gum 99

gum pa shi la khad pa yog tho tsam re las med pa byas pa de yin/ de bzhin du da lta rang res skyid por brtsi ba thams cad kha la za rgyu/ rgyab la gyon rgyu rgyu zas dang longs spyod thams cad gang la bsam yang sdig pa kho nas bsgrub pa zhig ma gtogs med pas/ sdig pa thams cad kyi 'bras bu mthar ni/ ngan song sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par spyod dgos pa yin pas/ da lta skyid por snang ba thams cad kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin no gsungs/ de dag ni dpal sprul chos kyi dbang po'i legs bshad do/ /de lta bu sdig pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i 'dod yon la ji tsam spyad kyang tshim pa med par slar yang mngon zhen cher song nas bag med du spyad pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su song ste sdug bsngal 'di ma myong bya ba med pa myong bar 'gyur te/spyod 'jug las/nyes dmigs mang la mnog chung ste/ /shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs dag gis/ /rtswa ni kham 'ga' zos pa bzhin//phyugs kyis bsgrubs na'ang mi dkon pa'i/ /mnog chung gang yin de don du/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed dka' 'di/ /las kyis mnar ba rnams kyis bcom/ /zhes so/ /lhag par bud med la chags pa'i nyes pa'ang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rnam pa kun du nor 'jig dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin//mi gang dag ni bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde bar ga la 'gyur/ /bud med phung bar byed pa ste//'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu//gal te bdag la phan 'dod na//de bas bud med rnam par spang / /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ bud med lus ni don du ni//gtsang ba cung zad yod ma yin//kha ni kha chu rul ba dang / /so skyag mi gtsang snod yin no//zhes dang /rje btsun rin po ches/dran pa nyams pa'i chang 100
