gum pa shi la khad pa yog tho tsam re las med pa byas pa de yin/ de bzhin du da lta rang res skyid por brtsi ba thams cad kha la za rgyu/ rgyab la gyon rgyu rgyu zas dang longs spyod thams cad gang la bsam yang sdig pa kho nas bsgrub pa zhig ma gtogs med pas/ sdig pa thams cad kyi 'bras bu mthar ni/ ngan song sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par spyod dgos pa yin pas/ da lta skyid por snang ba thams cad kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin no gsungs/ de dag ni dpal sprul chos kyi dbang po'i legs bshad do/ /de lta bu sdig pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i 'dod yon la ji tsam spyad kyang tshim pa med par slar yang mngon zhen cher song nas bag med du spyad pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar gtan 'khyams su song ste sdug bsngal 'di ma myong bya ba med pa myong bar 'gyur te/spyod 'jug las/nyes dmigs mang la mnog chung ste/ /shing rta 'dren pa'i phyugs dag gis/ /rtswa ni kham 'ga' zos pa bzhin//phyugs kyis bsgrubs na'ang mi dkon pa'i/ /mnog chung gang yin de don du/ /dal 'byor phun tshogs rnyed dka' 'di/ /las kyis mnar ba rnams kyis bcom/ /zhes so/ /lhag par bud med la chags pa'i nyes pa'ang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rnam pa kun du nor 'jig dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin//mi gang dag ni bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde bar ga la 'gyur/ /bud med phung bar byed pa ste//'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu//gal te bdag la phan 'dod na//de bas bud med rnam par spang / /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ bud med lus ni don du ni//gtsang ba cung zad yod ma yin//kha ni kha chu rul ba dang / /so skyag mi gtsang snod yin no//zhes dang /rje btsun rin po ches/dran pa nyams pa'i chang 100

dang gcig /snying rje nyams pa'i sha dang gnyis/ /grags pa nyams pa'i bud med gsum//'di gsum sgom chen gyi khong skran lags//nges 'byung gi me btsa' myur du thob//ces dang /spyod 'jug las/'jig rten 'di dang sku rol tu'ang //'dod pa rnams ni phung khrol skyed//'dir ni gsod dang bcings dang gcod//pha rol tu ni dmyal sogs sgrub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'dod yon gyi nyes dmigs shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la chags zhen spangs nas dam chos rnam dag cig bsgrub snyam pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ gsum pa skye shi la sun pa med pa'i sdug bsngal bsam pa ni/ 'o skol rnams bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol zhig nas/ da ltar gyi bar du las nyon gyi dbang gis 'gro ba drug tu rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba ltar 'khyams shing song song ba las sa phyogs 'dir bdag gis skye ba ma blangs bya ba'i sa phyogs sam/ sems can 'di'i lto bar ma nyal bya ba'i sems can nam/ rigs drug gi nang tshan 'dir ma skyes bya ba'i mtshan gzhi gcig tsam yang mi rnyed cing / sngar sems can gcig gis rang nyid kyi ma byas pa'i nu zho 'thung ba kho na bsags na'ang rgya mtsho bzhi las mang ste/ bshes zing las/ re res rgya mtsho bzhi las lhag pa yi//'o ma 'thung ste da dung so so yi//skye ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor ba pas/ /de bas ches mang nyid cig btung 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs la/ sems can gcig nyid du yang yang skyes shing shi ba'i rus pa sa phyogs gcig tu bsags na dbus kyi ri rgyal lhun po las lhag cing / sems can gcig gis rang gi ma yang yang byas pa'i grangs kyi mtha' sa chen po 'di rgya shug gi tshi gu tsam gyi ril bur dril na'ang da dung sas mi lang ste/ bshes spring las/ re 101

re'i bdag nyid rus pa'i phung po ni/ /lhun po mnyam pa snyed cig 'das gyur te//ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshi gu tsam//ril bur bgrangs kyang sa yis lang mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar skye shi la grangs tshad med pa de ltar byas kyang skye shi la sun pa med/ 'dod yon gyis tshim pa med/ las la zin pa med pa de lta bu'i sdug bsngal la dus rtag tu spyod kyang / /so so'i skye bo rnams kyis de dag sdug bsngal du ma tshor bar bde bar zhen nas de'i rgyu mi dge ba kho na la 'jug la/ 'phags pa rnams de dag sdug bsngal du gzigs pas yid 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin te/mdzod 'grel las/ byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis//'du byed sdug bsngal spu mi mthong //'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba rnams/ /de yis rtag tu yid kyang 'byung //zhes gsungs so/ /des na 'gro ba'i gnas rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin/ me'i 'obs/ srin mo'i gling / dug sbrul gdug pa'i tshang / mi gtsang ba'i khang pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi gnas kho na yin te/ byams pas/mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med bzhin 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ces dang /klu sgrub kyis/ des pa 'dod pas phongs dang 'chi ba dang / na dang rga sogs sdug bsngal du ma yi/ /'byung gnas 'khor ba 'di la skyo mdzad cing //de yi nyes pa'i shas kyang gsan par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal du shes pa'i skyo ba med na nges 'byung thar pa don gnyer gyi blo mi skye ste/ bzhi brgya pa las/gang la 'dir skyo yod min pa//de la zhi gus ga la yod/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ sdug bsngal med par nges 'byung med/ /de bas sems khyod brtan par mnos//zhes dang /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis bla ma sa skya pa chen po la/102

tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /'khor ba'i gnas ris ya ki srid rtse nas ma ki dmyal gnas yan chad gang du skyes kyang sngar bshad pa'i sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i tshul rnams go lo thos lo tsam du ma bzhag par sdug bsngal de rnams rang gi sems thog tu blangs nas/da ni gnas gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ grogs su dang 'grogs kyang sdug bsngal gyi snon ma/ zas ci la spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/las ci byas thams cad sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo las ma 'das pas/skyid dang bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang med cing / snying po mi 'dug snyam du zhen pa gting nas log pa mkhris nad can la btsos zan byin pa lta bu zhig dgos la/de byung na thar pa thams cad ma.o pa'i go 'phang la thob 'dod dang / las 'bras la yid ches pa/ tshe 'di blos thong ba/ sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la spro ba/ lam la slob pa'ang 'bad med shugs kyis 'byung ste/ lam 'bras jo lcags ma las de ltar khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang skyid med pa'i bsam mno thong na ci byas chos su 'gro ba yin rna/ /zhes dang / 'brom rin po ches kyang / dus nyin dang mtshan du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgoms/ /de shes na 'jigs pas yar la 'gro snying 'dod/ /ces gsungs pas 'dir thog mar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston pa'i dgos pa yang de yin la/ /des na khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas der mi skye ba'i chos rnam dag cig bsgrub snyam pa dang / de 'grub pa bla ma dkon mchog la gsol 'debs dang / 'khor bar skyes ba'i sems can thams cad la 103

byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab pa rnams tshul bzhin bya'o//srid gsum gnas ris mtho dman gar skyes kyang / /me 'obs srin gling zas mchog dug sbyar ltar//shes nas zhi bsil thar ba'i khang bzang du/sems yod shes ldan su zhig bros mi byed/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsgom pa'i khrid de 'di yan gyis yid 'byung bskyed de chos la 'jug phyir 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston pa'i khrid rnams bstan zin to//gnyis pa/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba/gnyis pa chos la brtson 'grus bskyed phyir dal 'byor rnyed dka'i khrid ni/de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes pas de las thar pa'i thabs 'tshol ba'i blo skye la/ thar pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos gcig pu las gzhan med cing de'ang mi lus kho na la brten nas bsgrub dgos pas na/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'i rjes su dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa yin la/ de la dal 'byor rnyed dka' bar bsam pa/ rnyed pa'i dal 'byor don chen bar bsam pa'o/dang po la rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba/ngo bo'i sgo nas/dpe yis sgo nas/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni rgyu nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa'i las mi dge ba bsags pa las 'bras bu ngan song gsum dang / rgyu dge ba'i las bsags pa las 'bras bu mtho ris rnam gsum 'byung ba las/ rgyu mi dge ba gsog pa ni mang du yod la/ rgyu dge ba byed pa ni ches nyung ba'i phyir dang / khyad par dge ba'i nang nas kyang rgyu tshul khrims bsrungs pa las 'bras bu 104

dal 'byor gyi rten 'di thob pa yin pa la/ rgyu tshul khrims dag par bsrung ba ni shin tu dkon pa yin la/ tshul khrims ma bsrungs nas nyon mongs pa 'byol nyog tu spyad pas bye ma'i sgro ba kha sbubs pa ltar ngan song du 'gro ba yin pas/ des na tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig bsrung bar bya snyam du bsam par bya dgos te/spyod 'jug las/ dge ba dag kyang ma byas shing / /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na//bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni//bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur//zhes dang /yon tan rin chen sdud pa las/khrims kyis dud 'gro 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang //mi khoms brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed//ces dang / kun mkhyen rong ston chen pos kyang /tshul khrims kyis ni ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal gcod//mi khoms gnas las ring du 'da' bar 'gyur/ /dal ba'i yon tan phun tshogs rab rnyed cing //lus ngag yid gsum dul ba dri med thob//ces gsungs so//gnyis pa ngo bo'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ spyir mi lus tsam thob pa mang yang chos bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus ni srid pa tsam yin la/ chos byed pa la mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spangs shing chos byed shes kyi 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa la dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad du bshad la/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ mi'i rten du ma gyur pa'i mi khom pa bzhi dang / mir gyur ba'i mi khom pa bzhi dang brgyad spangs pas dal ba brgyad de/de ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang //kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni//log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa//lhags pa 'di rnams mi khoms brgyad//ces gsungs pas/de la dmyal ba ni sdug bsngal drag pos gzir ba dang / yi dwags ni bkres skom kho nas gdung ste sems 'tshig pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang /105

dud 'gro ni kun tu rmongs shing ngo tsha dang khrel med shas che bas ngan song gsum ni chos kyi sgra tsam yang thos pa'i skal ba med cing / sdug bsngal gyis nyen drags pas chos bya ba'i long cung zad kyang med la/ lha tshe ring po ste bsam gtan bzhi ba'i nang tshan 'du shes med pa'i lha ni sems sems byung gi rgyu ba 'gags nas bskal chen mang por gnas shing mthar log lta skyes te chos sgrub mi khom/ de bzhin du gzugs med khams kyi 'phags pa ma gtogs pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po ni nga rgyal che ba dang 'dod yon la rtag tu g.yeng bas 'dod lha ste/ de rnams chos sgrub mi khom pa'i lha tshe ring po rnams yin par bshes spring gi 'grel par bshad/kla klo ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas ma khyab pa'i yul ma bag mar len pa la sogs pa blang dor phyin ci log tu spyod pa dang / log lta can ni dkon mchog gsum dang las rgyu 'bras la sogs pa nam yang mi bden par 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa ni sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i tshe la skyes pa dang / cigs pa ni ngag dbang la skyon zhugs pa dang /yid dbang la skyon zhugs te/ chos bstan kyang mi go zhing sgrub mi shes pa'i skugs pa ste/ de rnams su skyes na chos sgrub mi khom pas/ rang cag rnams da res de rnams su ma skyes chos bsgrub pa la dal zhing khoms pa'i gnas skabs su mi khom pa'i gnas su phyis mi skye ba'i chos rnam dag cig sgrub dgos te/bshes spring las/log par lta ba 'dzin dang dud 'gro nyid//yi dwags nyid dang dmyal bar skye ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang mtha' 'khob dang //kla klor skye ba glen zhing lkugs pa nyid//tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung bar ni//skye ba zhes bgyi mi khoms skyon brgyad po//de dag dang 106

bral khoms pa rnyed nas ni/ /skye ba zlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa ni//rang 'byor lnga dang /gzhan 'byor lnga las/ dang po ni klu sgrub kyis/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang las mtha' ma log gnas la dad/ /ces gsungs pas 'byor pa 'di dag med na chos bya thabs med pas/ lus rten mir skyes pa'i 'byor pa dkon pa'i tshul ni sngar yang bshad zin la phyis kyang 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yul dbus su skyes pa yul gyi 'byor pa'ang dkon te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ 'khor rnam bzhi bzhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub gang du yod pa'i phyogs la yul dbus dang /de ltar med pa rnams la mtha' 'khob tu gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub med pa'i phyogs ni rgya che la/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bshad sgrub rnam dag yod pa'i sa phyogs nyung la dkon pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang po lnga tshang ba yon tan gyi 'byor pa ni/ dbang po lnga gang rung ma tshang na rab byung gi sdom pa'i snod du mi rung zhing / mos gus kyi rten rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la sogs pa mjal ba/thos bsam gyi yul gsung rab rin po cher blta ba dang nyan pa sogs kyi skal ba dang mi ldan pas chos rnam dag gi snod du mi rung ba yin no/ /las mtha' ma log pa bsam pa'i khyad par gyi 'byor pa ni/ las mtha' log pa zhes rngon pa shan pa smad tshong ma la sogs pa'i rigs rgyud du skyes pas chung ngu nas las kyi mtha' log pa'i lam du zhugs pa la zer yang / don du sgo gsum chos dang 'gal ba byed tshad las mtha' log par zhugs pa yin pas/ des na rang rgyud dam pa'i chos dang mi 'gal bar byed dgos la/ gzhan yang mtshams med dang / nye ba'i 107

mtshams med sogs rang gis ma byas shing gzhan gyis byas pa la rjes su yi rangs sogs ma byas pa'o//dad pa'i 'byor ba ni/dad pa'i gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma dad na ni/ gzhan 'jig rten pa'i lha klu rgyal po sogs mthu bo che rnams la dad pa dang / phyi rol mu stegs pa'i bstan pa sogs la ji tsam 'bad kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob mi nus pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung rtogs kyi bdag nyid can la rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad pa skyes pa ni chos rnam dag gi snod ma nor ba yin pas/ rang 'byor lnga yi gtso bo yin no/ /gnyis pa gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs//bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas 'byon par dkon pa ni/ de la spyir sangs rgyas byon pa'i bskal pa la sgron bskal dang / mi 'byon pa'i bskal pa la mun bskal zhes bya zhing / sngon yang sgron bskal dang mun bskal mang du byung la/ da ltar gyi bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon pas bskal pa bzang po zhes bya la/de nas mun bskal drug cu'i rjes su yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig /de nas mun bskal khri'i rjes su/snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig /de nas mun bskal sum brgya'i rjes su dpe skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba'i sgron bskal gcig ste/ de lta bu'i sgron bskal dang mun bskal 'dres mar 'byung zhing / sgron bskal gyi dus su yang skye gyi rnams kyi tshe lo yar 'phel la yang sangs rgyas mi 'byon par gsungs pa'i phyir/dus phal cher sangs rgyas mi 'byon pas 'da' zhing / mun pa'i bskal pa'i gnas skabs su 'phrad na dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra tsam yang med la/ da lta 108

bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pas sgron me'i bskal pa yin pas na ston pa khyad par can gyi 'byor pa yin no/ /des chos gsungs pa'ang dkon te/ gdul bya chos kyi snod du gyur pa med na sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang chos mi gsungs par bshad la/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'dis kyang rdo rje gdan du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed//su la bstan kyang go bar mi 'gyur bas//mi smra nags kyi nang du gnas par bya//zhes gsungs nas bdun phrag bdun du chos ma gsungs par bzhugs pa la/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa dang / dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phul te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pa lta bu yin la/ der ma zad bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyang dam pa'i chos la 'chad nyan ma mdzad na sems can la dngos su phan thogs par dka' bas/ des na bdag cag gi ston pas chos 'khor rim pa gsum bstan cing /de bzhin du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis kyang mdo sngags kyi chos la 'chad nyan tshul bzhin mdzad pas bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'byor pa/ bstan pa gnas pa'ang dkon te/ sangs rgyas byon chos gsungs kyang bstan pa'i gnas tshad rdzogs na/sangs rgyas phyi ma ma byung gi bar du bstan pa med la/ da res sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la/ 'bras bu'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag gsum/ sgrub pa'i dus lnga brgya phrag gsum/lung gi dus lnga brgya phrag gsum/rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya phrag gcig ste/ lnga brgya phrag bcu yod pa gsungs pa las da lta lnga brgya phrag 109

bdun pa'am brgyad tsam la slebs pas da lta bstan pa'i gnas tshad ma rdzogs pas dus kyi 'byor pa/ bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'ang dkon te/ phyi rol mu stegs pa sogs bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa mang zhing / bstan pa gnas kyang rang nyid bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs na phan thogs med de nyi ma shar yang dmus long la phan thogs med pa bzhin yin la/ zhugs pa de yang tshe 'di'i lto gos la sogs pa'i phyir ram/ phyi ma lha ma'i bde 'bras tsam don du gnyer bas bstan pa la zhugs pa ni legs smon gyi chos zhes bya la/ yang tshe 'di yi nad gdon sogs zhi ba'i ched dam phyi ma ngan song gi sdug bsngal tsam la skrag nas bstan pa la zhugs kyang 'jigs skyob kyi chos zhes bya ba de gnyis ni lam zhugs dngos ni ma yin te bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba tsam yin no/ /des na 'khor ba mtha' dag snying po med par shes nas thar pa'i lam don du gnyer bas chos sgor zhugs na ni lam gyi sna zin pas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa rang gi skal pa'i 'byor pa'o/ /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'ang dkon te/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba sogs log 'tsho sgrub mkhan rnams la sbyin bdag mang zhing 'bul mkhan mang yang / rab tu byung ba 'du 'dzi dang khyim la mi dga' zhing bsod snyoms kyi zas tsam la brten nas klog pa thos bsam dang / spong ba bsam gtan la brtson par byed pa de dag la ni bsod snyoms ster ba dkon te/ sa paṇa gyis/ gal te log 'tsho mi za ba'i//chos byed de dag dman dman 'dra//zhes gsungs/ des na dad ldan gyi yon bdag la sogs pas chos kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i 'byor pa ste/ lnga po 'di ni gzhan rkyen la ltos nas tshang dargos pas gzhan 'byor zhes bya'o/ /des 110

na lus rten gcig gi steng du chos bco brgyad po mtha' dag tshang ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du dkon zhing / der ma zad mkhas pa chen po klong chen rab 'byams pa'i yid bzhin mdzod du/ 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom pa brgyad dang /ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad gsungs pa'i dang po ni/ dug lnga 'khrugs dang blun rmongs bdud kyis zin/ /le lo can dang las ngan mtsho chen rdol/ /gzhan dbang 'jigs skyob chos ltar bcos pa ste/ /'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ni dgra gnyen la chags sdang sogs dug lnga'i nyon mongs rags pas chos sgrub 'dod kyi blo tsam skyes kyang dug lnga'i dbang du song ste chos yang dag byed du mi khom/ shin tu blun zhing shes rab med pa ni chos sgor zhugs kyang chos kyi tshig don mi shes pas thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa'i skal ba med pas mi khom/ lta spyod phyin ci log tu ston pa'i bdud kyi bshes gnyen gyis zin na log lam du bsgyur bas yang dag pa'i chos byed du mi khom/ le lo can ni le lo dang phyi bshol gyi dbang du song ste chos byed du mi khom/ sdig sgrib can las ngan gyi mtsho chen rdol ba ni/ rang byas kyi las 'bras mi shes par chos la yi chad skyes nas chos byed mi khom/ gzhan gyi bran du bkol ba rnams ni chos byed 'dod kyang gzhan dbang du song nas chos sgrub tu mi khom/ sto gos mi 'byor pa'am gzhan gyi gnod pas 'jigs nas chos la zhugs kyang zhe thag pa nas chos la nges shes med pas sngon gyi bag chags ngan goms kyis chos min la spyod pas chos rnam dag byed du mi khom/ yo byad dang rnyed bkur dang snyan grags bsgrub pa'i ched du chos sgrub pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams gi tshe 'di kho na don du gnyer 111

bas thar lam dang bral bas mi khom pa ste brgyad dang / ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ yang de nyid las/ 'ching ba dam ldan kun spyod shin tu ngan/ /'khor bar mi skyo dad pa cung zad med/ /mi dge sdig spyod chos la sems pa bral/ /sdom dang dam tshig 'chal ba zhes bya ba/ /ris chad blo yi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ tshe 'di'i nor rdzas bud med gnyen grogs sogs la chags pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings pas/ de dag gi don du g.yengs pas chos byed long med de mi khom/ mi gzhi gshis ngan kun spyod shin tu ngan pa rnams ni yang dag gi bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam du bsgyur dka' bas mi khom/ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes pa bshad kyang skrag pa'i blo gtan nas mi skye na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu nges 'byung gi blo rtsa ba nas mi skye bas chos la mi khom/ chos dang bla ma la dad pa med na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar lam du mi tshud pas mi khom/ mi dge ba sdig spyod la dga' zhing spyod na dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos las phyir phyogs te mi khom/ yon tan dge ba dang dam pa'i chos sgrub 'dod kyi sems pa dang bral zhing spro ba med na rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye bas mi khom/ thun mong theg par zhugs nas so thar byang sems kyi sdom pa nyams na ngan song las 'gro sa med la/gsang sngags kyi theg par zhugs nas bla ma dang mched grogs la dam tshig nyams pa sogs sngags kyi dam tshig nyams shing 'chal na rang gzhan phung la sbyor nas dngos grub kyi skal ba chad de rdo rje dmyal bar nyung bas 'di gnyis mi khom pa'i gnas las mi thar bas mi khom pa ste brgyad/de lta bu'i mi khoms pa'i gnas bcu drug po 'di la legs par ma brtags na deng 112

bas thar lam dang bral bas mi khom pa ste brgyad dang / ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad ni/ yang de nyid las/ 'ching ba dam ldan kun spyod shin tu ngan/ /'khor bar mi skyo dad pa cung zad med/ /mi dge sdig spyod chos la sems pa bral/ /sdom dang dam tshig 'chal ba zhes bya ba/ /ris chad blo yi mi khom rnam pa brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ tshe 'di'i nor rdzas bud med gnyen grogs sogs la chags pa'i 'ching ba dam pos bcings pas/ de dag gi don du g.yengs pas chos byed long med de mi khom/ mi gzhi gshis ngan kun spyod shin tu ngan pa rnams ni yang dag gi bshes gnyen dang 'phrad kyang dam pa'i lam du bsgyur dka' bas mi khom/ngan song dang 'khor ba'i nyes pa bshad kyang skrag pa'i blo gtan nas mi skye na chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu nges 'byung gi blo rtsa ba nas mi skye bas chos la mi khom/ chos dang bla ma la dad pa med na bstan pa'i 'jug sgo 'gags te thar lam du mi tshud pas mi khom/ mi dge ba sdig spyod la dga' zhing spyod na dam pa'i yon tan dang bral te chos las phyir phyogs te mi khom/ yon tan dge ba dang dam pa'i chos sgrub 'dod kyi sems pa dang bral zhing spro ba med na rang rgyud la yon tan mi skye bas mi khom/ thun mong theg par zhugs nas so thar byang sems kyi sdom pa nyams na ngan song las 'gro sa med la/gsang sngags kyi theg par zhugs nas bla ma dang mched grogs la dam tshig nyams pa sogs sngags kyi dam tshig nyams shing 'chal na rang gzhan phung la sbyor nas dngos grub kyi skal ba chad de rdo rje dmyal bar nyung bas 'di gnyis mi khom pa'i gnas las mi thar bas mi khom pa ste brgyad/de lta bu'i mi khoms pa'i gnas bcu drug po 'di la legs par ma brtags na deng 112

sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos byed pa'i gzugs brnyan du ma yod kyang / mtho dman bar ma thams cad mi khom pa 'di dag gi dbang du song nas chos byed lo byas kyang yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gro ba shas che ba 'byung ba yin pas/ des na rang rgyud la legs par brtags te dal 'byor gyi rang bzhin sum cu rtsa bzhi po 'di dag tshang ngam mi tshang legs par brtags tshang bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgom zhing /da res 'di lta bu rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor rnyed pa 'di chud zos su ma song ba'i yang dag pa'i chos shig cis kyang bsgrub dgos snyam du ne thag pa nas bsam/ mi tshang bar 'dug na thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas tshang pa'i thabs la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos so/ /gsum pa dpe yi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/rtag pa mtha' gzung gi dpe/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rgya mtsho chen por gyur ba'i nang na gnya' shing bug pa gcig pa yod pa zhig rlung gis bskyod nas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du yud tsam gyis 'khyams pa zhig yod pa'i dbang du byas/ rgya mtsho'i gting na rus sbal long ba zhig lo brgya brgya nas steng du zhug tsam re byed pa'i dbang du byas nas gnya' shing gi bug pa der rus sbal gyi mgrin pa chud pa srid dam mi srid pa shas che ba bzhin du/ dal 'byor gyi lus rten de bas kyang thob dka' bar gsungs te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing bu ga dang / /rus sbal 'phrad pa bas kyang dud 'gro las/ /mi nyid ches thob dka' bas mi dbang gis/ /dam chos spyod pas de 'bras mchis par mdzod//ces dang /zhi ba lhas kyang /rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gibu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu rnyed dka' gsungs//zhes 113

gsungs so/ /des mtshon pa'i mdo sde me tog gi tshogs dang / myang 'das sogs las gsungs pa'i khab rtser gyen bstan du bzung ba'i khar/yungs dkar khal du ma brabs pa'i tshe na/ phal cher sa la phog khab rtser yungs dkar chags pa srid pa tsam dang / gyang ngos 'jam po la sran ma gtor ba na gong bzhin 'byung la/ de ltar sa la phog pa'i tshod tsam zhig ngan song du skye ba dang / khab rtser chags pa'i tshod tsam mi lus thob pa yin gsungs so/ /bzhi pa grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ mi lus thob pa de tsam mi dkon pa 'dra/ bod gcig pu na'ang mi mang tsam yod snyam na/ de ni bsam gzhigs ma chud pa yin/ spyir lus ma thob pa bar do'i srid pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste dper na dbyar dus su ro brgya stong ji ltar bzhag kyang 'bus khengs pas 'bu'i bar srid kyang grangs med pa bzhin/lus thob pa'i rigs drug gi sems can de bas nyung du zin kyang /'gro ba gzhan gyi lus rten ni mi lus la ltos na bgrang gis mi lang ba lta bu yod de/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam/ yi dwags ni gaṅgā'i bye ma tsam/ dud 'gro ni chang 'gag gi sbang ma tsam/ lha ma yin ni kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa tsam/ lha dang mi ni sen steng gi rdul tsam las med par gsungs pas/ spyir mtho ris kyi lus rten dkon zhing de las kyang dal 'byor gyi mi lus dkon pa yin zhing / da lta rang res dbyar kha lta bu'i ri logs gcig gi sems can che phra grangs 'dren thub pa lta ci blos mi chud pa yin/ khang pa gcig gi steng 'og bar gsum na dud 'gro ni grangs med/ de'i dang gi mi ni grangs chod nges yin/rang gi gos lta bu la sro shig dang / khog pa'i nang na srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yod par bshad pas/ de dag 114

gi nang na mi ni rang nyid gcig pu las mi 'dug /mi la'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med pa'i mtha' 'khob kyi mi yi 'gro ba ni shin tu grangs mang ba rgya nag gi mi lta bu phyogs thams cad la yod la/ chos dar sar skyes pa'i mi ni shin tu dkon zhing /de las kyang dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mi lus ni ches dkon pa yin/dal 'byor gyi yon tan thams cad tshang na mi lus rin po che zhes 'bod du rung la/de thams cad dang ldan zhing dam chos rnam dag sgrub mkhan ni re re tsam las med la/ de dag ma tshang na 'jig rten gyi phyogs la rnam rig bkra zhing spyang grung du 'dzoms kyang mi lus rin po che ni ma yin te/ mi lus phal pa'am tsam po pa zhes bya/ byur po che/ snying med po/ stong log mkhan zhes bya ba'o/ /des na dal 'byor gyi lus rten 'di shin tu rnyed dka' bar 'dug pas/ da lta rang gis dal 'byor yang dag rnyed pa la dga' ba bsgom zhing / 'di cis kyang stong log tu ma song ba zhig byed dgos snyam pa sogs bsam par byed/ gnyis pa rnyed pa'i dal 'byor don che bar bsam pa ni/ de ltar rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di rnyed par dka' bar 'dug mod/ de rnyed pa la phan yon ci yod snyam na/ rang gis byung na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed pa las kyang phan yon che ste/yid bzhin gyi nor bu la gsol ba btab na tshe 'di'i sun tshogs tsam zhig 'byung la/ dal 'byor gyi lus la brten nas chos bsgrub na tshe 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad smos ci dgos/ tshe phyi ma'i mtho ris dang / theg pa 'og ma'i myang 'das nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sgo 'phang yang sgrub nus pa'i phyir te/slob spring las/gang zhig 115

thob na skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar byed cing / /byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs byed pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i//mi nyid thob nas su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces gsungs la/ slob dpon dpa' bos/gang zhig thob nas 'khor ba yi//pha rol phyin pa'i sa bon bskrun//byang chub dpal gyi sa bon mchog /yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /yon tan rgyan gyi mi rnams ni//su zhig 'dir de 'bras med byed//ces gsungs so/ /'o na 'gro ba gzhan gyi lus rten la de lta bu'i nus pa med dam zhe na/ med de spyir dge sdig gang byed kyang mi yi lus rten la byed pa stobs che ba yin la/ de'i dang nas kyang las kyi sa pa yin pas 'dzam bu'i gling pa stobs che zhing / de las kyang dal 'byor gyi lus rten stobs che ste/ slob thing las/ bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur ba'i/ /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed gnod sbyin dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes gsungs pas rigs drug gi lus rten gzhan gang las kyang dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i rten du dal 'byor gyi mi lus dgos pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /des na rgyu ngo bo dpe grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' la sngar bstan pa'i phan yon dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che rnyed pa'i dus su/ dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig ma bsgrubs par tshe 'dir snang la zhen nas chos byed lo thos lo tsam gyi ngang nas/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi sgo nas mi dge ba kho na bsgrubs na ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu lon nas chud zos byed pa'am/ gser snod rin chen gyis spras pa'i dang du ngan skyugs blugs pa'am/116

gser gling nas stong log byed pa lta bu las kyang tha chad de/ bshes spring las/gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa der/ /ngan sgyugs 'phyag par bgyid pa de bas ni/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags//zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas//bdag gis dge goms ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa gzhan med de//'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do//zhes dang /dge bshes gu chung bas/dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob nas dge ba ma byas par shi na nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa zhig rnyed nas longs ma spyad pa stor du bcug pa dang 'dra la/ sdig pa byas na nor bu de dug nad 'dres pa'i lhad zan rdog po gcig tu btsong pa dang 'dra gsungs la/yang ji skad du/ legs na thar pa'i gru gzings lus 'di yin//nyes na 'khor ba'i gting rdo lus 'di yin//dge sdig kun gyi g.yog po lus 'di yin//zhes pa ltar/ da res gang ltar byas kyang rang la rang dbang yod pa'i dus 'dir/ spyod 'jug las/dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'//skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis ni yang dag 'byor pa ga la 'gyur/ /zhes da res kyi skye ba'i lus rten 'di ni 'dun ma gtan legs dang gtan nyes kyi so mtshams yin pas/ tshe 'di la btsan sa zin nges pa'i dam pa'i chos shig ma byas na phyis nas 'di 'dra ba'i dal 'byor mi thob pa ma zad bde 'gro tsam yang dka' ste/ spyod 'jug las/ skad cig gcig byas sdig pas kyang //bskal par mnar med gnas gyur na//thog med 'khor bar bsags sdig gis//bde 'gror mi 'gro smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngan song gi 117

gnas rigs lta bur skyes na chos kyi snang ba med pas spang blang gi gnas la rmongs pa 'og nas 'og tu ngan song mu mtha' med par cing bar 'gyur ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod//dge ba dag kyang ma byas la//sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na//bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni//bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/zhes gsungs so/ /des na jo bo rjes/ /dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus/ /shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur cing / /phyis kyang shin tu rnyed dka' bas//sgrub la 'bad pas don yod mdzod/ /ces dang /'brom ston pas/rten dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'//rje sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba de bas dkon//khyed rnyed dka' dal 'byor chud zos ma byed cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ thob dka' ba dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob/ mjal dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ /'phrad dka' ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'phrad/thos dka' ba gdams ngag zab mo rnams thos pa'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor la snying po lon pa zhig bya'o snyam pa dang / de ltar 'gyur bar bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing / dal 'byor chud zos su gtong ba rnams la snying rje bsgom zhing / de dag rnams kyang mthar thug bdag gis byang chub chen por 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang /de lta bu'i dge rtsa ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi don du dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab par bya'o//dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'di la//dal 'byor chud zos gtong ba'i snying phod can//dal 'byor snying po lon nges dam chos shig/dal 118

gnas rigs lta bur skyes na chos kyi snang ba med pas spang blang gi gnas la rmongs pa 'og nas 'og tu ngan song mu mtha' med par cing bar 'gyur ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod//dge ba dag kyang ma byas la//sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na//bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni//bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/zhes gsungs so/ /des na jo bo rjes/ /dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i lus/ /shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur cing / /phyis kyang shin tu rnyed dka' bas//sgrub la 'bad pas don yod mdzod/ /ces dang /'brom ston pas/rten dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'//rje sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal ba de bas dkon//khyed rnyed dka' dal 'byor chud zos ma byed cig /ces gsungs pa ltar/ thob dka' ba dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob/ mjal dka' ba sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang mjal/ /'phrad dka' ba bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'phrad/thos dka' ba gdams ngag zab mo rnams thos pa'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor la snying po lon pa zhig bya'o snyam pa dang / de ltar 'gyur bar bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing / dal 'byor chud zos su gtong ba rnams la snying rje bsgom zhing / de dag rnams kyang mthar thug bdag gis byang chub chen por 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang /de lta bu'i dge rtsa ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi don du dmigs med bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab par bya'o//dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'di la//dal 'byor chud zos gtong ba'i snying phod can//dal 'byor snying po lon nges dam chos shig/dal 118

'byor rnyed dka' shes pas sgrub re ran/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom pa'i khrid do//gsum pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/gsum pa chos la myur du 'jug phyir 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i khrid la/ /phan yon bsam pas spro ba bskyed du 'jug/nges par 'chi ba bsams la rtag 'dzin spang / /nam 'chi cha med bsams la blo sna bsnang / /chos min phan med bsams la dam chos sgrub pa ste bzhi las//dang po la phan yon spyir bstan pa dang / /bye brag so sor bstan pa'o//dang po ni/ mdo las/ dge slong dag mi rtag pa bsam pa ni sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa yin no/ /mi rtag pa bsam pa ni sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa yin no//mi rtag pa bsam pa ni sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin no//dge slong dag rjes rnams kyi nang nas glang po che'i rjes mchog yin no//'du shes rnams kyi nang nas mi rtag pa'i 'du shes mchog yin te/ 'di dag gis ni khams gsum gyi 'dod pa dang ma rig pa dang / nga rgyal thams cad sel lo/ /zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa la dngos po la mngon zhen ldog/brtson 'grus kyi lcag tu 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyi gnyen por 'gyur/ /mthar thug stong nyid rtogs pa'i grogs byed pa'o//dang po ni/ mi rtag pa bsgoms pas/ phyi nang gi dngos po gang la'ang yid brtan med par rtogs nas mngon zhen mi skye'o/ /gnyis pa ni mi rtag par go nas nam 'chi nges med shes na bzhin pa bzang por zhon nas lcag gis bskul ba ltar/ dang po chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed/ bar du chos la skul pa'i rkyen 119

byed/ tha mar 'chi chos rgyud la 'khel ba'i grogs byed/ ga'an yang chos med chos sgor 'jug /chos pa tha ma 'bring du byed//'bring rab tu byed/ rab yang rab tu byed/ yang rab sangs rgyas thob par byed de/ mi rtag pa ma go na gzugs chos gzugs dang / kha chos byed zer yang / snying du tshe 'di'i 'dun mar gtad nas rnyed bkur dang zas nor la sems/ thos bsam sgom sgrub gang byed kyang tshe 'di'i che thabs 'ba' zhig sgrub pa las mi 'ong / gsum pa ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag par ma rtogs pa'i gang zag ni 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis kyang mi 'jigs na sdug bsngal phra mo gzhan gyis lta ci smos/ des na mi rtag pa sdug bsngal du shes pa ni sdug bsngal spong ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ji skad du/ mi rtag pa la nges par gnod/ /gang la gnod yod de bde min//zhes so/ bzhi pa ni chos rnams kyi rang bzhin don dam par grub pa zhig yin na mi 'gyur ba las/rkyen sna tshogs kyis 'gyur ba'i phyir na ngo bo ma grub pa yin no snyam du rtogs par 'gyur te/byams pas/mi rtag don ni med don dang //skye zhing 'jig pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa nges par 'chi ba bsams la rtag 'dzin spong ba la'ang / skyes nas sdod dbang med pas 'chi ba bsam/ lus la snying po med pas 'chi ba bsam/tshe la rtag pa med pas 'chi ba bsam pa'o//dang po ni/dal 'byor gyi lus 'di la brten nas dam pa'i chos rnam dag cig bya dgos par 'dug med/chos de ma 'ongs pa dal khom yod pa'i dus su bya chog gam snyam na/ ma yin te spyir 'jig rten gyi lams na skyes nas ma shi bar rang dbang du bsdad chog pa 'di lta bu zhig ces mthong ba'am/yid ches nga 'i satam thos pa'am/'di lta bu mi 120

'chi bar srid dam snyam pa'i the tshom za ba tsam yang med de/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo phyin chad nas/ /dma' dmyal ba'i gnas la thug pa yan chad du sems can yod do cog la 'chi ba'i gnas las thar pa ni gcig kyang med de/ mya ngan bsal ba las/'di ltar skyes pa thams cad kyi//mdun na 'dug pa 'chi ba ste//sa'am 'on te mtho ris na/ /skyes nas la la ma shi ba/ /'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes gsungs so//der ma zad da lta'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la sngon byon pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan zhing spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i sangs rgyas rab bdun 'khor nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas gdul bya rnams la theg gsum gyi chos mang du bstan/da lta rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i lhag zhabs tsam lus pa ma gtogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mya ngan las 'das/ bstan pa dam chos kyang rim gyis nub/da lta'i bstan pa 'di la nyan thos chen po dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang /gtad rabs bdun/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu sogs dang /bod gangs can gyi smongs 'di na yang sngon mkhas grub mang du byon zhing / de rnams kyang sa lam gyi yon tan la dbang 'byor/ /mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ 'byung bzhi la rang dbang bsgyur chog pa'i grub brnyes dam pa yin yang mthar thams cad mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan te da lta ni lo rgyus tsam las med de/ mya ngan bsal ba las/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i//rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu thing snying po med 'dra ba'i//chu bur lus la smos ci dgos//ci ste rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / sangs rgyas rnams dang nyan thos kyang //sku lus 'dzi 121

ni spong mdzad na//tha mal skye bo smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang mi 'chi ba'i gnas su bros sa gab sa sogs srid gsum gang na yang med de/ skyes rabs las/ gang du gnas kyang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa'i/ /sa phyogs de ni gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /nam mkha' na med rgya mtsho'i gting na med/ /ri bo kun gyi phrag na'ang yod ma yin//zhes gsungs so/ /des na rang re las nyon gyi dbang gis bskyed cing 'byung bzhi'i rang bzhin mi gtsang ba'i 'khrul 'khor la sems kyi rgyud brten pa sgyu lus kyi tho yor chu bur dang 'dra ba 'di nges par 'chi ba yin pas/ da lta nyid nas sgo gsum dge ba la 'bad dgos snyam du bsgom mo/ /der ma zad myur du yang 'chi ste sems can skyes pa kun gyi mdun na yod nges pa ni 'chi ba yin zhing / de yang ma yi mngal du zhugs pa'i nub mo nas bzung lam gzhan du cung zad tsam yang ma gol bar 'chi bdag gi drung du skad cig re re la yang je nyer 'gro zhing / 'chi bdag gi bdud po ni skad cig kyang mi sdod par nub ku'i grib so bzhin du tshur tshur 'ongs nas myur ba nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur te/skye rabs las/dang po ma yi mngal du zhugs pa nas//de nas bzung ste 'jig rten 'di dag ni/ /lam der zhugs nas lam gzhan ma gol bar/ /'chi bdag drung du de ni myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na blo sna bstungs te myur du 'chi bar bsams nas chos sgrub pa la myur du 'jug dgos so//gnyis pa lus la snying po med pas 'chi ba bsam pa ni/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos rnams thams cad skye 'jig mi rtag pa kho na yin te/ tshoms las/ kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /skye shing 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ skyes nas 'jig par 'gyur ba ste/ de 122

bas nye bar zhi ba bde/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas rgya mtsho dang bcas pa sra zhing mkhregs pa bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa 'di dag kyang mi rtag par mthar me bdun gyis bsregs nas me lce gcig tu 'bar/ thal ba tsam yang med pa nam mkha' stong par 'gro ba'i dus kyi mtha' yang de lta bur 'gyur na/rang re'i mi lus rten shin tu nyam chung ba gnas skabs rkyen cung zad res kyang 'jig nus pa 'di la rtag pa dang brtan pa ci yod/ nges par 'jig pa'i chos can yin no snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom dgos te/ bshes spring las/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs pas lus can 'di dag kyang //thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes so/ der ma zad stong gsum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa/ 'dod khams kyi bdag po brgya byin sogs/ bskal pa gnas pa'i tshe/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags mang por slebs pa'i lus/ nyi zla zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi brjid can rnams kyang 'chi ba las thar pa med la/ lha mi'i drang srong mngon shes lnga dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'gro ba rnams kyang 'chi ba las ma thar la/'jig rten mi yul gyi stobs 'byor mnga' ba 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal po rnams dang / 'phags yul du rgyal por snga ba mang bkur ba sogs rgya gar shar nub kyi rgyal po mnga' thang stobs 'byor rgyas pa du ma byon la/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / de man chad du yang btsan phyug kha drag mnga' thang can 123

bas nye bar zhi ba bde/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par spyi mthun gyi bsod nams las grub pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas rgya mtsho dang bcas pa sra zhing mkhregs pa bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa 'di dag kyang mi rtag par mthar me bdun gyis bsregs nas me lce gcig tu 'bar/ thal ba tsam yang med pa nam mkha' stong par 'gro ba'i dus kyi mtha' yang de lta bur 'gyur na/rang re'i mi lus rten shin tu nyam chung ba gnas skabs rkyen cung zad res kyang 'jig nus pa 'di la rtag pa dang brtan pa ci yod/ nges par 'jig pa'i chos can yin no snyam du snying thag pa nas bsgom dgos te/ bshes spring las/ sa dang lhun po rgya mtsho nyi ma bdun/ /'bar bas bsregs pas lus can 'di dag kyang //thal ba yang ni lus par mi 'gyur na/ /shin tu nyam chung mi lta smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes so/ der ma zad stong gsum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa/ 'dod khams kyi bdag po brgya byin sogs/ bskal pa gnas pa'i tshe/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags mang por slebs pa'i lus/ nyi zla zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi brjid can rnams kyang 'chi ba las thar pa med la/ lha mi'i drang srong mngon shes lnga dang ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkhar 'gro ba rnams kyang 'chi ba las ma thar la/'jig rten mi yul gyi stobs 'byor mnga' ba 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal po rnams dang / 'phags yul du rgyal por snga ba mang bkur ba sogs rgya gar shar nub kyi rgyal po mnga' thang stobs 'byor rgyas pa du ma byon la/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs su rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang / de man chad du yang btsan phyug kha drag mnga' thang can 123

bsam gyis mi khyab kyang /da lta de dag che ba rnams la lo rgyus kyi gtam cam dang /chung ba rnams la de tsam yang med pa la bsam na/ rang re'i gnas khang longs spyod mnga' thang ji tsam bzang por brtsi ba rnams kyang snga ma rnams la dpag na byi'u'i tshang tsam las med na/ 'di lta bu la rtag brtan ci yod snyam du bsam mo//de yang ji skad du/skya ngan bsal ba las/drang srong chen po lnga mngon shes//mkha' la rgyang ring 'gro ba yang / /gang du 'chi med spyod yul ba'i/ /sa der phyin par mi nus so//zhes dang /mi rtag pa'i tshoms las kyang /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi lus 'di btang nas 'gro ba dang / /de kun 'jig pa mkhas pas rtogs byas te//chos la gnas kyi nges par spyad pa spyod///ces gsungs so//de na rang cag gis da lta zas gos sogs kyis gces par bskyangs pa'i lus 'di yang mthar ro ru 'gyur te/ rul myags bya rgod sogs kyis za ba'am me la bsregs/ chu la bsgyur ba sogs kyis sha rus so sor bral te mthar thal ba tsam yang mi lus par 'gyur ro snyam du shes par bya ste/ bshes zing las/ lus mtha' thal ba mthar skam mthar 'drul zhing / /tha mar mi gtsang snying po ma mchis pa/ /rnam par 'jig dengs myag par 'gyur ba ste/ /so sor 'gyes chos can du mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa tshe la rtag pa med pas 'chi ba bsam pa ni/ rang nyid skyes nas lo dang zla ba zhag kha sang nas de ring gi bar du nyin mtshan skad cig re re la'ang tshe 'dzad cing bri ba kho na las snon pa cung zad kyang med pas myur du 'chi ba cis mi 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin ma tshan sdod pa yod med par//tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing //snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /124

bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so//da lta nad med skyon med yin kyang da lta tsam mi 'chi ba'i gdeng ni med de/ ri gzar gyi 'bab chu dang /nam mkha'i glog ltar 'chi ba myur du 'ong bar 'gyur te/ rgya cher rol pa las/srid gsum mi rtag ston ga'i sprin dang 'dra/ /'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs//skyes bu'i tshe srog nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste//ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro//zhes so//gzhan yang yul phyogs lung pa khyim mtshes//nye 'brel grwa rogs grogs mched sogs 'chi bdag gi shan pas rim gyis gsod pa mthong bzhin du rang la de lta bu 'ong snyam pa'i blo tsam yang med par/ shi ba de dag gi shul nas rgyu zas longs spyod rnams la/ dpal sprul rin po ches/mi shi ba ro yi sngas mgo na//za 'dod pa ban bon gyi glu dbyangs len//gsungs pa ltar/ro sngas kyi bla ma byed pa'am 'ga' zhig gis rin phran bu byin nas khe nyo byed pa sogs thabs gang drag gi sgo nas bya rgod ro la 'du ba lta bus yo rgyad rnams ci rnyed dang /ci thob byed cing shi mkhan des sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum gyi sgo nas bsags/mchod 'bul sbyin gtong rang gis longs spyod pa sogs gang yang ma bra bar yi dwags kyis kha lud bzhin bskyang ba de blos ma thong bzhin du shi yo byad rnams don med gzhan gyis longs spyod/ shi ba de skyabs med mgon med bar do dang ngan song sogs kyi 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal myong dgos pa de la bsams te skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byams snying rje/ dngos gzhi lha sngags ting 'dzin bsngo smon sogs bya dgos pa ni sne gcig med par/ ja thug zhim min sku 'gyed che chung sogs bsam brjod byed cing / gshin po las ngan de yi yo byad 125

dang zas skom yin snyam pa tsam yang med par bag med kyi spyod pa sna tshogs byed bzhin pa'i ngang nas rang yang 'chi nad drag pos thebs/ 'chi bdag shan pas gdong la bltas te thabs gang gis kyang bzlog tu med par bsad de 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyi gnas bar do sogs su 'khrid par 'gyur nges pas/des na longs spyod sogs la chags zhen spangs te chos rnam dag cig bsgrub dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ rang sde rim gyis gsod pa yang / /khyod kyis mthong bar ma gyur tam//'on kyang gnyid la brten pa gang / /gdol pa dang ni ma he bzhin//lam ni kun nas bkag nas su//'chi bdag gis ni bltas bzhin du//ji ltar khyod ni za dga' zhing / /'di ltar gnyid log ji ltar dga'//zhes gsungs so/ gsum pa nam 'chi nges med bsams te blo sna bstung ba la/ tshe la tshe tshad med pas nam 'chi nges pa med/ 'chi rkyen shin tu mang bas nam 'chi nges pa med/gson rkyen shin tu nyung bas nam 'chi nges pa med pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nam phugs 'chi mod/ tshe stod la tshe 'di'i 'dun ma bsgrubs nas/ tshe smad la chos bya snyam pa'am/da lo chos rgyags bsgrubs nas/da gzod chos bsgrub snyam pa yod mod/de la nges pa med de zla ba phyi ma dang /tshe phyi ma su snga mi shes//sang dang phyi ma su snga mi shes//da lta'i skad cig tsam la yang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med de/tshoms las sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'ong gtol med pas//sang gi tshis la mi 'bad par//phyi ma'i chos la 'bad par rigs//zhes dang /yang de nyid las/sang tsam 'chi yang sus shes kyi//de ring nyid du brtun te bya//'chi bdag sde chen de dang rmi/ /khyod nyid bshes pa ma yin no//zhes gsungs/de ltar yin pa'i tshul 126

yang / /'dzam bu gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med de/ mdzod las/ 'di na ma nges tha mar ni//lo bcu dang po dpag tu med//ces gsungs pas/kha cig ni ma'i mngal du 'chi ba'ang yod//de bzhin du skyes tsam nas 'chi ba sogs ma nges pa yod de//tshoms las/kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur//de bzhin kha cig btsas pa'i sar//de bzhin kha cig gog tsam na//de bzhin kha cig yongs brgyug na//la la rgas dang la la gzhon/ /la la dar la babs pa'i mi/ /rim gyis rab tu 'gror 'gyur te/ /'bras bu smin pa lhung ba bzhin//zhes gsungs/ des na rang re rnams de ring tshe rdzogs nas mi 'chi ba'i gdeng dang /yid brtan thub pa ni cung zad kyang med de/spyod 'jug las/de ring kho nar mi 'chi zhes//bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin//bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'ong / /zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'chi rkyen mang bas nam 'chi nges med bsam pa la/ lus srog 'bral sla bas nam 'chi nges med bsam/ 'chi bdag brtse ba med pas nam 'chi nges med bsam/ 'gal rkyen nad gdon mang bas nam 'chi nges bsam pa'o//dang po ni/gal te tshe lhag cung zad yod srid kyang de'i bar du 'dug pa'i nges pa med de/rlung dmar nang gi mar me snum ras ma zad kyang skad cig la 'chi ba ltar/ mi rnams kyi lus srog kyang 'bral sla ba de ltar yin te/ slob spring las/ mar me me lce shugs drag rlung gis bskyod pa lta'i/ /tshe 'di skad cig gnas pa'i gdeng yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs/des na lus srog 'bral sla tshul 'di la bsam na gnyid log nas ma shi bar sad long byung ba dang / dbugs phyir phyung nas ma shi bar nang du rngub long byung ba 'di yang shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas yin te/127

bshes spring las/ tshe ni gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi//chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na/ /dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las/ /sad khoms gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che//zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa 'chi bdag brtse ba med pas nam 'chi cha med bsam pa ni/mtho rgyal po nas dma' sprang po yan chad kyis so so'i lus shin tu gces pas zas gos sogs kyis legs par bskyang yang /'chi bdag la snying brtse ba cung zad kyang med pas/ rang dbang med par 'phrogs te bya khyir sbyin zhing / bya ba grub ma grub na mi na sogs gang la'ang ltos pa med par glo bur du gsod de tshe phyi ma'i lam po cher khrid 'gro ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'di ltar khyod kyis bsrung yang ni//'chi bdag brtse ba med pa yis//'phrogs te bya dang khyir byin na//de tshe khyod kyis ci byar yod//ces dang / yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di//byas dang ma byas mi sdod par//na dang mi na kun gyis kyang //glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'gal rkyen nad gdon mang bas nam 'chi nges med bsam pa ni/ pyi nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas 'chi ba/log 'dren gyi bgegs 'khrugs te 'chi ba/ sa'i gtib 'og tu song ba/chus khyer ba/mes 'tshig pa/gcong rong du lhung nas 'chi ba/dgra la 'thab ste shi ba/ gnyen gyis bslus te 'chi ba/ lus 'tsho rten du 'dod pas kyang kha zas ma 'phrod pas 'chi ba/ phan par re ba'i sman ma 'phrod nas 'chi ba sogs 'chi rkyen ma nges pa mang bas kyang nam 'chi la nges pa med de/ /rin chen phreng ba las/'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste//gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung zad cig /de dag rnams kyang 'chi rkyen te/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /128

bsum pa gson rkyen shin tu nyung bas nam 'chi nges med bsam pa ni/ gal te rim gro dang sma na dang kha zas la sogs pa gson pa'i rkyen mang du yod do snyam na/tshe dang las dang bsod nams gsum po gang yang rung ba gcig tsam zad pa'am gnyis tsam zad pa sogs dus min gyi 'chi ba 'ga' zhig la de dag gis phan pa'i skabs srid mod kyang / gsum ka zad de dus la babs nas 'chi ba la ni/slob dpon pad+ma dngos su byon nas sku rim sgrub/ sangs rgyas sman bla dngos su byon nas sman gnang yang phan pa cung zad kyang med la/ sman dang kha zas slar yang 'chi rkyen du song ba yang mang ngo / /gzhan mang gson du re ba'i na tshod gzhon pa/ nad med pa/ zas nor longs spyod phyug pa sogs kyis kyang 'chi ba mi thub ste/ rgas shing 'khogs pa'i sngon du byis pa skyes ma thag pa mang po 'chi ba dang /skyes bu lo nad can gyi sngon du nad med skyon med glo bur du 'chi ba mang du mthong ba dang / phongs pa nang zas nang tshol/ nub zas nub tshol dgos pa'i sngon du btsan phyug zas nor 'khor g.yog gis mtha' skor ba mang po shi ba mthong bas/ des na lang tsho nad med btsan phyug sogs gang gis kyang 'chi ba la mi phan pas nam 'chi nges med yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ nad med nyi ma 'di lta bu/ zas bcas 'tshe ba med kyang ni//tshe ni skad cig bslu ba ste//lus ni thang cig brnyan po bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na da ltar rang re rnams la nam zhig 'chi dgos snyam pa tsam yod kyang nam 'chi nges med kyi 'du shes 'di rgyud la ma skyes pas rtag 'dzin phyi tshis kyi re dogs kho nas g.yengs/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum bsgrub pa'i bya rtsol kho na la zhin pa'i skabs 'dir glo bur du 'chi 129

bdag gi gathin rje kho 'ong nas skad cig gcig la bsad de/ lus 'di g.yar po bzhin du 'phrog 'gro ba yin pas/des na da lta nyid du 'chi khar 'gyod mi dgos pa phyi mar phan nges pa'i dam chos yang dag pa zhig bsgrub dgos snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsgom mo/ /bzhi pa chos min phan med bsams la dam chos sgrub pa la/zas dang nor gyis phan med dam chos bsgrub/ /gnyen dang 'khor gyis mi phan dam chos bsgrub/ /khe drag stobs kyis mi phan dam chos bsgrub pa'o//dang po ni/nges par 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe na tshe 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa zas nor longs spyod rnam thos bu'i 'byor pa lta bu zhig yod kyang phan thogs cung zad kyang med de/ nor rdzas de dag gis 'chi bdag la rngan pa byin nas 'chi ba bzlog tu'ang med/ spu yon byin pas 'chi ba blu rgyu yang med/ rang gis pha rol tu khab skud tsam khyer nas 'gro rgyu'ang med par mar gyi dkyil nas spu phyung ba ltar rang nyid gcer bu lag pa stong par skye ba phyi ma'i lam po cher 'gro dgos te/spyod 'jug las/rnyed pa mang po thob gyur nas//yun ring dus su bde spyad kyang //chom pos 'phrogs pa ji bzhin du//sgron mo lag pa stong par 'gro//zhes so/ /mi phan pa'i steng du nor longs spyod de dag gi don du chags snang rmongs pa'i las ngan du ma bsags shing 'chi khar yang de dag blos ma thong bas chags sems drag po skye bas 'dre sogs su skye ba dang / de nas kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal mu mtha' med pa'i gnod pa skyel te/de nyid las/de bas rnam par rmongs pa'i yid//gang dang gang la chags gyur pa/ /de dang de bsdongs stong 'gyur du/ /sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur zhing ldang / /de bas mkhas pas chags mi bya/ /chags pa las ni 130

'jigs pa skye/ /zhes gsungs/ des na nor rdzas la chags zhen spangs nas dam chos rnam dag cig bsgrub dgos so//gnyis pa ni/ mdza' bshes 'khor g.yog la sogs pa ji snyed yod kyang 'chi ba'i tshe phan pa med de/ de dag gis 'chi bdag la 'thab pas bzlog pa'ang med/ ngo chen byas nas khrol ba'ang med/ 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal la bgo bsha' bya rgyu yang med/ pha rol tu 'gro ba'i tshe mnyam du 'gro rgyu yang med par rang nyid gcig pur 'chi bdag gshin rje'i drung du 'gro dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du//gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor kyang / /srog chad pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig bus myong bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la//gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan/ /de tshe bsod nams gcig skyabs na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten to/ /zhes gsungs/ mi phan pa'i khar de dag gi ched du dug lngas sdig pa dpag tu med pa bsags pa rnams rang gi rjes su 'brangs nas sdug bsngal snon te gnod pa skyel bar byed de/ de nyid las/ re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la'ang / /mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das//de dag don du byas pa'i sdig mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas//zhes gsungs/des na gnyen nye ring grogs mdza' bshes/ 'khor bu slob sogs la chags zhen spangs nas dben pa'i ri khrod la gnas te chos thos bsam sgom pa la brtson par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kha drag dang dpung stobs ji ltar che yang / 'chi ba'i tshe btsan pos btsan shed byed sa med/ dpa' ba'i dpung stobs kyis 'thab sa med par rang gi stobs dang dregs pa thams cad nyams nas mig mchi ma tsa re 'chi dgos te/ skyes rabs las/ gshin rje 'ongs nas mthu dang 131

dregs pa bcom ste nyal/ /zhes gsungs/ /des na thob go sa dpa' bo'i dpung stobs sogs kyis 'chi ba'i tshe mi phan pa'i steng du/de dag la brten nas nga rgyal dang rlom sems skye/ de'i rnam smin gyi sdig pa rang gi rjes su 'brangs nas gnod pa'i grogs byed de/spyod 'jug las/bdag ni rnyed mang bkur ste bcas//bdag la mang po dga' 'o zhes/ /de 'dra'i snyems pa 'chang gyur na/ /shi ba'i 'og tu 'jigs pa skye//zhes gsungs so//mdor na ji skad du spyod 'jug las/ gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i//sha tshugs can gyis bzung gyur cing //'jigs chen nad kyis thebs gyur pa/ /rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs pa ltar/'chi bdag gi bdud po khos zhags nag de lag na bzung /am gcigs de kha yis bsdams/ so zho 'jigs su rung ba ngom nas glo bur du drung du slebs tsa na/mthon po gnam lta bu/btsan po thog lta bu/phyug po klu lta bu/mdzes pa lha lta bu/'phyor po 'ja' tshon lta bu su gang yin kyang / 'chi bdag ni srung 'khor rdzas sngags kyis mi zlog /rten 'brel gto thabs kyis mi zlog /kha drag can gyi dpung gis mi zlog /dpa' bo'i stobs kyis mi zlog /phyug po'i nor gyis mi zlog /mdzangs pa'i spyod lam gyis mi zlog /mdzes ma'i gzugs kyis mi zlog /smra mkhas pa'i gtam gyis mi zlog /dpyad mkhas pa'i dpyad pa 'dzud du med/ /bang mgyogs pas bros sa med/sgyu ma mkhan gyis bslu rgyu med de zhi drag gi thabs gang gis kyang bsrung rgyu dang zlog thabs cung zad kyang med par/ 'chi bdag gi bdud po khos zhags nag de ske la bzhag /de nas rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ 'chi bdag gi gsal shing lus la gzugs te/ rgyalas pa 132

dang ni bral/ mgron ni med/skyabs ni med/ dpung gnyen ni med/skad kyis ni gdung /kha ni skam/ bzhin ni 'gyur/ rkang lag ni g.yob/ mchu ni brjes/sgra ngar ngar po ni 'byin/ /zhes dang / gshin rje'i skyes bus ni 'jigs shing skrag /dbugs rgyu ba ni chad/kha dang sna ni gdang / 'jig rten 'di ni 'bor/ 'jig rten pha rol tu ni 'gro/ /skyas chen po ni 'degs/ mun pa chen por ni cing / rgya mtsho chen pos ni g.yeng / las kyi chu bos ni khyer/sa tshugs med pa'i phyogs su 'gro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi 'jig rten pha rol tu khrid 'gro ba yin la/ de'i dus su 'khor g.yog grwa bu slob brgya stong yod kyang gcig tsam yang khrid sa med la/ /rgyu zas longs spyod nam mkha' dang mnyam pa tsam yod kyang dngul skya zho gang tsam yang khyer dbang med la/ tha na rang gis gces par bskyangs pa'i lus kyang shul du bzhag nas 'gro dgos pa yin te/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ de tsa na gson po'i dus su lus dar zab kyi grubs na/ kha ja chang gi ngang du yod pa'i mthon po dang mdzes pa lha sku lta bu'i lus kyang ro zhes bya ba mthong na 'jigs pa/ngam gnag pa wi yor yor ba der gnas 'gyur ba yin te/rje mi las/ ro zhes bya mthong na 'jigs pa de//dus da lta lus kyi rtsa na gda'//zhes gsungs/ de'i dus su tha gus bsdam/yol bas bsgrib/ sa dang rdo bas brten/ kha phor de mgo sngas su spubs nas/ gces dgu dmar dgu ji lta bu yin kyang ya nga ba dang skyug bro ba'i gnas su byed/ da lta tshar gos dang pags spu 'jam por brtsegs pa'i steng du sngas byas kyang gnyid thun gcig brgyab 'phral mi bde ba skyes te gzhogs g.yas g.yon spo dargos kyang /de'i dus su rdo'am po tho zhig 'gram 'og tu bcug nas/133

margo sa kha le yod pa de lta bu las ma 'das/ da lta rang re'i bza' dpon nam drag shos lta bu nga rang med na shul mi 'di dag ltogs gri'am 'khyag grir 'chi ba'am/ dgras gzhig chus khyer du 'gro ba las 'os med/ da lta 'di rnams la longs spyod dang bde skyid sogs 'di dang 'di lta bu yod pa 'di thams cad nga rang kho na'i drin yin snyam pa rnams kyang shi tsa na khong tshos ro de me la bsregs sam/ chu la bskur ram dur khrod du 'dor ram med pa byed thub na blo bde ba'i ngang la gnas pa las ci yang med/ 'chi tsa na rang gcig pu bar do'i gnas su grogs med par 'khyams dgos pa yin pas/ de'i tshe dam pa'i chos nyag gcig skyabs su 'gyur bas/ da lta nyid nas dam pa'i lha chos nyag ma re i 'grub ci nas kyang 'bad dgos snyam du yang nas yang du bsam/ zhes gsungs/ des na 'chi ba la chos ma yin pa gzhan gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na chos ma gtogs mgon gzhan med/ skyabs gzhan med/dpung gnyen gzhan med do//de'i tshe de'i dus na chos ni mgon dang skyabs dang rten dang gling dang dpung gnyen chen por 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ rje btsun rin po ches/ chos kyis 'di bde phyi mar bde//srid pa bar dor bde ba ste//skye ba phyi mar bde ba yin//skye ba med pas shin tu bde/ /rang bde gzhan bde gnyis ka bde/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ces gsungs/ des na 'chi ba snying phug tu bcug pa'i dam pa'i chos la da lta nas 'bad dbos/da lta dbang po gsal zhing lus sems las su rung ba'i dus/dam pa'i chos ma byas na da gzod lus rgas sems rmongs/ dbugs ma chad pa'i 134

ro ru song /'chi bas gtugs na chos mi 'ong ste/spyod 'jug las/myur ba nyid du 'chi 'gyur bas/ /ji srid du ni tshogs bsags bya/ /de tshe le lo spangs kyang ni/ /dus ma yin pas ci zhig bya//zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ mi lus gtsang ma thob dus 'dir//lha chos mi bgyid ji ltar lags//zhes gsungs so//gal te chos byas kyang 'chi bar ni 'gyur ro snyam na/ de yang 'chi lugs mi gcig ste/ chos pa yang rab 'chi mi dgos par tshe 'di la zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob pa dang / lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'gro ba dang / 'ja' lus 'grub pa sogs yod la/gal te 'chi dgos kyang 'chi lugs mi gcig ste/chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod/ 'bring mi 'tsher/ tha ma'ang mi 'gyod par bya ba yin pas bla med rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyis zin pa'i tshe na 'pho ba zab mo'i gnad kyis sam/ 'chi ba chos skur ngos zin pa'am/ min na'ang rang gar skye rnam shes 'pho chog pas brod/ phar phyin lam gyi nyams len byed pa zhig yin na yang / chos thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa'i lta ba dang kun slong byang chub kyi sems la rang byan chud pa'i sgo nas skyed tshal nas skyed tshal du 'gro ba lta bu'i dga' bde skye ba yin/ zhe 'tsher dang 'gyod pa sogs mi 'byung ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/de yis chos kun sgyu ma lta bu dang //skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas//'byor pa'i dus dang rgyad pa'i dus na yang / /nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag gis 'jigs pa med//ces dang /spyod 'jug las/de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i//byang chub sems kyi rta zhin nas//bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig skyid lug 'gyur//'es dang / sdig pa spangs phyir sdug bsngal med//malas pa'i 135

phyir na mi dga' med/ /ces gsungs so/ /chos ma byas pa'i skye bo 'chi ba'i tshe /dang po chos ma byas shing sdig pa byas pas 'gyod/ bar du gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal la 'tsher/tha mar 'chi bdag gshin rjes 'jigs shing skrag pa dang bcas te 'chi ste/spyod 'jug las/skye bo yan lag gcod pa'i sar//de ring khrid pa'ang bred 'gyur te//kha skam mig rtsa ngan la sogs//sngar las gzhan du 'gyur snang na//gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i/ /sha tshugs can gyis bzung gyur cing / /'jigs chen nad kyis thebs gyur pa/ /rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang skyo shas dang nges 'byung skye ba'i phyir du 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par bsam pa ni/ spyir bskal ba'i 'phel 'grib la bsam yang mi rtag ste/ bskal pa la chags gnas 'jig stong bzhi yod la/ gnas pa de yang bskal pa dang po'i dus su mi rnams lha la 'gran pa'i bde skyid dang tshe lo yang dpag med thub pa nas/ mar 'grib ste tshe lo bcu pa'i bar dang / yang yar 'phel ba sogs ya thog ring mo dang bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad kyi tha mar yar 'phel ba ring po ste/ de lta bu'i bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib la brtags kyang mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das/ bye brag nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog la bltas kyang mi rtag ste/ dbyar dus su ji shing nags tshal me tog lo 'bras rgyas te mi phyugs thams cad bde skyid la spyod cing /dgun de las ldog ste grang lhag gi ngad rgyas chu thams cad 'khyag rom du 'gyur ba sogs dbyar rjes su ston/ ston rjes su dgun/ dgun rjes su dpyid la sogs pa rim par 'byung bas snga ma'i rjes su phyi ma 'byung ba thams cad gzhan du 'gyur te mi rtag cing / khar sang dang de 136

ring / da nangs dang do dgong / da lo dang sang phod sogs thams cad rim par mi rtag pa'i tshul la dpag na/ gang la'ang yid brtan med cing / khyad par rang re gnas pa'i yul grong sde dgon sogs la yang sngon 'byor pa can rnams da lta rgyad pa dang / sngon dbul po rnams da lta stobs 'byor dang ldan pa/ tshe stod la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa mang po tshe smad la rgyu zas longs sbyod thams cad dang bral ba/ na ning gnag phyugs brgya phrag mang po yod pa gangs zhod god khas nyen nas da lor sprang por gyur pa dang / khar sang longs spyod can dgras brlags te de ring sprang por 'gyur ba sogs mang po mthong bas/ nor longs spyod la yang snying po dang rtag pa med pas phyi ma'i rgyags phye sbyin pa gtong bar bya zhing / 'dus pa thams cad kyang mi rtag par 'bral te/ tshong 'dus sam chos grwa chen por mi stong phrag sogs mang po 'dus kyang mthar so so'i yul du gyes 'gro zhing /yul grong dgon sde sogs kyi mi sngar yod rnams da lta med la/ rang re khyim nang gcig gi mi yang snga rabs kyi pha mes sogs rim par shi ste da lta ming lhag tsam dang /rang gi spun dang sring mo la sogs pa du ma shi zhing da lta gar yod tsam yang mi shes/ da lta rang re bla slob dpon g.yog grogs mched spun zla bza' tshang la sogs pa brtse bas 'grogs pa rnams kyang 'bral bar nges shing / de yang rkyen drag po glo bur du byung nas da lta mi 'bral ba'i nges pa med pas/ des na da lta lhan cig 'grogs pa'i dus su nga rgyal 'gran sems phrag dog 'thab rtsod khong khro sogs mi byed/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i nges pa med pas chags zhen med par brtse bas skyong dargos te/ rje btsun rin po che grags pas/ mos gus can gyi slob 137

ma dang / /las kyis 'brel ba'i gnyen dang gnyis/ /dam tshig can gyi mched lcam gsum//snang ba thug phrad du 'grogs mdzod la//'phral la gdung sems ma che bar /chos mi lam tshul du nyams su longs//zhes dang / pha dam pas/bza' tshang mi rtag tshong dus mgron po la/ /ngan shags 'thab mo ma byed ding ri ba//zhes gsungs/gzhan yang da lta btsan phyug mi mang po yod pa sogs/ sang phod dam zla ba phyi ma tsam la yang yod med mi shes/ des na phyi dang snod bcud kyi chos 'di dag thams cad rtag pa dang brtan pa gcig kyang med de/ skyes pa'i tha ma mi rtag ste 'chi/bsags pa'i tha ma mi rtag ste 'dzad/'dus pa thams cad mi rtag te 'bral/brtsigs pa thams cad mi rtag ste 'gyel/ /mthon po thams cad mi rtag par lhung bar 'gyur ba yin te/'dul ba lung las/bsags pa kun gyi mtha' mdzad cing // mthon po rnams kyi mtha' lhung 'gyur//'phrad pa'i mtha' ni 'bral ba ste//gson pa'i mtha' ni 'chi ba yin//zhes gsungs la/tshoms las/snga dro skye bo mang mthong ba//phyi dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur//phyi dro skye bo mang mthong ba//snga dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//gzhan yang tshe 'di yi dgra gnyen yang mi rtag ste/tshe stod la gnyen yin pa tshe smad la dgrar 'gyur ba/ /tshe stod la dgra yin pa yang tshe smad la gnyen du 'gro ba mang bas mi rtag la/ skye ba snga ma dang da lta'i dgra gnyen ni de las kyang mi rtag ste/sngon 'phags pa kā t+yā na bsod snyoms la phebs pas/khyim bdag cig gis bu zhig pang na bzung / nya sha zhig zhim zhim ltar za/ /khyi mo rus pa 'cha' ba la rdo rdeg par byed pa la 'phags pas mngon shes kyis gzigs pas/ nya de skye ba da res kyi pha dang / khyi mo de skye ba nga zas kyema'iskye ba 138

yin zhing /tshe sngon rang gsod pa'i dgra de srog lan chags nas bur skyes pa yin par gzigs pas/ pha sha za zhing ma la deg /gsod pa'i dgra bo pang na bzung //chung mas khyo yi rus pa 'cha'//'khor ba'i chos la gad mo bro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na ya ki srid rtse nas/ /ma ki dmyal gnas yan chad la rtag pa brtan pa med pa 'pho 'gyur 'phel 'grib kyi rang bzhin du yid ches par bya zhing /der ma zad rang re rnams kyi snang ba skad cig ma la'ang rtag brtan gang yang med de/ dpal sprul rin po ches/ rang la nges 'byung dang skyo shas sad sud skyes/ ltar snang gi chos shig sgrub lo byas/ gzhan 'jig rten pas bzang por brtsis te/ yon bdag dang slob mas zhabs nas bteg tsa na//rang gis rang rgyud zhib tu ma brtag par nga ni de dang de lta bu yin no snyam nas nga rgyal gyis rgyud sbos/snang ba 'ur langs/ngas gang byas kyang chog snyam pa'i blo skye ba ni/ bdud kyis mngon sum du bslus pa yin zhing / bdag 'dzin yul phud/ bdag med kyi ye shes skyes/ 'phags pa'i sa ma thob kyi bar du bzang ngan gyi snang ba la rtag pa med pas 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sogs dus rtag tu 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom/ rang rgyud kyi skyon la rtog /rtag tu dman sa 'dzin/ /nges 'byung dang skyo shas bskyed/ /zhi dul dang bag yod la bslab/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams nas dus rtag tu/ yi phya dung nge/ sems skyo chad de ba zhig la bslab dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bslab dgos te/ je btsun rin po ches/ skye bo dag la skyo ba bsgom par bya/ /des ni dben pa bsten cing log 'tsho spong / /zhes dang / sems skyo ba'i gnas su ngasam gtan 'khor/ /zhis gsungs so/ /de ltar 'chi ba mi rtag 139

pa dang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par rtogs nas ci byas chos su 'gro zhing chos mthar phyin pa zhig bya snyam pa dang / de ltar 'gyur ba bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa sogs sngar bzhin bya'o//mi rtag chu bur lta bu'i lus srog la//mi rtag yin par ma rtogs rtag 'dzin blo//mi rtag 'dod yon sgyu mas bslus pa'i ngang //mi rtag 'chi ba byung tshe ma 'gyod sang //'chi ba mi rtag pa'i khrid do//bzhi pa/ las rgyu 'bras/bzhi pa spang blang tshul bzhin shes phyir dkar nag las 'bras ston pa'i khrid ni/ de ltar 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong bas 'khor ba spong 'dod dang myang 'das thob 'dod kyi blo gsha' ma skyes pas blo chos su song / dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pas chos byed 'dod kyi bsam pa lhang nge ba chos bya lo'i sbyor ba tshab tshub yod kyang / gnad ma shes na chos lam du mi 'gro ba mang du snang ste/ chos kyi mthun rkyen zas gos longs spyod kyis chog mi shes pa dang de'i phyir du sdig pa gsog pa dang log pa'i 'tsho ba la spyad pas 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mthar lhung ste/ ngan song du cing ba'i rgyu byed kyi thar pa'i lam du gtan nas mi tshud pa dang / yang 'ga' zhig sto gos gtam gsum la gyong bskur ba'i dka' spyad drag po byas kyang gnad ma zin par ngal zhing dub pa'i mthar lhung ste/ bzang na mtho ris tsam las thar pa'i lam stegs su ma song bas dal 'byor chud zos su 'gro ba mang du mthong / de bas na chos lam du 'gro ba la thog mar las dge sdig dang rnam smin 'bras bu bde sdug so sor shes shing yid 140

ches pa zhig gnad du che ste/ rang 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe zas gos longs spyod nye 'brel 'khor g.yog kun shul du bzhag nas rang nyid gcig phur 'gro dgos kyang / las dge sdig gi rnam smin 'di lus dang gribs bzhin du rjes su 'brang ba yin te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'chi ba'i tshe/ /longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang / /skyes bu de ni gang dang gar 'gro ba/ /las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang / zhes dang /'bum las/ skye bo 'di dag thams cad ni las kyi skye gnas pa/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/ /las bdag gir byed pa yin/ /zhes dang / las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi za ba yin//zhes sogs gsungs la/ de yi don yang ngan 'gro ba rnams ni mi dge ba'i las las skyes pas mi dge ba'i las kyi skye gnas pa/bde 'gro ba rnams ni dge ba'i las las skyes pas dge ba'i las kyi skye gnas pa yin/'gro ba so sor sdug bsngal myong ba ni mi dge ba'i bgo skal la spyod pa yin/bde ba myong ba ni dge ba'i las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa yin/ rang gis las byas pa'i rnam smin ni rang gis myong dgos kyi gzhan gyis mi myong bas las bdag gir byed pa yin/ zhes pa'i don yin la/ yang rang gis ma byas par gzhan gyis byas pa'i rnam smin rang gis mi myong bas las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ rang gis byas par nges pa'i las des rang dus nam yang mi gtong bar rnam smin myong dgos pas las byas pa chud mi za zhes pa'i don yin te/ mdo las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni//bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la babs pa na//'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//yang gzhan bla 141

ma dang dge 'dun mang po'i don yin zhes srog gcod sogs byed pa dang /gnyen grogs sogs kyi ched du rang gis sdig pa byas pa de gzhan de dag la rnam smin gyi sdug bsngal de bgo bsha' byas nas myong ba'i grogs byed rgyu yod pa ma yin gyi/las byed pa po rang gis myong dgos pa yin te/bshes spring las/ khyod kyis bram ze dge slong lha dang ni//mgon dang yab yum sras dang btsun mo dang //'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyi ste/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis//zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la'ang //mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das//de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ /zhes gsungs so//des na de lta bu'i las 'bras kyi gnad la nges pa 'dren pa gal che ba yin/'o na blo chos su 'gro ba la las 'bras la nges nga rnyed pa'i spang blang de tsam gyis chog gam snyam na/ de tsam gyis kyang mi chog ste/sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rnams shes nas spong / dkar po dge ba spyad pa'i las lam de la'ang bde 'gro tsam du 'gro ba dang / thar pa myang 'das su 'gro ba'i lam gnyis yod pas/ de gnyis so sor phye ste gong du bshad pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i dge ba'i las la 'bad dgos pa yin/ las des sems can la ma dag pa'i snang ba de la yang las kyi snang ba dang 'khrul ba'i snang ba gnyis su phye nas/ 'khrul ba'i snang ba ni 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus bslad pa'i snang ba tsam yin la/ las snang ni sems can so so'i las dkar nag spyad pa'i las snang la shar ba chu phor pa gang la lha la bdud rtsi/ yi dwags la rnag khrag /dmyal ba la rku chu/ mi la chur snang ba sogs phyi snod bzang ngan dang / nang bcud la'ang tshe 142

ring thung longs spyod che chung sogs bde sdug sna tshogs su snang ba yin la/ de lta bu'i las la gsum du yod pas/ mi dge ba'i las 'bras bsams la spong 'dod bskyed/ dge ba'i las 'bras bsams la sgrub 'dod bskyed/ lung du bstan min bsams la dge bar bsgyur pa gsum/de'i dang po la mi dge ba'i las bsam pa/de'i 'bras bu bsam pa/ de spong bar bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni rin chen phreng ba las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /des bskyed las ne mi dge ba//zhes gsungs pas/rang phyogs la chags pa dang /gzhan phyogs la sdang ba dang / las 'bras la rmongs pa'i ma rig pa ste de gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i las thams cad mi dge ba yin la/de'ang mdzod las/de las che long bsdus nas ni//dge dang mi dge bcur gsungs so//zhes mi dge ba'i las bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang / rags pa tsam zhig bsdus na/ lus kyi las srog gcod ma byin len 'dod log ste gsum/ngag gi las rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dang bzhi/yid kyi las brnab sems gnod sems log lta dang gsum ste bcu'o/ /de la dang po srog gcod pa ni/ rang ngam gzhan bskos pas kyang rung bsam bzhin gsod 'dod kyis kun nas bslangs te sems can gzhan su yang rung ba/ dug mtshon dang me chu la sogs pas srog gi dbang po 'gags par byed pa ste/de yang dpa' bo g.yul 'thab nas dgra gsod pa lta bu zhe snang gi sgo nas srog gcod pa/ ri dwags dang sgo phyugs sogs sha za 'dod/pags pa gyon 'dod sogs kyis gsod pa 'dod chags kyi sgo nas srog gcod pa/dge sdig gi rgyu 'bras mi shes pa'am/mu stegs pa lta bus dge bar rloms nas srog gcod pa ni gti mug gi sgo nas 143

srog gcod pa yin/ de las pha ma dgra bcom gsum gsod pa ni mtshams med ces bar do med par dmyal ba mnar med du skye ba'i rgyu yin la/ da lta rang re rnams rang gi lag dar te dngos su srog ma bcad pa tsam la bsams nas/nga la srog gcod kyi sdig pa med snyam yang mtho dman drag zhan su yang rkang 'og gi 'bu bsad pa'ang grangs kyis mi chod pa yod la/ khyad par dpal sprul rin po ches 'di ltar gsungs te/bla ma dang ser mo ba rnams yon bdag gi khyim du byon skabs de dag gis sems can srog bcad nas sha khrag g.yos su byas nas drangs pa'i tshe/ sems can gsod pa la 'gyod pa dang snying rje sogs gang yang med par sha khrag gi ro la sred pas dga' bzhin du gsol tsa na/ srog gcod kyi sdig pa yon mchod gnyis khyad med par 'thob/ mi chen dpon chen rnams ni gang du byon kyang ja 'dren dang mgron kha la sogs kyi ched du srog bcad pa grangs kyis mi chod/ phyug po rnams ni spyir rgyugs lug ji tsam yod pa de thams cad mthar rgas pa'i dus na re re bzhin gsod pa las rang bzhin gyis 'chi ba re gnyis las mi 'ong bas srog bcad pa grangs kyis mi chod/ ma zad phyugs lug de dag gis kyang dbyar kha'i dus 'bu sbrang grog ma nya dang sbal sbrul byi'u phrug sogs dngos su za ba rtswa dang lhan du za ba/ rkang lag gi mig pas brdzis pa rta sbangs dang lci ba la sogs pa'i nang du bsad pa grangs kyis mi chod cing de dag gi sdig pa yang bdag po'i steng du 'ong / khyad par rta phyugs sogs gzhan las lug 'di sdig pa mi zad pa'i 'byung gnas su 'dug ste/ sngar bstan pa bzhin srog chags phra mo thams cad khu zas su byed/ dbyar bal las kyi dus su lug re re'i rgyab la 144

yang srog chags 'bum phrag re tsam yod pa de thams cad gsod/ ma mo thams cad bzho ba dang lug gu'i bed bcad nas sha pags kyi ched du gsod/ pho thams cad gsod rgyu las gzhan med/ lug shig byung tshe lug re re'i rgyab nan srog chags dung phyur tsam gsod/ des na lug brgya yod phyin chad bdag po de dmyal bar lan gcig skye nges su 'dug bud med rnams kyang gzhan dang gnyen sgrol nas rin rdzongs dang skyel bsu sogs kyi dus su bsha' lug grangs med gsod/de phyin chad rang khyim du nam 'ong gi grangs la sems can re nges par gsod/de bzhin du gnyen dang nye ba rnams kyis bos skabs kha zas gzhan byin kyang yi gar mi 'gro ba ltar byed cing khram ma des 'gram pa 'gul mi shes pa ltar byas nas za/ yang bsha' lug tsho ba re re bsad nas brang dang rgyu ma sogs che nges pa re mdun du bzhag tsa na srin mo gdong dmar ma de mgar 'dug cig byas/ gri chung zhig blangs te lcib thag gis za/sang nyin sha khog de dmar tsa re bkal nas rngon pa rang khyim du ldog pa ltar 'gro zhing / nam phyin phyin stong log mi byed pas rngon pa las kyang thu/ byis pa rnams nas kyang rtsed mo'i dus mthong dang ma mthong bar bsad pa grangs kyis mi chod cing / shing dang thag pa dang rgyun lcag sogs thogs te dbyar kha'i dus su sa gzhi la brab kyin 'gro ba de lta bu'i dus bsad pa grangs med/ rtswa dang lo tog brnga ba'i dus su sems can bsad pa yang grangs med/des na rang re mi rnams ni srog gcod kyi las thabs kho nas dus 'da' ba srin po dang 'dra zhing / tshe gcig tu rang gis ben spyad 'o ma 'thung ba drin gyis bskyangs pa'i ma 'bri pha ma dang 'dra ba rnams kyang bsad nas sha khrag la longs 14 5

spyod pa la bsam na srin po las kyang thu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang mdzod las/srog gcod pa ni bsam bzhin du/ /ma nor ba ni gzhan bsad pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ma byin pa len pa ni/ mi yis bdag tu bzung zhing rang la mi dbang ba'i yo byad/ bsam bzhin du che chung gang yang rung ba/ mthu dang 'jab bu dang g.yo thabs kyis len pa gsum yin la/ de yang yul dpon sogs dbang yod so so'i thob thang ma yin pa'i rgyu zas dbang gi mthus len pa dang /dmag dang jag pa sogs kyi dbang shed kyis 'phrog pa dag ni mthus ma byin pa len pa yin la/bdag pos mi mthong sar lkog nas zas nor blangs te bdag gir byed pa ni 'jal bus ma byin pa len pa yin la/ /lhag par dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas rku ba ni nyes pa shin tu che ste/ spyir ma byin pa blangs te brkus pas pham pa phog ste dge tshul slong gi sdom pa gtong zhing nyams pa ni gzhir bzhag la/ de'i steng du dkon mchog gi dkor rku ba byang sems kyi rtsa nyung du bshad pas de ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi dkor brkus pa yin pas byang sdom nyams la/ so byang gnyis kyi sdom pa nyams na/ gsang sngags kyi bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi rtsa lhung gnyis pa 'byung bas sngags sdom nyams te so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa thams cad gtong zhing nyams pas/dmyal bar skye bar nges te/mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas brkus pa ni tshor ba ma myong bar dag par 'gyur ba med de/zhing lci ba'i phyir/ gal te zhal du 'du ba'i sgo zhig na ni/de sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung la/ gal te zhal du 'du ba'i sgo ma yin na ni de'i nang gi bar mnar med pa'i 'khor mun nag chen po la sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro zhes 146

gsungs la/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzod las/ dge 'dun gyi/ 'du ba'i sgo ni 'phrog pa dag /mtshams med pa dang cha 'dra ste/ zhes nye ba'i mtshams med yin par gsungs la/ mtshams med ces pa shi ma thag bar do'i mtshams med par dmyal ba mnar med du skye bas mtshams med ces brjod la/ dmyal ba mnar med ni/ dmyal ba gzhan thams cad las sdug bsngal brgya stong du mas che bar gsungs la mnar med der skyes te sdug bsngal myong ba'i yun ni mdzod las/mnar med ni/ bar gyi bskal pa'o/ /gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ des na dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas rku zhing longs spyod pa rnams la skye ba phyi ma la de lta bu'i nyes dmigs dang sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin la/ yang dge 'dun gyi longs spyod dang bla grwa'i nor rdzas khyim pa la ster zhing khyim pas longs spyod pa ni nyes pa shin tu che bar gsungs te/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ spu gri rnon po dag gis su/ /rang gi yan lag gtubs pa bla'i//dge 'dun dag la bsngos zin pa/ khyim pa rnams la sbyin mi bya//me rtse 'bar ba lta bu yi//lcags kyi thu lum zos pa bla'i//dge 'dun dag las gang de ni//dge 'dun gyis las longs mi spyad/ /lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i me//blang ba byas te zos pa bla'i/ khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyod par ni mi bya'o/ /thams cad 'byung ba byed pa dang / /bsregs shing steng du bsregs bla yi/ khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyod par ni mi bya'o//me mdag dag gis gang ba yi/ /gnas khang der ni zhugs pa bla'i//khyim pas dge 'dun gnas khang du//mtshan mor gnas par mi bya'o//zhes gsungs so//der ma zad tshe 'di la yang dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas rku zhing za ba rnams la bya ba 147
