lam rgyug med cing / mi 'dod pa sna tshogs thog tu 'bab pa ni mngon sum mthong chos can yin la/ des na spyir bslab gsum rgyud ldan rab byung rnams kyis bag yod dran shes rgyun du dgos la/ lhag par dgon pa'i spyis so so'i 'bri g.yag 'bru dngul ja mar sogs la phyag len gnang mkhan rnams kyi thugs sems ni 'dod yon la 'jug 'dod che la/ nor rdzas rnams kyang phyag la 'byar nye zhing 'byar sla bas/ des na thugs sems bag yod dang dran shes bzhin lhod med gnang dgos par ni/ ji skad du/ spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /thams cad 'bad pas srungs shig ces//bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyar//zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /tshong sogs kyi dus su/ rdzun dang bre log sung log 'dzugs pa/ bal sho tshwa sho ko gru sho sbag sogs kyi tshe phar sbyin dgos pa la mi dgos thabs/ tshur len rgyu la lhag po thob thabs kyi g.yo sgyu byed pa/tha na kha gsag gzhogs slong sogs kyis pha rol gyi rgyu rdzas len pa ni/ g.yo thabs kyis ma byin pa len pa yin par 'dul ba las gsungs shing / der ma zad g.yar po dang skyin pa ma byin pa yang ma byin len pa yin par gsungs la/ de dang mthun par dpal sprul rin po ches kyang / des na deng sang rang re rnams nas dngos su rku ba ma byas phyin tshong sogs g.yo thabs kyi sgo nas blang ba thams cad la nyes pa yod snyam mi 'dug ste/ g.yo sgyu byas phyin tshong sogs gang la yang khe ji tsam rnyed pa de brkus pa dngos dang khyad med/khyad par deng sang gi skabs su bla ma dang ser mo ba rnams nas kyang tshong byed pa la nyes pa'am skyon du mi blta zhing sku tshe de la bsgril nas pho rgod por rlom par 148

'dug kyang / bla ma ser mo ba zhig gi rgyud chud zos byed pa la tshong las thu ba gang yang med de/ rtag tu de la g.yeng bas slob gnyer dang sgrib sbyong sogs byed rgyu'i blo g.yel zhing go skabs kyang med/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus tshun chad tshong rtsis kyi bsam blo gtong bas dad dang nges 'byung snying rje sogs kyi rtsa ba chad/dus rtag tu 'khrul bzhin pa'i dbang du 'gyur ba yin te sngon rje btsun mi la/dgon sde zhig tu byon nas mtshan grwa khang zhig gi sgor gzims bsdad pas/ de na grwa pa zhig yod pa mtshan mo nyal nas sang nyin ba zhig bsha' rgyu yod pa de'i sha ko btsong thabs bsam blo btang / mgo de'i 'di khug /de bzhin du lag pa sogs phyi nang thams cad la tshong rtsis btang bas/gnyid thun gcig kyang gnyid long ma byung bar/ mjug ma ma gtogs thams cad la 'ding phog skabs nam langs/ der kho rang 'phral du langs/chos spyod dang gtor ma gtong ba sogs byas rje btsun da dung yang gzims nas bzhugs pas kho 'ong nas khyed chos par rlom pa la chos spyod dang bzlas brjod sogs gang yang byed mi nus par da dung yang nyal nas sdod pa zer/ 'phya bar byed pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga dus rtag tu de ltar gnyid 'dug pa zhig min kyang / mdang nga rang ba zhig bsha' rgyu yod pa de btsong thabs bsam blo gtong gin bsdad pas/ gnyid long ma byung bar da nangs gnyid du shor bar 'dug gsungs pas/ kho'i mtshang la phog nas song / dpe de bzhin du da lta yang tshong kho na byed pa rnams nyin mtshan thams cad du tshong rtsis kyi mno bsam kho na la 'khrul nas g.yeng zhing / 'chi dus kyang de kho na'i ngang du 'khrul nas 'chi/ der ma zad tshong byed dus kyang / rang gi 149

btsong rgyu'i dngos po ngan pa zhig yin kyang de la bstod ra sna tshogs byed pa dang /sngar mi 'di dang 'di dag la btsong na gong 'di lta bu zhig sbyin zer yang ma brjes/ nga rang gis tshur nyo skabs kyang rin 'di lta bu byin pa yin zer ba sogs rdzun kho na gtong / de bzhin du pha rol gzhan gnyis tshong byed pa la rang gis nyo 'dod nas gzhan gnyis mi 'grigs thabs kyi phra ma/ pha rol gyi rgyu rdzas la ngan smras gtong ba dang / bu lon gyi rgyus 'thab mo byed pa sogs tshig rtsub/don med pa mi ri gong mo che zer ba dang / nyo mi bsam yang gong gtam pa sogs ngag 'khyal/ pha rol gyi rgyu rdzas la rlom sems kyis bdag po sprad pas brnab sems/ gzhan pham 'dod kyi gnod sems/ bsha' lug nyo tshong byed pa sogs srog gcod de/ log lta dang 'dod log tsam ma gtogs tshong la mi dge ba bcu ka tshang ba yin/ rngon pa dang jag pa sogs la gro chas kyi skal bskur phran bu yod pa tshun chad srog gcod dang ma byin len gyi nyes pa ni thams cad la mnyam par yod pa yin//zhes gsungs so/ des na deng sang mtho dman tshang mas sho sbag 'di la zugs rtsis shin tu che yang /rgyan po 'gyed pa ste sho sbag gi dus su pha rol po'i nor mas rang la rgyal thob tu re nas chags pa dang / rang nor pha rol po la shor na mi dga' ba dang de la zhe sdang drag po langs nas gzhan nor thob cing rang nor mi shor thabs kyi g.yo sgyu byed pa de dag gi ched du rdzun dang / chags sdang gis ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing / pha rol po la gnad la phog pa'i tshig rtsub smra zhing 'thab rtsod kyi rgyur 'gro ba sogs de lta bus sems phyi rol tu rgod de g.yengs nas/ dge sbyor la g.yel ba sogs nyes pa dang skyon de ltar che ste/ rin 150

chen phreng ba las/ rgyan po chags dang mi dga' dang / /zhe sdang g.yo sgyu rgod pa'i gnas/ /rdzun dang bkyal ba tshig rtsub rgyu/ /de bas rtag tu spang bar mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar slob gnyer sgrib sbyong sogs dge ba la g.yel zhing nyes pa mang po'i gzhir 'gyur bar 'dug pas dran shes yag po bstan dgos par 'dug /de yang / ma byin len pa gzhan gyi nor//mthu dang 'jab bus bdag gir byed//ces so/ /gsum pa 'dod log gam log g.yem ni/ rab tu byung ba rnams ni mi tshangs spyod rtsa ba nas spangs dgos pa yin pas log g.yem ni khyim pa'i khrims yin la/ nyes pa che shos gzhan gyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rkyen byed pa dang / gzhan yang yul ma yin pa gzhan gyis bdag tu bzung ba'i bud med la bgrod pa/bdun brgyud tshun chad kyi gnyen dang ma smin pa'i gzhon nu ma dang / rang dbang yin yang dus ma yin pa nyin mo dang /bsnyen gnas bsrung ba dang /na ba dang /sbrum ma dang / mya ngan gyis non pa dang / zla mtshan yod pa dang / bang ma sang ba la bgrod pa dang / gnas ma yin pa gtsug lag khang dang dkon mchog gi rten yod sa dang / pha ma'i drung du bgrod pa dang / lam ma yin pa kha dang bshang lam sogs su bgrod pa dang bzhi yin te/ bgrod min 'gro bar 'dod pa yis/ /log par g.yem pa rnam bzhi/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rdzun ni/ bsam pa nyon mongs pa can gyis 'du shes ma 'khrul bar bsam bzhin du gnas tshul las gzhan du bsgyur te smras pas pha rol pos tshig don go ba yin/ma go na ngag 'khyal tsam yin/ rdzun la dbye na/rdzun phal pa dang /chen po dang /mi chos bla ma'i rdzun dang gsum/ dang po ni gzhan bslu sems kyis rdzun smra ba thams cad yin/ gnyis pa ni/ dge sdig la 151

phan yon dang nyes dmigs med/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang ngan song sogs med zer ba yin/ gsum pa ni/ sa ma thob pa la thob/ mngon shes med par yod/ dzu 'phrul med pa la yod zer ba sogs rang la med pa'i yon tan yod pa lta bu smra ba thams cad do/ /des na dpal sprul rin po ches 'di ltar gsungs/ deng sang dam pa las kyang zog po brin pa'i dus su song zhing / mi thams cad kyang bsam spyod sgyur sla bas/bla ma'am grub thob tu khas 'che ba kha cig g.yo sgyus gzhan mgo bskor ba lhur len zhing / lha ngas mthong lha la gtang rag byin/ 'dre ngas mthong 'dre la chad pa bcad zer ba phal cher mi chos bla ma'i rdzun kho na yin pas/ tsab tsob tu zog po bslu brid can la blo mi gtod par rgyus yod kyi chos pa gnyom chung phyi nang mtshungs pa la 'di phyi'i blo gtad 'cha' ba gal che/ lar zag bcas kyi mngon shes phran bu 'jig rten pa'i lam du yod kyang res 'ga' ba yin pas thig mi thig sna tshogs 'ong / zag med kyi mngon shes ni 'phags pa'i sa thob pa ma gtogs gzhan la med pas de 'dra ni shin tu yang dka' 'o//zhes gsungs so//de yang / rdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan bsgyur ba'i/ /tshig don mngon par go ba'o/ /zhes so//lnga pa phra ma ni/bsam pa nyon mongs can gyis 'du shes ma 'khrul bas pha rol po mthun pa 'byed par byed pa'i tshig don go ba yin la/ de la yang mi dbang yod lta bus mi gnyis mnyam du yod pa la/khyod la mi 'dis ngos lkog nas skyon dang gnod pa 'di lta bu byas so zhes pa lta bu'i phra ma dngos su byed pa dang /mthun pa gnyis la lkog nas mi mthun pa'i tshig smras te lkog nas phra mas 'byed pa ste gnyis yin/ de las nyes pa che shos dge 'dun thugs mi mthun par byed 152

pa dang /khyad par sngags kyi chos ston pa'i bla slob kyi bar du dbyen byed pa dang /grogs mched phan tshun mi mthun par byed pa ni shin tu yang nyes pa che'o/ /de yang / phra ma pha rol dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyon mongs can gyi sems kyi tshig /ces so/drug pa tshig tsub ni/ pha rol po la mig zhar ba sogs skyon yod pa dang / mtshang yod pa sogs dngos su brjod de tshig don go ba yin te/ de yang / tshig rtsub po ni mi snyan pa/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa ngag 'khyal ni/bstan 'chos ngan pa la thos bsam byed pa'i ngag dang / chags sems kyis kha gsag dang glu len pa dang rgyal rigs dang dmag dang smad tshong ma dang tshong dang chom rkun sogs chags snang skye ba'i 'brel med kyi gtam sna tshogs smra ba rnams yin la/ khyad par kha 'don byed pa dang ting 'dzin sgom pa'i drung du gtam mang po smra ba ni/ de'i sems g.yengs nas dge ba'i bar chad byed pas nyes pa shin tu che/ rang gi kha 'don bzlas brjod la ngag 'khyal bsres nas bzlas brjod ji ltar byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byin la/ gzhan yang dpal sprul rin po ches/ khyad par dge 'dun gyi tshogs gral lta bur ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra ba ni tshogs pa gral gang de'i dge ba'i tshogs mi gcig gis gcog cing / sbyin bdag gi tshogs bsags chud gzan pa yin/ spyir rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ldan grol gnyis gang rung dang ldan pa ma gtogs dge 'dun gyi dkor la spyod par mi dbang zhing bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ma gnang mod/ da lam rang re rnams kyis sngags chog re gnyis re bslabs nas de 'don shes 'phral/ dkor nag gang byung za bar 'dug ste gsang sngags kyi cho ga'i sgo nas bkor nag za ba 'di la/dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa//53

bskyed rdzogs la mkhas shing bsnyen pa 'khyol ba zhig med na/ gya tshom du gsang sngags bon du gyer na nyes pa lci zhing /dkor dag po 'di lcags bsregs kyi ril bu dang 'dra ba la/bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i khro'i 'gram pa dang ldan na ma gtogs/ tha mal gyis zos na rgyud 'tshig cing brlag pa yin te/ ji skad du/dkor nag po dug gi spu gri yin/ /zos drags na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod/ /ces gsungs/ des na bskyed rdzogs dang ldan pa lta ci/ tshig tsam shes pa de yang legs par mi 'don/ khyad par cho ga'i don po gal che shos bsnyen pa yin pa la bsnyen mtshams su babs dus ngag 'khyal gyi gter sgo phye ste/ chags sdang gi gtam 'brel med sna tshogs pas dus 'da' ba ni rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba yin pas/ bla ma ser mo ba rnams nas rgyun du ngag 'khyal gyi gtam 'di spangs nas smra bcad dang bzlas brjod la brtson pa gal che ba yin gsungs so//de yang /nyon mongs can kun brkyal pa nyid/ /ces so/ /brgyad pa brnab sems ni/ gzhan pha rol po'i rgyu rdzas yid du 'ong ba la 'di nga'i yin na dga' ba la snyam du yang dang yang du yid kyis bdag gir byed pa dang / de ngas lon pa'i thabs ci lta bu yod snyam pa sogs/ yid tsam gyis gzhan nor la 'dod pa skyes pa thams cad yin te/ log pas gzhan gyi nor la chags//zhes so/dgu pa gnod sems ni/zhe sdang dang khong khro'i sems kyis 'di dang 'di lta bu la gnod pa 'di dang 'di lta bu bya'o snyam pa dang / gzhan la dpal 'byor yod pa la mi dga' zhing bde skyid dang yon tan 'di lta bu med na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / gzhan la mi 'dod pa byung na dga' ba sgom pa sogs gzhan la gnod par sems pa thams cad yin te/ 154

deyang /gnod sems sems can la sdang ba//zhes so//bcu pa log lta ni/ rgyu las dge sdig dang 'bras bu rnam smin bde sdug med par lta ba dang / 'jig rten skye ba snga phyi dkon mchog sogs med par lta ba dang gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bka' bla ma'i lung mkhas pa'i gzhung gang la yang mi bden no snyam du the tshom dang sgro skur byed pa thams cad kyang log lta yin te/ de yang / dge dang mi dge med lta ba/ /log par lta ba yin/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar mi dge ba bcu las log lta dang srog gcod gnyis sdig pa lhag par rtsi ste/ log lta ni mdzod las/ med par lta bas rtsa ba gcod/ /ces pa ltar dge rtsa gcod cing sdom pa thams cad gtong /nang pa'i khyu las 'das/ dal ba'i rten yang nyams/ log ltas rgyud bslad nas dge ba byas kyang thar lam du mi 'gyur/ sdig pa byas pa la bshags thabs kyang med pa yin la/srog gcod ni mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/sems can gcig gi srog bcad na srog lan lnga brgya 'jal dgos pa dang / sems can gcig gi srog bcad na bar gyi bskal par dmyal bar gnas dgos par gsungs la/ gzhan yang dpal sprul rin po ches/ dkon mchog gi rten bzhengs pa dang dge ba sogs la snyad btags nas rig pa'i las byed pa ni lhag par yang lci ste/pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ dkon mchog gi rten sdig sdug gis bzhengs/ /tshe phyi ma rlung la bskur zhes gsungs/ /de bzhin du dge ba byed par rloms nas bla ma rnams khyim du gdan 'dren pa dang dge 'dun pa tshogs pa sogs la sems can bsad pa'i sha khrag 'dren pa ni/ yon mchod thams cad la srog gcod kyi nyes pas 'gro zhing sbyin bdag gis 'tsho ba drangs pa yang /sbyin bdag la ma dag pa yi sbyin pa dang / 155

mchod yul la yang log pa'i 'tsho bar 'gyur te dge ba las kyang sdig pa che ba yin/ bsad pa 'phral du gso nus pa'i dus ma gtogs srog gcod kyi sdig pas mi gos pa'i dus med pas/ bla ma rnams nas kyang sku tshe dang mdzad phrin la gnod par nges pas rnam shes bde chen du 'dren nus na ma gtogs srog gcod kyi las 'di la ci nus su 'jom dgos so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar gsungs pa la dpag na sku rim dang bya ba gal che mdog byed pa dang / dbyar skyid chab zhugs/ gtong sgo sogs la yang bag yod gnang dgos su 'dug la/ khyad par chang 'thung ba ni/ rab byung rnams la ni ston pa thugs rje can gyis chang 'thung ba ni nga yi rjes 'jug ma yin la/ nga ni de yi ston pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang /chang ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /rtswa mchog rtse mos kyang ni btung mi bya//zhes sogs 'dul ba las rab byung nad pa la nad la phan pa'i ched du yang ma gnang zhing /gzhan yang mdo rgyud du ma nas chang 'thung ba ni so thar gyi sdom pa/ byang sems kyi bslab pa/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal bar gsungs pas nyes pa shin tu che la/ spyir chang 'thung ba rnams la/ ngag tshig mi bden zhing lus kyi bya spyod thams cad la yid brtan med pas 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis brnyas par 'gyur zhing tshong dang so nam sogs kyi bya ba'i don thams cad yal zhing shor la/ nor longs spyod thams cad zad cing yid kyang rmongs shing bag med pas bya ba ma yin pa mi dge ba thams cad la 'jug pa sogs kyi skyon dang nyes pa che bas ser skya kun gyis spong dargos te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis rin chen phreng ba las/ chang gis 'jig rten brnyas 'gyur zhing / /don yal nor yang zad par 156

'gyur//rmongs pas bya ba ma yin byed//de bas rtag tu chang ni spongs//zhes dang /bshes spring las/ rgyan po 'gyed dang 'dus la lta ba dang / /le lo sdig pa'i grogs la brten pa dang / /chang dang mtshan mo rgyu ba ngan song ba/ /grags pa nyams par 'gyur ba de drug spangs/ /zhes gsungs so//chang gi nyes dmigs zhib par dpal sprul rin po che'i gsung nyes pa'i 'phrang sgrol chen mor blta bar bya'o//gzhan yang tha ma kha ste sna tha 'di la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bdud thams cad 'dus te/ gros byas nas nyon mongs pa dug lnga skyed pa'i rdzas dang /gzhan yang mi gtsang ba dang grib dang rmongs par byed pa sogs ma rungs pa'i rdzas thams cad bsdus nas/ de bdud thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs te tha ma kha zhes pa'i sngor gyur nas de gang gi snar 'then pa khar za ba sogs de la longs spyod tshad ngan song du 'gro zhing /de'i dri ma dang du ba phog pas sku gsung thugs rten dang ye shes pa'i lha thams cad la grib phog pas ye shes pa yal/ lha srung thams cad khros/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams/ sems can gyi bde skyid 'grib/ 'jig rten gyi khams su mi 'dod pa sna tshogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur bar o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa sogs bla ma mkhas grub mang pos mgrin gcig tu gsungs pas mchog dman kun gyis 'di la yid ches gnang dgos so/ /gnyis pa mi dge ba de'i 'bras bu bsam pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal dang / /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi dge ba re re la yang rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras bu gsum gsum las/ mi dge ba thams cad kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal skyed 157

de/de nyid las/kun gyi dang po ngan 'gror 'gro/zhes te/ de yang kun slong gi sgo nas zhe snang gis kun nasabaslangs te spyad na dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gror skye ste/ de nyid las/zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar skye/ /chags pas yi dwags gnas su skye//rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gro /zhes so//ngo bo'i sgo nas mi dge ba bcu chen por spyad na dmyal ba/'bring du spyad na yi dwags/ chung ngur spyad na dud 'gror skye la/rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la myong ba rgyu mthun dang byed pa rgyu mthun gnyis las/ myong ba rgyu mthun ni/ srog gcod pas mtho ris kyi lus rten thob kyang / tshe thung ba dang nad mang ba yin te/ da lta skyes ma thag 'chi ba sogs tshe thung ba thams cad dang tshe de la nad kyis gzir ba sogs nad dang na tsha ji snyed yod pa thams cad sngon srog gcod dang rdung deg byas pa'i las 'bras smin pa yin la/ skye ba phyi ma la yang tshe thung ba dang na tsha sogs mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba la ni da lta dang khyad par med pa des na srog gcod mi byed cing / dud 'gro sogs la rdung deg mi bya bar sngon byas kyi las ngan la bshags sdom bya ba dang las ngan gyi gnyen po dge ba sgrub pa la 'bad dgos pa yin/ ma byin len gyis longs spyod dbul zhing longs spyod cung zad re yod na yang gzhan gyis 'phrog pa rku ba nor phyugs shi ba sogs kyis rang dbang du longs spyod du med pa yin la/ sngon gzhan nor brkus pa sogs las ngan bsags pas da ltar nor dang longs spyod dbul ba rnams kyis longs spyod 'byung du re nas/rku ba 'phrog pa g.yo sgyus tshong byed pa sogs la brtson pa ni/zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song ba yin te/ las ngan des bskal pa 158

mang po'i bar du yi dwags su skye zhing / las ngan de'i sun ma tshe 'di la yang slebs nas longs spyod cung zad yod kyang rang dbang med pa dang sdig pa'i rgyur 'gro ba dang ser sna'i rgyu las ji tsam 'byor bzhin phongs sems dang med snang je cher 'gro zhing / je dbul je ngan du 'gro ba las med pas/ des na 'bad rtsol ri rab tsam byed pa las bsod nams me stag tsam gsog pa dga'//zhes pa ltar/ sngon bsags las ngan la 'gyod sems dang bshags sdom/ phyin chad las ngan de 'dra mi byed pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pas spang blang byas te/ longs spyod yod pa des yar bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod 'bul dang /mar ngan slong la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs kyis sgyu ma'i nor rdzas la snying po len dgos te/ 'jam mgon bla ma sa paṇa gyis/ /nam dgos tshe na len pa yi//nor ni sbyin par thub pas gsungs//bsags pa'i nor ni sbrang rtsi ltar//nam zhig gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na bun btang bas/ /dngos po thob pa'i nges pa med/ /slong la byin na 'bad med par//chung yang brgya 'gyur thob pa yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ /da lta stobs 'byor yod pa rnams kyang pho rgod pa dang g.yo thubs la mkhas pas ma yin la/ sngon bsod nams bsags pa'i lag rjes yin pas/ des kyang tshe 'di dang skye ba phyi ma'i bde skyid kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i bsod nams bsags pa dang rang tshe 'dir dam chos sgrub pa'i lto gos sogs su longs spyod ma bra na dbul po las kyang tha chad de/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ gang la longs spyod yod bzhin du//spyod dam sbyin par mi byed na//mi de nad kyis btab pa'am//yang na yi dwags mngon sum yin//zhes gsungs so/ /'dod pas log par gnam 159

pa'i 'bras bu ni/ khyim thabs mi mdzes shing / dgra zla lta bu 'byung bar gsungs la/ da lta bza' tshang phal cher dus rtag tu 'thab rtsod dang 'khon 'dzin byed dgos pa rnams kyang rang rang gis sngon 'dod log spyad pa'i myong ba rgyu mthun yin pas/ gcig gis gcig la zhe sdang mi skyed par sngon byas la bshags sdom dang phyin chad 'dod log spong ba la bslab dgos so//rdzun smras pas rang la skur 'debs mang ba dang gzhan gyis bslu bar byed pa mang ba yin/ der ma zad rdzun smras pas tshe 'dir yang sa paṇa gyis/ rdzun gyis pha rol bslus so zhes//snyam na rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /lan gcig rdzun du smras pa des//bden par smras kyang dogs pa skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na da lta ma nyes pa'i kha yogs dang gzhan gyis skur 'debs/ yid gtad pas bslu ba sogs byung na rang gis sngon rdzun smras pa'i 'bras bur bsams la/ de la zhe sdang dang ngan shags rtsod pa sogs mi byed par/rang gi las ngan 'dzad pas drin che snyam du dga' ba sgom pa dang / sngar byas la 'gyod sems dang / phyin chad rdzun spang bar bya dgos te spyod 'jug las/ brnyas dang tshig rtsub smra ba dang / /mi snyan pa yi tshig de yis//lus la gnod par mi 'gyur na//sems khyod ci phyir rab tu khro//zhes dang /'jigs med gling pas/ dgras log sgrub byas kyang thugs dam gyi bogs 'don//gtam ma nyes kha yogs dge skul gyi lcag 'debs/ /'di chags zhen 'jig pa'i bla ma ru 'dug pas/ kho'i drin lan 'khor thabs med pa ru gzigs mdzod//ces gsungs so/ /phra ma byas pas mdza' bshes dang 'khor nyung zhing yod kyang mi mthun pa dang rang la rgol ba dang / ngag la mi nyan pa sogs 'byung ste/ da ltar de ltar byung ba 160

thams cad sngon phra ma byas pa'i las 'bras smin pa yin pas/ las ngan la 'gyod pas bshags sdom dang / rang gzhan 'khon pa bsdum pa la brtson dgos so//tshig rtsub smras pas rtag tu gtam mi snyan pa thos shing / rang gi ngag smras pa yang 'thab mo'i rgyur 'gro la/ lar tshig rtsub ni 'di phyi kun tu nyes pa che ste/ /'jam mgon bla mas/rma gzhan mkhas na 'tsho srid kyi//nyes pa'i tshig rma 'drub pa med/khā yis 'ug pa dma' phab pas//bskal pa'i bar du 'gras la ltos//zhes dang /pha rol gnad du 'bebs pa'i tshig /dgra bo la yang smra mi bya//brag ca bzhin du rang nyid la/ /de ma thag tu le lan 'byung //zhes gsungs la/ 'jig rten pa'i dpe la yang /tshig la mtshon cha med kyang mi sems tshal par gtong //zer ba ltar/pha rol po'i rgyud la zhe sdang glo bur du skyed/ tshur la yang de 'dra ba'i tshig rtsub smra ba sogs las ngan la 'jug cing /khyad par yul gnyan pa la tshig ngan smras pas tshe 'di dang tshe rabs mang por ngan song nas mi thar bar byed pa yang yod de/sangs rgyas mang po'i rtogs brjod las/ ma pham pa sngon gyi dus na sde snod gsum par gyur pas dge 'dun rnams la bud med ces tshig rtsub smras pas/ tshe de la bud med du mtshan 'gyur zhing skye ba lnga brgyar bud med du gyur pa dang / yang sngon bram ze ser skya bya bas/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dge slong rnams la/ rta'i mgo can/ ba lang gi mgo can zhes pa lta bu'i tshig ngan smras pas/ chu srin nya'irigs mgo bco brgyad yod par skyes pa de bskal pa'i bar du mi thar zhing /de las 'phos nas kyang dmyal bar skye bar gsungs pa dang / yang dge slong ma zhig bis/ dge slong ma la khyi mo zhes brjod pas khyi mo'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs pa 161

sogs de lta bu du ma yod pas/deng sang grwa pa sogs la ming ngan 'dogs shing /de pho rgod du rlom zhing mtshar chos su byed pa rnams kyis 'di dag la thugs zhib gnang dgos su 'dug la/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i gang zag dang byang sems gang na yod dang / gang yin mi shes pas thams cad la dag snang sbyangs/ dus rtag tu 'jam por smra zhing gzhan gyi yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod dgos/byang sems la skur 'debs dang ngan smras byas na nyes pa shin tu lci ste/phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'ga' zhig khros nas phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad btson ra mun nag tu bcug pa bas/ khros te byang sems la rgyab kyis phyogs te 'dug nas ma rungs pa 'di la mi blta'o/ /zhes zer na snga ma las sdig pa ches grangs med par bskyed pa dang / 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad kyi bdog pa thams cad 'phrog cing bsad pa bas/ byang sems gang yang rung ba la smad na snga ma las sdig pa grangs med par bskyed pa dang / mchod rten gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bshig pa dang bsregs pa las/ theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang sems la gnod sems dang khong khro bskyed cing mi snyan pa smra ba ni snga ma las sdig pa ches grangs med par bskyed par gsungs so/ /ngag 'khyal gyis rang gi bden par smras kyang gzhan gyis tshad mar mi 'dzin la/ mang po'i nang du gtam bshad lta bur spobs pa chung ba yin/ brnab sems kyis yid la bsam pa'i don mi 'grub cing / longs spyod mi thob pa dang / thob kyang chog mi shes pa yin/ gnod sems kyis rtag tu 'jigs shing skrag pa dang / 'tshe ba mang la/ log ltas lta ba ngan pa dang phrad pa dang shes rab chung ba'am shes rab 'chal bar 'gyur pa'o/ /nge skad 162

du yang rin chen phreng ba las/ srog bcad pa yis tshe thung 'gyur/ /rku ba yis ni longs spyod phongs/ /byi bo byed pas dgra dang bcas/ /rdzun du smra bas skur ba ste/ /phra ma yis ni bshes dang bye//tshig rtsub pa yis mi snyan thos/ /ma 'brel ba yis tshig mi btsun/ /brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ /gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par byed//log par lta bas lta ngan nyid//ces so/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni/ mi dge ba byas pas de la blo goms pa'i shugs kyis tshe rabs brgyud mar mi dge ba byed pa la rang bzhin gyis spro ba ste/ dper na da lta srog gcod la dga' ba de tshe rabs snga mar srog gcod goms pa'i byed pa rgyu mthun yin la/ da lta rku ba la dga' ba de snga mar ma byin len pa'i byed pa rgyu mthun yin pa/ de bzhin du mi dge ba gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o//bdag po'i 'bras bu ni/ gang du skye ba dang gnas pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten la smin par gsungs te/ de yang srog bcad pas sa phyogs gzi mdangs chung ba/ g.yang sa la sogs srog la gnod pa can du skye zhing gnas dgos pa dang / de bzhin du ma byin len gyis sad ser gyis sdang /ljon shing 'bras bu mi chags mu ge yod sar skye/ 'dod log gis rdul 'khrigs shing bshang gci dang 'dam rdzab la sogs pa yid du mi 'ong bar gnas dgos pa'o//rdzun gyis btsog cing dri nga ba 'byor pa mi brtan cing skrag pa'i yul dang /phra mas yul phyogs ngam grog dang gcong rong sogs mtho dman can du skye ba dang / tshig rtsub kyis tshwa sgo can sogs sa phyogs yid mi bde bar skye/ ngag 'khyal gyis so nam byas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung dus 'gyur ldog can du skye ba dang /brnab sems kyis lo tog nyes thing 'bras bu chung la gnas dus ngan pa'i gnas 163

su skye/ gnod sems kyis rtag tu 'jigs pa dang 'tshe ba mang zhing 'bras bu ro kha ba'i gnas su skye/ log ltas 'bras bu chung ngu'ang med pas 'byor pa nyung zhing skyabs dang dpung gnyen med par skye ba yin te/ de skad du/ sa phyogs gzi chung ser ba mang / /rdul 'khrigs dri nga mtho dman can//tshwa sgo can sogs dus log dang //'bras bu phra kha chung du'am med/ /ces so/ /des na phyogs gang na de lta bu yod pa rnams kyang mi dge ba'i bdag 'bras su shes par bya ste/spyod 'jug las/sdig pa byed pa bde 'dod kyang //gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni sdig pa des//sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam par 'joms//zhes so/ /gsum pa mi dge ba de dag spong dgos par bsam pa ni/ mi dge ba byas pa las ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang / mtho ris su skyes kyang mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag 'byung bar 'dug pas/ /da phyin chad sdig pa'i las srog la babs kyang mi bya snyam du bsam par bya ste/ /de nyid las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /de las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni//'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs//zhes gsungs/ des na dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob nas sdig pa gsog pa ni/ gser snod rin chen gyis spras pas ngan skyugs 'phyag pa las kyang ches blun zhing / rang gis rang bslus pas phangs pa'i gnas yin te/ bshes spring las/ gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis ngan skyugs 'phyag par bgyid pa de bas ni/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa dag /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags//zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag gis dge rgoms ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa 164

gzhan med de//'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do//zhes dang / shin tu rnyed dka' phan pa'i sa/ /ci zhig ltar stes rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag nyid shes dang ldan bzhin du//phyir yang dmyal ba der khrid na//sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa bzhin//bdag la 'dir sems med du zad/ /ces gsungs so//gal te mi dge ba chen pos ngan song du skye ba bden mod/sdig pa chung ngus 'bras bu de tsam 'byin nam zhe na/ shin tu'ang 'byin te/ sngon rgyal po zhig gi mchod gnas rang sangs rgyas mang po yod pa'i nang nas sku gzugs sgur ba zhig yod pa ma tshang bas/ rgyal po'i bu mo zhig gis/ rang sangs rgyas de'i sku gzugs kyi lad mo byas te 'di lta bu de ma tshang byas pas/skye ba mang por sgur mor skyes pa dang /phyag rgya'i mdo las/'dzam gling gi mi thams cad kyi mig phyung zhing longs spyod thams cad 'phrog pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' la ma dad pa'i sgo nas mig log tsam bltas pa sdig pa che bar gsungs pa dang / yang byang chub sems dpa' la khong khro lan gcig skyes pa'i yun tshad kyi skad cig ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal par dmyal ba myong dgos par gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /gal te ngan sems skyed par byed na de/ /ngan sems skyes pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni/ /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang / skad cig gcig byas sdig pas kyang / /bskal par mnar med gnas gyur na/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags sdig gis/ /bde 'gror mi 'gro smos ci dgos//zhes dang /'dul ba las/sdig pa chung ngu dag la yang //mi gnod snyam du brnyas mi bya//me stag chung ngu dag gis kyang / /rtswa phung ri tsam sreg par byed//ces 165

gsungs pa ltar ro//mdor na rang re rnams kyis tshe rabs thog med nas da lta'i bar du sdig pa mi gsog pa'i dus nyin gcig kyang med par bsags ba'i tshod yin zhing /de'i rnam smin rang gcig pus myong dgos pas/dang por sdig pas mi gos pa'i thabs la 'bad/ gal te byung na sdig pa ngo shes pas 'gyod sems drag pos stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom bya zhing / phyis mi byed pa'i dam bca' bzung bar bya ste/mdo las/skyes bu dam pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/nyes pas ma gos pa dang / nyes pa byung ba 'chags pa'o//zhes gsungs//gal te bshags pas sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur ram zhe na//'gyur te/ gcung dga' bo chung ma la chags pa'i dbang du gyur pa yang / ston pas rdzu 'phrul gyis lha yul bstan pas mngon mtho'i khrims bsrungs ba la/ yang dmyal gnas bstan pas nges 'byung gi tshul khrims bsrung nas bslab pa'i gnas phra mo la yang mi 'gal bar byed pas/bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang po'i sgo bsdams pa rnams kyi mchog tu bstan cing dgra bcom thob pa dang /sor phreng can bram ze spun po zhig slob dpon du bsten pas/ des bslus te mi stong phrag bsad nas sor mo'i phreng ba byas na chos su 'gyur ro//zhes pa'i ngag bden par bzung nas/ mi stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bsad pa na/bcom ldan 'das dang mjal te nyes pa bshags sdom byas/ rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa dang / mthong ldan te rgyal po ma skyes dgras yab rgyal po gzugs can snying po bgrongs pa'i mtshams med kyi las byas kyang / phyis ston pa la mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa thob ste/ bshags sdom tshul bzhin byas pas/ tshe de la bden pa mthong / bde byed 'dod pa'i log g.yem byed pa 166

mas bzlog pas ma bsad pa'i mtshams med byas kyang / phyis rab tu byung ba na gnas tshul dge 'dun rnams kyis shes nas gnas nas phyung nas/logs shig tu gtsug lag khang brtsigs dge 'dun 'dus nas gnas brtan tshul bzhin byas pas/ dmyal bar pho long brdab pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal myong ste lhar skyes bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob pa lta bu yin te/ bshes spring las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la//phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang / /zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te//dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dge ba'i las 'bras bsams la sgrub 'dod bskyed pa la/dge ba'i las bsam/ de'i 'bras bu bsam/ de sgrub par bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni rin chen phreng ba las/ /ma chags mi ldang gti mug med//des bskyed las ni dge ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang phyogs la ma chags pa/gzhan phyogs la zhe sdang med pa/las 'bras la rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi las thams cad dge ba'i las zhes bya la/ de la dbye na lus kyi las srog gcod spong ba sogs gsum/ ngag gis dzud spong ba sogs bzhi/yid kyis brnab sems spong ba sogs gsum ste bcu yin la/de yang lus kyi srog gcod spangs te sems can gyi srog skyabs/ /ma byin len spangs te sbyin pa gtong / /'dod log spangs te tshul khrims bsrung ba ste gsum/ngag gis rdzun spangs nas bden par smra/ /phra ma spangs te 'khon pa bsdum//tshig rtsub spangs nas snyan par smra/ ngag 'khyal spangs te kha ton byed pa ste bzhi//yid kyis brnab sems spangs nas gtong sems 'chang / gnod sems spangs nas 167

phan sems bsgom/log lta spangs nas yang dag lta ba rgyud la bsten dgos la/de dag thams cad kyang dug gsum med pas kun nas bslangs te srog gcod spong bar bya'o snyam pa'i dam 'cha' ba dang / de bzhin du ma byin len spong bar dam 'cha' ba la sogs pa mi dge ba bcu char la mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' zhig nges par dgos la rang gis dam bcas pa yang dge bar 'gyur mod/ khyad par bla ma dang rten gyi drung du dam bcas na lhag par stobs che/ khyad par rab tu byung ba rnams kyis khyim pa pho mo rnams la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gnang ste srung du bcug na phan yon shin tu che ste/ klu sgrub kyis/'tshe dang chom rkun 'khrig pa rdzun dang ni//chang dang dus min zas la chags pa dang //mal stan mtho la dga' dang glu dag dang / /gar dang phreng ba'i khyad par rnam spong zhing / /dgra bcom tshul khrims rjes su byed pa yi/ /yan lag brgyad po 'di dag dang ldan na/ /gso stong 'dod spyod lha lus yid 'ong ba/ /skyes pa bud med dag la stsol bar bgyid//ces gsungs pa ltar khyim pa rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnams dang gzhan yang bco lnga gnam stong sogs la bsnyen gnas blang zhing bsrungs na mchog tu 'gyur la/ de ltar ma byung na yang mi dge ba bcu char ram gang tsam bsrung thub pa de spong sems dang ldan pas bsrungs na phan yon chen po 'thob ste/spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las//tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de yang sngon 'phags pa ka kyā na'i drung du gnas pa grong gi shan pas mtshan mo srog mi gcod par khas len byas pas/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes te/ nyin mo lcags bsregs kyi khang pa'i nang du sdus bsngal myong 168

yang / mtshan mo gzhal med khang du lha mo bzhis bskor te bde skyid myong ba lta bu yin no//gnyis pa de yi 'bras bu bsam pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang / /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces gsungs te/ dge ba bcu po re re la yang rnam smin/ rgyu mthun/ bdag po'i 'bras bu dang gsum gsum las/ dang po rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni/ dge ba bcu po thams cad kyis mtho ris kyi bde ba skyed de/ de nyid las/ chos 'dis dmyal ba yi dwags dang / /dud 'gro dag las rnam grol zhing / /lha dang mi yi nang dag tu/ /bde dpal rgyal srid rgyas pa 'thob//ces so/ /de yang dge ba chen po byas pas lha//'bring du spyad pas lha min/chung ngur byas pas mir skye'o//'o na dal 'byor rnyed dka'i skabs su/mtho ris rnams kyi nang nas mi'i lus rten bzang bar bshad pa ma yin nam zhe na/der ni chos bsgrub pa'i rten bzang ngan 'chad pa'i skabs yin la/'dir ni tshe rabs snga ma'i las kyi 'bras bu bzang ngan 'chad pa'i skabs yin pas mi 'dra'o//rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la/myong ba rgyu mthun ni/srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring zhing nad nyung / ma byin len spangs pas longs spyod dang ldan zhing dgra rkun med/ 'dod log spangs pas khyim thabs mdzes shing dgra zla nyung / dzun spangs pas kun gyis bstod cing byams/phra ma spangs pas 'khor g.yog gus/ tshig rtsub spangs pas snyan par thos/ ngag 'khyal spangs pas tshig btsun/ brnab sems spangs pas bsam don 'grub/ gnod sems spangs pas 'tshe ba bral/ log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang po rgyud la skye ba ste sngar gyi mi dge ba'i 'bras bu las bzlog nas 'byung ste/ji skad du/mi dge zhes bya de dag gi/rnam smin bsgrags pa 169

gang yin pa/ /dge ba dag ni thams cad la/ /'bras bu de ni bzlog ste 'byung //zhes so/ /byed pa rgyu mthun ni srog gcod la mi mos shing / srog gcod mi byed pa la dga' zhing spro ba tshe rabs thams cad du gong 'phel du 'gyur/de bzhin du rku ba la mi dga' ba sogs dge ba byed pa la dga' zhing spro ba'o/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu ni yul la smin pas sa phyogs gzi mdangs can du skye ba la sogs sngar gyi mi dge ba bcu yi 'bras bu las bzlog pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis 'byor par 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ yid la bsam pa'i dge byas pas/ gang dang gang du 'gro gyur pa/ /de dang der ni bsod nams de'i/ /'bras bu'i yon gyis mngon mchod 'gyur//zhes so/ /gzhan yang dge ba'i las 'di dag nges 'byung bsam pa'i rtsis zin na thar pa thob pa dang / sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems dngos gzhi stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab/ rjes yongs su bsngo ba ste thabs kyi khyad par de gsum gyis zin par byas na thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'o//gsum pa dge ba de dag bsgrub par bsam pa ni/ phan yon de dang ldan pa'i dge ba rnams la mos shing gus pas bdag gis dge ba phra mo tsam yang khyad du mi gsod par bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pas bsgrub dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/dge ba'i phyogs ni thams cad kyi//rtsa ba mos par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes dang /de bas dge la mos bya zhing //gus pa nyid du bsgom par bya//zhes dang /rnam smin bde la zhi ba yi//bsod nams kyis lta ci ste ngoms//zhes gsungs pa ltar ngoms pa med par dge ba bsgrub par bya'o/ /gal te dge ba phra mo tsam gyis 'bras bu 'byin par nus sam zhi na/dge ba phra mos kyang 'bras bu chen po 'byin 170

nus pa yin pas 'dis ci bya snyam du brnyas par mi bya ste/ rgyal po nga las nus sngon dbul por gyur pa'i tshe/ sran ma spar gang thogs nas phyin pa'i lam du sangs rgyas bsod skyabs grong khyer du byon pa dang mjal shin tu dad de sran ma spar gang po sangs rgyas la gtor bas bzhi lhung bzed du song gnyis thugs kur phog pa'i rnam smin gyis//'dzam gling du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes/sngar sran rdog bzhi lhung bzed du lhung ba'i 'bras bu gling bzhi la dbang ba'i rgyal srid lo brgyad khrir byas shing gnyis thugs kur phog pa gcig gi 'bras bu rgyal chen ris bzhi'i bdag po lo brgyad khrir byas/ gcig gi 'bras bu sum cu rtsa gsum du brgya byin sum cu rtsa bdun brjes kyi bar la brgya byin gyi rgyal srid phyed la dbang byas pa yin/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na me tog gcig nam mkhar gtor ba'i dge 'bras kyis brgya byin dang / 'khor spos sgyur ba thob pa mtha' yas par gsungs la/ gzhan yang sngon shing lo la brten pa'i srin bu bdun rlung gis bdas nas rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na rnam snang gi sku yod pa la g.yas bskor lan gsum byas pas rigs ngan gyi bu mo bdun du skyes/ de rnams rang gi rigs dang longs spyod la skyo ba skyes nas rna shing bsdus khol mo byas te bsod nams bsags pas/ rgyal po kri kri'i bu mo bdun du gyur nas sangs rgyas 'od srungs mnyes par byas pas phyis sangs rgyas par lung bstan pa dang / de bzhin du sgos bdas pa'i phag gis mchod rten la lan gsum bskor ba byas pas phyis dgra bcom pa thob pa dang /bram ze'i bu mos bcom ldan 'das la 'bras chan lhung bzed gang phul ba'i bsod nams kyis skye ba thams cad du bde 171

'gror skyes nas rang sangs rgyas su lung bstan pa lta bu yin te/ de skad du yang mdzangs blun las/ dge ba chung ngu dag la yang //mi phan snyam du brnyas mi bya//chu yi thigs pa bsags pa yis//snod chen yongs su gang bar 'gyur//zhes so//'o na dge sdig 'di dag la phra rags su gang gis 'jog ce na/ 'di yang spyod 'jug las/ rtag par mngon zhen gyis bslangs pa'am/ /gnyen po yis ni bslangs pa nyid/ /yon tan dang ni phan 'dogs zhing / /sdug bsngal ba la dge chen 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dus kyi sgo nas rtag tu byed par 'dod pa'am dam bcas pa ni dge sdig gang yin kyang stobs che la/glo bur du byed pa ni chung ngo / /bsam pa'i sgo nas mngon zhen drag pos sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i las stobs che zhing / rang mi 'dod bzhin gzhan gyis dbang med du bskul nas byas pa ni stobs chung ngo / /thar pa'i ched du srog dang sha khrag gi mchod sbyin byed pa lta bu phyin ci log gi sems las byung ba'i sdig pa ni stobs che la/ byis pa'i rtsed mo lta bu mi shes pa ni stobs chung ngo / /gnyen po'i sgo nas dge sdig gang byas la 'gyod pa med cing rjes su yi rang bar gnas pa dang gzhan la 'chab pa ni stobs che la/de las bzlog pa ni stobs chung ngo //des na dge ba byas pa gzhan la mi ngom zhing 'chab pa gal che ste/spyod 'jug las/'di yi yon tan ci nas kyang //'gas kyang mi shes de ltar bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//sdig pa byas na blo bde mor mi 'dug par bdag gis 'di lta bu bgyis zhes/ gzhan la sgrog cing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa gal che ste/ dmyal ba yi ni las byas nas/ /ji ltar bdag yid bde bar 'gyur/ /ces dang bdag gis nyes pa chung byas kyang / /skye bo mang la 172

rab tu shog /zhes so/ yul gyi sgo nas yon tan gyi zhing bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum dang / mkhan slob chos smra ba la sogs pa la dge sdig gang bsags kyang stobs che la/ phal pa rnams kyang stobs chung ngo //gtso bo'i zhing pha ma dang rigs kyi rgan pa dang rigs kyi rgan pa dang rang drin che ba rnams la stabs che la/gzhan rnams la chung ngo / /snying rje'i zhing nad pa dang / mgon med pa dang / sdug bsngal can dang rang la yid brtan byed pa rnams la phan gnod byas na stobs che la/ de lta bu ma yin pa rnams la chung ste/ bshes byung las/rtag dang mngon par zhen dang gnyen po med/ /yon tan gtso ldan gzhi las byung ba'i las//dge dang mi dge rnam lnga chen po ste/ /de bas dge ba sgrub la brtson par mdzod/ /ces gsungs/de rnams kyi nang nas kyang zhing dang bsam pa gtso che ste/mdzod las/zhing dang bsam pa'i bye brag gis/ /mthong chos 'bras bu can gyi las/ /zhes gsungs la/ dngos gzhi chen po byas kyang sbyor rjes gnyis chad na byas la ma bsags pa yi las yin pas rnam smin myong bar ma nges shing /yang dngos gzhi ma byas kyang / sbyor rjes gnyis yid la bsam bzhin pa dang / gzhan gyi dge sdig byed pa la rjes su yi rangs byed pa dag ni/ ma byas la bsags pa'i las yin pas rnam smin myong bar nges la/gang zag mang pos blo mthun pas byas na che la/re re'am so sor byas na chung ste/ des na dge 'dun mang pos lhan cig mdo tshar gcig bton na re res dge 'dun de snyed kyi bsod nams kyi 'gyur khyad thob la/ rang nyid gcig pus bton na gcig po de'i phan yon las med la/ de bzhin du mi brgya gros byas nas sems can gcig bsad na mi re res sems /73

can re bsad pa'i sdig par 'gyur bas che la/ gros ma byas par mi gcig gis bsad na sems can gcig bsad pa'i sdig par 'gyur bas chung ngo / /gnas kyi sgo nas gtsug lag khang dang / dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung dang bla ma dang dge 'dun bzhugs pa'i sa dang / dus kyi sgo nas yar ngo mar ngo'i dus bzang bzhi dang sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnams dang bla ma dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi dus mchod sogs la dge sdig gang byas kyang stobs che la/ gzhan rnams chung ngo / /rten gyi sgo nas rab tu byung ba la sogs pa bslab pa khas blangs pas dge sdig gang byas kyang stobs che la/ bslab pa khas ma blangs pa'am khyim pas byas na chung ngo / /de'ang mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rtsi mar gyis bkang ba'i mar me de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phul ba bas/ byang sems rab tu byung bas sdong bu 'ga' zhig snum gyis sbags te de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang gi sgo them snang tsam byas na de snga ma las bsod nams che'o/ /gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du rab tu byung ba rnams la 'byung nye zhing stobs che ba ngan song du mda' 'phangs pa ltar 'gro ba'i chos bzhi/ myur du 'gro ba'i chos bzhi/song nas thar dus med pa'i chos bzhi ste bzhi tshan gsum las/dang po ni/byams pa seṅge sgra'i mdo las 'byung ba'i don sdoms su byas na/ /bslab pa nyams pas dad rdzas spyod/ /cing ba shes bzhin khyad du gsod/ /nyes cing dag dang zhag tu 'grogs//gzhan gyi phun tshogs la snang bzhi/ /dmyal bar mda' 'phangs bzhin 'gro'i chos//zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni spyod 'jug la sogs pa'i don te/ rnyed bkur 174

mang bas khengs pa dang / /thos pa mang bas khengs pa dang / /tshul khrims brtul zhugs kyis khengs dang / /ster mang mdza' bshes kyis khengs bzhi//dmyal bar myur du 'gro ba'i chos/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni lhung ba sde lnga'i rtsi yang bstan pa'i mdo sogs kyi don te/ rtsa ba'i ltung bas gos pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon brjod dang //dam pa'i chos la 'khu ba dang //log lta 'dzin rnams dmyal ba nas//thar dus med pa'i chos bzhi yin/ /zhes te lung rnams mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so zhes mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsungs so/ /kun slong gi sgo nas zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las rnams mi dge ba gzhan las stobs che ste/ nye ba 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpas bskal pa 'bum du/ 'dod chags kyi kun du spyod pa spyad pa bas/ yul sems can su yang rung ba zhig la khro ba'i sems thang cig tsam skyes pa sdig pa che'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du yul khyad par can la khong khro'i sems skad cig ma gcig tsam la skyes na'ang bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dus gcig la 'joms par gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs//legs spyad gang yin de kun kyang /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /ces dang / 'jug pa las/ sbyin dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags pa skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir/ /mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin//zhes so/ /dgos ched kyi sgo nas dge sdig gang byas kyang gzhan don byed pa stobs che la/ rang gcig pu'i don du stobs chung / des na gang zag gzhan gyi 175

ched du sdig pa byas kyang rnam smin rang la 'byung gi /gzhan dag gis skal pa mi len no//mdor na las dge sdig tu 'jog pa phal cher/ las rang gi ngo bo las kyang / kun slong gtso che ba yin la/ des na rang 'dod kyi 'khris rtsa ba nas med cing gzhan don kho na yin na/rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' la lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun po dngos su gnang ba'i skabs kyang yod de/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa ded dpon snying rje chen por sku skye ba bzhes skabs tshong pa lnga brgya dang bcas rgya mtshor phyin pa'i lam du mi nag mdung thung can bya ba'i chom rkun gdug pa can zhig tshong pa lnga brgya gsod du byung bas/ khong gi thugs dgongs la tshong pa lnga brgya po 'di dag phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems sha stag yin pas 'di dag thams cad mi gcig gis bsad na de bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i bar dmyal bar gnas dgos pa snying re rje de bas ngas 'di bsad na 'di dmyal bar mi 'gro bar 'dug tsong pa lnga brgya po rnams kyi srog skyob par 'dug pas/nga rang dmyal bar song yang thabs med snyam du dgongs nas blo stobs chen pos chom rkun pa de bsad pas bskal pa bdun khri'i tshogs rdzogs pa dang / de bzhin du bram ze'i khye'u skar ma la dga' bas lo grangs mang por nags su tshangs par spyad nas/ grong du bsod snyoms la byon skabs/ bram ze'i bu mo zhig khong la chags nas 'chi bar rtsom pa de la snying rje skyes te khyim thabs byas pas bskal pa bzhi khri'i tshogs rdzogs pa yin/ des na srog gcod dang mi tshangs spyod kyang de dang de lta bu la gnang ba yin gyi/ rang 'dod kyi chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis spyod pa ni su la yang gnang ba med la/ de bzhin du ser sna can gyi longs spyod 176

las rku ba sogs kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa dang ngan slong la sbyin gtong bya ba dang / rdzun gyis sems can gsod pa bsrung ba sogs dang / phra mas sdig grogs dbye bar bya ba'i phyir dang / tshig rtsub ni 'jam pos mi thul ba la btsan thabs kyis chos la gzud pa dang / gdams ngag brjod pas mtshang la rgol ba sogs kyi ched du gnang ste jo bos/ bla ma'i mchog mtshang la rgol ba yin/gdams ngag gi mchog mtshang thog tu 'bebs pa yin/ gsungs pa lta bu yin/ngag 'khyal yang gtam la dga' zhing chos la 'jug mi nus pa la thabs kyis 'brid de chos skor gzhug pa'i ched du gnang ba ste/ 'di dag thams cad rang don gyi 'khris dang chags sdang gtan nas med cing gzhan don kho na'i ched du gnang gi rang gi chags sdang rmongs pas las ngan gsog pa'i ched du gnang ba med/yid kyi nyes pa gsum po ni kun slong dge bar bsgyur du med cing rnam rtog ngan pa gcig skyes na mi dge bar 'gyur bas nam yang gnang ba med la/de skad du chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ gzhan gyi don gyi sems brtan pas/ /pham pa bzhi po spyad na yang //nyan thos rnams kyi sdig pa ste/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge chen yin//zhes gsungs so//de bzhin du rin chen phreng ba las/tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur ste'i ched/ /dbang po sdom par byed pa ste//zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i rang gi kun spyod la gzhan yid ches nas rnyed bkur thob pa'i ched du sgo gsum dge ba la sbyor ba sogs ni/ ltar snang dge ba lta bu yin yang don du mi dge ba 'ba' zhig yin te/ sngon pas ngur smig gyon nas ri dwags bsad pa dang / g.yon can gyis ri dwags kyi rnga ma bstan nas bong bu'i sha btsong ba lta bu ste/ sa paṇa gyis/ ri 177

dwags rnga ma ma bstan na//bong sha tshong bar mi nus ltar//de bzhin bzang spyod ma bstan na//log pa'i chos kyis bslu mi nus//zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o//des na dge sdig thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems dge mi dge la rag las pas dus rtag tu rang gi sems la brtags te/ sems dge bar 'dug na dga' ba bsgom zhing dge ba de gong 'phel du bya/ so so'i skye bo'i sa 'di la mi dge ba'i kun rtog ngan pa'i bsam sbyor rgyud la mi skye ba mi 'ong ste/chags sdang bongs pa'i sems mi dge bar 'dug na ngos zin par byas la 'phral du bshags sdom bya zhing / nga ni chos de tsam thob kyang da dung rnam rtog ngan pa de lta bu skye ba ngo re tsha/ da phyin chad de lta bu'i kun rtog ngan pa rgyud la mi 'char ba zhig bya snyam du bsams te sems kyi kun slong dge bar sgyur ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ bshes thing las/bsnyengs dang bral la mang du smos ci 'tshal/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag don po 'di lags te/ /khyod kyis thugs dul mdzod cig bcom ldan gyis//sems ni chos kyi rtsa ba lags par gsungs//zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis/ /rab tu bsgrims nas sems bsrung ste//sems de bsrung bar ma byas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yongs mi nus//sems kyi glang po yan btang bas//mnar med gnod pa byed pa ltar//glang chen ma thul myos pa yis/ /'di na de 'dra'i gnod mi byed/ /kun nas dran pa'i thag pa yis/ /sems kyi glang po dam btags na//'jigs pa thams cad med 'gyur zhing //dge ba thams cad lag tu 'ong / /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa lung du bstan min bsams nas dge bar bsgyur ba la/ lung ma bstan gyi las bsam/ de la 'bras bu med par bsam//des 178

na dge bar bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po ni lung ma bstan zhes bya ba/nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang dug gsum ma yin pa'i kun slong gang gis kyang ma zin pa'i 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug la sogs pa sgo gsum gyi 'phral gyi bya spyod btang snyoms pa thams cad yin no/ /gnyis pa de la 'bras bu med par bsam pa ni/ de dag gis ni 'bras bu bde sdug gang yang skyed par mi nus te/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ btang snyoms gnyis ka ma yin pas//rnam par smin pa'ang gnyis ka min//zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa dge bar bsgyur ba ni/ las de dag gis sdug bsngal mi bskyed mod kyang /bde ba mi bskyed pas byas pa don med yin pas thabs la mkhas pas dge bar bsgyur dgos la/de yang spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par sgyur bas na//byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zungs//zhes dang / 'phags pa lhas/bsam pas byang chub sems dpa' la//dge ba'am 'on te mi dge rung //thams cad dge ba nyid 'gyur te/ /gang phyir sems de gtso ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mar gyur mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god 'dod kyi sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin na mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan yang dge bar 'gyur ba gsungs pas/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug zas za ba/ gos gyon pa la sogs pa thams cad la sems bskyed des zin par byed cing / bye brag spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i mdo bzhin mdo sde rgyan las kyang / rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bur/ /dbang po'i spyod yul sna tshogs 'jug gyur pa//de lta de ltar rigs pa'i mthun tshig gis/ /sems can 179

phan phyir de mngon 'du byed do/ /gsungs pa ltar/ khyim du gnas pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyis thar pa'i grong thob par gyur cig /stan la 'dug pa'i tshe rdo rje'i stan thob par gyur cig /nyal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos sku thob par gyur cig /mi lam byung na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs par gyur cig /gnyid sad pa'i tshe ma rig pa'i gnyid sad par gyur cig /ldang ba'i tshe gzugs sku thob par gyur cig /gos gyon pa'i tshe ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi gos rgyan par gyur cig /khrus byed pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang bral bar gyur cig /zas za ba'i tshe bsam gtan gyi zas thob par gyur cig /khyim nas 'gro ba'i tshe 'khor ba'i grong las thar par gyur cig /lam du 'jug pa'i tshe 'phags pa'i lam thob par gyur cig /gzhan dang phrad pa'i tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang mjal bar gyur cig don spyod pa'i tshe don gnyis mthar phyin par gyur cig /khyim du 'jug pa'i tshe thar pa'i grong du 'jug par gyur cig /slebs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi sar phyin par gyur cig /me gtong ba'i tshe nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsregs par gyur cig /me 'bar ba'i tshe ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur cig /g.yos zin pa'i tshe ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thob par gyur cig /sgo 'byed pa'i tshe thar pa'i grong khyer gyi sgo 'byed par gyur cig /sgo gcod pa'i dus su ngan song gsum gyi sgo gcod par gyur cig /ces pa lta bu skabs su gang babs kyi rung mthun sbyar te shes par bya zhing / 'di dag rgyas par shes pa 'dod na sa paṇa gyi thub pa'i dgongs gsal la blta bar bya'o/ /mdo sdud pa las/ 'gro 'chag nyal dang 'dug par shes bzhin rab tu ldan/ zhes gsu/ngas pa'i don yin no/ /de lta bu'i las dge ba /80

dang mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan dge bar bsgyur ba'i las de rnams kyi 'bras bu rnam smin myong tshul yang mdzod las/ de yang nges dang ma nges dang / /mthong ba'i chos la sogs pa la/ /myong 'gyur phyir na nges rnam gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngar bstan pa'i las che chung dang zhing dang bsam pa'i khyad par gyis/ nges pa'i las de la yang mthong chos tshe 'di nyid la rnam smin myong bar nges pa dang /skye ba phyi mar myong ba la yang skyes nas myong 'gyur dang /skye ba phyi ma phan chad lan grangs gzhan du myong ba ste gsum dang /ma nges pa'i las la yang / sngar bstan pa ltar sbyor dngos sogs tshang ma tshang dang / byas la bsags ma bsags sogs kyi khyad par las/ las gang zhig rkyen dang phrad na rnam smin 'byin la/ ma phrad na mi 'byin pa dang / de la yang rnam smin gtan nas mi myong ba zhig dang rnam smin myong yang mthong chos sogs gsum po gang du'ang ma nges pa ste gnyis su 'byed de/mdzod las/ kha cig las rnam lnga zhes zer//gzhan dag mu ni bzhi zhes zer//zhes gsungs so//gzhan yang 'phen rdzogs kyi las kyang shes te nges pa rnyed dgos la/de yang 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i gsung las shes par bya ste/ gzhan yang las la rnam gnyis gsungs//'phen byed las dang rdzogs byed las//zhes dang /mtho ris gsum po 'grub pa ni//dge ba'i las kyis 'phon pa yin/ /de dag bde ba 'byung ba ni/ /rdzogs byed dge bas 'phangs pa yin/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba ni/ /'phen byed sdig pa yin par gsungs//de yi sdug bsngal bye brag kun//rdzogs byed las ni sdig pa yin/ /mtho ris dge bas 'phangs mod kyi//de yi nad dang gnod pa kun//rdzogs byed sdig pa yin par gsungs//ngan 'gro'i 'phen byed sdig yin 181

yang //de yi lus sems bde ba yi//gnas skabs dge bas 'phangs par gsungs//zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /des na las 'bras la rnam smin myong tshul dang / /'phen rdzogs kyi khyad par de ltar yod pas/ /'ga' zhig rgyud ma rungs pas sdig las 'ba' zhig la spyod kyang / skyid la kha drag pa kho na 'dug pas/ /mi dge ba'i las la 'bras bu sdug bsngal mi 'dug snyam pa'i log lta dang / 'ga' zhig blo gzu bor gnas shing dge ba 'ba' zhig spyod kyang sdug bsngal kho na myong bar mthong bas/ dkar po dge ba la 'bras bu bde ba mi 'dug snyam pa'i log rtog ni las che chung dang rnam smin myong tshul sogs ma shes pa'i skyon te/ mi dge ba kho na dang stobs chen byed pa la bde ba 'byung ba de mi dge ba de'i 'bras bu tshe der smin pa ma yin gyi/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su dge ba skyes nas myong 'gyur ram/ lan grangs gzhan du myong 'gyur bsags pa'i rnam smin sdig pa stobs chen de'i mthus/ tshe 'di'i bde ba tsam du myong ste zad par byas nas/ de phan chad sdug bsngal kho na myong dgos pa'i rtags su gsungs te/ dper na sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal po gtsug phud can 'khor dang bcas pas 'phags pa kā kyā na la thal ba sbar mo re gtor bas/ thal ba'i 'og tu 'gro ba'i las ngan bsags/ nam zhig na las ngan de'i mthus sngon bsags kyi dge ba'i rnam smin tshe der smin te/ nam mkha' las rin po che'i char dang gos kyi char babs pas rgyal po khyed 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba'i ltas so zhes gzengs bstod pa na de bye ma'i char par gnas gyur te/ bye char zhag bdun babs pas thams cad bye 'og tu non nas shi ste dmyal bar skyes pa ste/ mthong chos tshe 'dir smin pa rmi zhing 182

dang bsam pa gnyis kyi nus pa yin pa lta bu'o/ /yang blo gzu bor gnas shing dge ba kho na byed pa la tshe 'dir nad na tsha dbul phongs dgras sdang ba sogs sdug bsngal myong ba yang /dge ba de'i 'bras bu ma yin gyi/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su skyes nas dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi mi dge ba bsags pa'i rnam smin/ dge ba stobs chen de'i mthus tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal tsam du zad par byas nas de phan chad sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i rtags yin par gsungs te/rdo rje gcod pa las/rab 'byor/gang dag 'di lta bu'i tshig len pa dang /'dzin pa dang 'chang ba sogs byed pa de dag ni mnar bar 'gyur/ shin tu mnar bar 'gyur ro//de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor/sems can de dag ni tshe rabs snga ma'i mi dge ba'i las ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba gang dag byas pa de dag tshe 'di la mnar bas/tshe rabs snga ma'i mi dge ba de dag byang bar 'gyur te sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas thub pa'i dgongs gsal las/ des na sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa skyid mi thang ba la skyid pa dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig byed pa sdug mi thang ba la sdug pa ni/skyes nas myong 'gyur ram/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur la spyod pa'i rtags yin pas/ de'i phyir las 'bras la 'dzems dgos so//zhes gsungs so/ /des na dus rtag tu rgyu 'bras kyi gnas 'di la nges shes bskyed nas spang blang byed pa gal che/yang 'ga' zhig gis lta ba mtho mtho po'i chos skad kyis rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na//shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur//ji ltar sbrul la gzung nyes dang / /rig sngags nyes pas 183

dang bsam pa gnyis kyi nus pa yin pa lta bu'o/ /yang blo gzu bor gnas shing dge ba kho na byed pa la tshe 'dir nad na tsha dbul phongs dgras sdang ba sogs sdug bsngal myong ba yang /dge ba de'i 'bras bu ma yin gyi/ tshe rabs snga ma rnams su skyes nas dang / lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi mi dge ba bsags pa'i rnam smin/ dge ba stobs chen de'i mthus tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal tsam du zad par byas nas de phan chad sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i rtags yin par gsungs te/rdo rje gcod pa las/rab 'byor/gang dag 'di lta bu'i tshig len pa dang /'dzin pa dang 'chang ba sogs byed pa de dag ni mnar bar 'gyur/ shin tu mnar bar 'gyur ro//de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor/sems can de dag ni tshe rabs snga ma'i mi dge ba'i las ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba gang dag byas pa de dag tshe 'di la mnar bas/tshe rabs snga ma'i mi dge ba de dag byang bar 'gyur te sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas thub pa'i dgongs gsal las/ des na sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa skyid mi thang ba la skyid pa dang / bsod nams 'ba' zhig byed pa sdug mi thang ba la sdug pa ni/skyes nas myong 'gyur ram/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur la spyod pa'i rtags yin pas/ de'i phyir las 'bras la 'dzems dgos so//zhes gsungs so/ /des na dus rtag tu rgyu 'bras kyi gnas 'di la nges shes bskyed nas spang blang byed pa gal che/yang 'ga' zhig gis lta ba mtho mtho po'i chos skad kyis rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na//shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur//ji ltar sbrul la gzung nyes dang / /rig sngags nyes pas 183

sgrub pa bzhin//zhes dang /rin chen phreng ba las/chos 'di log par shes gyur na/ /mi mkhas rnams ni chud kyang za/ /'di ltar med par lta ba yi/ /mi gtsang der ni bying bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rma rgyan chen pos/ rgyal po chen po/ /nga'i gsang sngags 'di lta ba gtso che/lta ba'i phyogs su spyod pa ma shor bar mdzod//de shor na dge stong sdig stong nag po kha 'byams bdud kyi lta bar 'gro /yang spyod pa'i phyogs su lta ba ma shor bar mdzod/ de shor na dngos po dang mtshan mas bcings nas grol ba'i dus med/ ces gsungs/ des na lta ba nam mkha' bas mtho na//spyod pa bag gye bas zhib ces pa ltar/ lta ba gnas lugs stong pa nyid ji tsam rtogs bzhin las rgyu 'bras kyi spang blang la zhib tu 'gro zhing / de ltar ma rtogs shing las 'bras khyad gsod byed pa rnams la snying rje lhag par skye ba zhig dgos te/ de skad du byang chub sems 'grel las/ de ltar rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgoms byas na/ /blo ni gzhan don la dga' bar/ /'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med//ces dang /klu sgrub kyis kyang /gdod nas skye med rang bzhin 'di//blo yi gting nas rtogs gyur na/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying ba la/ /snying rje ngang gis skye bar 'gyur//zhes dang / pha dam pa rin po cher/ stong nyid rtogs na sdig pa byas na gnod dam mi gnod zhus pas/stong nyid rtogs na sdig pa bya don med/stong nyid rtogs pa dang snying rje skye ba dus mnyam gsungs la/ las bsags pa'i rnam smin 'phags pa dgra bcom pa la yang myong dgos na gzhan la lta ci smos te/de yang sngon 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mo gal gyi bu gnyis dmyal bar phebs pas/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'od sungs rdzogs byed dmyal bar skyes te sdug bsngal 184

mang po myong ba des na re/ nga yi slob ma rnams la/kun tu rgyu la dge stong med/ /dge sbyong shākya'i nang na yod/ /rang re rnams kyi chos lugs de phyin ci log tu 'dug pas/ khyed rnams kyis rang gi chos lugs de spongs la/ shākya'i sras kyi rjes su slobs shig /khyad par kho bo'i rus bu la mchod rten byas nas/ khyed rnams kyis de la phyag mchod bskor ba sogs byed pa'i dus su/ kho bo'i steng du lcags bsregs kyi char 'bab pa sogs sdug bsngal mang po 'dug pas/ de ltar ma byed gsungs shig zer 'phrin bskur ba de mo gal gyi bus mu stegs rnams la gsungs pas/ mu stegs rnams khros te 'dis rang cag la la zer ba ma tshad bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa la yang skur ba 'debs par 'dug pas/ 'di choms shig zer nas brdungs pas sku lus 'dam bu ltar bcom nas btang / khong dzu 'phrul dang mngon shes la thogs pa med kyang /de'i dus su sngar byas kyi las kyis non pas/rdzu 'phrul dran pa tsam yang ma byung ba yin/ de bzhin du dgra bcom mang po la las kyi rnam smin myong tshul yod kyang / yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris la/ rab tu byung ba rnams kyis kyang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrungs na/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin pa dang / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob byed kyi lam dang rgyu yin te/ rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ tshul khrims 'di ni bde ba'i mchog /tshul khrims 'di ni thar pa'i lam/ /tshul khrims 'di ni yon tan gzhi/ /tshul khrims 'di ni sangs rgyas rgyu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gal te tshul khrims ma bsrungs shing tshul khrims 'chal na dge slong gi pham lhag sogs sang ba sde lngas/ dmyal sanas rngams su rim bzhin skye ste sdug bsngal myong bar 'dul ba 185

sogs las gsungs la/ der ma zad bslab pa phra mo rtsa shing gcod pa'i nyung ba byung ba la yang / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus kyi dge slong zhig gis/dpral bar shing e la'i 'dab ma phog pas kho khros te/ bslab pa khyad du bsad nas shing de bcad pas/ kho shi nas klu e la'i 'dab ma zhes pa sbrul chen po dpag tshad mang por khyab pa mgo bdun yod pa mgo re re la shing e la'i sdong po chen po re skyes pa'i lcid kyis non zhing /rtsa ba 'bus g.yeng bas sdug bsngal chen po myong ba zhig tu skyes te/ ma 'ongs pa na byams mgon gyis chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus su de las thar dus lung ston par gsungs pas de lta bu'i bar du sdug bsngal myong dgos par gsungs la/ las brgya pa las/lus can rnams kyi bde sdug ni/ /las rnams yin par thub pas gsungs/ /las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las//de yis 'gro ba sna tshogs byas//sna tshogs rnam par 'khyam zhing 'jig /las kyi drwa ba 'di che'o//zhes dang / mdzod las/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ da lta bde sdug gang yod pa thams cad ni/ skye ba snga ma'i dge sdig gi 'bras bu yin par 'dug /da lta dge sdig che phra gang byas pa thams cad ni bor zags med par/ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/de 'dra ba yi 'bras bu skye ba phyi ma la rang nyid gcig bus myong dgos par 'dug la/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin ni de lta bur 'dug dal 'byor rnyed dka' la/ rnyed pa de yang tshe thung la nam 'chi cha med yin pa ni de lta bur 'dug /las dge sdig de dag gi 'bras bu bde sdug gi rnam smin myong tshul dang bcas pa ni de lta bur 'dug na/ da res dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i 186

dus 'di la/ dge ba yang dag pa zhig bsgrubs te/ dal 'byor la snying po lon pa zhig bya dgos la/ de la yang 'phral gyi spyod lam mjos mdzes dang / chos spyod dang thos bsam sogs la brtson pa lta bur 'dug kyang / spyod 'jug las/ lus dang sems kyi gnas skabs la//yang nas yang du brtag bya ba//'di nyid kho na mdor na ni//shes bzhin srung ba'i mtshan nyid do//zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i rang gi kun slong dang kun spyod la brtags pas/ tshe 'di'i rnyed dang grags pa 'dod pa dang / gzhan dad phyir mig sngar mdzes su re ba sogs chags snang rmongs pa'i dbang du song 'dug na/ de shes par byas nas/ bdag gi chos ltar snang ba 'di ni nyon mongs kyi gnyen por ma song / gnyen po spang bya'i kha zhabs su song /chos spyod bsrung byar shor/ sman ma zhu dug tu song ba lta bu kha gzugs chos su rloms pa 'di lta bu ni/ rin chen gling du slebs nas dug gi sdong po khyer 'ong ba ltar rang phung du 'gro ba 'dug par bsams te rnam pa thams cad du mi dge ba rnams spong zhing / lung ma bstan du 'dug na yang dge bar bsgyur nas bdud las kyi dbang du ma song ba zhig bya/ dus rtag tu dran shes dang ldan pas sdig pa'i las phra mo tsam yang mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pas spangs/ dge ba'i las phra mo tshun chod dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas ci nus su bsgrub/tho rangs gnyid sad 'phral ngas mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du dkar po dge ba'i las bsgrub/nag po sdig pa'i las ci nus su spang bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed/ nub mo nyal khar yang /'jam mthon bla mas/ thub pa'i dgongs gsal du/ nyal pa'i tshe 187

nyin par cing ba byung ma byung brtags/ ma byung na dga' ba bsgom/de'i dge ba sangs rgyas su bsngo/ /byung na rang gi sems la khrel ded 'gyod pa bskyed de phyi bshol mi bya/nyes pa ma dag par mi nyal/ dngas par ldang ba na'ang de bzhin du byas la nyes pa ma bshags par zas mi za ba la bslab par bya ste/ legs par grub pa las/nyin par bag med byas pa dag/mtshan mor so sor bshags par bya//nub mor byas pa nangs par bshags//legs par byas la mngon dga' bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gsungs so//de ltar dge sdig so sor shes te blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa zhig bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / las 'bras mi shes shing phyin ci log tu spyod pa rnams la snying rje bsgom zhing de dag rnams kyang las 'bras shes shing blang dor byed pa la sbyar nas mthar sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed dang / de dag gi dge rtsa 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyi ngang nas/ ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab par bya'o//de lta bu'i las 'bras la yid ches nas blang dor tshul bzhin spyod na 'jig rten yang dag lta ba rgyud la ldan pas ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste/ ār+ya de was/ 'jig rten pa yi yang dag lta//chen po gang la yod gyur pa//de ni bskal pa stong du yang / /ngan 'gror 'gro ba mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs so//las 'bras shes pas yang dag lta bar nges/ /nges 'byung bsam pas blang dor thar pa'i lam/ /lam de sems bskyed ldan pas sangs rgyas lam//lam de rgyud la skyed mdzod bla ma mkhyen//dkar nag las 'bras ston pa'i khrid do// 188

lnga pa/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems/lnga pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir byams dang snying rje byang sems bsgom pa'i khrid la/ 'o na 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du 'dug pas/ de spangs nas nyan rang gi lam gyis phung po lhag med kyi myang 'das thob na bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du/ sdug bsngal gtan med du 'dug pas de don du gnyer dgos sam zhe na/ de ni ma yin te thog med nas ma drin can du gyur pa'i sems can rnams yal bar dor nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don du gnyer ba ni/ma chus khyer ba mthong zhing de gdon pa'i thabs yod bzhin mi 'don par rang nyid skam sa na yid bde bar gnas pa ltar/ drin ma shes pas rang ngo tsha zhing gzhan gyis khrel ba'i gnas su 'gyur te/ slob spring las/ nye du 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang du chud gyur pa/ /klong gi nang du lhung ba lta bur snang bzhin du/ /skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /gal te gcig thar byed na de las khrel bor med//ces dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pas/ bdag gcig pu thar pas phan pa med//khams gsum gyi sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le//zhes gsungs so/ /de lta mod kyi sems can gzhan las rang nyid gces pa'i phyir nam 'chi cha med kyi dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i skabs 'dir rang nyid 'khor ba las thar ba'i thabs la 'bad par rigs so zhi na/ de yang ma yin te/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs 189

rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs/ gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung / bzo nyes pa 'chos dka' ba ltar mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du 'gor bas/ blo gros can gyis don du gnyer bya ma yin pa'i phyir dang / dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa 'di la snying po mchog tu gyur pa blang du yod bzhin du de dor nas/dman pa len pa ni ches blun pa yin te/ sher phyin bsdus pa las/ 'jig rten don sgrub tshul la mthu med pa'i/ /theg pa gnyis po gtan du spangs byas shing / /thub rgyal theg pa snying rjes bstan pa la//gzhan phan ro gcig rang bzhin de dag 'jug /ces gsungs so//gal te theg chen lam sgrub par dka'o snyam na//theg chen gyi lam ni sgrub dka' ba ma yin te/ theg pa bde zhing gzhan don la zhugs pas rang don ma tshang ba med pa zhar byung du 'grub pa'i lam mchog tu gyur pa yin te/spyod 'jug las/'di ni byang chub sems stobs kyis/ /sngon gyi sdig pa zad byed cing / /bsod nams rgya mtsho sdud byed phyir/ /nyan thos rnams las mchog tu bshad/ /de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rtar zhon nas//bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la//sems shes su zhig sgrid lug 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ der ma zad sems can rnams ni lam sgrub pa'i grogs yin pa'i phyir te/ sems can bde ba dang bral ba ni byams pa skye ba'i grogs/ sdug bsngal can ni snying rje skye ba'i grogs/ phongs pa ni sbyin pa gtong ba'i grogs/ gnod byed ni bzod pa sgom pa'i grogs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na rgyal ba rnams lam ston pa po yin pa ltar/ sems can rnams byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs yin pas sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar gus pas bsnyen bkur sogs sems can gyi don bya dgos tshe/ 190

spyod 'jug las/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba las/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ /rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ /zhes gsungs/ des na sems can thams cad la ma yis bu bzhin du byams snying rje sogs bsgom par bya dgos so/ /de la gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i byams pa bsgom/gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod snying rje bsgom/gzhan phyir sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i byang sems bsgom pa'o/ /de la theg chen gyi 'jug sgo sems bskyed yin yang / byang chub kyi sems bcos min snying rje la brten nas skye la/ de'ang mdo sde rgyan las/ snying rje'i chu ba byams pa ste/ /zhes pas byams pa'i sems rnal ma zhig rgyud la skye dgos pas/ des na dang po byams pa bsgom pa la 'bad par bya ste/ de la byams pa bsgom pa'i phan yon ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig mchod rdzas kyis bkang ste sangs rgyas rnams la nyin re bzhin phul ba bas/sems can la yud tsam gyi byams pa bsgom pa phan yon che ste/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/bye ba khrag khrig gtams pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa'i rnam pa dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la nyin re rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems la grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces gsungs so/ /byams pa'i ngo bo ni/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par 'dod pa ste/ slob dpon zla bas/ 'gro la phan pa nyer bsgrub pa//byams pa chen po zhes byar brjod//ces so//de bsgom pa la yang /dang po skye sla ba gnyen la byams pa bsgom/ bar du skye dka' ba dgra la bsgom/ tha mar sems can kun la byams pa bsgom pa'o//de'i dang po la/ma la byams pa bsgom/de gnyen gzhan 191

la bsre/de dang tha mal pa bsre ba'o//dang po ma la bsgom pa la'ang /mar shes pa/drin dran pa/drin lan 'jal 'dod pa'i byams pa bsgom pa'o//dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de gson nam shi'ang rung / lus bong dbyibs kha dog rgyan cha lugs sogs ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms la/ bdag la brtse zhing gdung ba'i spyod lam ji ltar gnas pa de yid la bcag pa'i sgo nas/'di bdag gi drin can gyi ma yin zhes drag tu bsam mo/ /gnyis pa drin dran pa la/ lus srog byin pa'i drin/ blang dor bstan pa'i drin/ dka' ba spyad pa'i drin no/ /dang po ni 'dis bdag zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar du mngal du bzung / phan pa'i zas spyod bsten/ gnod pa'i zas spyod spangs nas/ dal 'byor gyi lus 'di bskyed pas drin che zhes bsam/srog byin pa'i drin ni/phyir btsas nas kyang /lus kha lag mi 'phrod/ sems kyis blang dor mi shes pa'i 'bu lta bu de shir ma bcug par brtse ba'i sems kyis bskyangs/byams pa'i mig gis bltas/snyan pa'i ming nas bos/zas khas snyod/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/lus kyi drod kyis bsros/mngar ba'i nu zho byin/ me chu g.yang gsum las baspungs/tsha grang gi gnod pa las bskyabs/skad cig kyang 'bral mi phod par snying gi dum bu phyir rgyung ba ltar/ gces par bskyangs pa'i drin can gyi ma yin snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa ni za lugs 'thung lugs mi shes pa la za lugs 'thung lugs bslabs/ 'gro sdod mi shes pa la 'gro lugs sdod lugs bslabs/ smra brjod mi shes pa la smra brjod bslabs/ dngos po phra rags thams cad kyi brda don sprad de blang dor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i drin can yin snyam du bsam/ gsum pa ni ma rang nyid yal bar dor nas 192

bdag na yi dogs/shi yi dogs/gzhan dang ma mnyam dogs/mo rtsis sman dpyad rim gro sogs brjod kyis mi langs par byas/bdag gi ched du nyin dal rgyu med/mtshan gnyid rgyu med par rkang lag ser kur song song las byas/ rang gis za ma nus/ gzhan la ster ma nus/ phyi ma'i ched du gtong ma nus pa'i zas rnar longs spyod thams cad bdag la ster ba la phangs pa cung zad kyang med pa'i steng du ma rang gi 'dod pa grub pa'i lugs su byed/ bsam rgyu bsgom rgyu de bdag min pa med par/ rang las kyang gces par bskyangs pa'i drin can gyi ma yin/ der ma zad sems can gyi khams na dkon mchog gi sgra thos pa yang dkon la/ rang gis byung na tshe 'dir lus bde/ bar dor sems bde/ phyi mar lam bde/ rnam pa thams cad du bde nas bde bar 'gro chog pa'i dam pa'i chos bsgrub rgyu yod pa 'di ma 'di yi drin yin/ tshe 'dir kho nar ma zad 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du ma yang yang byas shing / byas res kyis 'di lta bu'i drin gyis bskyangs pa la tshad med/ phongs par skyes te lto gos gzhan nas slong nas byin pa la yang tshad med/nya shan du skyes nas sdig zas kyis gsos pa la yang tshad med/dud 'gror skyes nas gzhan gyi gnod pa bsrung ba'i phyir rang nyid shi ba la yang tshad med/ nu zho byin pa la yang tshad med/ de bzhin du pha byas nas zas nor longs spyod byin pa la yang tshad med/spun zla dang nye 'brel byas nas shin tu yid gcugs shing snying nye ba'i sgo nas phan btags pa la tshad med/de la sogs pa pha ma'i drin mtha' dag bskal pa'i bar du brjod kyang ga la rdzogs te/ de skad du/gang gis bdag gi ma byas nas/ /nu zho 'thung ba gang yin pa/ /rgya mtsho bzhi yi chu 193

la yang / /de yi tshad tsam yod ma yin/ /gang gis bdag gi pha byas nas//rta dang glang po byin pa yang //tshangs pa'i 'jig rten las kyang thal//rkang 'gro gzhan yang de bzhin no//zhes so//gsum pa drin lan 'jal 'dod bsam pa ni/de ltar drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i ma 'di la drin lan tu drin ma bcal/phan lan tu phan ma btags na bdag las khrel bor ba med de/ mi gang drin du mi gzo ba//de ni skyes bu tha shal yin//zhes pa ltar yin pas/ des na ma 'di la drin lan du drin dang phan lan du phan 'jal ci thub cig dgos/ma la gang gis phan na/ bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang ldan na phan par 'dug pa la da lta de dang bral nas 'dug des na bdag gi ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ de la 'god par bya snyam pa sems bskyed dang 'brel ba/ de ltar gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba ste de gsum blo la gang 'thad lan grangs mang du bsgom/ mthar ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu la 'god pa'i nus pa bdag la med/ su la yod na bla ma dang dkon mchog la yod pas/ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer na ra mda' gzhan la 'bod pa ltar drin can gyi ma 'di lus sems bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang ldan pa zhig bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen zhes gsol ba btab cing bsgoms pas ma la byams pa bcos min skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa de dang gnyen bsre ba ni/ pha la sogs pa'i nye 'brel drin che ba rnams rim pa bzhin mdun du bsams/ de dag so so'i drin dran pa'i sgo nas tshe 'dir dngos su drin 'di dang 'di lta bus bskyangs/ tshe rabs gzhan du'ang pha ma yang yang byas nas 194

phan btags/gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can sha stag yin snyam du bsams/de la drin lan 'jal 'dod la sogs pa snga ma bzhin sbyar te rtsa ba'i ma dang khyad par med pa'i byams pa skyes kyi bar du bsgom/ gsum pa de dang skye bo tha mal pa bsre ba ni/ yul mi khyim mtshes la sogs pa rang dang zas nor gyi 'brel pa yod pa rnams mdun du bsams la/ dngos su 'di lta bu'i 'brel ba'i sgo nas phan btags/ brgyud nas tshe rabs mang po'i pha ma byas tshul sogs sngar bzhin sbyar te bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa dgra la byams pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang la gnod pa byed pa'i dgra dang gdon la sogs pa zhe sdang skye ba'i yul de mdun du bsams la 'di bdag gi tshe rabs mang po'i ma yin/ ma yang lan grangs du ma'i bar du byas/ byas res kyis phan btags shing gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can yin yang / rang gis drin lan du drin ma thengs/ phan lan du phan ma btags pas tshe rabs snga ma'i lan chags 'ded pa la dgra 'drer go ba yin/ rang cag gnyis ka las nyon gyis bsgribs nas skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes par phan tshun gnod bya gnod byed du mthong nas sems zhe sdang gis bslad de rang dbang med par gnod pa skyel res byas pas je 'gyangs su song ba yin gyi don la yid shin tu nye ba'i pha ma yin te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma//sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang //smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med//mi dge'i las kyis mnar med 'gyur//zhes gsungs/des na dgra 'dis tshe rabs mang por phan btags par ma zad da lta yang rang nga rgyal dang rlom sems sogs kyis rgyud khengs nas dmu spyod dang tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs byed 195

pa'i skabs 'dir/ nga rgyal bcag nas chos la skul ba'i grogs byas pas drin chen yin zhes gzu lum tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas drin lan 'jal 'dod bskyed de/ gnod byed du snang ba'i drin can ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba dang ldan na zhes sogs ma ltar bsgom mo//de skad du/dgra'am 'od te mdza' yang rung / /nyon mongs skye ba'i yul rnams la//dge bshes yin par sus mthong ba//de ni gang na gnas kyang bde/ /zhes so/ gsum pa tha mar sems can kun la byams pa bsgom pa ni/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad kyang bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med/ pha ma yang lan grangs du mar byas/ byas res kyis phan btags gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can yin yang las nyon gyis sems bsgribs nas skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa la brten / da lta ci yang mi 'ong ba ltar 'dzin pa ni ma legs/ de bas na drin lan 'jal 'dod bskyed de ma rgan sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na zhes sogs sngar ltar dang res 'ga' dmyal ba nas brtsams te rigs drug sde tshan so sor bcad la ma rgan dmyal ba pa 'di rnams bde ba dang zhes sogs sngar ltar bsgom mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pas mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad la phan par 'dod pa'i blo bcos min skyes na byams pa 'byongs pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpas sems can la//bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin/ /rkang gi khong nas byams pa che//de ltas rtag phan byed par 'dod//ces so/ /des na sems can su la yang khong khro spangs la mas bu mthong ba lta bu'i byams pa dang / 'jigs pas 196

nyen pa rnams la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang /srog skyabs pa la sogs pa'i grogs bya/ phongs pa dang mgon med pa rnams la zas gos dang gnas mal la sogs pas phan gdags/'jam zhing snyan pa'i gtam gyis dbugs dbyung /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa rnams la yang rna bar sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs sngags sgrogs pa la sogs pa bya/ mdor na theg chen chos kyi rtsa ba byams pa yin zhing / byams pa skyes na snying rje skye sla bas byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la nan tan du bya'o/ /gnyis pa gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsal 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pa la/dang po snying rje bsgom pa'i phan yod ni/chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/spyan ras gzigs kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas chos mang po la bslab par mi bgyid do/ /chos gcig la bslab par bgyi'o//de gang zhe na/snying rje chen po'o//bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o//bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchis pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ des na theg chen gyi lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin te/ rgyan las/ dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan//'di ni snying rje'i sngon shin chen po yin/ /rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na//dka' spyad bzod pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snying rje chen po yon tan 'byung gnas kyis/ /sems can rnams la snying rje su mi byed/ /'di ltar 'di dag la yang sdug bsngal yang //brtse bskyed bde ba gzhal du med pa 'byung //zhes dang /dpal ldan zla bas/gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo tog phun tshogs 'di'i/ /197
