sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du/ /longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod gyur pa/ /de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'grub pa la thog mtha' bar gsum snying rje gtso che ba sogs phan yon de lta bu dang ldan pa'i snying rje de ni zeg chen chos kyi nyams len thams cad kyi thog mar gal che ba yin te/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa'i mdo las/btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu/gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po mi zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ /btsun pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu 'di lta ste/ dper na dbugs phyi dang du rgyu ba ni mi yi srog gi dbang po'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po ni theg pa chen po yang dag par 'grub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba yin no//zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/ theg pa chen po gang zhig las/ /snying rje sngon btang spyod pa dang //ye shes dri ma med bshad pa//sems yod su zhig de la smod//ces gsungs/de lta bu'i snying rje'i ngo bo ni/dmigs pa sdug bsngal can gyi sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa ste/gā ya go ri'i mdo las/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa'i rtsom pa ni snying rje chen po'o//gnas ni sems can no//zhes dang / slob dpon zla bas kyang / /sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /thugs rje chen po'o zhes gsungs la//'di bsgom pa la gsum/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje bsgom pa'o/ /'di gsum la bka' bstan bcos las khyad par sna tshogs bshad kyang / dpal brtse ba chen po kun 198

dga' snying pos/ lam 'bras jo lcags ma las/ yul sems can sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams la sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa sems can la dmigs pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ma rig pa yin pas ma rig pa dang bral bar 'dod pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ sems can ngo bo nyid kyis yang dag par ma grub pa yin yang sems 'dzin pa dang bcas pa la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ni sgom mkhan gang zag su yang rung bas sems can la dmigs nas sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa ni snying rje dang po ste snying rje 'di tsam phyi rol pa la'ang yod srid la/ sgom mkhan gang zag des gang zag bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas zin par byas te yul sems can de ma rig pa dang bral bar 'dod pa ni chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ste/ skabs 'di yi ma rig pa ni chos kyi grags pas/ gti mug nyes pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /de yang sems can 'dzin pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bdag 'dzin de yin la/ snying rje de tsam theg dman la'ang yod srid/ sgom pa pos chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub par spros bral du shes pa'i lta bas zin par byas te chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral las ma 'das kyang / de ma rtogs te gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pas bden 'dzin yod med sogs 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal can gyi sems can rnams sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje ste/ 'di ni theg pa gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can zhes pa de yin pas shin tu gal che ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can//byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o//zhes dang / zhi ba 199

lhas bslab btus su yang / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can//bskyed pas bsam pa dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na snying rje gsum po phyi ma rnams snga ma'i nang tshan yin pas gcig tu dril nas bsgom yang chog mod/ las dang po pas bsgom bde ba'i phyir rim gyis bsgom ste/de la yang dang por skye sla ba gnyen la bsgom pa sogs sngar byams pa bsgom pa'i skabs bzhin shes par byas te/dang po rang gi ma de mdun du yod par bsams la/ drin yod tshul dang tshe rabs mang por ma byas tshul la sogs pa sngar bzhin bsams la ma 'di bdag gi don kho na bgyid pas rang nyid 'khor bar 'khyams shing mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal du mas nyam thag pa 'di snying re rje/ 'di la drin lan du drin dang phan lan du phan zhig 'jal dgos/ gang gis phan na/dngos su lus sems sdug bsngal ba dang bral/brgyud nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral na phan par 'dug pa la/ da lta de las go ldog nas dngos su sdug bsngal la longs spyod/brgyud nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs sbyod pa 'di snying re rje/ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba la 'god par bya'o snyam pa sems bskyed dang 'brel ba/sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba ste gsum gang mang dang / yang rang gi mdun mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog mngon sum du bzhugs yod par bsams la ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba gang mang bsgom/200

lhas bslab btus su yang / stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can//bskyed pas bsam pa dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na snying rje gsum po phyi ma rnams snga ma'i nang tshan yin pas gcig tu dril nas bsgom yang chog mod/ las dang po pas bsgom bde ba'i phyir rim gyis bsgom ste/de la yang dang por skye sla ba gnyen la bsgom pa sogs sngar byams pa bsgom pa'i skabs bzhin shes par byas te/dang po rang gi ma de mdun du yod par bsams la/ drin yod tshul dang tshe rabs mang por ma byas tshul la sogs pa sngar bzhin bsams la ma 'di bdag gi don kho na bgyid pas rang nyid 'khor bar 'khyams shing mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal du mas nyam thag pa 'di snying re rje/ 'di la drin lan du drin dang phan lan du phan zhig 'jal dgos/ gang gis phan na/dngos su lus sems sdug bsngal ba dang bral/brgyud nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral na phan par 'dug pa la/ da lta de las go ldog nas dngos su sdug bsngal la longs spyod/brgyud nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs sbyod pa 'di snying re rje/ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa 'dun pa dang 'brel ba/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba la 'god par bya'o snyam pa sems bskyed dang 'brel ba/sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa smon lam dang 'brel ba ste gsum gang mang dang / yang rang gi mdun mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog mngon sum du bzhugs yod par bsams la ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba gang mang bsgom/200

de bzhin du pha la sogs pa'i gnyen dang nye ring bar ma'i skye bo rnams dngos su sdug bsngal du mas nyam thag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba byed pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral na ci ma rung sogs sngar ltar bsgom/dgra rnams la 'dis bdag gi ma lan grangs du mar byas/ byas res kyis phan btags shing gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can yin/ da lta sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis ngo ma shes par bdag la gnod pa byed pa snying re rje/gnod byed du snang ba'i ma 'di sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral ba zhig byung na ci ma rung sogs dang / de bzhin du rigs drug sde tshan du bcad la dmyal ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal rang thog tu smin pa lta bu so so'i sdug bsngal dang bcas pa yid yul du byas la de rnams so so nas ma byas tshul/drin gyis bskyangs tshul/ drin las 'jal 'dod sogs snga ma'i rigs 'gres sbyar te sde tshan re re nas sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral bar 'dun sems smon lam gsol 'debs dang 'brel ba rnams yang yang bsgom/ de bzhin du chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ni/ sems can sdug bsngal ba ni bdag tu lta ba'i ma rig pas lan pa yin pas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyu bdag tu lta ba'i ma rig pa dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa sogs sngar bzhin bsgom/ dmigs med kyi snying rje ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid spros bral du rtogs pa'i lta ba la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag lta ba de'i ngang nas gnas lugs ma rtogs par sdug bsngal 'di myong ba snying re rje snyam pas/ sems can 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang / de'i rgyu bdag 'dzin dang de'i rtsa ba ma rig 201

pas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs la rmongs pa dang bcas pa thams cad bral bar 'dun sems sogs gsol 'debs kyi bar drag tu brjod cing bsgom dgos te/rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /thog med brtse bas bskyangs pa yi//drin can rnams la snying rje bsam/ /sngon tshe yang yang phan btags kyang / /smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med//mi dge'i las kyis mnar med 'gyur//de ltar shes na sems can la//snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur pa yin//zhes gsungs/ lta ba de shes shing goms 'dris yod pa'i gang zag gis lta ba des zin pa'i snying rje ni/ yul sems can la dmigs pas snying rje dang po tshang / gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pas gnyis pa'ang tshang / chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pas gsum pa dngos yin pa'i gnad kyis gsum ka gcig tu dril nas bsgom par 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang dbang yod dang shan pa sogs sdig pa stobs chen byed pa rnams dang / gdon la sogs pas sems 'khrul pa'i dbang du gyur pa rnams dang / sdug phongs dang nad pa dang / mgon med pa rnams la ched du gtad de bsgom pa dang mthar sems can thams cad la spyi khyab tu snying rje rgyun chags su bsgom par bya dgos la/ gzhan yang / dpal sprul rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ khyad par rang la brten pa'i phyugs lug dang mdzo rta dre'u sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang dka' las la bltas nas snying rje bsgom/ de yang da lta rang re rnams nas rang gi sgo phyugs kyi dud 'gro rnams la sna 'bigs pa dang /bya gcod pa/ spu btog pa/ gson khrag 'byin pa sogs dmyal ba dang 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal du ma la gtad nas/ de dag la sdug bsngal yod snyam pa'i snang ba tsam yang mi 202

byed par 'dug pa 'di/legs par brtags na snying rje ma bsgoms pa'i skyon yin/legs pa brtags na da lta rang gi skra nyag ma gcig 'then nas btog na a tsha tsha zer zhing bzod mi nus pa lta bu'i zug ju yod/ de bzhin du gnag phyugs rnams lus kyi rtsid pa ci yod thams cad gcus phud brgyab nas shed kyis 'then shul dmar rjen du phud/ spu nyag ma re re'i shul nas khrag thigs pa re 'bab/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal mi bzod par 'khun bu byed kyang de la sdug bsngal yod snyam pa mi byed par/ rang gi lag pa chu bur du song ba la mi bzod pa skye/ de bzhin du rta khal sogs zhon nas 'gro ba'i tshe yang rang gi 'phongs na nas sga thog tu sdod mi nus par gzur te sdod dgos skabs kyang / rta khal de la na tsha dka' las sam sdug bsngal cung zad kyang yod snyam pa mi byed/cis kyang 'gro mi nus par 'u thug gom jugs pa'i skabs/ da rung yang 'dis ngan gshis byas nas mi 'gro ba yin snyam ste/ zhe sdang langs nas rdeg btsog byed pa las de la sha tsha skad cig kyang mi skye/ khyad par bsha' lug sogs gsod pa'i skabs/ dang po mang po'i khyu nas bzung ba'i tshe/ de la 'jigs skrag gi snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas/deng po gang du bzung sa der sha la khrag tshom 'byung /de rjes lus gnam sa bsgyur/yan lag 'breng pas bkyigs/ mchu tha gus dkris/ dbugs phyi nang gi rgyu 'grul bcad de gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dos drag po myong ba'i skabs su yang da dung cung zad 'chi ba 'gor na shan pa las ngan phal cher zhe sdang langs nas 'di la 'chi rgyu mi 'dug zer te brdung rdeg sogs byed/ shi ma thag de'i pags pa bshus dang lto phyung / de ma thag gnag phyugs gzhan zhig la zungs khrag bton 203

te/ de yang lus gom tshugs mi thub par 'khyor ro ro 'gro ba zhig byas/shi khrag dang gson khrag gnyis bsres pas sngar bsad pa de'i dang lto g.yos pa za phod pa 'di las kyi srin po dngos su 'dug /da legs par bsam na dud 'gro de dag rnams kyi sdug bsngal la bltas nas/ de rang yin par bsgoms na ci 'dra zhig 'dug /rang gi mchu lag pas bkab nas dbugs bgags te cung zad sdod dang /de la na tsha dang 'jigs skrag ci lta bu zhig 'dug /de ltar legs par brtags nas/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal drag po la 'khor mor spyod pa'i sems can de thams cad snying re rje/ de thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs de dag las skyob pa'i nus pa bdag la yod na ci ma rung snyam du yang dang yang du bsgom/khyad par byams pa dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma ser mo ba rnams yin dgos pa las/ bla ma dang ser mo ba rnams la byams pa dang snying rje spu tsam yang med par sems can sdug la gtad pa khyim pa rnams las kyang thu ba 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' la thug ste/ sha za dang srin po mchod gnas su byed pa'i skabs la babs pa yin/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor te rab tu byung /'khor dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil bsnams te zhabs thang du bsod snyoms la phebs pa las/ rta khal dang dre'u sogs yod pa lta ci/ bcom ldan 'das nyid la chibs pa zhig kyang chibs rgyu med pa de/ sems can sdug la gtad pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs min par dbongs nas ma chibs pa yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das thabs rdugs nas rta rgan 204

zhig chibs rgyu ma rnyed pa ga la yin/ da lta rang re'i ser mo ba noms grong chog sogs la 'byon skabs rta rgan sogs chibs/ rta dre'u g.yag sogs khal bkal nas 'byon dus kyang rta khal de dag la rang yin pa'i blo zhig bzhag rang gi rgyab tu mi theg pa'i khur chen po zhig bskur/ sna thag pas drangs/ kha lcags srab kyis drangs/ 'phongs lcag gis brab/ rtsib ma yob chen gyis bcom pas mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon thams cad na zug tsha zug gi ngang la skad cig tsam yang ngal gso long med par gyen mthon po la 'jogs/ thur gzar mo la babs/chu chen po la 'bog /thang chen po la bgrod/ zas kham gcig kyang za long med par da nangs nam langs nas do dgong nyi ma dmar thag ma chod bar mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro dgos byung na/de la dka' tshegs dang ngal dub ci lta bu zhig yod/na tsha dang bkres skom ci lta bu zhig myong snyam nas sdug bsngal rang thog tu blangs na/snying rje drag po shas mi bzod pa zhig mi skye ba'i thabs med/ de bzhin du spyir bla ma dang ser mo ba zhes bya ba ris med pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang skyob pa mgon dang dpung gnyen yin pa la/ rang la bza' btung dang 'bul ba byed pa'i yon bdag de rang phyogs su bzung nas de la srungs shig dang skyobs shig zer zhing dbang bskur dang byin rlabs byed/las ngan gyi rgyus 'phangs pas lus ngan blangs pa'i yi dwags dang 'byung po gnod byed kyi 'dre de gzhan phyogs su bzung / de la zhe snang skyes te sod sod dang rgyob rgyob zer nas brdung deg gi stangs ka byed/lha 'dre gnod byed de gsod rgyu dang brdung rgyu zhig tu 'dzin pa de yang rang rgyud chags snang ri dbang du thor nas mnyam pa'i snying rje chen po ma 205

skyes pas lan/ de legs par brtags na yon bdag las kyang gnod byed de snying rje ste/ gnod byed kyi rtse 'dre de las ngan gyi rgyus 'phangs/ lus ngan yi dwags su skyes pas/ na tsha dang 'jigs skrag gi snang ba dpag tu med/ rtag tu bkres skom dang ngal dub kho na la spyod/ snang ba thams cad dogs par 'char/rgyud zhe sdang dang gdug rtsub che bas shi ma thag dmyal bar 'gro ba mang bas de las snying rje ba su yod/ yon bdag de la na tsha dang zug ju skyes kyang des las ngan 'dzad pa ma gtogs las ngan mi gsog /gnod byed des bsam ngan gyis gzhan la gnod pa byas pas las ngan gyi rgyus ngan song gi gting du 'phen pa yin/ des na rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas drag shul dang mngon spyod kyi las kyis lha 'dre bskrad pa dang bsdigs pa sogs gsungs pa de yang lha 'dre de kho rang snying rje bas/ dper na byis pa chung ngu nyan du ma btub pa la mas rdung rdeg byed pa lta bu dang / sdig pa dang mi dge ba kho na la longs spyod pa'i sems can de las ngan gyi rgyun bcad nas rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du 'phen nus na bsgral las byed pa sogs gnang ba yin gyi/ yon bdag dang grwa 'khor sogs rang phyogs su bzung nas de la chags/ lha 'dre dang gnod byed ni gzhan phyogs su bzung nas de la sdang / chags snang gi dbang gis rang phyogs sung ba dang gzhan phyogs rdung ba'i thabs rgyal bas gsungs pa ga la yin/ de lta bu'i chags sdang gi blo dang ldan phyin lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can de dag bskrad pa dang brdung ba sogs byas kyang nyan du mi btub cing slar rang la gnod pa byed do/ /zhes gsungs so//gsum pa gzhan phyir sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i byang sems bsgom 206

pa ni/'o na sdig pa spang zhing dge ba sgrub pa dang /gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang / gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel 'dod kyi snying rje bsgom pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ram zhe na/ de dag ni bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su 'gro ba yin gyi byang chub kyi sems rin po che med na ni theg chen du yang mi 'gyur la/ theg chen ni mdo sngags gnyis su nges te/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ yang na pha rol phyin pa yi/ /mdo las ji ltar 'byung bzhin gyis/ /yang na rdo rje theg pa yi//rgyud sde bzhin du nyams su longs//'di gnyis min pa'i theg chen ni//sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa med//ces gsungs la// dge sdig blang dor byed pa byams snying rje stong nyid sgom pa sogs nyan rang sogs la yod kyang byang chub kyi sems dang / de'i bslab bya sogs med pas theg chen byang sems su mi 'gyur te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ nyan thos theg pa de las ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam dang / /spyod pa yongs bsngo ma bshad des/ /byang chub sems dpar ga la 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/byang chub sems bskyed rgyud la skyes ma thag ming don gnas 'gyur te rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' zhes 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag mchod kyi 'os su 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams//bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur//zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las kyang //bdag nyid dang ni 'jig rten 'dis//bla med byang chub thob 'dod na//de yi rtsa ba byang chub sems//ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan dang //zhes dang /dbu ma 'jug pa las/207

byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu//zhes gsungs/des na byang chub sems bskyed rgyud la ma skyes na gzhan gang gis kyang sangs rgyas thob byed theg chen du mi 'gyur te/sa paṇa gyis/de phyir pha rol phyin pa la//sems bskyed min pa'i chos gzhan med//ces gsungs/khyad par gsangs sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas brjod la 'bad rtsol ji ltar byas kyang byang chub sems bskyed rnam dag cig rgyud la ma skyes na sngags sdom skye dang gnas pa'i rten du yang mi rung la/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur rnam pa kun tu mi 'gyur te/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/'jam dpal/ gang dag byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la zhugs pa dang /gang gi tshe bdag gis byang chub kyi sems 'grub par gyur pa de yi tshe/ 'jam dpal/byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa gsang sngags kyi sgo spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ye shes chen por dbang bskur pa'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya yi/ gang dag byang chub kyi sems rdzogs par ma gyur pa de dag ni gzhug par mi bya ste/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor yang bltar mi gzhug go /de dag la ni phyag rgya dang gsang sngags kyang bstan par mi bya'o//zhes gsungs la/ rtsa rgyud las/byang chub sems kyis rnam par sbyang / /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ bdag gis byang chub thob bya'i phyir//gang phyir gzhan dag bsgral bya'i phyir//byang chub tu ni sems bskyed pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge 'dun gyi yang bstan pa yin//zhes gsungs so//yang byang sems nyams pa sngags kyi rtsa cing lnga par 'gyur zhing byang sdom yang gtong ste/ sdom gsum las/ spyir na byang sdom gtong bas sngags sdom yang / /gtong ste snga ma'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs la/208

dpal sprul rin po ches/ /gal te bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin yod na yang / /yang dag byang chub sems dang ma 'brel na/ /'khrul snang 'khor bar skye ba'i sa bon las//rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob la mi phan no//zhes dang /byang chub sems kyi man ngag mi ldan par//snyigs dus 'di na sngags par zlokha pa phal/ kha chos mthon pos nam mkha' 'gengs bgyid mod//ji tsam bzang yang 'byung po'i chos lugs yin//zhes dang /nges 'byung byang sems chos kyi rtsa bas//rang rgyud 'dul ba yal bar bor nas//sngags spyod tho co'i mi mgo bskor bskor//phyi ma'i 'bras bu dam sri rgyal 'gong / /bskyed rdzogs med pa'i mnan bsregs 'phang gsum//ngag nus med pa'i mthu gtad byad gsum//dpa' dpung med pa'i dme 'khrug gyod gsum/ /dus ngan 'bod pa'i g.yab mor 'dug go/zhes gsungs so//des na byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon/ dam chos thams cad kyi nying khu/ mdza' bshes kun gyi mchog /dge ba kun gyi nang nas sangs rgyas thob byed kho na yin pas mchog yin te/sdong po bkod pa las/rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes dang /spyod 'jug las/dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las//mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin/ /zhes dang / de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod//de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod//bsod nams de 'dra'ang ga la yod//ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sems bskyed de la dbye na/ dpe grogs kyi sgo nas dbye na dpe sa lta bu nas sprin lta bu'i bar nyer gnyis yod de/ rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ zhes sogs gsungs la/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na bzhi yod de/mdo sde rgyan la/ sems 209

bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spang ba'o//zhes so/ /blo stobs kyi sgo nas dbye na gsum ste/ thog mar rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas nas/de'i rjes su sems can thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa rgyal po lta bu ni 'dod chen pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste blo stobs tha ma yin/yang rang dang sems can thams cad lhan cig tu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa mnyan pa lta bu ni ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste blo stobs 'bring po dper na rje btsun byams pa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin par gsungs/ yang sngon la khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod nas/ phyi nas rang nyid 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa rdzi bo lta bu ni dpe med pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ shin tu blo stobs chen po dang ldan pa dper na rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs lta bu'i sems bskyed yin par gsungs pa yin/ sems bskyed rang gi ngo bos dbye na kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis yod/ de gnyis las dang po slob dpon gzhan las yang dag blangs pa brda las byung ba kun rdzob sems bskyed de/skye ba'i rgyu'i dbye ba ni/mdo sde rgyan las/grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs//thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba'i/ /gzhan gyi brtan pa'i sems bskyed 'dod/ /ces pa'i dang po ni mi brtan pa dang phyi ma bzhi ni brtan pa'i sems bskyed yin no/ /gnyis pa phra ba chos nyid rang gis rtogs pas thob pa'i don dam sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu ni/mdo rgyan las//rdzogs 210

pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ /chos la mi rtog ye shes ni//skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod//ces gsungs pa ltar yin la//de yang 'jam mgon bla mas/ don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba//bsgom pa'i stobs kyis skye mod kyi/ /cho ga'i sgo nas 'di mi skye//gal te cho gas skye na ni//brda las byung ba'i sems bskyed 'gyur//'di ni don dam chos nyid kyis//thob pa zhes bya'i sems bskyed yin//'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi//cho ga rgyal bas gsungs pa med//mkhas pa thams cad 'di mi mdzad//mdzad kyang cho gar mi 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ don dam sems bskyed cho gas mi skye mod/ kun rdzob sems bskyed ni/ byang sems kyi slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mdun nas cho ga rnam dag gi sgo nas len dgos la/ de la dbu ma'i lugs dang sems tsam pa'i lugs dang sngags kyi brgyud pa gnyis las 'byung ba dang gsum yod/ dang po ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bka' srol/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi rjes su 'brang ba phal po che las byung ba spyod 'jug gi lugs yin no/ /gnyis pa ni mgon po byams pa'i bka' srol slob dpon thogs med kyi rjes 'brang byang sa las 'byung ba sdom pa nyi shu pa'i lugs de yin/ gsum pa ni kye rdor dang bde mchog gi brgyud pa gnyis las 'byung zhing / lam 'bras pa'i bka' srol de yin no/ /de lta bu gang rung gi sgo nas thob pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed des zin pa'i dge rtsa phra mo'ang sangs rgyas thob byed du 'gyur zhing gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i dpe gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gi dpes bstan pa spyod 'jug gi lung ni sngar bstan zin pa ltar dang / rang rgyud du byang chub kyi sems 211

skyes na sdig pa chen po ji ltar yod kyang rnam smin sdug bsngal las skyob cing sdig pa 'joms nus pa dpa' bo dang dus mtha'i me'i dpes bstan pa ni spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang //dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar//gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur pa/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten//zhes dang /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa//de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis non par 'gyur//zhes dang / des ni dus mtha'i mes bzhin sdig chen rnams//skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed//ces gsungs/ dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang //gal te de la gzugs mchis na//nam mkha'i khams 'di kun gang ste/ /de bas kyang ni lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i phan yon dang ldan no/ /'on kyang la la rang la brtse ba can dang / rang gis bskyangs pa'i dud 'gro sogs la bsam bzang dang snying rje nas des mig chus brlan pa sogs byang sems su 'dod pa mang yang /de ni byang chub kyi sems ma yin te/dpal sprul rin po ches/bsam pa bzang dang snying rje phyogs re bas/ /gnas skabs mig chu g.yo ba sla ba phal/ /blun pos byang chub sems dpar sgro 'dogs kyang / /de 'dra byang chub sems mchog yin re gan/ /zhes gsungs/des na byang chub sems bskyed 'di legs par shes shing bsgom pa gal che bas/ de la smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ de dag gi bslab bya bstan pa'o//de la smon 'jug gnyis kyi khyad par ni spyod 'jug las/byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste//byang chub smon 212

pa'i sems dang ni//byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no//'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi//bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar//de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi//bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya//zhes pa ltar/dang po smon pa sems bskyed ni//rgyan las/sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir//yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod//ces pa ltar/ sngar bshad pa de ltar byams snying rje bsgoms pas sems can thams can bde ba rgyu 'bras dang 'phrad pa dang / sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bral bar 'dod pa'i blo bcos min skyes pa na/ de ltar 'god dgos kyang de'i nus pa bdag la mi 'dug /su la yod na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ni rdzogs//mkhyen pa'i spyan ras ni gsal/thugs brtse ba chen po mchog gi rlan dang ni ldan/ /skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa khong la mnga' bas/ bdag nyid kyi lus sems bde ba sogs khyad du bsad nas/ pha ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/de thob na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / thob nas kyang sems can thams cad gnas skabs su theg pa so so'i byang chub la bkod nas/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag par bya'o/ /zhes sgo gsum chig dril gyis ngag tu brjod cing yid la bsam par bya zhing /ngag 'don bsdus pa/sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o/ /zhes brgya stong sogs brjod la bsgom mo/ /de lta bu'i smon sems bskyed pa la yang phan yon dpag med yod de/spyod 'jug las/sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam//bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang //phan 'dogs bsam pa dang ldan te//bsod nams 213

dpag med ldan gyur na//sems can re re'i mi bde ba//dpag tu med pa bsal 'dod cing //re re'ang yon tan dpag med du//sgrub par 'dod la smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs/ /de la yang dbu sems sogs gang rung gi sems bskyed nges par thob dgos la/ ma thob pa'am thob kyang gong 'phel du 'gyur bas/ rten gyi drung nas sems bskyed len pa 'di ni gnad che'o/ /gnyis pa 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ /sems bskyed kyi rgyu sngar bstan pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad pha mar shes shing drin dran la/drin lan 'jal 'dod kyis de dag gi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du par phyin drug la bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed yin la/ de ltar gzhan don yid la bsam zhing sbyor bas zin pa de ni rang gzhan la phan bde mi zad pa'i byung gnas yin te/spyod 'jug las/'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa//de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung / /'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa//de kun rang bde 'dod las 'byung //mang du bshad lta ci zhig dgos/ /byis pa rang gi don byas dang / /thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par ltos//zhes gsungs pas so//des na 'jug pa sems bskyed bsgom pa la/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i byang sems bsgom pa dang / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems bsgom pa ste gnyis/ blo rim gyis sbyangs pa'i phyir thog mar bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa ni/ /dang po nyid du 'bad de bsgom//zhes pa ltar bsgom pa la/stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi smon sems la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag /bdag nyid pha ma sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i btson ra nas 'don par 214

dam bcas nas/de'i ched du sangs rgyas thob 'dod skyes pa tsam gyis mi chog /sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba'i lam 'khrul med cig rnyed dgos de'i lam gyi 'jug sgo bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang chub kyi sems 'di yin/bdag bde ba 'dod pa bzhin sems can du gtogs pa thams cad kyang bde ba 'dod pa sha stag yin pas dus da nas bzung ste/ sems can thams cad kyi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa dang / bdag sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa bzhin sems can du gtogs pa thams cad kyang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa sha stag yin pas/ dus da nas bzung ste sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar bgyi'o snyam du yun ring du bsgom dgos te/zhi ba lhas/ bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam pas na/ /thams cad bdag bzhin bsrung bar bya//zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i bsam sbyor gyi sgo nas gzhan phan ci nus bsgrubs pas rim gyis gzhan don rgya chen po 'byung ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ gzhan phan las la mthu med kyang //de yi bsam pa rtag tu bya//gang la bsam pa de yod pa//de ni de la don gyis zhugs//zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa ni/gal te bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i sems tsam la brten na byang chub 'grub par mi 'gyur ram zhe na/mi 'gyur te spyod 'jug las/bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na//sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing //'khor ba na yang bde ba med//ces so//des na myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya dgos te/de nyid las/gang zhig bdag dang gzhan rnams ni//myur du skyabs par 'dod pa des//bdag 215

dang gzhan du brje bya ba//gsang pa'i dam pa spyad par bya//zhes dang / sa paṇ+ḍi tas/byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya'i mchog/bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems//bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgom tshul snying por dril na/rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de nyid mdun du yod par bsams te/drin dran pa dang / drin lan 'jal 'dod rnams byams snying rje'i skabs ltar bsams/ ma 'di la gang gis gnod na//sdug bsngal gyis dngos su gnod/sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs pas brgyud nas gnod pas/ de dag bdag gis blang snyam du bsams la/ bdag gi drin can gyi ma 'di'i sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing /ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad skyi gris mgo spu bzhar ba bzhin du nag nyil gyis tshur byung ste/bdag gi snying gi dkyil du hril byung bar bsgom/ des rang rgyud la yod pa'i bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'gong po kho gzhi med rtsa bral la btang bar bsams/ yang ma la gang gis phan na bde bas dngos su 'phral du phan/ bde ba'i rgyu dge bas brgyud nas yun du phan par 'dug pas bdag gi bde dge thams cad ma la btang snyam pas/ bdag gi brgyud kyi bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dge ba thams cad ma la smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing / rang gi bde dge thams cad snying ga nas nyi ma shar ba bzhin du 'od lhag gis song nas ma la byin pas/ mas de dag la longs spyad de gnas skabs su lus sems bde zhing chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad 'dzoms nas dge ba 'phel te sangs rgyas par gyur song snyam du bsgom/de ltar byung na nga 216

re dga' snyam du yun ring du bsams/ de ltar yang yang bsgoms pas dmigs pa gsal bar gyur pa na/ de bzhin du rang gi pha dang spun zla la sogs pa gnyen gzhan dang / yul mi khyim mtshes la sogs pa rnams dang / rang nyid la tshe 'dir gnod pa byed kyi dgra bo gdon bgegs dang bcas pa rnams dang rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa rnams la yang ma la bsgom pa ji lta bar rim bzhin bsgom/gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu rang gi lus la na tsha'am sems la sdug bsngal drag po byung na de lam du bya ba'i phyir 'di ltar bsam ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pas/de thams cad snying re rje de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyis gtsos sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal tshur len pa dang / bdag gi bde dge de dag la smin nas de thams cad bde ba dang ldan par gyur song snyam pa dang / yang gdon sogs kyis gnod pa'i tshe'ang / gdon 'di tshe rabs thog med kyi mar bsams te gtong len sngar bzhin du bya/de bzhin dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dang /yi dwags bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal sogs rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal re re bzhin gtong len sngar bzhin bsgom/de yang klu sgrub kyi gsung /bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing //bdag dge ma lus der smin shog/ces sam zhi ba lhas/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gang ci'ang rung / /de kun bdag la smin gyur cig /byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro ba bde la spyod par shog /ces pa gang rung brjod cing tshig snga ma'i tshe len pa dang / phyi ma'i tshe gtong ba'i dmigs pa bsgoms te brgya stong la sogs brjod/ 'di rmi mgon po klu sgrub kyi man ngag ltar yin la/ yang 217

byams pa'i man ngag ltar bsgom pa ni byams pas/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa'i sems nyid dam/ /bdag bas gzhan ches sdug pa mthong nas ni/ /de ltar bdag pas gzhan don mchog tu gces/ /gzhan gyi don gang rang gi don gang yin//zhes pa ltar/ pha rol po'i nad gdon sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang /dmyal ba tsha grang gi sdug bsngal sogs yid la bsams te pha rol po'i sdug bsngal dngos su myong ba de rang gi sems thog tu tshur blangs te rang gi sems kyi sdug bsngal de ches lci bar bsam zhing / de lta bu'i sdug bsngal de bdag la smin zhing myong ste pha rol po bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig /de ltar gyur na ci ma rung snyam du bsam zhing / gzhan 'jig rten pa dag gis rang gi dgra la brtse ba med par gnod par byed pa de bas ches lhag par sems can gyi don du rang lus la gnod pa byed snyam pas sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal bar gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu brjod la sbyor bas kyang gzhan la phan na rang gi bde ba khyad du bsad de dga' bas sdug bsngal dang du len par bya dgos te/mdo rgyan las/gzhan don brtson ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid 'di/ /gang tshe mnar med la yang dgar 'dzin pa//de 'dra ba dag 'jig rten gzhan rten can//sdug bsngal 'byung ba rnams kyis ga la 'jigs/ /zhes dang / gang tshe snying rje'i bdag nyid gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag la sdug bsngal mi bzad 'jug pa rab byed pa/ /de ltar 'jig rten gdung ba'i las kyis gzhan dgra la'ang //shin tu brtse ba med pa rab tu 'jug ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pas gzhan sdug bsngal ba la blo mi bzod par mchi ma dku ba sogs bcos min byung na bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i 218

byang sems 'byongs pa yin no//mthar brje ba'i yul sems can dang / brje ba po rang nyid dang / brje bya bde sdug gces 'dzin dang bcas pa don dam pa'i gshis lugs la grub pa ci yang med mod/ kun rdzob tu sems 'khrul ba'i dbang gis med bzhin du snang ba 'di lta bu la longs spyod dgos pa snying rje snyam pa dang /brje yul gyi sems can 'di rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig snyam pa'i dge ba bsngo'o/ /de lta bu'i sems bskyed gzhan don gyi khur chen po khyer te rang ci bde bder 'jug pa ni/gzhan bslus shing rang ngo tsha dang khrel bor ba yin pas/ des na gzhan gyi don du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che la slob pa'i brtson pa ni/ nyan rang gis rang don la brtson pa las kyang brgya 'gyur du bya dgos te/mdo rgyan las/mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams dal gyis 'gro mi mdzes/ /bdag gzhan sna tshogs 'ching bas rab bcings pas//brtson pa brgya 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs//zhes so/ /bdag gzhan brje ba sogs gzhan don ma byas shing / rang don kho na byas pa'i skyon ni/zhi ba lhas/ yid khyod rang don byed 'dod pas/ /bskal pa grangs med 'das gyur kyang / /ngal ba chen po 'di lta bus//khyod kyi sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig bsgrubs/ /zhes dang / bdag nyid mtho bar 'dod pa des//ngan 'gro ngan dang glen par 'gyur//de nyid gzhan la spo byas na//bde 'gro rim gro thob par 'gyur//bdag gi don du gzhan bkol na//bran la sogs pa myong bar 'gyur//gzhan gyi don du bdag spyad na//rje dpon nyid sogs myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/mdor na nyes pa thams cad bdag gces 'dzin las byung ba yin pas 219

de la dgrar bltas nas gzhan gyi skyon thams cad de'i steng du blangs te bdag 'dzin gyi 'gong po 'dul ba dang / phan bde thams cad sems can la brten nas 'byung ba yin pas sems can thams cad pha mar shes nas bde dge thams cad de dag la btang ste sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god 'dod kyi blo 'di yod na tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa sogs dge ba ji snyed byas pa thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgyur 'gro zhing / de las gzhan du ni ji tsam mkhas bcun bzang gsum dang ldan zhing / dge bar brtson yang bdag gces 'dzin la gnyen po ma thongs pa'i chos kyis 'khor ba las 'phags mi nus pas/chos mjad rnams kyis gnad 'di gal che zhing /de ltar goms pa'i dbang gis rang la gces 'dzin gyi blo log ste gzhan don du 'gyur nges na mgo dang rkang lag gtong ba la yang ji snyam du mi sems pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs chen la slo ba nus pa 'byung zhing / de la brten nas myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur te/ zhi ba lhas/ de ltar nges pas gzhan dag gi /don la rab tu 'jug gyis dang / /thub pa'i bka' ni mi bslu bas/ /de yi yon tan phyis mthong 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/der ma zad bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems 'di sgom pa 'phyis pa'i skyon yang yod de tshe rabs sngon ma zhig tu bsgoms na deng sang sangs rgyas su zin nas bde ba kho na las sdug bsngal 'di lta bu mi 'byung ste/zhi ba lhas/gal te khyod kyis snga dus su/ /las 'di byas par gyur na ni/ /sangs rgyas phun tshogs bde min pa//'di 'dra'i gnas skabs srid mi 'gyur zhes gsungs des na bdag ga'an brje ba'i sems 'di lan re bskyed pa la yang phan yo na dpas tu chen pa yo da de/pa d+ma220

dkar po'i mdo las/ sngon ston pa 'di nyid so so'i skye bo 'ching ba kun ldan gyi dus su dmyal ba'i gnas su shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du gyur pa na des dmyal ba pa rnams la snying rje skyes nas 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal 'di bdag gis 'khur na ci ma rung zhes smras pas grogs po a wa zhes pas khyod spyi brtol re che zhes smras nas/ tho lum mgo bor bsnun te bsad nas snying rje chen po skyes pa'i stobs kyis dmyal gnas nas shi 'phos nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes so / /zhes gsungs so//gsum pa bslab bya ni/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa spyi la bslab pa/rang smin par byed pa phar phyin drug la bslab pa/ gzhan smin par byed pa bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab pa'i tshul lo//de dag kyang phyogs gcig tu brjod na rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa 'di dor nas bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa dang bcas pa thams cad sems can kun la gtong bar bgyi snyam du bsam zhing / ngag tu yang / lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /phangs pa med par gtang bar bya/ /zhes brjod cing bsams/ de ltar btang ba la brten nas sems can zas 'dod pa la zas/ skom 'dod pa la skom/ dbul zhing phongs pa rnams la mi zad pa'i gter/ nad pa rnams la sman dang nad g.yog /chos 'dod rnams la chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dam pa'i chos/ chu la brgal 'dod rnams la gru dang gzings zam pa/ lam zhugs rnams la ded dpon/mgon med pa rnams la mgon/ skyabs med pa rnams la skyabs/dpung gnyen med pa/ rnams la dpung gnyen sogs mdor na sems can so so'i mdun du gang 221

'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi dngos po zad mi shes par 'byung bar gyur cig snyam du bsams la/ de bzhin du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi tshogs chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir bdog pa'i dngos po gzhan la gtong ba sbyin pa/gzhan la gnod pa'i kha na ma tho ba spong ba tshul khrims/ gzhan gyi gnod pa la sems mi 'khrugs pa bzod pa/ dge ba la sems spro ba brtson 'grus/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa bsam gtan/ chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / zang zing gi sbyin pas chos kyi phyir 'khor du bsdu ba dang / snyan par smra bas pha rol mgu bar byas nas snod dang 'tshams pa'i chos bstan pa dang / chos bstan pa de nyams su len pa la thabs mkhas kyis 'jug pa don spyod pa dang / gzhan nyams len la gzhug pa'i ched du rang nyid kyang chos nyams su len pa la 'bad rtsol gyis 'jug pa don mthun pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bslab cing thugs nyams su bzhes pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang rang smin byed phar phyin drug dang / gzhan smin byed bsdu dngos bzhi la bslabs te/ sems can thams cad la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du bsams shing / de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i blo bskyed/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing dge ba bsngo zhing theg pa chen po'i smon lam btab bo/ /dus rgyun gyi nyams len 'di tsam gyis 'thus la/ rgyas par shes par 'dod na mdo dang / mdo sde rgyan/ rin chen phreng ba/ thub pa'i dgongs gsal rnams la blta bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa la/don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bshad/ de nyid rgyud la skyed pa'i thabs dngos 222

bshad/ thabs de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po phyi rol pas btags pa'i bdag dang /nyan thos sde gnyis kyis btags pa'i phung khams skye mched dang / sems tsam pas btags pa'i rnam rig bden par 'dod pa la sogs pa mthar 'dzin can gyi rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs ma bslad par 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas spros pa dang bral bar rtag tu gnas pa ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems//bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi/ /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pa'i//rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed//ces so/de nyid 'khor 'das bde sdug thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ /de'i kho na de nyid rtogs na chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyang gcig char du rtogs par 'gyur te/ mdo las/ dngos gcig dngos po kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /dngos kun dngos po gcig gi ngo bo nyid/ gang gi dngos gcig de bzhin nyid mthong ba//de yis dngos kun de bzhin nyid du mthong / /zhes dang / bzhi brgya pa las/ dngos po gcig gi lta po gang //de ni kun gyi lta por bshad//gcig gi stong nyid gang yin pa//de ni kun gyi stong pa nyid//ces so/ /gnyis pa de nyid rgyud la skyed pa'i thabs ni/ rten zhi gnas dang / brten pa lhag mthong gnyis te/ de yang zhi gnas ni sems gnas thabs la brten nas mtshan 'dzin gyi rnam rtog thams cad zhi ste sems kyi rang gdangs la 'jog cing gnas pa yin la/ lhag mthong ni gzung 'dzin gyi sgrib g.yogs bsal nas chos rnams kyi rang bzhin ma 'dres pa so sor 'byed cing gnyug ma'i sems kyi rang zhal lhag ger mthong bar byed pa ste/ dkon mchog 223

sprin las/ zhi gnas gang zhe na sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /lhag mthong gang zhe na yang dag par so sor rtogs pa'o//zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ /sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang / /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir//zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong brjod//ces so/ /gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul la//zhi gnas bsgom pa/lhag mthong bsgom pa/zung 'brel du bsgom pa'o//dang po ni spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni//'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub//ces gsungs pas / bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs drungs nas 'byin pa la lhag mthong dgos shing / de skye ba la zhi gnas dgos la/ zhi gnas kyang lus sems dben pa la brten nas 'byung bas/ thog mar 'jig rten gyi bya brel dang / zang zing gi nor rdzas/ gnyen dang mdza' bshes sogs la chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs te/ rang nyid dben par gnas nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/dben pa'i yon tan bsam byas nas/ rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba dang / byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches/ dben par gnas nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ /byis dang 'grogs na dben pa mi thob pas skye bo dag la skyo ba bsgom bya ste/ /'di yis dben pa thob cing log 'tsho spong / /zhes so//de ltar dben par gnas nas zhi gnas bsgom pa la/ gnad bzhis nyams su len pa ste/ rten mi g.yo ba/ lus mi 'gul ba/ mig rdzi ma mi 'khrab pa/ sems gzhan du mi g.yeng ba'o/ /dang po rten ni/ shing bu/ rde'u sogs dang / ting 'dzin 224

rgyal por sangs rgyas kyi sku la sems 'dzin pa sogs gsungs kyang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pa me tog sngon po la sems 'dzin par mdzad/ de'ang dar ram ras lta bu la bris pa'i me tog sngon po sor bzhi tsam lte ba nag thing nge ba/'dab ma bzhi'i dbus sngo zhing mthar yal gyis song ba/ de lta bu mtho bdun gyis gzhal ba'i sar mdun drang por sna rtse dang mnyam pa'i smyug ma lta bu stegs ye mi 'gul ba byas te bzhag /de'i dgos pa me tog ni yid 'jug sla ba dang / sngon pos mig la mi gzan pa yin gsungs/ gnyis pa lus ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi chos bdun rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung / lag pa mnyam gzhag mthe bong lto sbyar/sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrang / dpung pa rgod gshog ltar rgyangs pa/ ol kos ol mdud non tsam/ mig dmigs rten la gtad/ lce ya rkan la sbyar te lus gnad dwangs sing nge ba bca'/ gsum pa mig ni sna rtse'i tshad tsam nas mtho bdun 'jal ba'i sar mig ha cang gdang ba dang / zum pa ma yin par rim mer blta ba ni gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhes mdo las gsungs pa'i don yin/de ltar lus gnad lta stangs de lta bu bcas nas ji srid thun de ma grol gyi bar du ya yo gal gul ye ma byung ba dang / khyad par mig la rnam rtog gi rtsa yod pas 'gul na sems gnas dus mi 'ong bas ye ma 'gul bar mdun gyi rten me rtog sngon po de'i steng du ce re bltas nas 'jog bzhi pa sems ni de lta bu'i ngang nas mdun gyi me tog de'i steng du cham gyis 'jog pa las/ de'i dbyibs kha dog sogs la sru ris mi byed pa lhan ne 'jog/de'ang dang por bsgrim/bar du glod/tha ma rang so bzung ba zhes bya ba gsum yod pa'i/ dang po bsgrim pa rmi lus 225

sems hril gyis bsgrim/ sems me tog sngon po'i steng du yid mig rlung gsum gcig tu dril nas chad der 'jog /gnyis pa bar du glod pa ni/ de la ched 'dzin byas na de dag rnam rtog tu 'gro bas/ sems me tog gi steng du gnas ci byung ba dang lhod de bzhag /gsum pa tha ma rang so bzung ba ni de ltar bzhag pa'i tshe na sems dang me tog 'dres pa cham me shig ge 'dug na rang so bzung bar bya ste/bcas bcos ci'ang mi byed par de ga'i ngang la 'jog /sems gzhan du 'phro na tshur bkug nas sngar bzhin bsgrim/ yang glod/ rang so'i sgo nas nyams su len/de ltar byas pas rnam rtog je mang la song na thol skyes rbad chod du bya ste/rnam rtog thol te skyes ma thag sems de'i rjes su mi 'brang bar rbad kyis bcad la yang me tog sngon po'i steng du 'jog pa'am rnam rtog gi rang zhal blta ba zhes pa rnam rtog kho rang gi ngo bo la ched du bltas pas rjes med du yal gyis song ba de ga'i ngang du glod pa de gnyis sems la gang bder byas pas chog go /de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i dus na bying rgod kyi gegs byung ba yang bsal zhing bsgoms pas nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu rnam rtog gi phreng ba gcig rjes la gcig 'byung ba ni rnam rtog ngos zin gyi nyams yin/ nyams gnyis pa gcong rong dog mo'i 'bab chu lta bu rnam rtog nyal gyis zhi ba'i 'phral thol gyis skye yong /yang zhi 'gro ba sogs res 'jog tu 'byung ba ni rnam rtog ngal gso ba'i nyams yin/ nyams gsum pa lung pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu ltar rkyen gyis ma dkrugs pa'i tshe rnam rtog cher mi 'byung rkyen gyis dkrugs pa na rnam rtog cher skyes te sems gnas pa la yang gnod par byed na rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams yin/ nyams 226

bzhi pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bcas pa lta bu ni/ rnam rtog gi rba rlabs byung yang sems gnas la cher mi gnod cing rang shugs kyis myur du zhi 'gro ba ni rnam rtog 'du byed pa'i nyams yin/ nyams lnga pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu ni/rnam rtog gi rba rlabs thams cad nyal gyis zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu khrig ger gnas pa ni rnam rtog 'du mi byed pa'i nyams yin/de ltar lnga pa de 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i nyams yin pas da dung yang de'i rgyun bskyangs pa las lus sems la shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skyes pa na bsam gtan sas bsdus kyi zhi gnas mtshan nyid par sleb cing / 'dir lhag mthong bsgom pa'i rten la yang zhi gnas 'di byung na mchog yin no/ /'di'i skabs su nyes pa lnga ngos zin par byas nas/ de spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad bsten te/sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu'i sgo nas zhi gnas btsal dgos kyang / las dang po bas go dka' bar dogs nas ma bris la/ shes par 'dod na dbus mtha' dang / mdo sde rgyan sogs las btsal bar bya'o//gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgom pa la gsal ba ngos gzung ba/mtha' bral la blo bzhag pa/ brjod bral la nges pa bskyed pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad ni las nyon las 'byung zhing / las nyon ni bdag 'dzin las 'byung ba yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'jig rten dag na 'tshe ba gang yod dang / /'jigs dang sdug bsngal ji snyed yod gyur pa//de kun bdag tu 'dzin pa las byung na/ /'dre chen de kos bdag la ci zhig bya/ /bdag nyid yongs su ma btang na/ /sdug bsngal spong bar mi nus te/ /ji ltar me ni ma btang na/ /bsreg pa spong bar mi nus bzhin//zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ji srid phung 227

por 'dzin yod pa/ /de srid de la ngar 'dzin yod//ngar 'dzin yod na yang las te//de las yang ni skye ba yin//zhes gsungs//des na thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas bdag 'dzin spong ba'i gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can zhig bskyed dgos la/ de yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis bdag 'dzin mgo gnon zhing / don dam byang chub sems stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bdag 'dzin drungs nas 'byin par nus te/ rnam 'grel las/ byams sogs rmongs dang mi 'gal phyir/ /shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min//zhes dang /stong nyid lta dang de 'gal phyir//de yi rang bzhin nyes kun dang //'gal bar rab tu grub pa yin//zhes gsungs/ de yang theg pa chen po'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis thabs byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang / shes rab stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba zung du 'jug pa zhig dgos te/ 'jam dbyangs bla mas/ gang dag dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa ni/ bslabs nas bla med theg pa ni/ /'dus ma byas pa de thob bo//zhes gsungs la/de yang rgyan las/shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa//zhes pa ltar/ byams snying rje sogs thabs kyis zhi mtha' 'gog la/ shes rab kyis srid mthar ma nyung tsam nyan rang la yod na yang theg pa chen pos ni chos thams cad stong nyid spros bral du rtogs dgos la/ de yang rim gyis bdag med gnyis kyi sgo nas rtogs dgos pas/ de la rang gi phung po la dmigs nas bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ni 'khrul pa kho na ste/ bdag ces bya ba yod na ming dang lus sems gang rung las ma 'das 228

pa las ming ni glo bur du btags tsam yin pa'i phyir bdag ma yin/ lus ni sha khrag rus pa'i gong bu la btags pa'i phyir dang / spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi phyi nang gang du yang bdag ma dmigs pas na lus bdag ma yin/ sems 'das pa ni 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes/ da lta ba ni de ma thag 'gag par 'gyur bas na bdag ma yin/ de bas na bdag go snyam pa ni gzhi med la 'khrul pa kho na'o/ /phyi rol gyi ri ra ba khang khyim la sogs pa 'di dag kun kyang /phywa dang dbang phyug dang / 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran la sogs pa byed pa po gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin gyi/rang sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i snang ba tsam ste/mi lam gyi grong khyer rta glang sogs dang mtshungs pa'o//gzung ba ma grub pa'i phyir 'dzin pa yang ma grub la/ des na gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi sems gsal zhing rig tsam de'i ngang la ma yengs par yun ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'jog /gnyis pa ni de ltar gnas pa'i tshe gsal tsam rig tsam zhig nyams su myong ba na/sems de nyid thog mar gang las skyes brtags pas/ skye ba'i rgyu ma rnyed pas skye med du stong sang nge ba/ bar du gang du gnas bltas pas kha dog dbyibs sogs gang du yang ma grub cing lus kyi phyi nang gang du yang ma rnyed pas gnas med du dwa ngas sang nge ba/ tha ma gang du 'gag bltas pas gang du yang mi 'gag pas na 'gag med du bde cham me/ /de ltar skye 'gag gnas gsum yod med yin min thams cad dang bral bas stong nyid spros bral du rjen ne ba/myong rig tu gsal tsam rig tsam/ gsal ba'i dus nyid na stong pa/ stong ba'i dus nyid na gsal ba'i rgyun ma 'gags pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med/mtha' bral ris med/brjod bral blo 'das 229

kyi ngang la khrig ge rjen ne ye re bzhag /tha na brjod bral tsam du'ang 'dzin pa med pa had de chad de bzhag /gsum pa spros bral brjod pa dang bral ba la nges pa bskyed pa ni/de ltar bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor/ sgom byed kyi thabs/sgom mkhan gsum ga yang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ngo bo 'di zhes brjod du med cing blo yi yul las 'das pa de'i ngang la bzhag /thun mtshams su yang snang ba'i chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang gzugs rang mdangs yin par blta'o//'di dag ni rje btsun rin po che grags pas/sems dang po skye ba med pa la//gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid//skye 'gag med par bsam pa yang //rnam rtog yin gyis zhog la thong / /'jog mkhan rang yang rnam rtog yin//zhes dang / gsal la ma 'gags stong pa de//zung 'jug gi gnas lugs yin par go /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don nyams su len tshul dmigs par dril ba'o/ /gsum pa zung 'brel du bsgom pa ni/ /de lta bu'i lhag mthong gi shes rab de nyid sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi steng du bsgoms la/ gnas cha che na shes rab kyi ngar bskyed/ shes rab ngar ches pas sems mi gnas na lhod kyis glod pas zung 'brel du 'gyur bas de lta bu la 'bad rtsol bya'o/ /theg chen 'jug sgo byams dang snying rje bsgom//theg chen byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /bdag gzhan mnyam brjes bdag lta'i gces 'dzin bshig /bdag med lta bas bdag lta'i spros pa bcad//thabs kyis zin pas gnas lugs spros bral rtogs//thabs shes zung 'jug theg chen lam mchog 'dis/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas don gnyis mthar byin pa'i/ /sku gnyis mngon gyur rnam mkhyen thob par shog/thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i khrid rnams bstan zinato//230

lam thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i skor/kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi rgyas bshad/smin grol lam ston bla ma skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchi gsol 'debs lam rnams khyed kyi drin//mchog gsum skyabs bsten lam log g.yang las skyob/ /byang chub sems kyis lam dman 'phrang las sgrol/ /rdor sems bdud rtsis lam gyi 'gal rkyen 'khrud/ /maṇ+ḍal mchod pas lam gyi mthun rkyen sgrub//skyabs mchog bla ma lam rnams kun gyi gtso/ /bdag sogs 'gro la lam mchog myur stsol mdzod/ /gsum pa lam thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i khrid la/ gnyis med rgyud rgyal kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi snyan brgyud zab mo'i sngon 'gro rnams kyi spyi chos rgyas par bshad pa/ zab lam gzhan rnams kyi sngon 'gro rnams kyi sgos chos so sor bshad pa'o//dang po la thog mar sngon 'gro rnams dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo//dang po ni/slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas sngags kyi bshad pa snying po rgyan las/ sdom gsum cho ga mi ldan par/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te//zhes dang /dang po skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te//sdom gsum cho ga rab tu brtags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgrub pa po'i rgyud sdom gsum dang mi ldan par bskyed rdzogs kyi lam ji tsam nyams su blangs kyang ye shes mi skye bas rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ni mi dgos ka med kyi gzhi chen yin pa sa bskyed rdzogs kyi 231

lam nyams su len pa'i tshe sdom gsum gyi nyes skyon che ba rnams ni slar blang zhing phyir bcos pa'i sgo nas sbyong / thun bar gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams ni sngon 'gro 'di gsum gyis stong ba yin/ gnyis pa la'ang lam log pa mu stegs pa las khyad par 'phags shing so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du byed pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par 'phags shing byang sems kyi sdom pa yar ldan du byed pa sems bskyed kyi khrid/ lam gyi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong zhing sngags kyi sdom pa yar ldan du byed pa rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ lam gyi mthun rkyen tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ /lam rgyud la skye zhing mthar phyin par byed pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang lnga/dang po/ skyabs 'gro/dang po sbyir chos nyams len thams cad kyi sgo dbye ba skyabs 'gro'i khrid la/rgyud rgya gzhung las gsungs tshul/ skyabs 'gro'i mtshan nyid/ sgra don/ dbye ba/nyams su len pa'i tshul dngos bshad pa/ de yi bslab bya/ de ltar slob pa'i phan yon bstan pa dang bdun las/dang po ni rdo rje gur las/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi//zhes dang /sa bhu ṭi las/skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa yis//shin tu legs par sbyangs nas ni/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la//bsam pa dag pas skyabs su song / /zhes sogs gsungs la/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ dang po so sor thar pa yi/ /sdom pa legs par ma bsrung bar/ /gsang ba sogs tshul 232

gnas byed pa/ /thal ba las 'bras ji bzhin no//rtsa ba rnyed par mi 'gyur pas//dang po skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa skyabs 'gro'i mtshan nyid ni/yul mchog la brten par khas len pa'o//gsum pa sgra don ni/ shā ra ṇi gats+tsha mi zhes bya ba skyob pas na skyabs/ de la brten par bsnyen pas na 'gro ba ste/de yang mdo sde rgyan las/'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang /'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa dang / /thabs ma yin dang ngan song las//skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa skyabs 'gro'i dbye ba la'ang 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis/ de re re la yang khyad par bzhi bzhi las/dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu yi khyad par 'jig rten pa rnams ni phyi ma ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa dang / tshe 'dir nad dang /rgyal po'i chad pa dang /dgra rkun sogs kyis 'jigs pa dang / tshe ring nad med longs spyod sogs 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro ba gtso che la/ /nyan rang gnyis la 'jigs pa dang / 'dod pa'ang yod mod kyi rgyu dad pa gtso che/ byang sems la rgyu gsum po de'ang yod mod kyi snying rje gtso che'o/ /gnyis pa yul gyi khyad par la 'jig rten pa la skyabs 'gro'i yul dman mchog gnyis las/ dang po ni dbang phyug tshangs pa sogs dang / rgyal po btsan sogs dang ri dang shing la sogs pa rang gang mos la skyabs su 'gro ste/ 'on kyang skyabs yul de ni log pa yin te/thogs med kyis/ rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings pa yi//'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus//zhes dang /'jigs pas nyen pa kha cig ni//phal cher ri dang nags tshal lam//ljon shing che la skyabs 'gro yi//skyabs de dam pa ma yin 233

te//skyabs de la ni brten nas su/ /'jigs pa che las mi grol lo//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gnyis pa mchog ni/yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro yang /blo 'jig rten pa ste tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'am/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la legs par smon pas skyabs 'gro byed pa ste/bsam pa de lta bus dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro yang 'khor ba las mi grol ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa la'ang thun mong thun min gnyis te/ dang po nyan thos ni dge 'dun gyis gtso byas pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ rang rgyal ni chos gtso byas pa'i mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa pha rol tu phyin pas ni sangs rgyas gtso bor byas pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir//chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs//gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin te/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi//skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin//skyob pa chos kyi sku can te//tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir//zhes gsungs so//de lta bu'i dkon mchog gsum la yang ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ste/ nyan rang gnyis ni sangs rgyas la sku gsum mi 'dod/ rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas pa'i shākya thub pa de nyid sangs rgyas mtshan nyid par 'dod/ chos kyang theg pa chen po mi 'dod/ nyan thos kyi gsung rab nyid 'dod/dge 'dun yang byang chub sems dpa' mi 'dod par nyan thos kyi gang zag brgyad nyid 'dod do/ theg chen phar phyin pas ni sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/chos theg pa chen po/ dge 'dun byang chub sem sa dopa 'a kho 234

te//skyabs de la ni brten nas su/ /'jigs pa che las mi grol lo//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gnyis pa mchog ni/yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro yang /blo 'jig rten pa ste tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'am/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la legs par smon pas skyabs 'gro byed pa ste/bsam pa de lta bus dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro yang 'khor ba las mi grol ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa la'ang thun mong thun min gnyis te/ dang po nyan thos ni dge 'dun gyis gtso byas pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ rang rgyal ni chos gtso byas pa'i mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /gnyis pa thun mong min pa pha rol tu phyin pas ni sangs rgyas gtso bor byas pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir/ /med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir//chos rnam gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs//gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin te/ /dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi//skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin//skyob pa chos kyi sku can te//tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir//zhes gsungs so//de lta bu'i dkon mchog gsum la yang ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra ste/ nyan rang gnyis ni sangs rgyas la sku gsum mi 'dod/ rdo rje gdan du sangs rgyas pa'i shākya thub pa de nyid sangs rgyas mtshan nyid par 'dod/ chos kyang theg pa chen po mi 'dod/ nyan thos kyi gsung rab nyid 'dod/dge 'dun yang byang chub sems dpa' mi 'dod par nyan thos kyi gang zag brgyad nyid 'dod do/ theg chen phar phyin pas ni sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid/chos theg pa chen po/ dge 'dun byang chub sem sa dopa 'a kho 234

na'o/ /gsum pa dus kyi khyad par ni/'jig rten pas tshe 'di phyi'i rang don phra mo nam thob pa ma gtogs pa/ ji srid 'tsho dang snying po byang chub kyi bar gyi tha snyad mi shes shing / nyan rang gis ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar ma gtogs/ snying po byang chub kyi bar gyi skyabs 'gro mi 'dod la/ byang chub sems dpas ji srid snying po byang chub kyi bar du 'gro'o/ /gzhan mi 'dod do//bzhi pa chen du bya ba'i khyad par ni/'jig rten pas tshe phyi ma'i don tsam la dmigs nas skyel ma lta bu'i tshul du skyabs su 'gro/ nyan thos kyis ni rang don du dgra bcom thob par 'dod pas/rang sangs rgyas kyis ni rang don du rten 'brel rtogs nas sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du rang byung gi ye shes thob par 'dod pas/ byang chub sems dpas gzhan don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro'o//de'ang rgyud bla ma las/ ston pa bstan pa slob don gyis/ /theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas//skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ lnga pa gsang sngags bla med kyi skyabs 'gro nyams su len tshul dngos bshad pa la brgyad/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten gyi gang zag ngos gzung ba/rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba/ dus nam gyi bar du skyabs su 'gro ba/tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba/ched du bya ba gang gi phyir skyabs su 'gro ba/ /mthar dngos grub blang zhing de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa/bye brag sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo//dang po ni/rang nyid bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du 'khod la/dbugs stod 'tshang lha bu ma/ yin par cung zad ngal gso ba'i tshul du ba'ab/235

rang rgyud kyi dug gsum ngan rtog dang / zhi bde don gnyer sogs kun slong ngan pa rnams bcos/ de nas rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs gnas khang sogs la dmigs pa ched du gtad pas de thams cad nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar rjes med du yal zhing / tha mal gyi snang ba dbyings su nub/ de'i ngang las zhing yongs su dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i sa phyogs thams cad be+e ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la 'dzam bu chu po'i gser gyis mig mangs ris su bris pa/mnan na nem byed pa/ btegs na 'phar byed pa/ reg na bde ba khyad par can skyed pa lag mthil ltar tha gru mnyam pa/ ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che la/ mtho zhing lhun stug pa/ rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi dril g.yer rlung gis bskyod pa las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba/gser gyi rgya thabs kyi rtse mor nor bu'i rtog gis spud pa/ gzhal med khang de'i dbus su/ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lo ma me tog phun sum tshogs pa/rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du pad 'dab shag gis gyes pa'i dbus su/ gser dngul/ margad sogs rin po che sna tshogs las grub cing 'od 'phro ba'i khri yangs shing rgya che la mtho ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing dbang phyug brgyad mtshon pa phyogs rer seng ge gnyis gnyis te/ rngam zhing brjid pa'i seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa/khri de yi steng du chags sogs 'khor ba'i chos kyis ma sos pa'i brdar sna tshogs pad ma 'dab ma 236

brgyad dang ldan pa kha bye ma jig pa lta bu zil pa phrom me dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa/dbus kyi ze'u 'bru'i steng dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i brdar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba re re/ /dbus kyi zla ba'i steng du snying rje chen pos sems can mi gtong zhing dkar po'i chos thams cad kyi myu gu 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor smin pa'i brdar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar ser gsal zhing 'od 'phro ba/ de yi steng du bdud bzhi rtsad nas 'joms par mtshon pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams mgo g.yas su bstan nas steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ gdong gyen du phyogs shing thal mo sbyar ba'o//'dab ma brgyad kyi zla gdan la bdud bzhi dang 'byung bzhi'i rnam rtog rnams spangs par mtshon pa shar du tshangs pa ser po sogs nas/ nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha rnams mgo g.yon tu bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs nas thal mo sbyar ba'o//dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'dus pa sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ rnam pa dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo snying po kye rdo rje/ de yang chos dbyings las 'gyur ba med cing bde ba chen po mtshon pa sku mdog sngo sangs/ rnam thar sgo brgyad dag pas zhal brgyad kyi rtsa zhal sngon po mdun du gzigs pa/ spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma bral bas g.yas zhal dkar po/ thugs rje chen pos sems can la rjes su chags pas g.yon zhal dmar po/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings mngon du gyur pa las mi 'gyur bas zhal lhag ma 237

gnyis gnyis gung ba ltar gnag pa/ thabs shes gnyis su med pas steng zhal dud kha mgrin pa dang bcas pa mdun du gzigs pa/ khams gsum la gzigs shing dus gsum mkhyen pas zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du rgyas pas dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa/bdud bzhi 'joms pa la dpa' bas mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gcigs pa/ stong nyid bcu drug rtogs pas phyag bcu drug gis thabs shes zung 'jug gi thod pa bcu drug bzung ba/ g.yas kyi thod pa'i nang gi glang po sogs srog chags brgyad ni/ sems can rnams kyi glo nad dang dbugs mi bde ba sogs nad brgyad tshur len zhing dag pas kha nang la bstan pa/ phyag g.yon gyi thod pa'i nang gi sa chu la sogs pa'i lha brgyad ni sems can thams cad la sku yi dbang phyug la sogs pa dbang phyug brgyad stsal bas kha phyir phyogs pa/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pas zhabs bzhi'i g.yas gnyis brkyangs pas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan zhing / g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo g.yas pa'i brla la gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ye shes lnga yongs su rdzogs pas mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan/ ā li kā li lnga bcu dbyings su dag pas shes rab kyi rang bzhin mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phar phyin drug dag pas rus rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ phrin las bzhis gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad pas rtsa zhal gyi mtshogs ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i pang du chos dang gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa'i shes rab mngon du gyur pa'i rdo rje bdag med ma sku ma dog sngo mas zhal gcig phyag gnyis 0yas gzung 'dzin gyi rngam rtos 238

dang nyon mongs gcod pa'i zangs kyi gri gug /bde chen gyi bdud rtsis thugs rgyud gang bas phyag g.yon bdud thams cad kyi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhi mtha' la mi gnas shing 'khor ba'i sems can snying rje chen pos mi 'dor bas zhabs g.yon yab dang lhan cig brkyangs pa'i mthe bong gis drag po'i snying ga mnan pa/ shes rab chen pos 'khor bar mi chags pas zhabs g.yas bskum pas yab kyi dpyi g.yon gyi steng nas 'khyud pa/thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus rgyan lngas brgyan pa/yab yum gnyis ku'ang ye shes lnga'i yon tan rdzogs pas ye shes kyi me ris sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus na gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pas bzhugs pa ni bla ma sangs rgyas yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin yin la/ de dag gi thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i bde stong gi ye shes dang 'gog lam gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gtso bo'i sku rgyab/ lha mo be+e tā li'i mdun du rin po che'i khri'i steng du po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu gser gdong ngam sa ler gdong dar khra bun ne ā li kā li'i rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs pa ni chos dkon mchog yin la/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu/ rnal 'byor ma ri rab kyi rdul dang grangs mnyam pa/gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa phyir mi sdog pa'i rtags thob pa yan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i ngo bo lha mo brgyad de/ de yang shar gyi pad 'dab la zla ba dang tshangs pa'i gdan la lha mo gi rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro nyi ta 'dzin pa/de bzhin du lho yi gdan la tso rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu be+e tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ 239

byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sprul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pu si sngon mo g.yas seṅge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral bas gcer bu thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ lnga bcu'i do shal/rus rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ni dge 'dun dkon mchog yin la/gzhan yang gur zhal sogs chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa thams cad dpag bsam shing gi yal ga dang / lo ma'i khrod du sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de dag rnams kyang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bzhugs par bsam pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gsal 'debs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten gyi gang zag ngos gzung ba ni/de lta bu'i tshogs zhing gi mdun du rang nyid/ rang gi g.yas su skye ba da res kyi pha/ g.yon du ma/mdun du mngon par snang byed kyi dgra bo dang / mi mngon par gnod pa'i 'dre gdon/ mtha' skor du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad smra shes don go ba mi'i rnam pas ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa ltar smug shig ger yod par bsam/ rang dang de thams cad kyang lus gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar ba/ ngag gus pa'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro 'don pa/ 240

yid gus pa'i sgo nas mtho ru gtong ngam dma' ru gtong ngam skyid sdug legs nyes na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci byung yang bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che khyed ma gtogs skyabs dang skyob pa/ mgon dang dpung gnyen/ re sa dang skyabs gnas gzhan na med pas/ dus de ring nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du blo gtad dang yid ches khyed la bcol/ blo pha la mi 'dri/ /gros ma la mi byed//thag rang gis mi bcad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che khyed la brten no/ khyed las gzhan skyabs dang re sa med do snyam pa'i yid khyed shes kyi mos gus rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro byed par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rgyu gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba la gsum ste/ 'jigs pa dang /dad pa dang / snying rjes skyabs su 'gro ba'o//dang po la'ang gsum las/dang po 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ pha ma la sogs pa'i bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas tshul la bltas pa'i tshe/ 'khor ba'i thog ma 'di'o zhes tshad gzung du med pa nas da lta'i bar du sdug bsngal 'di myong ba dang ma myong gi sa mtshams med pa sdug bsngal gyi yo lang sdug bsngal gyi nyin sribs kho na la longs spyod/da dung yang skyabs khyad par can zhig dang ma 'phrad na/ 'khor ba'i tha ma 'di zhes tshad gzung bar mi nus pa'i bar du sdug bsngal kho na la longs spyod dgos par 'dug snyam pa rang gzhan gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo mi dag can chad pas skrag pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rang don yid byed kyi 'jigs pas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang gi bu la'ang ma chags pa'i/ /nyan thos rnams ni skal ba dman//zhes dang /rje btsun grags pas/ rang gcig pu thar 241

pas dgos rgyu med/ khams gsum gyi sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde ba 'dod pa be le le/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gcig pu zhi bde 'dod pa dang / rang don yid byed kyi blo thams cad ni spyir theg chen khyad par gsang sngags kyi lam gyi 'gal rkyen dang spang bya che shos yin pas de la 'jigs shing skrag ste/ de las skyob pa'i nus pa dkon mchog la mnga' bar shes pas skyabs su 'gro ba'o//gsum pa tha mal snang zhen gyi 'jigs pa ni/gsang sngags bla med nyams su len mkhan rnams kyis snang ba thams cad lha/grag pa thams cad sngags kyi rang bzhin/ dran rtog thams can ye shes kyi rang bzhin du shes dgos te/ gsang sngags ni yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs nyams su len pa yin pas/ de dang 'gal ba'i snang grag rig pa tha mal du zhen pa ni/ gsang sngags bla med kyi lam gyi 'gal zla dang spang bya thun mong ma yin pas de la 'jigs shing skrag pa ste 'jigs pa de rnams las skyob pa'i nus pa mdun na bzhugs pa'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la yod par shes pa ni mi nag can kha drag la skyabs 'tshol ba lta bu ste skyabs 'gro'i rgyu dang po yin no/ /gnyis pa dad pas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ sdug bsngal dang 'jigs skrag de dag las skyob pa'i skyabs khyad par can zhig mi 'tshol ka med du 'dug /de'ang 'jig rten pa'i lha dang nyan rang la sogs pa la skyabs zhus kyang / kha cig ni kho rang 'khor ba las ma thar bas sdug bsngal la longs spyod pa las mi 'dug /la la ni rang don du spangs rtogs ma rdzogs shing gzhan gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs mi mkhas pas de dag bsten kyang don mi 'dug la/ des na bla ma dkon 242

mchog gsum po skyabs gnas thams cad kyi mthar thug spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs/ mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i mnga' bdag bslu ba med par shes pa'i dad pa ni dwang pa'i dad pa/ de'ang sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa phra zhing phra ba ma 'dres par lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar sa ler mkhyen pa'i mkhyen pa mnga'/ mkhyen yang brtse ba med na don mi mdzad pa las/ slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su thugs bskyed pa'i smon lam gyi dbang las/ sems can thams cad la ma bu gcig po na ba la brtse ba lta bu'i thugs rje dang ldan/ brtse'ang nus pa med na ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba ltar skyob mi nus pa las/ thugs gtad pa'am 'od zer phra mo spros pa tsam gyis sems can tshad med pa byang chub la 'god pa lta bu'i nus pa mnga' bar shes shing de lta bu'i yon tan rnams bdag gzhan thams cad kyis thob par 'dod pa ni 'dod pa'i dad pa/ skyabs yul rnams la de lta bu'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan de ltar yod pa la yod par ngo shes shing the tshom dang yid gnyis med pa ni yid ches pa'i dad pa ste de lta bu'i dad pa gsum gyi sgo nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni rgyu gnyis pa'o//gsum pa snying rjes skyabs su 'gro ba ni sems can thams cad la yang bltas pas/ sems can la la ni sdig pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal gsum gyis gzir ba dang / la la ni sdug bsngal gsum gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod pa'i sems can rnams la mi bzod pa'i snying brtse bas rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras las bskyab pa'i phyir du bla ma dkon ma chog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /bzhi pa skyabs su 243

'gro ba'i dus ni/ dus da nas bzung ji srid du bdag dang bdag gi pha mas gtso byas mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /lnga pa tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la bdag gzhan sems can thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang la lam sna 'dren pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang / de bzhin du sangs rgyas dkon mchog la lam ston pa po mdzad du gsol/ chos dkon mchog la lam dngos mdzad du gsol/ dge 'dun dkon mchog la lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang /sngar bstan pa'i 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyis kun nas bslangs te bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa de dag las sgrol ba'i skyabs zhu snyam pa kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying gi dkyil rus pa'i long nas bsam pa rtse gcig pas bdag gis 'dun pa byed pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyis kyang 'dun pa byed par bsam/ bdag gis gus 'dud byed pa dang / ngag nas skyabs 'gro 'don pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyis kyang brjod par bsam mo/ /legs nyes skyid sdug gang byung yang mgon skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bar bla ma dkon mchog la blo snying brang gsum gtad nas skyabs 'gro byed/ de yang brag phug lta bu la char pa skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang /rang gis blo ma bkal bas der ma phyin na khu nas brag phug brgya stong bos kyang char pas bangs pa la mi phan/ the tshom med par 'tshang phyin na nges par skyob pa bzhin/ blo rgya g.yeng the tshom gyi ngang nas kha nas skyabs 'gro brgya stong du ma byas 244

kyang phan thogs mi 'byung ste/ zhi ba lhas/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs//zhes so/ /des na the tshom dang rnam rtog thams cad kyi spros pa bcad/ /yid mig rnam gsum gcig tu dril te/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs 'don la skyabs 'gro'i ngag 'don gyi 'bru cung zad 'grel na/bdag rnal 'byor pa rang dang 'gro ba dgra gnyen bar mas bsdus pa mtha' skor du yod pa/ de yang kha shas tsam ma yin pa phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sngags lam la zhugs pa'i dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba chos nyid de bzhin dag pa gnyis ldan gyi ngang du gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rnam par snang mdzad/ gsung 'od dpag med/ thugs mi bskyod pa/ yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ phrin las don yod grub pa thams cad kyi ngo bo/ gdul bya 'dod chags la spyod pa'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod nyis khri chig stong / zhe sdang la spyod pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod nyis khri chig stong / gte mug la spyod pa'i gnyen po mngon pa'i sde snod nyis khri chig stong / dug gsum cha mnyam la spyod pa'i gnyen por gsang sngags kyi sde snod nyis khri chig stong ste chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ gsang sngags kyi lam la zhugs pa 'i phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa yan chod kyi 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag dad pa can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar mdzad pa'i rje btsun/ rang la smin grol 245

dngos su gnang ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / de yi bla ma nas bzung rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi brgyud par bcas pa'i tshogs gnyis zung 'jug gi dpal dang ldan zhing /gu ru'i sgra las drangs na yon tan gyi khur gyis lci bas na bla ma/ de la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab na tshe 'di'am bar do sogs su sangs rgyas 'byin par nus pas dam pa sngar gyi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma de rnams thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid yin par thag bcad la bdag gzhan thams cad byang chen la 'dren par mdzad du gsol snyam pas 'dun pa shugs drag po bskyed la bla ma'i thugs skar thim la khad lta bur bsams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /spang rtogs kyi yon ta na thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas nyon shes gnyis kyi dri ma phra mo'i phra mo yang sangs nas shes bya ji lta ji snyed ma lus pa'i gzigs pa'i blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa/ lha'i bu la sogs pa'i bdud bcom zhing / dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa/ srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das pa/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog ste skyabs gnas rnams thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo snying po kye rdo rje la dmigs te bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lam ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pas skyabs su mchi'o/ /gtso bo'i sku rgyab kyi chos la dmigs te bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pas skyes bu dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos lung rtogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo lha mo brgyad/ chos srung nor lha bcas pa la dmigs te bdag gzhan gyi lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs dang lam gyi 'gal rkyen sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub par mdzad du gsol snyam pas so skye'i sa 246
