las ring du 'phags pa'i tshogs dge ba'i bya ba la gcig tu 'dun pa nam yang mi phyed pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro bzhi skor brgya stong la sogs pa'i bar du lus sems 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas lus kyi ba spu g.yo ba/mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa/lus sems tshugs mi thub pa zhig ma byung gi bar du sgrub par byed/de lta bu thun re la ci nus su bsags shing / tha na'ang skyabs 'gro 'bum phrag gcig 'gro nges su thun du bcad la bsags/ rgyun du yang skyabs 'gro la yi dam du bya'o//drug pa gang gi ched du skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du'o//bdun pa dngos grub blang zhing skyabs yul bsdu ba ni/mthar rdo rje'i thal mo snying gar sbyar te bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs skyabs gsol dkyus bzhin brjod de gsol ba drag tu btab pas skyabs yul rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba ltar 'phros/ mtha' skor gyi sems can thams cad la phog pa tsam gyis de dag gi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sangs kyis dag /tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te sems rtog med chos sku dang / lus zag med bde chen gyi sku gang la gang 'dul gyi rnam par sangs rgyas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing so sor sems can gyi don la bya'i khyu chen po 'phur ba bzhin 'ur gyis byon par bsam/ de nas dge 'dun dkon mchog gi ngo bo lha mo brgyad chos skyong nor lha dang bcas pa 'od zer dkar por zhu nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/chos dkon mchog gi ngo bo gsung rab po ti rnams 'od zer dmar por zhu nas 247

mgrin par thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo gtso bo yab yum dbu skra nas mar rim bzhin thim/ pad sdong dang seng khri nas yar 'od du zhu te thugs ku'i thad du 'od sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od dang ldan par ltem gyis zhu rang gi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum dang ye shes dang /rang gi sgo gsum bya byed dang bcas pa dbyer med du 'dres song snyam pa'i ngang du 'dzin pa ma zhugs par ji tsam gnas kyi bar du had de bzhag /de ltar ba'as pa'i tshe na sems gsal le hris ge ye re gnas pa'i cha ni/sasal ba sems kyi ma tshan nyid dge 'dun dkon mchog dang / gsal ba de'i ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe na sang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du rjen ne gnas pa ni stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin te chos dkon mchog gsal ba dang stong pa me dang me'i tsha ba ltar dbyer 'byed mi shes pa'i zung 'jug ni bcos min sems kyi ngo bo ste sangs rgyas dkon mchog zung 'jug de'i ngo bo la gsal stong gnyis 'di'o zhes so sor brjod mi shes par blo yi yul thams cad las 'das pa'i brjod bral ni bla ma/brjod bral de'i ngo bo la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis ye gdod ma nas rgos ma myong ba'i bde chen gyi ye shes ni yi dam/ gnas lugs de'i rgyun bskyangs pas phrin las thams cad 'bad med du 'grub pa ni chos skyong ste/ sems rig pa skad cig ma gcig gi steng du skyabs gnas thams cad lhun grub tu tshang ba la/de ltar ngo shes thag bcad nges shes bskyed nas de ga'i ngang la 'dzin pa ma zhugs par 248

bzo med du skyong ba ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro yin gsungs so/ /de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa gang / /bag la nyal dang bcas las grol//sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi//rdo rje rnams dang dbyer med 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa'i don yang yin no/ /de nas dge rtsa sems can gyi don du bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab bo/ /brgyad pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni/ 'di'i skabs sbyang gzhi ni/ spyir ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dang / khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi 'jig rten gyi dpon po/ lha klu bdud btsan mthu bo che dang tshangs pa dang dbang phyus la so gas pa skyabs su 'gro bar mi 'os pa'i yul la skyabs su song ba bla ma/ dang dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i yul la skyabs su ma song zhing / ma dad ma gus pa bgyis pa la sogs pa sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa ni sbyang gzhi yin la/skyabs su 'gro ba ni sbyong byed kyi lam/de nyid dbyer med du nyams su len pa ni skyabs 'gro 'khor 'das dbyer med yin la/de'i don ni sbyang gzhi de dag skyabs 'gro byed mkhan sgru ba pa po rang rgyud kyi sems nyid skad cig ma gcig gi rnam 'phrul du shes par byas/ de nyid gsal rig tsam du gtan la phab nas de nyid ngo bo ci yang ma grub pa stong pa nyid du bsgom pa de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du gdangs 'gag med skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba po/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i chul rnams gsal btab ste zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa yin te/ rtsa rgyud las/ skye bo mi zad pa yi 'a sa/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur pa/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur//tshes dang / rmam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog dang / /srid 249

pa nyid kyis srid pa 'dag /ces dang / 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste/ /'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa nyid//ces dang /rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i man ngag las/skyon yon tan du slong ba'i gdams ngag /bar chad dngos grub tu len pa'i gdams ngag/ces gsungs pa'i don yin no//drug pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya la/thun mong gi bslab bya dang / so so'i bslab bya gnyis/ dang po sgrub pa'i bslab bya la'ang gsum ste/ skyes bu dam pa dang 'grogs pa dang / dam pa'i chos mnyan pa dang /chos bzhin du bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten la mdo sngags kyi chos mnyan zhing / sdig pa'i grogs po spangs te chos bzhin du sgrub pa'i grogs po la yid rton pa/ rang gi nye 'brel 'khor g.yog sbyin bdag sogs la chos bshad cing blo chos la sgyur te chos sgor 'dzud pa'o//gnyis pa chos nyan pa ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs nges pa'i sde snod gsum mam/ rgyud sde bzhi nyan/ yang na dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mgon po byams pas gsungs pa'i byams chos sde lnga/ thogs med sku mched kyis gsungs pa'i mngon pa gong 'og gnyis/klu sgrub yab sras kyi dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum rigs tshogs bcas pa/phyogs glang chos grags rnam gnyis kyi tshad ma kun btus rnam 'grel nges bcas dang / slob dpon zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug /yon tan 'od kyi 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs khungs thub pa'i chos nyan dgos/ gsang sngags yin yang / klu sgrub kyi gsang 'dus/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i lam 'bras/ lu nag dril gsum gyi bde mchog sogs bstan bcos khungs nas byung ba nyan dgos te/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi gsungs/ sdud pa pos bsdus/ grub thob rnams kyis bsgoms/ paṇ+ḍi 250

tas bshad/ lo tsā bas bsgyur/ mkhas pa rnams la grags pa gcig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yin pas de la nyan bshad sgom sgrub byed dgos so//de las bzlog pa'i chos zab zab dang legs legs 'dra ba mu stegs sogs la'ang 'dug ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ma yin pas dor la bzhag go/gsum pa chos bzhin bsgrub pa la gnyis te/spyir sde snod dang mthun par bya ba dang / bye brag tu 'phral gyi spyod lam ji ltar bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni spyod pa 'dul ba dang mthun/ sgom pa mdo sde dang mthun/ bshad pa mngon pa dang mthun/ gsang sngags rgyud sde dang mthun pa gcig dgos so/ /gnyis pa 'phral gyi spyod lam ji lta sgrub pa ni/ 'dug pa'i tshe spyi bo'i gtsug gi nam mkhar dkon mchog gsum gyi lha tshogs bsgom/ de gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten yin/ 'gro ba'i tshe phrag pa g.yas kyi nam mkhar bsgom/ de bskor ba byed pa'i gnas yin/ khyad par du gar 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro byed cing 'gro ste/ dbus na sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad/shar phyogs na mi 'khrugs pa/lho phyogs na rin chen 'byung ldan/nub phyogs na snang ba mtha' yas/ byang phyogs na don yod grub pa bzhugs pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs shing phyin pas gnas skabs kyi bar chad zhi/bsam pa 'grub/mthar thug sangs rgyas rnams dang mjal ba 'thob bo zas za ba'i tshe yang ci za ci 'thung gi phud kyis mchod/ la zas kyi rnal 'byor yang rang rang gi gzhung dang mthun par byas la bza'o//nyal ldang gi tshe yang bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs shing / sngags gzhung so so'i nyal ldang gi rnal 'byor bzhin du bya'o/gzhan yang bde ba skyid pa ci byung yang bla ma dang dkon mchog la 'bul/251

na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci byung yang bla ma dang dkon mchog la blo gtad/ de la phan pa'i sngags/ dmigs pa/ klog 'don sman dpyad sogs thams cad dkon mchog gi phrin las yin pas skur ba mi gdab par 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang srog dang bya dga'i phyir yang dkon mchog mi spong zhing bya ba ci byed pa thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog bya ba la bslab bo/ /gnyis pa so so'i bslab bya ni/mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs song ba//de ni yang dag dbe bsnyen te/ /nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs song ba/ /'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral/ /nge 'dun la ni skyabs song ba/ /mu stegs gzhan dang 'grogs mi byed/ /ces gsu ngas pas/sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i lha dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug la solas pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i rgyal po dang btsan dang / gzhan yang yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa'i lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams la ston pa dang 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas su bzung nas phyag mchod la sogs bya mi rung la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha de dag la snying rje'i dbang gis mchod gtor tsam phul bas skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa la mi gnod la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas su 'dzin te phyag mchod dang skyabs 'gro sogs byas na skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa gtong zhing mu stegs pa dang khyad med du 'gro gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bris 'bur sogs thig tshad 'bri gzhal nas bzo bcos byed skabs lta bu ma yin par/ mi mdzes pa sogs kyi skyon rtog sosas byed na nyes pa thin tu lci bas spangs ce/ tha na byis pa'i rtsed mo'i phyir 'jim pa dngartsisangos 252

lasku bzugs dang mchod rten gyi rnam pa/ sku rten chag dum yan chad la gus pasamachod/ spyi bor bteg /gtsang sar bzhag sangs rgyas dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed dgos te/ bshes spring las/ ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang //bgyis pa ci 'dra'ang rung ste mkhas pas mchod//ces gsungs so//dam pa'i chos la skyabs su song bas sems can gzhan shig sro tsam la yang gnod 'tshe mi bya bar 'bad pa drag pos bsrung zhing / chos ma yin pa lam du mi byed/gsung rab glegs bam dang /sho ka li sogs bshang gci 'dor ba'i tshe lag tu thogs pa/gdan dang sa rjen la 'jog pa dang yig ldeb sgyur ba'i tshe mdzub mo mchil ma dang bcas pas reg pa/ tha na gsung rab yi ge'i ras ma lta bu yig 'bru gcig gam/ gnyis 'brel tsam yan chad la 'gom pa sogs ma gus pa spangs te spyi bor mchod de dam chos dkon mchog dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag dargos te/ spyan 'dren rgyud gsum pa las/ bla ma'i bla ma bla med dkon mchog gsum//yi ge gnyis 'brel dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan//zhes gsungs la/khyad par du gsung rten ni blang dor gyi gnas ston pa dang /bstan pa'i rgyun 'dzin pa sogs kyis sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par cung zad kyang med cing khyad par 'phags par gsungs te/ mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na//nga ni yi ge'i gzugs su gnas//nga yin snyam du yid byos la//de tshe de la gus par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sku gzugs dang gsung rab kyi glegs bam sogs la nor rdzas kyi 'du shes bzhag nas tshong byed pa dang gta' mar 'jog pa so gas byed pa ni/dkon mchog gsum gyi sku glud za ba 'es bya ste nyes pa shin tu lci/ lhag par chos 25 3

la nyan bshad byed pa la ma gus shing dgos pa med zer zhing 'chad nyan 'gog pa ni/ mkhas pa rgyun 'chad/ chos shes pa med na pu ti mang po yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhig pa yin/ chos kyi skyabs 'gro rtsa ba nas stongs 'gro ba yin pa sogs gsungs pas/ mchog dman rnams bag yod par mdzod cig /dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis dang / ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ma dad pa dang / rang gi bla ma dang chos la gshe zhing smod pa dang / gsang sngags zab mo'i chos la skur ba 'debs pa la sogs pa mu stegs pa dang 'dra ba gzhan la grogs su 'grogs pa dang mchod gnas su mi gzung / sdom brtson dang sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la gnod cing ma gus par byas na dge 'dun gyi skyabs 'gro stongs pas ma gus pa spangs te gus par bya dgos par ma zad tshul khrims 'chal ba dang / lhan pa dmar po yan chad la ma dad cing 'gom yug sogs mi bya bar gus pas mchod/ spyi bor bteg /gtsang sar bzhag pa sogs dag snang bya dgos te/ mdo las/me tog tsam pa ka ni rnying gyur kyang / /me tog phal pa rnams kyis do zla min/ /nga yi rje 'jug tshul khrims 'chal gyur kyang //mu stegs phal pa rnams kyis do ma yin//zhes gsungs pas so/ /der ma zad da lta phal cher rdo rje dang dril bu ni rang bzhin nyer spyad lta bu las/dkon mchog gi rten yin snyam pa mi byed kyang / rdo rjes ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs ye shes lnga la sogs pa mtshon zhing / dril bus kyang zhal gyi rnam pa yod pas rgyud sde 'og ma las rnam snang song ma rnams las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sogs sku'i rnam pa dang / yum brgyad kyi sa bon dngos su yi ge'i rnam pa dang / gzhan 254

yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs mtshon par byed pa yin pas sku gsung thugs rten gsum ka tshang ba dang / lhag par du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar rdor sems yab yum sogs lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin dang / dril bu sher phyin ma yab dang bcas pa sogs lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin dang /dam tshig gi rdzas thun mong ma yin pa yin pas brnyas bcos byas na shin tu nyes pa lci bas dus rtag tu bkur ste dang bcas gces spras bya dgos so//brgyad pa skyabs su song zhing bslab bya la slob pa'i phan yon ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba 'di ni dge chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te/ gang gis skyabs su song ba tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon thebs pa dang / log par mos pa'i mi dge ba'i tshogs las ring du byed pa dang / dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang /sdom pa kun gyi gzhir 'gyur zhing / yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba yin te/ skyabs 'gro bdun cu pa las/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyang / /skyabs su ma song ba la med//ces gsungs so/ /gnas skabs kyi phan yon mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal chung zhing zhi nus pa dang / mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag sbyong ba'o/ /ming 'pho ba'i yon tan thob ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ming thob pa dang / dam pa dam pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su chud pa'o/ /der ma zad don 'pho ba'i yon tan thob ste/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod gnas su 'gyur ba dang / spyir bsrung ba chen por 'gro ba dang /bye brag tu bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rngams kyis srung ba dang / tshe 'dir blo bde/ skye 255

ba thams cad du dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral ba'i gdeng thob pa'o /mthar thug gi phan yon rang la 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas rang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya/ chos la skyabs su song bas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par bskor/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas 'khor dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dpag tu med pa 'du ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ba yin no//gzhan la 'byung ba'i phan yon ni/ bdag de ltar grub pa'i stobs nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rim gyis tshud nas dkon mchog gsum mngon du 'grub pa'o/ /de yang bsam pa zhe thag pa nas tshul dang mthun pa'i skyabs 'gro byas na phan yon de rnams 'byung ba lta ci smos/ bsam pa zhe thag pa med kyang skyabs 'gro ngag tu brjod pa tsam la yang phan yon 'byung bar gsungs te/ sngon rgan zhugs blun po zhig la sbyin bdag mo zhig dad nas ras zung sbyar ba phul nas chos zhus/ des chos bshad rgyu ma rnyed nas yi mug ste mi shes pa nga sdug bsngal zhes yang yang bzlas/der sbyin bdag mos rgyu mi shes pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung bar rtogs te bden pa mthong / des slob dpon gyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral zhes bsngags pa brjod/ der rkun po zhig gis blun po 'di las ras brku bar bya snyam du bsams nas phyi bzhin du 'brangs so/ /der rgan zhugs de khang par zhugs pa dang / rkun pos ras byin cig smras pas rgan zhugs skrag pas phyir 'byung mi nus kyi khang pa'i rgya skar nas longs shig brjod/ rkun mas lag pa gcig gis blangs pas/ rgan zhugs kyis kho bo la yang sbyin bdag gi lag pa 256

gnyis gas byin/ khyod kyang lag pa gnyis gas longs shig smras/ des gnyis ka brkyangs pa na tha gus bkyigs nas ka ba la btags/ de nas rgan zhugs phyir byung ste skyabs 'gro'i lad mo gyis zhes bsgrags nas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs 'gro re la dbyug pa na nges pa re brgyab/ de nas rkun ma btang ste 'theng zhing chu 'gram zhig tu phyin pa dang / mgron po zhig gis khyod ci ste 'theng zhes dris pas/smras pa kho bo rkun ma zhig na/kho bo bas kyang rkun chen dge spyong zhig ste skyabs 'gro re dang dbyug pa re bsdebs nas brdungs/ sangs rgyas mngon shes mnga' bas skyabs 'gro gsum du bsdus/ skyabs 'gro bzhi pa srid na kho bo gdon mi za bar srog dang bral zer nas sangs rgyas la dad bzhin zam pa zhig gi 'og tu chur zhugs/ de'i tshe mi ma yin pa dpag tu med pa zam pa las 'gro bar brtsam pa na 'gro ma nus pas bsam par/ sngar kho bo cag bde blag tu 'gro nus pa la 'di cis lan snyam ste/mi de la smras pa/ khyed kyis rig pa ci shes/dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro zhig shes de las gzhan mi shes zer ba dang / gdon de dag kyang skyabs 'gro la nges shes bskyed de tshe 'phos nas lhar skyes zhes grags/ /rkun po de yang sangs rgyas la dad nas rab tu byung zhes thos so/ /'di dag ni 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi gsung gtso bor byas la/ yang dpal sprul rin po che'i kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung las/ da lta rang re rnams bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drin las dam pa'i chos yang dag pa thos te dge ba'i las sgrub blo dang /mi dge ba spong blo cung zad tsam re skyes pa'i skabs 'dir snying thag pa nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la 'bad na rgyud byin gyis brlabs te 257

dad pa dang dag snang / nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa sogs lam gyi yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur zhing /de ltar ma yin pa bla ma dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro gsol 'debs btang snyoms su lus na/da lta nges 'byung dang skyo shas sogs ji tsam bzang bar yod kyang snang ba 'brid mkhas/ rig pa col chung / rnam rtog bslu skyen pas da lta dge bar yod 'phro la yang mi dge bar 'gyur 'gro ba la tshegs med pas/ phyin chad mi dge ba rgyun gcod pa yang skyabs 'gro las lhag pa med par shes par bya'o/ /gzhan yang bsgrub pa brtson 'grus can la bdud rnams lhag par sdang / zhes dang /chos zab tsa na nag po'i bdud kyang zab/ces gsungs pa ltar/da lta dus snyigs mar thug pas zab mo'i don sgom pa dang / dge ba rlabs po che byed pa rnams la 'jig rten tshe 'dis bslu brid dang / gnyen grogs kyi bshol 'debs/ na tsha dang gdon bgegs kyi 'gal rkyen/ rang gi yid la the tshom dang rnam rtog la sogs chos kyi bar chad cir yang brdzu zhing dge ba'i phyogs 'joms pa yin pas de dag gi gnyen por dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro sogs la snying thag pa nas 'bad na/ chos kyi bar chad thams cad mthun rkyen du 'char zhing dge ba gong 'phel du 'gyur/ der ma zad da lta'i dus su mi nag 'jig rten pa rnams nas kyang lo gcig gi bar du na tsha dang god kha mi 'byung ba'i srung ba byed pa yin zer nas//dbang lung dang gzhi bsnyen sogs gang yang med pa'i bla ma dpon g.yog kha shas bos nas drag sgrub kyi dkyil 'khor zhig zhal phye bskyed rdzogs gang yang med pa'i mig phor khog tsam re bgrad nas zan song zhig gi steng du zhi sdang bzod dka' 258

ba bskyed de khug khug sod sod/ya ya/ rgyob rgyob zer zhing thos tsa na snang ba rtsub reg ge 'ong ba zhig bton nas sha khrag gi dmar mchod kho na byed 'dug ste/ de ltabu de legs par brtags na/ rje btsun mi las/ ye shes pa'i lha 'jig rten pa'i srung skyob la spyan 'dren pa de rgyal po khri thog nas phab ste phyags dar gyi las bcol ba dang 'dra gsungs pa dang / rje dam pa sangs rgyas kyis/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor grong pa'i ra tshang du bzhings nas gnyan po yin pa skad zer ba 'di dargod bro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang sngags bon du gyer ba'i nyes pa 'go zhing / bsgral las byed pa de yang rang 'dod kyi 'khri ba med pa'i gang zag gis bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che bsgrub pa'i phyir du zhing bcu tshang pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol ba la gnang ba yin gyi/rang gzhan gyi phyogs zhen dang bcas pas/zhe sdang rang mtshan pas bsgral las byas na pha rol bsgral bar mi nus shing rang nyid dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu byed pa dang /bskyed rdzogs dang dam tshig med par sha khrag gi dmar mchod kho na byas pas ye shes pa'i lha dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma mi 'grub cing / nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre rnams 'dus nas/ de'i mchod gtor sogs la longs spyod de 'phral du phan pa ltar byed kyang / phugs su mi 'dod pa du ma 'byin pa yin pas/ de bas blo gtad dkon mchog la bcol/ rgyud zhi zhing dul ba'i bla ma dang ser mo ba bos nas skyabs 'gro 'bum ther re bsags bcug na srung ba la yang de las lhag pa med de dkon mchog gi skyabs 'og tu tshud/ tshe 'dir mi 'dod pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing 'dod rgya'i bsam pa thams cad 'grub/ dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing / nag phyogs kyi gdon 259

bgegs rnams nye mi nus pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs la/ gzhan yang mdo las/skyabs su song ba'i bsod nams gang //gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang yang //de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ zhes dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba/ bdud rnams bye bas bsad par mi nus te/ /tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs gyur kyang //de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro//zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar phan yon tshad med pa dang ldan pas dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du skyabs 'gro la nan tan bya dgos so/ /bslu med bla ma dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /bslu med blo gtad dad pas skyabs 'gro bas//bslu med srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyabs te//bslu med mchog gsum go 'phang myur thob shog /lam kun gyi gzhi rten skyabs 'gro'i khrid do//gnyis pa/ sems bskyed/gnyis pa theg chen gyi lam gyi rtsa ba sangs rgyas thob byed kyi dngos rgyu sems bskyed kyi khrid la/ sems bskyed sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/rgyud rgya gzhung las bstan tshul/ sems bskyed kyi dbye ba/ sems bskyed gang las len pa'i cho ga'i khyad par/ sems bskyed kyi phan yon/ ji ltar nyams su len tshul/ sbyang gzhi stong byed ngo sprod tshul/ byang sems kyi bslab bya bstan pa dang bdun las/ phan yon bstan pa yan chad sngar thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed kyi skabs su rgyas par bstan zin la/ lnga pa ji ltar nyams su len tshul bstan pa la yang /spyir 260

smon 'jug gi sems bskyed/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i byang sems bsgom tshul sngarargyas par bstan zin yang / skabs don 'di'i nyams su len tshul ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rang gi pha ma ma byas pa ni med la/ de yang lan gcig ma yin par lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par byas shing / pha ma byas res kyis phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba snying re rje snyam pa yang dang yang du bsgom pa'o/ /'di lta bu sngon du ma song na sems bskyed rnal ma mi skye ste/ rgyan las/de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod//ces gsungs pa'o//des na rgyu snying rje chen po sngon du song nas 'bras bu sems bskyed dngos ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya/ /thob nas kyang sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas snying po kye rdo rje'i sa la 'god par bya'o snyam pa dang /de yi ched du rgyud thams cad kyi rtse rgyal/man ngag thams cad kyi yang snying / zab pa las kyang ches zab pa kye rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo 'di ci nas kyang nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsgom mo//de'i dang po ni smon pa sems bskyed/ phyi ma ni 'jug pa sems bskyed yin no//'di yi ngag 'don ni rje btsun rin po ches/ bdag gis sems can thums cad kyi don du snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du kye rdo rje'i lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/lan gsum nyung mtha' byas pa'i brgya stong gi sgo nas gsal gdab cing bsgom pa ni kun 261

rdzob sems bskyed dang /de ltar sems bskyed pa'i yul/sems skyed pa po/sems bskyed dngos te 'khor gsum po thams cad bde stong spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam sems bskyed yin no/ /drug pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo spyod pa ni/ 'di skabs kyi spyir btang gi sbyang gzhi ni sngar dang 'dra/ khyad par gyi sbyang gzhi ni tshe thog ma med pa nas gzhan la bsam ngan bsgoms pa dang /sems bskyed par mi 'os pa bskyed pa dang / bskyed par 'os pa ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi 'khor ba yin la/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ni stong byed myang 'das yin/ de gnyis dbyer med dam zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa ni sems bskyed 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/ bdun pa sems bskyed kyi bslab bya ni sngar bstan zin to/ /dus gsum sras bcas rgyal ba'i bgrod gcig lam/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems mchog la//zhugs nas ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams//sku gsum rgyal ba'i grong du myur 'jug shog/ces lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi khrid do//gsum pa/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/gsum pa sdig sgrib nyes ltung bshags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid la bzhi ste/ bshags pa byed pa'i dgos pa/ ji ltar bshags pa'i tshul/bshags pa byas pa'i phan yon dang / ma bshags pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa'o//dang po ni/ spyir 'khor ba'i gnas su mi 'dod pa sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rgyu dang rtsa ba ni sdig sgrib kho na yin zhing / lhag par gsang sngags kyi dngos gzhi'i 262

lam rim gnyis zab mo rnams bsgoms pas nyams rtogs khyad par can skye ba dang / sa lam bgrod pa la bar du gcod pa'i gtso bo sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams yin pas thog mar de rnams bshags shing sbyong pa'i thabs la myur du brtson dbos te/ zhi ba lhas/bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar//sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi//ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar/ /myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol//zhes dang / bde mchog gi bshad rgyud a lha rta nar/ gang du dam tshig nyams pa la/ /stong ba 'di ni sbyin par bya//zhi bar gyur nas bla med pa//zhes sogs gsungs la/de la sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs mdo rgyud las mang du gsungs kyang / de dag thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa ni/bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas yin la/khyad pa/ra gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshis nyams pa rnams mi 'phel bar byin gyis rlob cing bshasas pa'i thabs kyang 'di nyid yi na te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ gal te ltung sogs byung gyur na//yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlabs//ji srid dus las ma 'das par//dag pa'i las la nyer gnas bya//'gyod bcas nyes pa 'phel mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa la bzhi ste/lha sgom pa/sngags bzla ba/bshags sdom bya ba/sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul lo//dang po la'ang gsum ste/ bsgom bya'i lha rgyud las bstan tshul/ bstan pa'i lha gnas gang du bsgom pa/ der bsgoms pas sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i 'od dang 'dra ba'i mdog /ces dang / rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ /zhes dang / sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nga //zla ba nyi ma'i dbus sanas pa//rdo rje'i 263

skyil krung dag tu bzhugs//thams cad ral pa'i cod pan can//thod pa'i phreng ba de nyid do//thams cad phyag rgya drug gis brgyan//zhes dang / 'khor los sgyur drug lhan cig tu/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro ma bzlas bya//zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' dpal ho ru ka yab yum bsgom pa'o//gnyis pa ni/nges brjod bla ma'am a lha dha na'i rgyud las/ phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya//zhes dang / rnal 'byor ma yis dbang yang bskur/ /zhes gsungs pas spyi bor bsgom par bzhed/ gsum pa ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkhar/ 'khor bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang 'khor ba'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i mtshon byed pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa sdong bu rang gi tshangs bug la reg pa/ de'i lte bar byang sems rgyas pas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du skad cig gis ngo bo dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mtshungs med thugs rje'i gter chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rnam pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal ho ru ka sku che chung mtho tshad tsam sgrib gnyis spang pas sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/chos nyid ro gcig tu rtogs pas zhal gcig /bden gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis kyis thabs shes zung du 'jug pas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/phar phyin drug dag pas rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa ste/de yang /spyi por rus pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa rus phreng so gnyis dang ldan pa/ snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long nyis gshibs kyi rnam pa'i snyan rgyan rtse mor gser gyi pa tras mdzes pa/ mgul par rus pa'i gzhung gsum gyi bar rus phreng gis thel 264

zhing dus phreng bsnol mar spel ba'i drwa mig bcu drug sne rnams su drwa phyed zar tshags 'phyang ba/ phyag gi dpung pa gnyis/ mkhrig ma gnyis/ zhabs kyi long bu'i mtshams rnams su rus pa'i gzhung gsum re/ phan tshun rus phreng gis thel zhing drwa phyed ldan pa'i gdu bus brgyan pa/ snying gar mdun rgyab gnyis su rus pa'i 'khor lo de gnyis thel ba'i rus phreng brgyad dang ldan pa se ral kha'am mchod phyir thogs/ sku sked du rus pa'i gzhung lnga rus phreng gis sprel pa la rus phreng gi drwa mig drug cu re bzhi/ /rus phreng gi sne mor dril chung zla ba phon tshar dang bcas pa'i 'og pag ste phyag rgya drug dang / 'don cha sogs su mi gsal yang / rgyud nas thod phreng dngos su bstan pas thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang / thod pa leb mo tshon dmar pos kha mig gi ri mo btod pa'i thod skam lnga'i rtse mor gser gyi pa tra'i nang la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan yod pa/de rnams kyi rtsa bar be+e ḍūr ya'i thag pa gser gyi mu 'brel rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra tshom gyis spud pa'i cod pan dbu'i skra mtshams nas bcings pa 'di dgos sam snyam ste mkhas rnams dpyad par zhu/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/spyi bor rdor sems rang 'dra chung ngu zhig rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing /byin pa gnyis yab kyi sku skad la 'khril te rgyab tu zhabs mthil gnyis sprad pa pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pas mnyam par sbyor ba/ se ral kha spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing thod skam gyi do shal sogs yab bzhin dang rang 'dra'i rigs bdag ma chad pa dgos te yan lag bzhi rdzogs 265

bsdus pa yin pas so/ /de nas yab kyi thub gar zla dkyil dkar po sen mo tsam gyi steng du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo rgyu dkar po spus bris pa lta bu 'grengs stabs su gnas pa/ r+ghaṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rgyu la thim par bsam pa ste/ de rnams ni sdig nyung bshags pa'i yul spyi bo'i rdor sems bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha sogs skyabs gnas thams cad kun 'dus su mos pa ni rten gyi stobs yin la/de yang lha sgom pa thams cad la thang sku dang / gyang sku lta bu'i leb la bcar bcar po ma yin la/ gser sku sa sku lta bu'i dngos po gdos bcas kyi rang bzhin sems med bem po'i rnam pa lta bu ma yin pa snang cha nas spya na gyi dkar nas chun chad ma 'dres par gsal ba la/ stong cha nas dngos po gdos bcas sha khrag nang khrol la sogs pa'i rnam par grub pa med pa/nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon nam/shel dri ma med pa lta bu zhig bsgom dgos pa yin/ sdig ltung bshags pa la gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa'i las byas shing bsags pa thams cad 'dag par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ rnam par sun 'byin pa dang / byang chub sems la brten pa dang / gnyen po sgom pa dang / nyes pa las ldog pa'o/ zhis gsungs la/ de la smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa ni sdig bshags tham sa cad la med du mi rung ste/ byang chung sem sa bstong med 266

na sdig ltung stobs bzhi chang bas bshags kyang srab tu 'gro ba tsam las rtsa ba nas 'dag par ma gsungs/ byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skyes na sngon chad sdig pa'i las ji tsam byas pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par gsungs te/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi zad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba//de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /des ni dus mtha'i mes bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /nyes byas rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad dran zhing sdig pa la sdig tu mthong zhing mi 'chab pa dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po dang ldan pas ma bshags na sdig pa mi 'dag pas de lta bus sdig pa bshags dgos te/ phung po sa/sum pa'i mdo las kyang / mthol lo bshags so//mi 'chab bo/mi sbed do/ zhes dang /spyod 'jug las kyang / mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung //de las ji ltar nges thar zhes//nyid mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni/ 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs//bdag ne mi shes gti mug pas/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang / /bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las//gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams//mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du//thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' zhes mtshan nas bos te bdag rang dang ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi sems can tham / cad kyi tshe 'de dang 'khor ba thog med nas mi shes pa sogs 267

nyes pa 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi la brten nas bsags pa'i sdig pa ni nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba/ sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyes pa ni rang bzhin gyi nyes pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ nye ba'i mtshams med pa lnga sogs dang /nyung ba ni bcas pa'i sang ba so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dang 'gal ba/dri ma ni gnas kyi dri ma sogs drug dang /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i mna' zos pa/ khril dang ngo tsha nyams pa/ las 'bras khyad du bsad pa sogs sdig pa'i las bsags tshad dngos su dran pa thams cad blo la blangs shing / rang gi yid la mi dran pa dang tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa du ma zhig yod nges pas de dag thams cad mi 'chab bo/mi sbed do/mthol lo bshags so//bzod par gsol lo//sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs de dag thams cad dus da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du/'dug sa 'di nyid du lhag ma tsam med par byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol snyam pas snying gi khong nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang bcas pa ni rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs so/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ /sngar byas kyi sdig ltung dag pa la gnyen po bsten dgos pa'ang / spyod 'jug las/ tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang / sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na/ /'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi//nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos//zhes gsungs pas de la/gnyis pa sngags bzla ba la bzhi ste/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/bzla rgyu'i sngags/ ji tsam bzlas ba'i grangs/ bzlas pa'i dgos pa'am phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rdor sems kyi thugs ma'i hūṃ las bdud rtsi dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam pa skya chil chil babs//yab de ru rka'i sku gang / de nas rdo rje'i dbyibs 268

brgyudayum gyi pad+mar babs/ /yum gyi sku gang yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rgyun zil pa phrom mer babs/ pad+ma'i sdong bu la 'khril te rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus kyi dang nas mar dang / bdud rtsi 'ga' zhig pad zla'i steng nas brag mthon po'i kha las chu 'phyar ba bzhin du babs/ rang gi lus kyi phyi dang thams cad bkrus par bsams te/ a bhi dha na las/ phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya/ /zhes gsungs/ de la thun mong ba'i dmigs skor gsum dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor bzhi ste bdun du gsungs pa las/ dang po sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i dmigs pa ni/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun des las nyon sdig sgrib nyes nyung bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rnag khrag chu ser dud khu sol khu lta bu'i rnam pas bshang gci'i lam dang / rkang mthil gnyis nas dbyar gyi sha 'od drag pos bye rdul dang spur ma ded pa ltar phyir bton nas nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar mi dmigs par bsam/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad shel bum dri mas ma gos pa ltar dwangs gsal du song bar bsam/ gnyis pa nad sbyong ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rlung mkhris bad kun sogs nad rigs rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad rlung ljang dmar dang / khu rlangs sngo dmar 'khyil zhing 'tshub pa'i rnam pas sngar bzhin phyir thon par dmigs la mi dmigs par bzhag/gsum pa gdon sbyong ba'i dmigs pa ni/gdon bgegs thams cad sbal sbrul/ sdom sdig rta glang grog sbur sogs srog chags ma rungs pa'i rnam par ded de sbyang bar mos pa byed/ de yang gnyis med ye shes kha dog dang dbyibs las 'das kyang gsang sngags thabs la mkhas pas 269

bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par bsgoms pa des/ sdig pa la'ang gzugs su grub pa med kyang / kha dog nag po sogs dang 'dis bskyed pa'i nad gdon rnams kyang rnag khrag dang srog chags sogs kyi rnam par thon nas lus thams cad zag med kyi bdud rtsis khengs par bsam mo/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor dbang bzhi blang ba la/ khrid yi ga snga ma gzhan rnams las rtsa 'khor gsal 'debs pa ma gsal yang / tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam bshad nyi zer las/ a sgyi sta nar/ dus bzhi dag pa'i rim pa yis//rnal 'byor ma yis dbang yang bskur/ /zhes sasungs pa ltar/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su bdud rtsi byon pas dbang thob pa ra bsgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lus stong sangs phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang gi dbus drang thad sgal tshigs la cung zad nye bar rtsa dbu ma mda' sgyug dang / ro rkyang gro sog si phra sbom tsam sum gshib tu gnas pa mar sne lte thog sor bzhi tsam dang / dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug tu kha gdang nger yod pa/ de nyid la srog shing byas pa'i/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug /snying gar brgyad/lte bar drug cu re bzhi pa rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ltar bkram pa/kha dog rang gi sha mdog lta bu/thams cad kyang sbug stong ldir re bar bsam/ de'ang rang lus stong sang nger bdud rtsi phab ste dbang bzhi blang dmigs byas chog kyang / rdzogs rim zab mo'i smin byed du rtsa sbyong gi cha mthun lta bur 'gro bas rtsa 'khor bsgom pa nyid legs pa yin gsungs/ de la dmigs skor dang po ni/ rdor sems las song ltar bdud rtsi babs/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang / rtse nas phyir 'u da pas 270

smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /rdor sems kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/bum pa'i dbang thob/ sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/gnyis pa ni sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang / ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs gsang ba'i dbang thob/longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ gsum pa ni sngar bzhin bdud rtsi babs/snying ga'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ bzhi pa ni sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dang lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ zung 'jug ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs rkang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa bzla rgyu'i sngags don bshad pa ni/oṃ ni/rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/yi ge oṃ ni ci zhig brjod//mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis brjod//nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar don brgyad la 'jug kyang / 'dir mchog gi dngos grub ster ba la sbyor/ spyir yi ge brgya pa la du ma zhig yod kyang / 'di ni a gi dha nar bshad pa'i he ru ma'i yig brgya yin la/ /de yi dngos bstan la shrī med kyang //thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon gang gang gis/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang la yang //dpal ni nges par sbyor bar bya//zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'phags pa rin po ches bcug pa ltar na/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /271

smin mtshams yan chad gang / lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /rdor sems kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/bum pa'i dbang thob/ sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/gnyis pa ni sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang / ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs gsang ba'i dbang thob/longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ gsum pa ni sngar bzhin bdud rtsi babs/snying ga'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ bzhi pa ni sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dang lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ zung 'jug ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs rkang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa bzla rgyu'i sngags don bshad pa ni/oṃ ni/rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/yi ge oṃ ni ci zhig brjod//mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis brjod//nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar don brgyad la 'jug kyang / 'dir mchog gi dngos grub ster ba la sbyor/ spyir yi ge brgya pa la du ma zhig yod kyang / 'di ni a gi dha nar bshad pa'i he ru ma'i yig brgya yin la/ /de yi dngos bstan la shrī med kyang //thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon gang gang gis/ /lhag pa'i lha ni gang la yang //dpal ni nges par sbyor bar bya//zhes gsungs pa'i don/ 'phags pa rin po ches bcug pa ltar na/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du 'gyur ro/ /271

badz+ra he ru ka ni rdo rje khrag 'thung / sa ma ya dam tshig /ma nu pā la ya bdag la rjes su skyongs shig /gang gis na rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rang bzhin nges don gyi ho ru gas skyong ba'o/ /tshul ji ltar skyong na/ ho ru ka twe no pa te khrag 'thung gis bdag la nye bar mnos pa de rang gi bsam pa bzhin du'o//gang bsam na/ dṛ rnyo me bha wa bdag la brtan pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ /su to skyo me bha wa bdag la dga' ba'i rang bzhin du'o/ /a nu rasto me bha wa bdag la rjes su chags pa'i rang bzhin du'o//su po ṣ+yo me bha wa bdag la mdzes pa'i rang bzhin du'o/ sarba sirnyi the bra yats+tsha bdag la dngos grub thams cad stsol cig sarba kurma su tsa me bdag la las thams cad stsal//ces te tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas bdag rjes su skyongs shigaces pa'i don no/ /bskyangs nas ci byed na/ tsi shrī yaḥku ru bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod/gang gnas par mdzad na/ ju ni 'gyur ba med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ ha ha ha ha bzhi ni ye shes gzhan bzhi/ /ho ni dbyer med pa ste mdor na dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i nges don gyi ho ru ka de bdag gi snying la gnas par mdzod cig/de la tha snyad du mtshan ci zhig brjod na/bha ga wan badz+ra he ru ka bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung zhes bya/ des bdag nam yang gtong bar ma mdzad cig /ces gsol ba ni/ ma me muñtsa bdag ma gtong zhig ces pa'o//he ru ko3 bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa khrag 'thung gi rang bzhin dam tshig gi sems dpa' chen po zhes ched du 'bod pa'o/ /a ni gdod ma nas ma skyes pa chos thams cad kyi sgo ste lha dang sngags dang sgrub pa po rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ngang du ro gcig pa'o/ /: ri don lnga la 'jug kyang / 'dir ni/272

sdug bsngal 'chos shing 'joms byed dang //srid pa'i zhags pa 'joms par byed//ces pa ltar spang bya de dag 'joms pa'i don no/ /phaṭa ni don gsum la 'jug pa las/ 'dir nyes pa dag pa'am gzhig pa la 'jug go /gsum pa ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs ni/ grangs ji tsam mang na bzang bas ci nus nas nyin re bzhin nyung mtha' yang nyer gcig re ma chag pa dang / gzhan yang brgya stong 'bum sogs bzla dgos so/ /bzhi pa bzlas pa'i dgos pa'am phan yon ni/ de la sngar bshad pa'i 'gyod sems dang bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa de rnams la/sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas gtso bor bzlas pa byed/ res spyi bo'i rdor sems kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur rgyan chas sogs gsal 'debs pa'i ngang nas dang / res sems kyi gnas lugs spros bral rtogs pa'i ngang nas bzlas pa byed dgos/ mdor na bzlas brjod gang byed kyang sems dmigs pa las gzhan du ma yengs pa dang / bzlas brjod mi tshig gis bar ma chod pa ni ci nas kyang gal che ste/ bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'phro'i sems kyis ni/ /de lta'i tshul gyis bzla bar bya/ /yul gzhan blo ni 'phros pa yis/ /bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes gsungs la/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas kyang / lo gcig 'bags bsnyen byas pa bas/ /zla gcig smra bcad byas pa dga'//zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i lha sgom sngags bzlas sogs dang byang chub kyi sems sgom pa rnams ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs yin la/ nyes pa las slar log pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa'i las de nyid dran te da phyin chad srog la babs kyang /de lta bu'i sdig pa'i las mi bgyid do snyam pa de yin te/phung po gsum pa'i 273

mdo las kyang /slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom par bgyi'o//zhes gsungs shing /spyod 'jug las kyang / 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas//slad chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid//ces gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i sgom bzlas la brtson pas dngos nyams mi lam sogs su lus las 'bu srin rnag khrag thon pa/ khrus byas pa/ nam mkhar 'phur ba/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ nyi zla 'char ba sogs sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du brtson par bya la/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs thams cad la nyin re bzhin rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag mang po 'byung la/de la sngar bshad pa bzhin yig brgya nyer gcig re ma chag par bzlas/ des ltung ba byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba sdig cing stobs nyams par byed pa dang / rnam smin mi 'phel bar byed pa yin la/ yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na sdig nyung thams cad rtsa ba nas dag par 'gyur te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /lcang sogs byin gyis brlabs 'gyur bas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya//'bum phrag dag ni bzlas gyur na//rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//yi ge brgya pa 'di ni dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi snying po yin te/a sgyi dha na las/dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma//'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te/ /zhes gsungs la/ dri med bshags rgyud las kyang / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying nyams chag dang rtog sgrib thams cad sbyong bar byed pa/274

yi ge brgya pa zhes bya ba bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal po 'di dus gcig la lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas na nyams chag thams cad bskangs te ngan song gsum du nyung ba las thar par 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gis yi dam du bcas nas 'don na/ mi de tshe 'di la'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sras kyi dam par dgongs nas srung skyob mdzad la/ shi 'phos nas kyang bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras kyi thu bor 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ gsum pa bshags sdom bya ba ni/ a gi dha na las byung ba'i/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug gis slar yang sdig skung stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags sdom byed pa yin te/ de la ngor lugs la bla ma bdag ni dang / tshar lugs la mgon po bdag ni zhes gsungs kyang / gnad 'dra ste spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon po dpal rdo rje sems dpal la 'bod pa ste/ 'dis rten gyi stobs bstan/ bdag ni mi shes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs bstan te/ de yang bdag ni rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud sde rnams las dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi dam tshig gi rnam bzhag rgya cher gsungs pa rnams/ji ltar bar mi shes pa blang dor gyi gnas la rab tu rmongs pa ste/ zhes lhung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi las mi shes pa dngos su smos nas/ ma gus pa dang / bag med pa dang / nyon mongs pa gsum shugs las bstan to/ /de'i stobs kyis mnyam gzhag rjes spyod bzang srung mi 'bral ba'i dbang bzhi'i dam tshig rnams las bdag ni 'gal zhing nyes pa phog pa/sa 'bras bu mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa las nyams pa bdas la/ bla 275

ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje sems dpa' khyed kyis skyabs mdzod cig /ces so/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs tshig rkang pa gsum gyis gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs bstan te/ de'ang rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po ste/de nyid kyi thugs ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ 'gro ba'i gtso bo de nyid la snying nas dad pas bdag skyabs su mchi zhing / da phyin chad dam tshig rnams srog gi phyir yang mi gtong zhing bsrung bar bya'o snyam du dam bca' ba'o/ /de ltar byas pas nyes cing thams cad dag yod snyam pa ni nyes pa las ldog pa'am sor chud pa'i stobs so//'di'i mjug tu bla chen 'phags pa'i gsung sku gsung thugs sogs kyi don ni rang gzhan gyi lus snang stong dbyer med lha yi sku ru shes pas skyes pa bud med sogs kyi lus la mi smad cing lus kyi mi dge ba gsum spong ba sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig /rang gzhan gyi ngag gi brjod pa thams cad grag stong dbyer med yi dam lha'i gsung du shes pas ngag la mi smad cing ngag gi mi dge ba bzhi spong ba gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig/rang gzhan gyi yid kyi dran rtog thams cad rig stong dbyer med yi dam lha'i thugs su shes pas yid la mi smad cing / yid kyi mi dge ba gsum spong ba thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin te/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus//las ni du mas bskyed pa na/ /mi shes pas kyang mi bya ste/ /sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /sems can sna tshogs gdungs pa rnams//kun rtog drwa ba'i rnam rtog gis//sems la smad par mi bya ste//thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/phrag dog nyid kyis ma rangs 276

pas//tshig rtsub la sogs smra mi bya//rna ba bde bar byed pa nyid//gsung gi rdo rje'idam tshig go /zhes gsungs so//rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang yan lag gi cing ba brgyad sogs dam tshig nyams pa thams cad ngag gis sba gsang med par mthol lo/ /sems kyis 'gyod pa dang 'jigs pa drag pos bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa 'di gnyis spyir sngar bshad zin kyang / lam 'bras kyi chos skad thun mong ma yin pa ni/ so skye'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs dug lnga dang 'jig rten chos brgyad sogs rang gar rnam rtog rgyun chags skye ba ni nyon sgrib dang / sgom byung nyams skyon can brgyad la shes sgrib tu 'dod/de nyid rgyud bla las/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang ///de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod//ces gsungs pa dang don gcig yin par gsungs//nyes pa/cing ba/dri ma 'di rnams ni sngar bshad zin/de rnams kyi don yid la dran zhing / rdo rje'i thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ngag tu mgon po bdag ni sogs brjod cing / nyes pa'i tshogs de thams cad la sngar byas la 'gyod sems dang phyin chad lus srog gang la thug kyang mi byed pa'i dam 'cha' ba dang ldan pas mthol zhing bshags na/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed kyis kyang bdag gi sdig sgrib nyes cing dri ma'i tshogs de dag byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' dgyes bzhin pa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyed kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag go zhes dbugs dbyung stsal zhing phyin chad de ltar ma byed ces gdams te/legs so sbyin pa'i tshul du 'od dkar por ltem gyis zhu rang gi spyi bo nas thim 277

par bsam pa yan chad ni kun rdzob kyi bshags pa dang /rdor sems rang la thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres song snyam pa'i ngang nas 'dzin pa ma zhugs par chad de 'jog /de ltar bzhag pa'i tshe na sems kyi gsal ba sna tshogs su 'char ba ni/ sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa//zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / sems gsal ba'i rang bzhin stong par gnas pa ni/rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod/ces gsungs pa ltar rdo rje ste/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa thams cad dang bral ba ni don gyi rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ de nyid ngo shes par byas la de kha'i ngang du 'dzin pa ma zhugs par 'jog pa ni don dam pa'i bshags pa ste/thar pa chen po shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gal te 'gyod tshang byed 'dod na/ /drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos//yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /de ni 'gyod tshangs mchog yin no//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gyod tshangs kyi mchog yin par gsungs so/ /de rnams ni 'don char rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sogs nas lta bur gyur bar gyi bsgom bya rnams yin no/ /de nas bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs pa'am dngos gzhi sogs la 'jug go /bzhi pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod tshul ni/ spyir nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa thams cad ni sbyang gzhi yin la/ sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid yin la/ sbyang gzhi de rnams sbyong byed de'i ngo bor snang ba bsgyur nas nyams su len pa ni sbyong tshul 'khor 'das dbyer med yin no/ /gsum pa bshags pa byas pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir sdig pa'i las gang yang bshags pas mi dag pa med 278

de/ sdig pa la yon tan med kyang bshags pas 'dag pa sdig pa'i yon tan yin par gsungs pas/ des na mi dge ba bcu dang / mtshams med lnga la sogs pa dang / so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa dang / dam tshig nyams pa sogs sdig pa'i las ji tsam tshabs che yang tshul bzhin du bshags pa byas na mi 'dag pa med de/sor phreng can dang ma skyes dgra sogs kyis mtshams med kyi las sogs byas pa tshul bzhin bshags pa byas pas phyis dgra bcom pa thob pa sogs mdo las gsungs pa ltar/ klu sgrub kyi bshes spring gi lung gis sgrub pa sngar las 'bras bstan pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa sdig pa ma bshags pa'i nyes pa bstan pa ni/de la mi dge ba'i las bcu po re re la yang rnam smin/rgyu mthun/ bdag 'bras kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos tshul sngar las 'bras bstan pa'i skabs su rgyas par bstan zin la/sdom pa gsum ldan gyi gang zag la yang /sor sdom nyams pa la'ang 'dul ba las/ pham pas dmyal ba tsha ba/ lhag mas ngu 'bod chen po/ cing ba sbom pos du 'bod/ sang byed kyis bsdus 'joms/ sor bshags kyis thig nag nyes byas kyis yang sos bcas kyi sdug bsngal bskyed tshul rgyas par gsungs la/byang sdom nyams na/bslab btus kyi rtsa nyung mjug sdud du/'di dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu//zhes dang / spyod 'jug las kyang / bla na med pa'i bde ba la/ /bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer nas//'gro ba thams cad bslus byas na//bde 'gror ci ga 'gro 'gyur ram/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsang sngags kyi rtsa nyung las/ gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdung kyis gzung bar 'gyur/ /de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur zhing / /279

thur du bltas te dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / yan lag gi dam tshig nyams na yang //de las/ sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i sdom gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa rags par smos pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa yang dpag tu med pa yod pa des/ spyod 'jug las/ skad cig gcig byas sdig pas kyang //bskal par mnar med gnas gyur na/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags sdig gis/ /bde 'gror mi 'gro smos ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / der ma zad rang re shi gson gyi dad rdzas gshin rdzas la longs spyod cing dkor dag bis 'tsho dgos nga/ rnams la/ dpal sprul rdo rje 'chang gis zhal gdams ched du gsungs pa ni/ da lta'i dus grong chog pa rnams kyang tshogs gral sogs su/ 'don nga/ dang bzlas rjod kyi dus smra bcad byed pa ni ci nas kyang gal che/ tha mal pa'i ngag 'khyal dang 'dres pa'i 'don zlos sogs la snying po ci yang med pa dang / khyad par gshin po sogs kyi don yin na/ bar do na gnas pa'i sems can de 'jigs skrag dang sdug bsngal la sogs pas gdungs pa'i tshe phan du re nas yon gnas dang bla mchod la sogs pa'i drung du rgyugs/ de'i tshe de dag gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang sdom pa dang dam tshig ma das pa dang /chags sdang gi gtam dang rtog pa 'char gyin yod na/ bar do'i 'gro ba de mngon shes dang ldan pa yin pas/ de dag shes nas bla mchod la log lta'am zhe sdang skyes nas rkyen des ngan song du 'gro bar bshad pas/de lta bu'i bla mchod mi yod pa las kyang me da pa dga'/khyad pa ra gsang sngags rtso 280

rje theg pa'i chos rnams ni/ bskyed rim gsal 'debs brjod pa tshig gi sgo zhes bskyed rim gyi gnad de dag gsal 'debs pa'i tshig tsam yin pa la/ gsal 'debs rgyu'i bskyed rdzogs kyi don la blo kha tsam yang mi phyogs pa kha tshig stong pa zhig gis gsal gsal bsgom bsgom dmigs dmigs la sogs pa'i cho ga'i tshig rigs mang po zhig gyer ma gyer khug /'ur 'ur chem chem du gyer te/ don gyi snying po ngag gi bzlas brjod bsnyen pa dngos la thug tsa na/ blo bag gis lhod/ tha na lus tshugs drang po zhig yod pa yan chad shig gis bshig /mi dge ba brgya phrag gi 'byung khungs tha ma kha la sogs pa gzhib/ phu mda' la shod kyi gtam 'grel me da kyi ngag 'khyal mang ngo 'i gter sgo phye/ phreng ba stong bgrang rgyu nas 'ded 'ded byed pas dus 'da'/ phyi dro tsa na gnam la gcig bltas nas badz+ra pu ṣ+pe dhu pe zer zhing rol mo 'ur chem pa gtong ba ni/cho ga'i bzugs brnyan las kyang yang brnyan tha chad pa yin pas de lta bu las ni/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas ltung bshags sam bzang spyod tshar re tsam bton pa de dga' nges so /de ltar ma dag pa'i bzlas brjod dang cho ga'i gzugs brnyan la brten nas gshin po ngan song du 'phen pa'i bla mchod des ni/ gson po'i sku rim byas kyang phan las gnod pa che ba de dang 'dra/ de lta bus dkor zos pa yang lcags kyi tho lum me 'bar ba zos pa 'dra ba de yin no/ /des na dad zas dang gshin dkor za ba rnams gi bla ma'am grwa pa su yin kyang 'dra ste/ sha che chung thud srab mthug 'bul ba bzang ngan kho na la thugs dam gyi mthil du mi bya bar nad pa'am shi bo su/ yin kyang 'dra ste sal 'gag la bab ste sdus thus pa 'i sems can skyabs dang 281

bral ba de la phan 'dod kyi byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byas nas bskyed rdzogs rang gis gang shes snying thag pa nas ma yengs par 'bad/ de ltar mi shes pa rnams kyang tshig rjes don dran tsam mam/ tha na yang nyam thag pa'i sems can la byams pa dang snying rje dkon mchog gsum gyi bden mthu bslu ba med pa la dad pa nges shes sogs lus ngag yid gsum chun gcig dril gyis 'bad de/ cho ga dang bzlas brjod sogs sgra dag sgros gtsang ba re 'grub nges byas na/skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i nus mthu/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon tshad med pa rnams la brten nas/ nad pa dang gshin po gang yin de la phan thogs nges shing / mi'i stan thog nas rang gi sgrib pa sbyong zer ba ltar/ rang gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis mnyam du rdzogs/ 'brel tshad thar ba'i lam la 'god pa yin pas de lta bu re ci nas kyang 'bad dgos so/ lar da lta'i dus na bla ma'am ser mo cung zad bzang du re ba rgyu 'bras shes pa rnams ni/ dkor gyi nyes dmigs tsam la 'jigs nas nad pa dang shi bo sdug thug pa'i sems can de la/byin rlabs dang bsngo smon tsam yang mi byed par byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba gcod/ phal cher ni ha cang rang 'dod ches pas sbyin bdag gi tshogs gral du 'ong / de tshang la dgos rgyu'i 'don pa re mi 'don par/ rang gi kha ton nag lcibs lcibs shig blangs te de chag mi nyan pa'i khul gyis 'don tshul byed/ de dag su yin kyang 'dra ste/ rang don gyi 'don pa de dang bzlas brjod sogs cung zad re byed pa de la gzab gzab re byed cing / de rang gi sgrib sbyong dang dkor sbyong yin khul byed/sbyin 282

bdag gi 'don pa mang tshogs kyi gral du byed pa de la ni kha yengs mig gnang khral rgyug ma byed/ gang bskyab par bya rgyu'i sems can shi gson su yin kyang de'i don ni blo la mi 'char ba de rnams ni byams snying rje byang chub sems kyi rtsa ba chad pa yin pas/ rjes nas dkor sbyong byas kyang rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan des dkor sgrib stong ba yang dka'/ dang po nyid nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la gzhi bcol/ bskyed rdzogs sogs ci shes ci nus la snying thag pa nas 'bad/sems can thams cad la phan 'dod kyi kun slong dang ma bral ba byas na/rang gi khyim nas bskyed rdzogs bsgoms te bzlas brjod byas pa dang / gzhan gyi khyim nas bskyed rdzogs bsgoms te bzlas brjod byas pa la ni khyad par spu tsam yang med cing / gang ltar yang rang 'dod kyi blo dang bral te/ gzhan don la dmigs dgos pa ni 'dra 'dra yin pas de lta bu re nges par dgos so/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di ni rdo rje'i gsung 'khrul pa med cing bslu bar med pa yin pas rang cag dkor nag la spyod pa rnams kyis 'di la gzigs rtog re nges par dgos gal che la/ shi gson gyi dad rdzas za ba'i nyes dmigs dang dkor sgrib de lta bu yod pa dang / ma zad deng dus ser skya gang yin kyang dbang ma thob pa med pa lta bu yin la/ dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs te dbang thob pa rnams sdom pa gsum ldan yin pas de dag dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa mang po 'byung ba dang /lhag par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bzhi'i dam tshig nyi shu las mnyam rjes dang / sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig lus lha ngag sngags sems ye shes las skad cig gcig bral yang dam tshig las 'das par gsungs la/ sngags kyi dam tshig 283

nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar skye ba las gzhan med pa yang / sngar rtsa ltung gi lung dang / dam tshig ma nyams na sangs rgyas thob byed kho na yin pa yang / klong chen rab 'byams pa'i zhal nas/sngags la zhugs pa'i skyes bu ngan song dang //sangs rgyas las gzhan 'gro sa gsum pa med//ces gsungs/yang gal te rang ngos nas bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad la mkhas pa dang / bag yod dran shes brtan pa/ bla ma la dad pa 'gyur med sogs kyis rang la dam tshig nyams pa'i skyon med kyang /gzhan rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa dag dang gtam 'dres pa dang / spyod lam gyis 'brel ba/ tha na dam nyams gnas pa'i lung pa'i chu 'thung bas kyang / /zla nyams zhor nyams kyis nyes pa skyed pa yin te/ 'gro margon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ dam tshig ma dag pa dang tshogs 'dres pa dang /spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang / zhes gsungs la/ bshags rgyud las kyang / nyams la 'grogs shing nyams pa skong ba dang / /nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang / /nyams la mi 'dzem nyams pa de dag gi /nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i sgrib gyur rnams/ /rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags/ /zhes gsungs/ yang tshogs gral gcig na dam tshig nyams pa'i mi gcig yod kyang / de'i nyams grib kyis phog ste der dam ldan brgya stong yod kyang sgrub pa'i 'bras bu cung zad kyang mi 'byin pa 'o ma rul pa thigs pa gcig gis ma rul ba zangs gang yang rul bar byed pa bzhin yin te/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'o ma thigs pa gcig /rul bas thams cad rul ba ltar/ /rnal 'byor nyams gyur gcig gis ni//rnal 'byor can kun ma rungs byed//ces gsungs/ der ma zad 284

blam skyes bu dam pa grub thob yin yang / nyams grib kyis mi gos pa med de/grubathob o rgyan pa'i mgur las kyang / gangs can gyi sprang po rin chen dpal//dgra nyams grib min pas thub ma myong / /grogs bla ma min pas skyob ma myong / /zhes gsungs/des na sngar bstan pa'i sdig cing de rnams sbyong zhing bshags pa la/slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pu/ /pad dkar zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/yi dam thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med du bsgoms pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom pa zhes shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug pa yin la/ sngags kyang yi ge brgya pa las lhag pa med tshul sngar bshad pa ltar yin pas/ sngar 'bum gcig bzla bar bshad pa de yang / sdom 'byung las/ rtsod ldan bzlas pa bzhi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'bum bzhi ma mthar byas pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas 'di lta bus sdig snang sbyong ba'i thabs la thams cad kyis 'bad par bya'o/ /rdor sems lha sngags ye shes bdud rtsi yis/ /sgo gsum dkyil 'khor bzhi yi dri bkrus nas//lam dang lta ba grub mtha' 'bras bu bzhi'i/ /bcud bzang 'dzin zhing 'grub pa'i snod rung shog/sdig ltung dri ma sbyong ba'i rdor sems kyi khrid do//285

bzhi pa/ maṇ+ḍal/bzhi ba mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la bzhi/ tshogs gsog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ tshogs gsog thabs kun las maṇ+ḍal khyad par 'phags tshul/ maṇ+ḍal ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul/phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni rang rgyud la lta ba rnam par dag pa stong pa nyid skye zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na/ lta ba stong nyid kyi don ma nor ba rgyud la mi skye la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob pa'i thabs med de/ mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las kyang / bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/ bsod nams ye shes las byung pa'i//dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces gsungs la/ stong pa nyid mngon sum rtogs nas kyang //da dung ji srid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar/ lam gong nas gong du bgrod dgos pas na/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad dgos te/rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i do ha las/ kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi re'i gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang / /bsod nams tshogs chen mi gcog ci nus 'bad par bya//zhes dang / tai lo pa'i zhal nas kyang / bu snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med par ma rtogs bar/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo dang / / 286

bzhi pa/ maṇ+ḍal/bzhi ba mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la bzhi/ tshogs gsog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ tshogs gsog thabs kun las maṇ+ḍal khyad par 'phags tshul/ maṇ+ḍal ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul/phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni rang rgyud la lta ba rnam par dag pa stong pa nyid skye zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs na/ lta ba stong nyid kyi don ma nor ba rgyud la mi skye la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob pa'i thabs med de/ mdo las/ ji srid tshogs gnyis dam pa de ni ma rdzogs par/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las kyang / bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis/ bsod nams ye shes las byung pa'i//dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog /ces gsungs la/ stong pa nyid mngon sum rtogs nas kyang //da dung ji srid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar/ lam gong nas gong du bgrod dgos pas na/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad dgos te/rnal 'byor dbang phyug birlu pa'i do ha las/ kun rdzob sangs rgyas mi re'i gdeng chen ldan gyur kyang / /bsod nams tshogs chen mi gcog ci nus 'bad par bya//zhes dang / tai lo pa'i zhal nas kyang / bu snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /don skye ba med par ma rtogs bar/ /tshogs gnyis shing rta'i 'phang lo dang / / 286

'bralabar ma byed nā ro pa//zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs gsog pa'i thabs la bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rgyal ba thabs mkhas la thugs rje che bas gsungs pa/de kun gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba 'di yin la/de yang maṇ+ḍal gyi mdo dang /rgyud las kyang /sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad la//stong gsum zhing khams ma lus pa/ /'dod pa'i yon tan brgyan pa yis//mchod na sangs rgyas ye shes rdzogs//zhes dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ /zhing 'di rin chen bdun rnams kyis//mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir/ /shes rab can gyis nyin rer 'bul/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs maṇ+ḍal 'di khyad par 'phags pa yin pa'i gnad kyis/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma 'di mdzad pa'i mthus/ chos srid kyi dpal 'byor thams cad gangs can na 'gran zla med par gyur pa dang / de yang zang zing gis tshogs bsags pa phal cher ni sbyor ba rtsol sgrub kyi dus sdig pa'i dri ma/ dngos gzhi 'bul ba'i dus ser sna'i dri ma/ rjes phul zin pa'i dus rlom sems dang snyems pa'i dri ma gsum gyis gos pas tshogs rdzogs dka' la/ maṇ+ḍal ni dri ma de gsum ka med pas tshegs chung bus tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i thabs khyad par can yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ lam 'bras slob bshad kyi khrid yig mkhyen klu gnyis kyis mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi tshogs gsog par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor dang / byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnyis 'chad pa la/dang po maṇ+ḍal la/ de la maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu ni/ rang bi 'byor pa dang bstun nas/ rab gser dngul la sogs rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal/287

'bring 'khar ba la sogs rgyu dag pa/ tha na rdo leb shing leb sogs 'jam pos kyang rung / tshad khru gang las mi chung ba nges par dgos na'ang gser dngul yin na gang 'byor bya//de la 'god rgyu'i tshom bu yang / rab mu tig mu med/ g.yu byur sogs rin po che/ 'bring a bar sgyur sogs sman gyi 'bras bu/ tha ma nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru rigs lhad med dri bzang gi chu'i rlan ldan/shin tu bya btang pa lta bu'i 'byor pa med na/ rdo dkar srin med pas kyang chog ste/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod 'u 'u ri'i gnas su shin tu bya btang ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis rdo dkar rkyang pas maṇ+ḍal phul ba kho nas grub pa brnyes te/ lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus ltar ro/ /de nas mdun du ji ltar mdzes pa'i stegs bu la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal de byi dor legs par byas la gtso 'khor lnga'i tshom bu bkod/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod sogs mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ rang gi mdun du mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal rin po che dang 'bru sogs dngos gtsang dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa sta gon byas la/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ji tsam 'os pa byas la/de nas sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal a sbo tas bsangs/su bhā was snod bcud thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang sne las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma zla ba nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpal kye rdo rje 'al brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum rtso rje bdag 288

medam dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can/ de'i mdun nas g.yas bskor du rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma nas bzung ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar g.yas bskor du bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma la dpal kyai rdo rje lha dgu gtso bor gyur ba'i yi dam/ lhor sangs rgyas sprul sku/ nub tu rtogs pa'i ngo bo rnam pa lung gi chos/byang du byang sems dge 'dun rnams gsal gdab/khrid yig gnyis las de tsam las ma gsungs kyang 'don char/ de rnams kyi mtha' skor du/ mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i thugs rka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhing nas skyabs yul thams cad spyan drangs so so'i sku la thim pas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo por bsam/ de nas khrid yig gnyis las/ phyi nang gsang sogs mchod pa dang bstod pa ci shes pas bstod nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar gsungs kyang / 'dir 'don cha bzhin byas na 'brel chags shing bde bas/ mchod pa thams cad kyi dmigs pa ni/ 'og bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su 'byung ba bzhin shes par byas la/ dang po phyi mchod ni/ oṃ gu ru bu bodhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra a nas/ shasda pra tīts+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la/ thog mar sems can thams cad kyi sems rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad lhag med du dag par gyur cig snyam pas yig brgya bzla bzhin pa'i ngang nas lag g.yon gyis mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal bzung / g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub kyis me tog cung zad bzung nas mkhrig mas yun ring du maṇ+ḍal shin tu dag par phyi dargos te/ ma dag pa cung zad re tsam yod na yang rang sems kyi 289

sgrib pa mi 'dag pa dang / maṇ+ḍal la dag rgyu med na yang rang rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma 'dag pa'i ched du dka' tshegs kyi sgo nas maṇ+ḍal la byi dor byed pa yin pas/ sngon gyi bka' gdams pa sogs bla ma gong ma dag gis phyag gi mkhrig ma brdol nas mir song ba'i tshe/ zur ngos kyis phyis shing / de yang brdol ba'i tshe rgyab ngos kyis phyis pa sogs kyi lo rgyus bzhin/ snam ras sogs kyis mi phyi bar/lag pa'i mkhrig ma kho nas phyi ba sdig sgrib 'dag pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad yod do/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma 'gro mgon chos 'phags rin po ches mdzad pa 'di bzhin bshad na/ rang gi sgo gsum 'jug pa chig dril gyis lus kyis tshom bu 'god pa/ ngag gis tshig brjod pa dang mnyam du sems kyis 'chad 'gyur gyi dmigs pa rnams lam gyis grub par bsam pa rnams chabs cig tu bya/de yang sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis grub pa'i ri gling sogs ma yin par/rgyu rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ rnam pa ri gling sogs zhing khams kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ ngo bo bde stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin du bsams la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dri bzang gi chu cung zad blugs nas gung srin gyis dbang ldan du khrid nas gru bzhi khyem med par byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥs/ zhes brjod pa'i tshe 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum/ rgyar grangs med pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi snying po can gyi mtsho rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad pa/ de'i steng du gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum nyi khri yod pa/ nge gnyis ma'i rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis 290

stong phrag gsum brgya phrag phyed dang lnga yod pa rnams lam gyis grub par bsam/yang ma por bskor la oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥrgyu/ zhes brjod la/ sa gzhi de'i steng gi mthar phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor bar bsam/ de'i dbus su rgyu zhes pa'i tshelag g.yas ma bteg par mtheb mdzub kyis me tog gnas srung gi tshom bu'i tshul du dbus su bkod/bzos pa'i lcags ri yod na 'dir 'god/ de nas ri'i rgyal po sogs brjod pa dang bsnan dbus su tshom bu che ba gcig 'god pa nas rim bzhin tshom bu rnams phyag len ltar 'god/'god tshul yang chang mjug nas blug na ma gus par 'gyur bas chang mgo'am/sor mo lnga bsdus kyi rtse nas 'god/ri rab ces brjod pa'i tshe dbus der ri rab bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa dpag tshad brgyad khri mtshor nub pa/brgyad khri gyen du 'phags pa/shar shel/lho be+e ḍūr+ya/nub pad+ma rā ga/ byang gser las grub pa'i mtha' skor du gser ri bdun rim bzhin bzhi khri sogs byed byed kyis dma' ba/ bar rnams su rol mtsho bdun kha zheng rim bzhin brgyad khri nas byed phyed chung ba rnams dang / ri rab kyi steng du grong khyer lta na sdug dang / de'i dbus su rnam par rgyal pa'i khang bzang sogs sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas dang / bang rim bzhi dang gser ri bdun gyi steng du rgyal chen ris bzhi'i lha'i bkod pa dang / ri rab kyi steng gi bar snang nas rim bzhin 'thab bral/ dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod pa'i lha rnams dang / tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar gyi gzugs khams kyi lha ste lha gnas de rnams kyi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa phun sum tshogs pa lam gyis grub par bsam/ shar du tshom bu bkod la shar lus 'phags po zhes 291

pa'i tshe shar gling dkar po dbyibs zla gam bcad kha chung ba la dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa lcags ri la bstan cing / ngos gzhan gsum la stong phrag gnyis re yod pa/ de bzhin du lho 'dzam bu'i gling zhes pa'i tshe lhor tshom bu dang lho gling sngon po sog kha ngos chung shos lcags ri la bstan pa la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ngos gzhan gsum la stong gnyis re yod pa/nub ba lang spyod ces pa'i tshe nub tu tshom bu dang nub gling dmar po zlum po dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad kyis 'khor ba/ byang sgra mi snyan zhes pa'i tshe byang du tshom bu dang byang gling ser po gru bzhi pa ngos re la dpag tshad nyis stong re yod pa/ de nas shar gling nas rim bzhin gling rang rang gi nub dang shar du gling g.yog gi tshom bu bkod de/ lus dang lus 'phags/rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ zhes gling phran brgyad kyang rang gling las chung ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing / gling de thams cad kyi phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dge bcu'i dpal dang ldan pa ste/de'ang / khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge /khang shing 'bud shing shing gi dge /zhing chu btung chu chu yi dge /khang rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge /gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge /zhes so/nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad khyad gzhi dal 'byor gyi chos bcod brgyad dang ldan zhing / khyad chos mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang /'khor lo chen po bzhi dang ldan pa theg pa chen po'i rigs can dbang po rnon po sha stag tu gyur pas gang bar bsam/yon tan bdun ni/ rigs ldan gzugs bzang longs spyod che/ shes rab phun tshogs dbang phyug ldan/ /nad med shin tu tshe ring ba//mtho ris yon tan bdun zhes gsungs/ /zhes so//'khor 292

lochen po bzhi ni/mthun par gyur pa'i yul du gnas pa dang / /skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang /bdag nyid legs smon sngon yang bsod nams byas//'khor lochen po bzhi ni khyod la mnga'//zhes so/ /de nas shar gling gi nang du tshom bu bkod la/ rin po che'i ri bo zhes pa'i tshe shar gling gsum gyi nang du/ pad+ma rā ga.in+d+ra nī la/be+e ḍūr+ya/margad/rdo rje pha lam/mu tig byu ru sogs rin chen sna tshogs kyi ri grangs med pas mdzes par bsam/ de bzhin du lho gling gi nang du tshom bu bkod la/lho gling gsum gyi dang du/rtsa ba gser/sdong po dngul/yal ga be+e ḍūr+ya/lo ma shel/ 'dab ma spug me tog mu tig dmar po/'bras bu rdo'i snying po ste rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing 'dod rgya'i longs spyod thams cad de las 'byung bas gang ba/ nub gling gi nang du tshom bu bkod la/ nub gling gsum gyi dang thams cad 'dod 'jo yi ba rwa dang mig pa in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can kha dog dmar ser gur gum gyi ri bo 'gro shes pa lta bu spu re re nas nor 'bru ci 'dod 'byung ba sogs yon tan kun ldan gyi khyu yis gang ba/byang gling gi nang du tshom bu dang / byang gling gsum gyi dang thams cad ma smos ma btab pa'i 'bras sā lu sogs lo tog phun sum tshogs pa ji ltar brngas kyang slar skye ba kha dog dang ro bcud phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar bsam/ yang shar gyi tshom bu'i nang du tshom bu bkod/ de bzhin du lho sogs 'gre /'khor lo rin po che zhis pa'i tshe shar gling gi steng gi bar snang thams cad du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa rgyar dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ nam mkhar 'phags te dpag tshad 'bum gyi lam nyin gcig la bgrod par byed pa/ gling bzhi dbang du 293

bsdu nus pa grangs med pas gang ba/ de bzhin du lho gling gi steng gi nam mkhar dgos 'dod thams cad kyi char 'bebs shing 'od kyis dpag tshad sogs snang bar byed pa/ 'od des tsha ba'i dus su bsil ba dang /grang ba'i dus su dro bar byed pa/nad kun sel bar byed nus pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ nub gling gi steng gi bar snang thams cad du gzugs mdzes shing / lta na sdug pa ci 'dod kyi reg bya can phrag dog dang mig ser chung ba sogs yon tan dang ldan pa'i btsun mo rin po che grangs med pas gang ba/byang gling gi steng gi nam mkhar des shing mdzangs pa sa 'og gi gter mthong ba/rgyal po'i bka' thams cad chos bzhin du sgrub nus pa'i blon po rin po che grangs med pas gang bar bsam/ de nas shar lho sogs rim pa bzhin phyi nas phyi ru mtshams rnams su tshom bu bkod la/ shar lho'i steng gi bar snang du yan lag thams cad legs par sa la gnas pa gangs ri 'gro shes pa lta bu pha rol gyi dgra sde 'joms pa'i glang po rin po che mang pos gang ba/ lho nub kyi steng gi nam mkhar gling bzhi nyin phyed tsam gyis 'khor nus shing bsam pa ltar byed pa'i rta mchog rin po che cang shes mdzes pa brgya stong gis gang ba/ nub byang gi nam mkhar pha rol gyi dgra sde thams cad kyi gnod 'tshe med pa chom nus pa'i dpa' stobs dang ldan pa'i dmag dpon rin po che grangs med pas gang ba/ byang shar gyi steng gi bar snang du 'dod rgu thams cad mi zad par len du yod pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa ras bzang gi mgul dkris dang dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsam/ yang shar lho'i bar snang du sgeg mo 294

ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re dku g.yas g.yon du snyems pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing 'gying ba dpag tu med pa/ lho nub kyi bar snang du phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dpag tu med pas gang ba/nub byang gi bar snang du glu ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis tha wang brdung ba la brtson pa dpag med dang / byang shar gyi bar snang du gar ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis 'dzin te gar sna tshogs bsgyur ba dpag med dang /yang shar lho'i bar snang du bdug spos ma dkar mo phyag na bdug spos kyi snod dang bcas pa 'dzin pa dpag med/ lho nub kyi bar snang du me rtog ma ser mo phyag na me tog gi snod za ma tog 'dzin pa dpag med/ nub byang gi bar snang du mar me ma dmar skya phyag na mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa dpag med/ byang shar gyi bar snang du dri chab ma ljang gu phyag na dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa dpag med de dag thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zag med kyi bde ba skyed pa'i nyams 'gyur du ma dang bcas bzhengs stabs kyis 'khod pa sprin phreng 'khrigs pa ltar bsam/ shar gyi nang du tshom bu bkod la/ nyi ma zhes pa'i tshe shar gyi gnya' shing 'dzin gyi steng thad du rgyu nor bu me shel las grub pa dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig yod pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tsha zer 'od kyis phyogs kun khyab pa gcig bsam/ de bzhin du nub tu tshom bu dang nub ngos su nor bu chu shel las grub pa dpag tshad lnga bcu yod pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsil zer gyis phyogs kun khyab pa gcig bsam/ lhor tshom bu dang lho ngos kyi steng thams cad du gser gyi yu ba dang nor bu rin po che'i tog can lha'i rgos 995
