dang / rin po che'i 'phyang phrul du ma'i khor yug can gyi gdugs brgya stong gis gang ba/ byang gi nang du tshom bu bkod la byang ngos kyi steng thams cad du lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs kyis spras pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog dang gser gyi yu ba can mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan grangs med pas gang ba rnams lam gyis grub par bsam/ nyi ma'i tshom bu shar du 'god pa sogs tshom bu 'god tshul 'di ni rje btsun grags pa'i gsung bzhin sa lugs 'khrul med yin la/ maṇ+ḍal dang po 'bul dus shar rang la bstan nas tshom bu bkod na/ 'di nas shar mdun rten la bstan nas 'degs dgos la/ dang po shar mdun rten la bstan na de ga 'dregs chog go /de nas 'bru cung zad phyogs thams cad du bkram/ tog yod na bzhag la maṇ+ḍal de lag pa gnyis gas snying ga'i thad du gus pas 'bul tshul du bzung la/rgyal mtshan gyi dbus su zhes pa ma dag pa yin/ lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa brjod tshe ri gling de dag gi steng dang bar snang ci rigs par/ bkra shis mas rtags brgyad/rin chen sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga sogs mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor mkho rgu yid du 'ong ba ma tshang ba med pas gang bar bsam pa ni gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig yin la/ de lta bu stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor ba ni stong dang po spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya/ yang de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen pos bskor ba ni stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ yang de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig gi mthar lcags ri chen pos bskor ba ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po 296

'jig rten te/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi dang ni nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni//stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no//de stong la ni stong gsum mo//zhes gsungs/ de dag na gling bzhi nyi zla sogs bye ba phrag brgya'am dung phyur bcu yod pa de lta bu zhig gsal btab/de las 'od zer brgya spros pa'i 'od zer re re'i rtse mor rin po che'i pad+ma stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa re re/de dag gi steng du sngar bsgoms pa ltar gyi stong gsum gyi 'jig rten re re/ yang de dag re re las 'od zer brgya re spros pa'i 'od zer re re'i rtse nas sngar bzhin pad+ma stong gsum dang bcas pa re re/ des mtshon te nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa zhig lam gyis bsam/ de'ang chos thams cad bden stong sgyu ma'i 'phrul ltar gdod nas gnas pa'i gnad kyis de thams cad go skabs yangs pa dwangs gsal 'ja' tshon gyi rang bzhin du gsal la ma 'dres par bkra ba ni dngos po 'bul rgyu'i mchog yin/ 'di nyid 'bul yul zhing gi mchog rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i de nyid kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol par shar ba'i skyabs yul rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ bsam pa'i mchog gzhan don kho nas gus 'dud rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis yang dag par dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la mthun rkyen tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing / 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib byang nas/ 'bras bu 'khor 297

'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs nas/ dbang bzhi'i lta ba khyad par can rnams rgyud la skye zhing grub mtha' rnam bzhi snyogs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid khyab bdag nye ru ka chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa'i ngang nas 'bul/mthar zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum logs su ma grub par sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol par shes pa'i lta ba'i rgyas gdab dgos te/ sa chen gyi dbang bzhi ngo sprod las/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum/ /gcig tu bsres la gsol ba thob//ces gsungs pa ltar ro//de nas tshom bu bdun ma dang /chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gsungs pa'i nang tshan/ phyi kun rdzob kyi maṇ+ḍal/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa sogs dang / jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs/ gang rung la grangs gsog ste 'bum phrag gcig 'gro nges bya dgos la/ 'di dag gi dmigs pa yang / tshom bu'i grangs kyis dmigs pa'i khyad par tsam las gzhan snga ma ltar yin la/ grangs gsog gi tshe 'byor pa yod na gro nas sogs maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod 'bru rnying pa yang zlos mi bya bar maṇ+ḍal re re bzhin gsar pa kho nas 'bul/ de tsam ma grub na nyi ma re re bzhin mchod 'bru brje ba sogs gang 'grub dwangs 'dod ngang dngos gtsang bya zhing /phul zin pa'i 'bru rnams bya byi'u long sprang sogs la sbyin pa gtong ba las/rang gis bdag tu bzung nas longs spyod sogs mi bya'o/ /mthar maṇ+ḍal lag pa gnyis kyis btegs te slar yang kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta ra 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad sa paṇa gyi gsung 'di dag tshig rjes don bsgom pa 'i sgo nas brjod 298

par bya ste/ de'ang sgrub pa po gang gi 'bad pas dngos su bshams shing yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas ri gling nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya sogs zhing khams rgya mtsho ltar rgya che ba rnams su rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs snyed kyi rgyal srid bdun dang mchod lha'i tshogs dang bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen bdun sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor sna tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gis/ /rnam par brgyan pa ni zhing khams gcig yin la de las 'od zer brgya 'phros pa'i rtse mor 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi pad+ma la gnas pa'i zhing khams re re de rnams re re las kyang 'od zer brgya brgya 'phros pa'i rtse mor pad+ma dang zhing khams re re yod pas mtshon ste/ de lta bu'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi/ /rdul gyi grangs snyed kyi rin chen las grub pa'i pad+mo rin chen gyi 'od 'byin pa 'dab ma phyogs kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa la/ /ri gling nyi zla sogs lha dang mi yi 'dod pa'i yon tan mid du byung ba 'di dag las 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba can bye ba phrag brgya'i grangs dang ldan pa re re legs pa gnas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji lta ba bzhin du sprul te/ de'ang gang gis sprul na chos thams cad rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol pa yin pas ci yang 'char du rung ba'i rang bzhin shes pa'i shes rab dang / thabs dad pa dang snying rje chen pos 'gro kun sdug bsngal las bsgral 'dod gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin gyi ngo bo rnam par dag pa 'di/ /yul chos kyi dbyings kyis ji 299

ltar khyab pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams kun tu ma khyab pa med pas kun la khyab cing dus sems can gyi khams dang chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' ji srid du gnas pa/ /de srid du rnam par gnas pa'i sgo nas zhing gi mchog rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ye shes gcig pu'i rnam rol las byung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la 'khor rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang rang rgyal nyan thos dang bcas pa nyon mongs pa'i dgra las rnam par rgyal ba dgra bcom pa dang chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs kyis/ /kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa kun la dus rtag tu rnam par mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod pa lags na thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde ba kun gyis mnyes par gyur cig /ces dang / dus de ring nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar te sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ /dngos po bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum du bsags shing gsog par 'gyur pa'i dge ba'i dngos po ji snyed mchis pa rnams//ched du bya ba sems can kun gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don rgyun mi 'chad par bgyid par nus pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ tshul sgo gsum gus pa chen pos/ zhing bla ma rgyal ba sras slob dang bcas pa khyed rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sems can thams cad la nyin mtshan dus drug tu thugs rje chen pos kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan pa//gang la yon phul na phan bde'i dpal mi zad par 'byung ba'i yon gnas dam par gyur pa khyed rnams kyis/ bdag la brtse bas nye bar 300

dargongs te/ /bdag gi mchod pa'i tshogs 'di dag bzhes su gsol//bzhes nas sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa sogs 'phral dang yun du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol//zhes dang / de nas oṃ ni mchog ster ba/ 'bul ba'i zhing gu ru ste gong ma'i yon tan gyi khur gyis lci bas bla ma dang bu sku bzhi mngon gyur sangs rgyas dang bodhi satwa nye sras brgyad sogs byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / sa pa ri wā ra mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnar lha'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ 'bul rgyu'i dngos po rat+na ste rin po che las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ste 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i ri gling nyi zla sogs kyi dkyil 'khor lha mi'i longs spyod dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i pu dza mchod pa me gha sprin te tshogs pa sa mu dra rgya mtsho ste grangs las 'das pa spa ra ṇa 'phro ba sa ma ya dam tshig gam mi 'da' ba ste rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal gyi mchod sprin gyi tshogs rgya mtsho ltar grangs med par 'phro ba 'di mchod yul khyed rnams kyis so sor bzhes shig /rgyu ni 'jig pa dang gcod pa sogs la 'jug pas/'dir tshogs rdzogs te las nyon gyi rgyun 'jig cing / sdug bsngal gyi myu gu'i rgyun gcod cing sangs rgyas thob pa'o/ /de ltar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i skabs su sngar bshad pa ltar gyi dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu phul na dngos su phul ba dang khyad par med pa'i phyir tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur te/ sngon dbul po zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srung dang mjal/ dad pa skyes kyang 'bul rgyu gzhan med par rde'u 'ga' zhig nor bu yin par dmigs nas phul ba'i bsod nams kyis phyis shākya thub pa bzhugs pa'i dus su skyes/ skyes ma thag rin po che'i 301

char bab cing bang mdzod thams cad rin po ches gang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba du ma dang bcas pas/ khye'u lha yi rin chen du btags/ nar son pa na rab tu byung ste dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par gsungs pa bzhin yin la/ gzhan du sems rgya yan la btang ste ra gan sgor mo zhig gi steng du 'bru ji tsam blugs kyang tshogs mi rdzogs pas cis kyang ma g.yeng pa gal che gsungs so/ /de nas nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi dngos yod pa'am/ med kyang mtheb srin gyis 'bul tshul bya zhing /dngos grub 'gugs shing mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rdzas/ /sogs tshigs bcad gang rigs kyis 'bul/de nas gsang mchod 'bul ba ni/gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim bde ba'i ro/ /sogs gang rigs dang / de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yang / mchod yul gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa dang / /sogs brjod la don la mnyam par bzhag/bstod pa ni/gang drin ma dang /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos//sogs dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod gsol 'debs gang mang dang /byams dang brtse ba'i shing rtas sogs yan lag bdun pa dang bcas pa'am de tsam mi nus na/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dkon mchog la/ /sogs nas/myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/bar gyis gsol ba btab/de nas mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i sogs nas snying gar pad+ma zla nyi'i steng du bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod cing don bsgom/ snying ga'i bla mar dad mos rtse gcig pas de nyid la yid cung zad mnyam par bzhag /de nas snying ga'i bla ma dam pa la/thos pa'i mchod yon/yon tan gyi me tog tshul khrims kyi bdug spos sogs tshig ris dang mthun pas mchod par bsams la/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun 302

nas 'khyil/ /sogs dang / skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang / /sogs bsngo smon rgyas par brjod nas thun las ldang ba'o/ /bzhi pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi khyad par bstan pa ni/ sngar bstan pa de rnams ni phyi kun rdzob rdzas kyi maṇ+ḍal yin la/ da nang rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal ni gsang dbang gi khrid kyi skabs dang rlung dang gtum mo'i nyams len skabs kyi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi dus su 'bul te skyabs sems dang tshogs zhing bskyed pa nas bla ma spyi bo nas zhugs te snying gar bzhugs pa'i bar sngar bzhin la snying ga'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus de la nang rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yin pas/don yid la dran bzhin pas/ de yang ho badz+ra las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa'i de nyid rab tu phye//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang zhing mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan la/ 'khor lo chen po bzhi mnga' ba'i rdo rje'i lus khyad par can 'di'i phyi pags pa 'di nyid 'og gzhi rlung dkyil rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbyibs su chags pa'i steng du gser gyi snying po can gyi chu dkyil de'i steng du dbang chen gsor gyi sa gzhi dang bcas pa lam gyis grub/ de la lus kyi dang gi rak+ta'i ste khrag gi rlan gyis kun nas byugs shing chag chag btab pas/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs kyi snying po can gyi rgya mtshor gyur/ lus kyi sgal tshigs rnams dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi las thon pa'i ri'i rgyal po lhun po rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa la bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa dbyibs gru bzhi pa lcog bzhi dang ldan pa/bang rim la rgyal chen ris bzhi dang /steng du sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha gnas kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ phyi rol du gser ri bdun 303

dang / rol mtsho bdun dang bcas pas khor yug tu gru bzhir bskor ba rnams lam gyis grub/ lus kyi yan lag rkang lag bzhi yi ni shar lus 'phags po sogs gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa snod bcud kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa lam gyis grub/ lus kyi nang gi rtsa g.yas ro ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin de nyid nor bu me shel las grub pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / g.yon rkyang ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin de nyid nor bu chu shel las grub pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su lam gyis grub/ rtsa dang gi khams dkar dmar byang chub kyi sems rnams ni bshad ma thag pa ltar nyi zla dang /gzhan yang gser dngul rdo rje pha lam la sogs pa/lha dang mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa lam gyis grub/nang gi glo mchin sogs don snod dang lus tshor bde ba'i cha dang bcas pa rnams 'khor lo rin po che nor bu rin po che sogs rin chen sna bdun du lam gyis grub/ khams bdud rtsi'i ngo bo spyi bo'i ha de nyid gtum mo'i mes bzhu btul byas pa las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas gzhan rkyen la ma bltos pa'i zag med lhan skyes kyi bde stong bskyed pa ni 'dod rgu thams cad bzho ru yod pa'i 'dod 'jo'i ba bzang po dang /lus rtsa sprul sku/rtsa yi ge longs sku/ khams bdud rtsi chos sku ste sku gsum rang lus la lhun grub tu yod pa ni sa bon ma btab cing ma rmos par 'khrungs pa'i lo rtog dang / rtsa 'khor rnams dang de dag las gyes pa'i rtsa phran sna tshogs pa rnams ni dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba dpag bsam gyi shing du lam gyis grub/ mdor na rang gi lus dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rang bzhin 'di ni gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan mtha' yas kyi gzhir 304

gyur pa de nyid da lta zas gos 'bru sogs longs spyod dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa dang bcas pa rnams ni 'bulargyu'i dngos po dang / gang la 'bul ba'i zhing ni rang gi snying ga'i dbus su lus kyi dwangs ma'i thig le chu skyes zla nyi bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng der brtan par bzhugs pa'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bo sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku khyed la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos 'bul lo/ /dgos pa gang gi phyir 'bul na bdag dang ma gyur mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub khyab bdag he ru ka khyed kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du 'bul na dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi go 'phang de bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis dus da lta nyid du thob par shog cig /mthu stobs thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed kyis kyang de ltar 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol//oṃ gu ru sogs brjod cing grangs gsog la 'bul/de nas thos pa rgya mtsho ma'i mthar skye ba kun tu sogs brjod la thun las ldang ngo / yang sher dbang dang / dbang bzhi pa'i khrid dang nyams len gyi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi skabs lta bur/ gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul na/ gong ltar bla ma rang la bstems pas snying gi dbus su sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa de nges pa don gyi bla ma dang yi dam dbyer med du shes par byas la de la gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul te don dran bzhin pas/ de yang phyi snod kyi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'di nyid ri gling kun gyi gzhi yin pa ltar/ ji skad du/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings//chos rnams kun gyi gnas 305

yin te//zhes pa ltar/ kun gzhi'am rgyu rgyud kyi sems kyi chos dbyings kyang / rje btsun grags pas/ rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu yi rgyud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sems rang bzhin gyis spros bral 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhir gyur ba'i sa gzhir/ theg chen gyi rigs sad pas/ ris med kyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las skyob par 'dod pa'i snying rje'i rlan gyis byugs shing khyab pa/ /de nyid dbang bzhis smin par byas nas/ lam bzhi bsgoms pas lta ba snang stong gsal stong bde stong zung 'jug gsum rtogs pa'i sems nyid ni lam gyi yon tan thams cad 'byung bas na/ rdo rje gur las/ 'di ni rin chen sems su brjod/ /'dod don 'bras bu rab ster ba//zhes gsungs pa ltar/rin chen las grub pa'i ri rgyal lhun po lta bu dang /gling bzhi'i sems can gtso bor gyur ba'i mkha' khyab kyi sems can dmigs yul du byas nas/ byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms te tshad med bzhi thun mong thun min gnyis kyis bsgom pa ni ri rab la gling bzhis brgyan pa lta bu dang / gnas skabs grub mtha' rnam bzhi snyogs pa dang / mthar 'gros bzhi thim nas/ rten dang brten pa gnas 'gyur gyi sku lnga ye shes lnga thob pa la sgrib byed ni zhi gnas lta ba'i dug rnam rtog rgyun chags rtsol ba nyon sgrib dang / lhag mthong bsam gtan sgom pa'i dug lta ba skyon can brgyad shes sgrib ste de dag ni mun pa dang 'dra la/ de dag gi gnyen po thabs snying rje chen po dang bskyed rim phyi nang gnyis dang / shes rab lta ba skyon med gsum bcas zung 'jug tu bsgoms pa ni sgrib gnyis mun pa'i gnyen po nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu dang / thog mar sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa nas lta sgom spyod pa thams 306

cad sems can gzhan don du sgrub pa ni rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i gzhi yin pa ni 'dod 'jo'i ba lta bu dang / /yang rje btsun grags pa'i zhal nas/gsal ba sprul sku stong pa chos kyi sku//zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin yang //zhes gsungs pa ltar/rgyu'i gnas skabs su'ang sku gsum lhun grub kyi tshul du yod pa de nyid/ji skad du/rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste//mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas 'gyur yin//zhes pa ltar/lam bzhis dri ma rnams sbyangs nas/ /mthar thug gnas 'gyur chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan thob nas zag med kyi yon tan sde tshan nyer gcig la sogs pa'i lo tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nges pa lnga ldan dang / sprul sku mchog dang bzo dang skye ba sogs ye shes kyi phrin las sku ston pa brgya byin lta bu/gsung 'doms pa lha'i rnga bo che lta bu sogs kyis sems can gyi don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni/ dpag bsam gyi shing 'bru lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs lta bu ste/ 'di rnams ni rang sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i yon tan kun tha snyad kun rdzob tu 'bul rgyu'i dngos po lta bu dang /'bul yul dbang yon tan rim pa las/ rang sems bla mar snang ba de/ /gnyis med slob dpon dam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang sems rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i chos sku dges pa rdo rjer snang ba'i bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje slob dpon la/ /gus pas 'bul gyis don dam par rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing gang zag med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 307

'bul bya 'bul byed tha dad ma grub pa'i gnas lugs brjod bral bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i ngang bskyangs te 'bul bya 'bul byed bral ba'i ngang nas phul bas bdag sogs ma gyur mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad la thun mong gi dngos grub las bzhi dang / grub pa chen po brgyad dang mchog gi dngos grub rang don gyi che ba sku lnga ye shes lnga thob nas rang gzhan gnyis kyi che ba 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas te sangs rgyas pa dang / gzhan don gyi che ba long bas gzugs mthong / 'on pas sgra thos pa/ sa nas sar 'phar ba sogs kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ oṃ gu ru sogs dang sngags don ni sngar bzhin no/ /'di yang grangs bsags la ci nus su 'bul/ de nas thos pa rgya mtsho sogs gong bzhin du brjod la thun las ldang ngo / /yang thun gcig gi steng du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar 'dod na/ thog mar phyi'i maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong bzhin nyams su blang mthar bla ma rang la bstems te snying ga'i dbus su bzhugs pa la nang rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du shes pa de nges pa don gyi bla ma yi dam dbyer med du nges pa'i sgo nas gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas/ thos pa rgya mtsho sogs brjod la thun las ldang ngo / /nang dang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'di gnyis ni lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag cha tshang thob pa'i skal ba yin gyi gzhan gyi ni ma yin no/ /de ltar maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa gang 'bul yang /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa gsungs pa bzhin/ ngo bo gtsang zhing rang gis kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bya zhing / /'bul rgyu'i dngos po yang 'bru rtsam ja 308

'bul bya 'bul byed tha dad ma grub pa'i gnas lugs brjod bral bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i ngang bskyangs te 'bul bya 'bul byed bral ba'i ngang nas phul bas bdag sogs ma gyur mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad la thun mong gi dngos grub las bzhi dang / grub pa chen po brgyad dang mchog gi dngos grub rang don gyi che ba sku lnga ye shes lnga thob nas rang gzhan gnyis kyi che ba 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas te sangs rgyas pa dang / gzhan don gyi che ba long bas gzugs mthong / 'on pas sgra thos pa/ sa nas sar 'phar ba sogs kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ oṃ gu ru sogs dang sngags don ni sngar bzhin no/ /'di yang grangs bsags la ci nus su 'bul/ de nas thos pa rgya mtsho sogs gong bzhin du brjod la thun las ldang ngo / /yang thun gcig gi steng du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar 'dod na/ thog mar phyi'i maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong bzhin nyams su blang mthar bla ma rang la bstems te snying ga'i dbus su bzhugs pa la nang rdo rje lus kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du shes pa de nges pa don gyi bla ma yi dam dbyer med du nges pa'i sgo nas gsang ba zung 'jug sems kyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas/ thos pa rgya mtsho sogs brjod la thun las ldang ngo / /nang dang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'di gnyis ni lam 'bras kyi gdams ngag cha tshang thob pa'i skal ba yin gyi gzhan gyi ni ma yin no/ /de ltar maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa gang 'bul yang /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa gsungs pa bzhin/ ngo bo gtsang zhing rang gis kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong bar bya zhing / /'bul rgyu'i dngos po yang 'bru rtsam ja 308

mar sogs kyi phud dang gang bzang ba rnams dkon mchog la 'bul/ de'i 'phro ma dang dman pa rnams rang gis longs spyod dgos/ de ltar ma yin par rang gi za 'phro sogs 'bags btsog can dang 'bru rtsam sogs ngan pa de mchod rdzas byed pa dang / mar la'ang kha tsha rul ba nas mchod me dang mchod mar byed pa rnams ni bsod nams zad pa'i rgyu yin pas nges par spang dgos/ gzhan yang dpal sprul rin po ches/ rang la yod bzhin du mchod sbyin gyi phyogs su gtong mi bra bar/ sngags dang dmigs pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan bden bden yin yin mang po bkod nas yin rlom byed pa ni rang mgo rang gis bskor ba yin/ zhes gsungs/ yang jo bo rje'i zhal nas bod bsod nams dman pa ni gtor zan sla bas so/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ bzo sla ched sla mo byed mi rung bas tshogs dang gtor ma la gar sla rang gis za ba'i tshad tsam byed dgos/ yang tshogs gsog pa la chu gtsang mas yon chab phul ba yang phan yon bsam gyi mi khyab pa yod de/ jo bo rjes/ bod na chu gtsang dwangs ma 'dis bsod nams gsog thabs chog par 'dug go /gsungs pa ltar/ yon chab de yang ting bdun sogs byi dor legs par byas/ gral bsgrigs pa'i tshe bar yang dog 'tsham pa dang / ya yo med pa chu nang du 'bru spu rdul srog chags sogs med pa dang /ma gang ba dang /ha cang gang drags pa sogs ma yin pa mchod stegs kyi steng du chu bo ba sogs kyang med par mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bya ste/ bzang spyod las kyang / bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog rnams kyis/ /gsungs pa ltar/ mchod pa gang yin yang tha na bshams tshul yan chad mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba byas na rgyal ba sras bcas la 309

gus pa'i rgyus rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa yin pas cis kyang 'bad par bya'o/ /dka' tshegs chung ngus rgya chen tshogs gsog thabs/ /maṇ+ḍal chung ngur rgya chen mchod sprin rnams/ /rgya chen dge tshogs lus longs rgyur byas 'dis//rgya chen ma gyur 'gro rnams sangs rgyas shog /mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid do//lnga pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/lnga pa byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la lnga/sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs te sangs rgyas thob pa la tshogs gsogs shing bla ma la brten dgos tshul/ tshogs gsog thabs kun gyi gtso bo bla ma la brten pa yin pa/ bla ma la brten nas tshogs bsags pas sangs rgyas myur du thob pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ji ltar nyams su len tshul/ rjes spyod lam ji ltar skyong ba'o//dang po ni/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya//zhes gsungs te/ de'ang tshe gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs dgos la/de lung rigs gtan tshigs gang gis kyang bstan par mi nus te/la dog yi ge yon tan dpe bral ba/ /smra ru mi btub gyi na tsam gyis mtshon//zhes dang /tai lo nga la ci yang bstan du med//rang gis rang la mtshon te shes par byos//zhes gsungs/brjod mi nus par ma zad rang gi lus kyi phyi nang sha khrag don snying 310

nas bzung ste phyi rol gyi ri ra ba'i bar gyi snod bcud gang du btsal yang /sems la kha dog dbyibs gzugs su grub pa cung zad tsam yang med pas rnyed par mi nus/ 'o na rtogs pa'i thabs med dam zhe na/ma yin te/ bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs te/thabs bla ma la mos gus dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa la brten nas rtogs par 'gyur ba yin te/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs bar/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/bsod nams gsog pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa yin te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa la bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa'i bar du bsnyen bkur ba las/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba sru'i bu ga la til gyis byugs pa ches bsod nams khyad par 'phags so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang bsod nams gsog pa'i yul thams cad bsdu na dkon mchog gsum la 'dus la/ de thams cad bla ma la tshang ste/ sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa yin la/ des mtshon pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha thams cad bla ma la 'dus pa yin te/ phung po lnga ni rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi shin tu rnam dag bde ba chen po dang lnga ni yum lnga/ mig sogs nang gi skyed mched ni byang chub sems dpa'/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo drug /tshigs chen brgyad la sogs pa ni khro bo bcu yin la/bdag cag la sogs pa'i skal pa dman pa'i don du phung lams skye mched kyi rnam par 311

ston pa ste/gang phyir rdo rje sems dpa' zhes//de nyid slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te//sems can 'dul ba'i don dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su ston par mdzad//ces gsungs so//gsum pa ni gsang ba 'dus par/ /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur//zhes gsungs pa ltar//lha dang 'byung po la sogs pa'i mchod pa thams cad spangs te/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bla ma mchod pa la brtson par byas na kun mkhyen gyi ye shes zhes bya ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ ri dbang rtse nas gang zhig lhung gyur na/ /lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur//bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur//zhes 'thad pa dang bcas te gsungs/'o na dngos grub de thob pa la yun ring du dgos sam snyam na min te/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud kun spyod las/gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid//skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang //bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku//sogs gsungs te/ bla ma gang gi drin gyis bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dus ring po ma yin par skad cig tsam la 'char ba yin/ dpe 'jig rten na yid bzhin gyi nor bu khyad par 'phags pa yin mod/des tshe 'di'i bde skyid tsam las phyi ma nyan rang gi rnam grol tsam yang 'byin mi nus na/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang lta ci smos/ bla ma ni de lta bu'i go 'phang tshe 'di la ster nus pas nor bu las kyang khyad par 'phags pa yin la/sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /312

kun gyi byed po bla ma yin//bla ma dpal ldan he ru ka/ /zhes dang / sa ṭi las/nang gi dbye ba 'di nyid ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya//bla mar dman pa'i sems can rnams//sngags dang dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur//zhes dang /gur las/slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma//'di nyid yin par shes par bya//zhes gsungs/ /'o na yi dam dang sangs rgyas sogs yod pa de dag las kyang bla ma lhag pa yin nam snyam na/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas spangs rtogs kyi sgo nas khyad par med kyang / sku drin gyi sgo nas bla ma lhag ste/ /sangs rgyas rdul gcig gi steng na rdul phra rab kyi grangs mnyam bzhugs kyang / las ngan can du ma tshogs pa'i dus 'dir sku dngos su mthong ba'i skal pa med/ gsung dngos su mi thos/ de'i rkyen gyis thugs kyi ye shes ji lta ba 'jug ma thub pa la/ bla mas rang dang skal pa mnyam par bstan pas sku dngos su mthong / des bstan pa'i chos thos shing nyams su blangs pas sgrib gnyis je dag dang tshogs gnyis je rdzogs las sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par nus pa yin te/dper na nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba/nyi ma 'od tsha ba/spra ba rlan med pa gsum 'dzoms kyang me shel lam/rgya long lta bu'i 'od bsdu chas shig med na/ nyi ma ji tsam tsha yang spra ba la me 'bar mi nus la/ shel lta bus 'od bsdus pa na skad cig tsam la me 'bar ba bzhin du/sangs rgyas ji tsam thugs rje che yang //rgyud ma sbyangs pa'i sems can la dngos su ye shes 'jug mi nus la/bla ma la sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus nas gsol ba btab pas myur du byin rlabs 'jug pa yin te/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang //me shel med 313

par me mi 'byung //de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang //bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs/de ltar rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung nas bshad par ma zad/par phyin sdud par/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes dang / ba tshwa can chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid mkhan po'i gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces dang /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis lam zab bla ma zhes tshig nyung la don rgyas par gsungs la/rdo rje dril bu pas/bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni//skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin//zhes dang /sa ra has/ bla mas smras pa gang yin snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra//zhes dang /yang rgyud las/gang gis bskal pa bye ba ru//lha sku 'bum phrag bsgoms pa las//bla ma skad cig dran pa mchog /ces gsungs/ des na rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa skyed par byed/skyes pa bogs 'byin pa/gegs sel ba/brtan par byed pa thams cad bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho na la rags las shing / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du bya ba'i dus na'ang bla ma mi spong ba ye shes kyi dam tshig tu 'dzin pa sogs mdor bsdu na rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du bla ma gtso bor bstan pa yin gsungs/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ji ltar nyams su blang zhing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul ni/ bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'bol la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yid 'khul nges shes par bya/ su bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de nyid dag 314

gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa shin tu mtho zhing yangs pa stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa/ nor bu'i tog tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na ye re ba'i rnam pa can/ de'i nang rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad tsam gyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma/ bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi/ yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can bdag la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor skya 'khyil le ba'i steng du dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ /mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo lhadamar po/ /thugs gar nyi ma'i steng du bugs rdo rje'i ngo bo rgyu sngon po/ /de thams cad kyang me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu/ /phyi gsal nang gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du sgom par byed/ /thugs ke'i rgyu las 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs kha dog sna tshogs pa bun gyis 'phros 'og min la sogs steng phyogs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rab 'byams dang / des mtshon pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ 'og phyogs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du khyab/ de dag na bzhugs pa'i gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pas gtso byas dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mala' 'gro chos 315

skyong srung ma ye shes pa thams cad 'od zer des bskul bas bos pa lta bu'i tshul gyis phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas srin chen po 'jibs pa bzhin thib thib byon/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dbu gtsug nas zhabs sen gyi bar sku'i cha shas thams cad du rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa'am/ bye ma la chu sim pa ltar sib sib thim pas/skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam/ de nas phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i nyer spyod lnga nam mkha' gang bar spros nas 'bul/bla ma dam pas bdag gir bzhes/thugs rgyud bde chen gyis mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ mahā gu ru ma nas shasta pra tits+tsha swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod sogs rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spros/ bla ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol ba dang /thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba sku la thim/ bde chen gyi ye shes kyis mnyes par bsams la/ dngos grub 'gugs shing mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rdzas//sogs nas/suhā'i bar brjod la mchod/gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ yang pad+ma can dang dung can ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgya mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba nam mkha' gang bar spros/ de dag gis 'o dang /'khyud pa dang /snyoms par 'jug pa la sogs pas mnyes par bsams la// gzugs mdzes sgra snyan sogs nas lha bar gyis mchod/de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/de lta bu'i mchod bya mchod byed mchod rdzas la sogs pa de thams cad rang sems gcig nyid de dang der shar ba ma gtogs/ sems las logs su grub pa cung 316

zad tsam yang med/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'jog la/ mchod yul gyur pa'i bla ma dam pa sogs nas rol par blta bar brjod/ de ltar mchod pa bzhi rdzogs par phul bas bla ma dam pa'i thugs bde chen gyi ye shes kyis shin tu mnyes te zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa/bdag la bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad pa/mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i nus pa can du thag bcad la/ bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /sogs dang /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos//sogs/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku//zhes dang /sku 'gyur ba med pa bla ma'i sku//sogs ci shes pas bstod/de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ tshe 'di phyi'i re ltos skyabs mgon gcig phur blo phugs rtse gcig tu gtod/ bla ma dang rang sems 'dres song snyam pa'am/tshur bla ma rang la thim song snyam pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos bla ma'i thugs ku'i thad du yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu gtad de/ rnam rtog gzhan gyi 'jug pa'i rgyun rbad kyis chod par byas te/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/zhes dang /mchog gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang //skyabs gzhan spangs nas mi phyed dad pa'i mthus/ /mkhyen brtse'i phyag gis mi 'bral dam du 'khyud/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs//zhes lus ngag yid gsum 'gyur ba ma thon bar du gsol ba gdab/de nas/rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis 317

brlab tu gsol/ yi dam kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dam/ chos kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dge 'dun kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa ci rigs dang / sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthu stobs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen birlu pa la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol /grub chen shar phyogs nag po pa la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas rim bzhin du brjod de gsol ba gdab/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa rin chen mkhyen brtse dbang po la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos lam du longs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis brlab 318

tu sasol/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams dang snying rje 'byongs bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos min gyi snang ba skad cig kyang mi skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ cir snang sems su shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems snang sgyu mar shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/sanas lugs brjod bral rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug sku bzhi'i bdag nyid khyab bdag he ru ka chen po'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur ba nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de la 'gal rkyen gegs kyi rnam pa gang yang mi 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mthun rkyen thams cad 'bad med lhun gyis grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba tshig tsam ma yin par snying nas gdab/ slar yang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sogs tshig lhug gam/gsung ngag slob bshad 'dzin pa'i 'dren pa la//chos la yid ches rnyed pa'i nges pa yis//rang sems 'od gsal dad dang dga' spro'i ngang /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ 'di dang gong gi tshigs bcad gnyis ka klu sgrub kyi gsung yin pas 'di dag gang rung ngam/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs so gas gsol 'debs brgya stong nas 'bum phrag sogs kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su la tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying gi dkyil rus pa'i gting nas 'u sa kyi ba spu g.yo ba mig mas mchi ma 'khrugs nga /blo snga bla mas 'phyogs pa lus 319

sems tshugs mi thub pa zhig ma byung gi bar gsol ba 'debs par byed/ des mtshon pa'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs kun bzang dbang bzhi ma sogs dang / de dag kyang bla ma rgyang 'bod kyi tshul lam gdangs shub bur ram skad kyi nga ro chen po nas brjod pa sogs mdor na sems gang 'khul gyi sgo nas bya zhing / nyams snang ma skyes kyi bar du nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa'i tshul du nyams su blang / de ltar byas pas bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang bzhin dang nas rang byung gi tshul du 'char ba yin/ dngos gzhi'i lam gyi nyams rtogs skye mi skye 'di la rag las pas rtse gcig tu nyams su len dgos so/ /yang 'bum lnga gsog pa sogs lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyong phyir phyag 'tshal ba ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la cing bshags kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba'i mdun du ltung bshags 'don zhing phyag 'tshal na yang chog la/ yang na sngar bshad pa'i skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing gi mdun du skyabs 'gro dang sbrags nas phyag 'tshal na'ang chog kyang /lhag par bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba bzang bar gsungs pas/'dir phyag 'tshal tshul 'chad pa la/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba gsum/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyag gi ngo bo ni/ phyag byed pa'i gang zag de yi yid kyis bskul ba'i lus ngag gi rnam pa rig byed kyi gzugs yin te/ yang grags pas/ngo bo phyag byed gang zag de yi ni/ /yid kyis bskul ba'i lus ngag rig byed do//zhes gsungs/ nges tshig ni/ gong ma 'khur zhing bkur ba'i phyir sgo gsum gus shing 'dud pa la phyag 'tshal ba zhes brjod de/rje btsun gyis/ phyag ces bya ba 'di yi nges tshig ni/ gong ma 'khur byed sgo gsum 320

'dud phyir ro//gsungs/ dbye ba mang yang / dkon mchog rten la dad pas gus phyag dang / /zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas nas bshad na/ phyag 'tshal ba'i gnas dang yul gyi khyad par yang /rje btsun rin po che'i zhal nas/phyag gi gnas ni dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ /bla sgo rab 'bring tshogs pa'i spyan sngar ro/ /phyag yul bla ma dkon mchog rgan pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang /phyag ji ltar 'tshal ba'i tshul yang / de nyid las/dkon mchog lha phyag bya yis sug bab med/ /ces gsungs pas/dkon mchog la lus kyis dngos su lha phyag 'tshal ba yin gyi/ lag pas phyag bab byed pa sogs kyang ma yin la/ phyag 'tshal ba'i dus rab byung khyim pa gang yin kyang so so'i rgyan gos bzang po dang mdzes pa dag gos tshugs te gyon tshul yang tshul dang mthun pa'i sgo nas phyag byed dgos te/rgyan la gsum yod gos tshugs bzang la mdzes//zhes gsungs/lha phyag 'tshal ba de yang snga ma las/ lha phyag de yang lus bsrangs rkang gnyis gshibs/ /lag pa thal sbyar gus pas rkang rtse gnyis/ pus gnyis lag gnyis dpral lam spyi bo rnams//sa la gtugs la 'og gi 'gying sogs bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar/lus kyis sked pa drang po bsrang / rkang pa gnyis mnyam por gshibs nas gus pa dang bcas pas lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba de yang / thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/pad+ma la 'bus phye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs bcas/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i thal mo khong stong du pad+ma kha 'bus pa ltar spyi bor sbyar bas lus kyi sdig sgrib 'dag /mgrin par sbyar bas ngag gi sdig sgrib 'dag /snying 321

gar sbyar bas yid kyi sdig sgrib 'dag /de nas rkang rtse gnyis/ bus mo gnyis/lag mthil gnyis/dpral ba rnams sam/yang na rkang rtse gnyis ma the ba'i lus ma lnga sa la phab ste phyag byas pas/ nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib pa 'dag pa dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i byin rlabs thob pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod de/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/'bras bu dkon mchog bla ma dge bshes la/ dad pas phyag byas sgo gsum sgrib pa 'dag /kun gyis ya rabs spyod tshul bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas yar langs pa'i tshe yang rked pa drang por bsrangs te thal mo bcas nas yang sngar ltar phyag 'tshal dgos pa yin/ phyag 'tshal dus mi rung ba'i spang bya ni/ thal mo khong stong med par lag mthil gnyis sprad de bca' ba dang / sor rtse thug tsam byed pa/ thal mo legs par mi sbyar ba yug tsam byed pa dang / pus mo dang dpral ba sa la mi reg par sgur tsam byed pa dang / yar ldang pa'i tshe rked pa legs por mi bsrang bar skur phyag byed pa sogs ni ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur du 'gro bas gtan nas mi rung la/ sgur phyag byas pa'i rnam smin gyis gyang ro khur zhes bya ba rgyab tu lnga ba chen po yod pa'i mi'u thung skur te 'gro ba'i lus len par dpal sprul rin po ches gsungs/ /gzhan yang pus mo sar 'dzugs pa'i dus skang pa rgyab tu ring du bsnar ba lus sems so sor bral ba ste sems phyi rol yul gyi rjes su 'brang / lus ya yo byed pa ste g.yas phyogs nas smra brjod dang 'gro 'dug byed pa byung na mig dang sems de phyogs su/ g.yeng zhing thal mo 'gram pa g.yon gyi steng du sbyar ba/ de ba'in g.yon la kha yengs mig yengs byed dus thal mo 'gram pa sayas la sbyar ba solas dang / las pa skyog la 322

rgyab tu thal che ba/phyag 'tshal ba'i sa yul dog pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i yul ma brtags par rtab rtob tu 'tshal ba/las sla chos byed pa sogs spang dargos te/rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ skyon spang gsum yin pus mo 'dzugs pa'i tshe/ /rkang pa rgyab tu ring du mi bsnar zhing / /lus kyi khyon yang ya yo med pa ste//lag pa'i skyog kha rgyab tu thal mi bya/ /dgra ya bzhi yod sa yul dog pa dang / /lus sems bral dang rang bzhin brtab pa dang /khog tu sla chos byed pa'i phyag dgra spangs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi skyon 'di rnams spangs nas sngar bshad pa ltar gyi tshul dang mthun pa'i rang lus sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa'am zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i mang por sprul te lus kyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba/ngag gi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa sogs phyag 'tshal ba'i tshig 'don pa/ yid kyis ci mdzad khyed shes dang blo gtad ling bskyur gyi mos gus dang bcas/bdag dang ma gyur sems can thams cad lhan cig phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs pa sogs lus ngag yid gsum gcig dril du byas nas phyag 'tshal bar bya'o/ /de ltar tshul bzhin du phyag 'tshal ba'i phan yon tshad med de/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib 'dag pa sogs ni sngar bstan zin la/ gzhan yang mdo las/sngon dge slong zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu spa dang sen mo'i mchod rten la phyag 'tshal ba la/ kun dga' bos nge'i phan yon bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas phyag lan gcig 'tshal bas rang lus kyis ji tsam non pa'i dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar du rdul ji tsam yod pa'i grangs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid nyams su myong rmi nga da dung nge'i phan yon gyi mtha' mi thus nga ra sasu/ngas/nge ba'in du mdo las/32 3

bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa ni bla mar bya ba'i skye bo la gus par btud de phyag 'tshal ba las 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ste mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa 'grub pa sogs phan yon tshad med do/ /mthar 'dod don la gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis gdan seng khri sogs mas yar 'od du zhu/ dbu skra nas yas mar 'od du zhu/yum rdo rje bdag med ma'ang yab la thim/ yab kyang 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ltem gyis zhu/rang la je nye je nye la spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas sib kyis thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres/ de la dbang bzhi'ang tshang ba yin te/ bla ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer du 'dres/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs bum dbang thob/ gsung dang ngag 'dres gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs gsang dbang thob/ thugs dang sems 'dres thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rang gi sgo gsum dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs dbang bzhi pa thob/ de ga'i ngang gshis skye med gdangs mos gus rang mdangs su 'dzin pa ma zhugs par lhod kyis glod la sems mnyam par bzhag /mnyam bzhag de yang dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i lhad dang bral ba'i rig pa skad cig mar ngos bzung / de yang dbang bzhi'i nyams len snying por dril ba'i man ngag yin par gsungs te/ rig pa skad cig ma de'i gsal ba'i cha de bum dbang gi ye shes te/de bskyangs pas 'bras bu sprul sku 'byung / de lta bu de gzung 'dzin 'khrul pas stong pa'i cha de gsang dbang gi ye shes te/ des longs sku/ de lta bu'i rig pa'i dwangs snyigs phyed pa'i rang rig 324

bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa ni bla mar bya ba'i skye bo la gus par btud de phyag 'tshal ba las 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ste mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa 'grub pa sogs phan yon tshad med do/ /mthar 'dod don la gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis gdan seng khri sogs mas yar 'od du zhu/ dbu skra nas yas mar 'od du zhu/yum rdo rje bdag med ma'ang yab la thim/ yab kyang 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ltem gyis zhu/rang la je nye je nye la spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas sib kyis thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres/ de la dbang bzhi'ang tshang ba yin te/ bla ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer du 'dres/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs bum dbang thob/ gsung dang ngag 'dres gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs gsang dbang thob/ thugs dang sems 'dres thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rang gi sgo gsum dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs dbang bzhi pa thob/ de ga'i ngang gshis skye med gdangs mos gus rang mdangs su 'dzin pa ma zhugs par lhod kyis glod la sems mnyam par bzhag /mnyam bzhag de yang dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i lhad dang bral ba'i rig pa skad cig mar ngos bzung / de yang dbang bzhi'i nyams len snying por dril ba'i man ngag yin par gsungs te/ rig pa skad cig ma de'i gsal ba'i cha de bum dbang gi ye shes te/de bskyangs pas 'bras bu sprul sku 'byung / de lta bu de gzung 'dzin 'khrul pas stong pa'i cha de gsang dbang gi ye shes te/ des longs sku/ de lta bu'i rig pa'i dwangs snyigs phyed pa'i rang rig 324

bde ba'i cha de dbang gsum pa'i ye shes/ des chos sku/ de lta bu'i gsal stong rang rig de yang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas stong pa/ stong pa de yang chad stong ma yin par gzung 'dzin gyis dag pa'i rang rig de'i ngo bor shar ba'i zung 'jug de ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te de bskyangs pas ngo bo nyid sku 'byung ba yin/ de 'dra'i ye shes de rang la ye nas gnas pa bdag gi bsod nams kyis nyer len dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa las byung bar yid ches pa na bla ma dam pa la mos gus snying nas skyed/ lus kyi ba sru ldang / mig nas mchi ma dku lus 'phar zhing g.yo/ rig pa dwangs snyigs bye/sems zag med dga' bde'i ngang du gnas pa sogs 'byung ngo / /mthar/ skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang /sogs dang /dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /gzhon nu nor bzang ji bzhin du//yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu yis//bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /sogs bsngo smon rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /lnga pa rjes spyod lam ji ltar bskyang ba ni thun mtshams thams cad du snang ba'i ngo bo gang mthong yang de'i rnam pa la mi dpyod ngo bo la bltas pa'i tshe stong nyid du rjen de/nga'i bla ma sku rdo rje snang stong dbyer med du mjal byung byin gyis rlobs shig snyam pa dang / de bzhin du 'byung ba 'byung gyur gyi sgra thams cad bla ma'i gsung / rang sems la rnam rtog gang shar kyang de na'i ngo bo la blta zhing bla ma'i thugs rdo rje mjal byung byin gyis rlobs shig /mdor na gshis stong nyid skye med du sal le//gdangs 'gag med mos gus su lam me ba'i ngang nas bla ma'i zhabs tog la brtson pa dang phyag dang bskor ba sogs dge bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /maṇ+ḍal dang bla 325

ma'i rnal 'byor 'di gnyis kyi ngag 'don thar rtse byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis slob bshad kyi khrid yig gnyis kyi dgongs pa bzhin mdzad pa de bzhin byas pa yin kyang / gsung ngag yongs rdzogs thob cing khyad par lam zab bla ma'i byin rlabs dang khrid thob pa rnams kyis ni rang lugs bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs chu rgyun bzhin nyams su len te/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas bla ma bskyed pa ni/ snod bcud mi dmigs dbyings 'dir ye shes kyi sogs mthar chags su btang ngo //zhar byung sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprod pa ni/ de'ang sbyang gzhi skye ba snga mar rigs drug gang yang rung ba'i lus rten la brten nas yar sangs rgyas nas mar 'bu srin gyi bar du ma zhig la chags sdang gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las ngan du ma zhig bsags yod la/ sbyong byed kyang las bsags yul mchog dman thams cad sbyong byed bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus dgyes pa rdo rje'i rnam par gsal ba la/ bsags pa'i las thams cad kyang sbyong byed bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di lta bu'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa yin/ sbyang gzhi de lta bu'i sems can rnams las ngan thams cad bsags zin pa'i rjes su 'byung ba phra rags rim gyis thims nas 'chi ba'i snang ba 'char ba de nyid stong byed bla ma rang la thim pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang la bzhag pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas sbyong ba yin la/ ma/ṇ+ḍal dang mchod bstod kyi sbyang gzhi ni/ rang gis skye ba snga phyi rnams su ser sna dang nga rgyal sogs kyi dbang gis mchod par 'os pa dang bstod par 'os pa rnam sa la ma 326

mchod cing ma bstod pa dang /mi shes pa'i dbang gis mchod par mi thos pa dang /bstod par mi 'os pa la mchod bstod byas pa'i sems snang bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad/ sbyong byed maṇ+ḍal dang mchod bstod kyi rnal 'byor du bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'o//gdan gsum mnga' bdag bla ma mkha' nor la/ /rtse gcig gsol btab skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i/ /byin mthu 'od brgyas las nyon mun bsal nas/ /kun mkhyen grong du 'gro kun lam ston shog /byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid do/ /kye rdo rje'i sngon 'gro rnams khyi chos kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad zin to//

zab lam gzhan gyi skor so sor bshad pa/gnyis pa zab lam gzhan rnams kyi sngon 'gro'i sgos chos so sor bshad pa de la gsum/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i zab lam gyi sngon 'gro'i sgos chos bshad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi sngon 'gro'i sgos chos bshad pa/ spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i sgos chos bshad pa'o//dang po/ na ro mkha' smyod ma'i sngon 'gro/dang po mkha' spyod ma la'ang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal te bzhi/ dang po skyabs 'gro la sngar skyabs 'gro'i byi chos las/ rgyud rgya gzhung las gsungs tshul nas/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon bstan pa'i bar sa bcad brgyad kyis bstan pa rnams kye rdor gyi skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin shes par bya dgos pa las/ khyad par mi 'dra ba drug pa skyabs 'gro nyams su len tshul dngos bshad pa la brgyad las/ dang po gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gyi khyad par ni/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i ngang las/ zhing yongs su dag pa gzhal yas khang sngar bstan pa bzhin/ be+eḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser zhun mas mig mangs ris su bris pa/ mnan na nem byed cing / bteg na spar byed pa/ reg na bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa/ de'i dbus su dpas 328

bsam gyi shing pad 'dab gyes pa'i steng du seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba nyi ma'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar gsal/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kur bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsam/ de nyid la skyabs yul kun tshang ba yin te/ de'ang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad zugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas bla ma kun 'dus/ bla ma'i phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin la/ rnam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyis 'dul bar dgongs nas de ltar shar bas na sangs rgyas dkon mchog de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad chos/ phyi nang gi skye mched byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa ni dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad de'i bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du bzhugs pas na/ skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal gdab bo/ /gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /gsum pa skyabs 'gro'i rgyu/bzhi pa dus rnams sngar kyai rdor bzhin la/lnga pa tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/sangs rgyas la ston pa/chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs zhu ba'i 'dun pas bdag dang 'gro ba zhes pa'i tshe skyabs su 'gro mkhan yid la bya/ bla ma zhes pa'i tshe rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos su bzhugs pa la sems gtad/ sangs rgyas la zhes pa'i tshe de nyid kyi phung khams rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa dang /chos kyi tshe thugs rgyud kyi spangs rtogs/dge 'dun 329

gyi tshe phyi nang gi skye mched byang chub sems dpa' yab yu ma du bzhugs pa la sems gtad la skyabs su 'gro'o/ /drug pa gang gi ched du skyabs su 'gro ba'ang sngar bzhin/ bdun pa dngos grub blang zhing skyabs yul bsdu ba'i khyad par ni/mthar thal mo sbyar te skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs sems rtog med chos sku/ lus zag med bde chen gyi sku rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur te so so'i zhing du bya'i khyu 'phur ba bzhin 'ur dir gyis 'phur song /bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim par bsams nas rig pa brjod med du cham me bzhag go/brgyad pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyang sngar kye rdor skabs bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed ni ngag 'don gyi khyad par tsam las gzhan kun rdzob smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang don dam sems bskyed kyang kye rdor bzhin shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems kyi khrid kyang sngar kye rdor bzhin las khyad par med pas de bzhin nyams su len par byed pa yin no//bzhi pa mthun rkyen tshogs myur du rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba ste/ de la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs ni sngar kye rdor skabs bzhin yin la/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ tha mal gyi snang ba dbyings su thim pa'i ngang dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ rang bi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge 330

chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khyi pad+ma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bka' drin gsum ldan gyi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kur bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/dran pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god par nus pa/ gsol ba btab na smos ci dgos/ skyon kun zad/yon tan kun rdzogs/skyo bzhi'i bdag nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ de'i pad 'dab kyi kha mtshams kyi steng mdun nas brtsams te pad+ma zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub chen nā ro pa nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bla ma'i bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams g.yon bskor gyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kur 'dzin pa/gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/dbu skra ral pa'i thor gtsug can rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing /gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur pa/de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/mgrin par āḥ thugs tar hūṃ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa 331

brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma re re la'ang skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re re bstim zhing / de dag —skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor yid 'khul nges bya/ de nas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'debs pa la lus kyis phyag 'tshal ba'am thal mo sbyar/ yid kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs shing /ngag nas/gang gi drin gyis sogs dang /brgyud 'debs tshig bcad lhug gang rigs kyis gsol 'debs bya/ bsdu na drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par sogs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol bar lan gsum mam brgya tshar nas 'bum gyi bar phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs mos gus drag pos bya/ de nas zhen chags spong ba ni/ rang gi mdun du dngos po longs spyod khang zhing gser dngul sogs sngar las bzang ba thams cad dang / g.yas su gnyen bshes mdza' grogs sogs chags yul rnams dang /g.yon du dgra 'dre sogs zhe sdang skye yul dang /rgyab dang mtha' skor du tshe 'dir phan gnod gang yang ma byas pa'i bar ma'i sems can thams cad dang bcas pa gsal btab la / rim pa bzhin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la phul bas mnyes bzhin pas bdag gir mdzad/rang nyid phyin chad 'dzin chags dang / sdang zhen dang / rmongs pa'i las ngan thams cad dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phul bas rang yang de dag dang bral bar bsam/de nas phyi mchod nyer spyod 'bul ba ni/rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi sne la mchod pa'i lha mo me tog ma dkar mo phyag na me tog sna tshogs thogs pa/ spos ma dud la phyag na spos sna 332

tshogs bdug pa'i dud sprin 'thul ba/ mar me ma dmar skya rin po che'i kong bur snang gsal sna tshogs kyi 'od bkrag 'gyed pa/ dri ma ljang gu rin chen gyi snod du ga bur gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang sbyar ba'i byug pa/ro ma dmar mos zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa bsnams pa/ sgra ma sngon mos pi waṃ gling bu la sogs pa'i rol mo'i dbyangs snyan bcas lha mo de rnams kyang mdzes sdug rgyan gyis sgeg pa dpag med sprul te/ de'ang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i rgyur byas nas phul bas mnyes song snyam pas phyag rgya bcas oṃ badz+ra budhe sogs kyis mchod/ mthar lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu ba ni rlung sems dbu mar 'du ba'i rten 'brel yin no//yang snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med sprul la de rnams kyis 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad/ rtags brgyad/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' sogs mchod rdzas dpag med kyis mchod par bsams la na ma sarba sogs brjod lha mo rnams rang la thim par bsam pa ni phyi mchod do//nang mchod//gsang mchod/de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gsum ni 'angon char zhal gsal ba dang /sngar kye rdor bla ma'i rnal 'byor las kyang bstan pa bzhin shes par byas nas/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ ku sā li zhes dge ba dang ldan pa'am/ku su lu zhes ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa la 'jug pas/ de'ang paṇ+ḍi ta ltar mkhas par ma bslabs/ rnal 'byor pa ltar brtul zhugs can du'ang ma byas par/ com chung ngus rang rgyud dge ba la sbyor ba'i nyams len te/ de la dngos po longs spyod gzhan rtsol sgrub gsog 'jog dang gces spras chen po byed pa ni/ rang lus 'ji gso ched yin pas longs spyod 333

gzhan las lus 'di gces 'dzin che la/ gces 'dzin bcad de lus kyi mchod sbyin bya ba ni dngos po gzhan gyi mchod sbyin byas pa las lhag par yang phan yon che ste/ji skad du/rta dang glang po brgya 'gyur yin//bu dang chung ma stong 'gyur yin//lus kyi mchod sbyin 'bum 'gyur yin/ /zhes dang / ma gcig gi zhal nas/chags med lus sbyin byed pa des//tshogs gnyis rdzogs par ma shes nas//lus la gces 'dzin byas pa de//ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags//zhes gsungs/ de la rang nyid tha mal par gnas pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi dang / yar sne tshangs bug tu kha gdang nger yod pa'i snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam zhig dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyang ste thon nas/rang gi phung po de la gzigs pas de ling gis 'gyel/de'ang tsho zhing snum pa/che zhing brjid pa/ mams shing yid du 'ong ba zhig tu mthong nas/ bdag gis tshe rabs thog med nas rnam smin gyi phung po ji snyed cig blang ba thams cad don med chud zos su song 'dug /da res mchod sbyin byas la/tshogs rlabs chen bsags te don yod par bya'o bsams nas/ phyag g.yas pa'i gri gug gis phung po'i smin mtshams su reg pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis bkog pa de stong gsum gyi khyon tsam du gyur/ de nyid thod pa'i snyed pu ri rab tsam gsum rang grub tu byung ba'i steng du bkal/ de'i 'og tu rlung dkyil ljang nag g.yo ba/de'i steng du me gru gsum dmar zhing 'bar ba zhig grub/ de nas phyag gi gri gug gis lus kyi skang pa g.yas g.yon/lag pa g.yas g.yon/ de bzhin du brla/ dpung pa lhag pa pa 34

rnams dum bu gsum gsum du bregs zhing gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/de nas lus khog pa/ nang khrol don snying thams cad dum bur btubs shing bskyur bas sha'i ri bo/ khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen por gyur pas mer gyis khengs par bsam/de nas lte ba'i a shad kyi 'od kyis rlung g.yos/me 'bar/ thod pa dros/ nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'khol/ snyigs ma rnams lbu sob kyi rnam pas phyir lud pa me lces lhag med du bsregs/ de'i steng gi nam malar r+ghaṃ sngon po/ /āḥdamar po/ /oṃ dkar po rnams brtsegs mar gnas pa/ de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang / khams gsum gyi bcud thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par bsdus te 'bru gsum la thim/rgyu mthing thod par lhung bas kha dog dri ro nus pa'i skyon sbyangs/āḥdamar lhung bas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur//oṃ dkar lhung bas mi zad pa'i gter du spel bar byas nas yi ge gsum bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres pas/ thod pa'i rdzas de nyid zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/nus pa shi nas zhag bdun lon pa'ang gso bar nus pa lta bu/ dran pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed nus pa/ rlangs pa las grub pa'i dpal be/ sayung drung / dga' 'khyil/ bkra shis dzos rtags kyi sazums brnyan 'char ba zhis tu bsams la/ o aḥ ha ho trīḥzhes phyag rgya bcas lan sasum brjod/ de mas rang sga snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa sacig spros te nges bdung rtsi nas thong pas bcus te rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rtso )ni da

rje chos la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par bsams la oṃ āX rdu lha mo rang la thim/ yang spro ba sogs gong bzhin lan bdun du 'bul ba ni kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan thob pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te mchod par bsams la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan la re re bzhin oṃ tsho sbyar ba'am/ bsdu na brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs brjod/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mnyes par bsam lha mo rnams rang la thim/yang spros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag thams cad la phul bas mnyes par bsam lha mo rnams rang la thim/ yang snying ga nas lha mo nam mkha' gang ba spros pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dang / rang la gnod cing lan chags pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la bdud rtsi byin pas/bdud rtsi de byang bas myong grol/reg pas reg grol/mthong ba dang /thos pa dang /dri tshor ba la sogs pa thams cad tshims shing / sgrib gnyis byang / tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos sku dang /lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsams la lha mo rnams tshur bsdu/ 'di yi mjug tu khrid yig khyab bdag bla ma'i zhal lung las dmar 'gyed bya bar gsungs pa bzhin byas kyang 'gal ba med par sems la/ 'di rgyun gcod lta bur nyams len byed na/ngag 'don sa skya pa pad+ma bdud 'dul gyis mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang gcod mkha' 'gro'i snying bcud du grags pa dang / de dang mthun pa yon tan rin po ches 336

mdzad pa gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa gcod pa'i man ngag gnad kyi spru gri zhes pa gang rung bzhin bya dgos la/ 'di lta bu'i nyams len ni mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin te/brtag gnyis las/lus kyi sbyin pa byin nas ni//phyi yi spyod pa yang dag spyad/ /gsungs la/ phar phyin yum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa sogs las/bdag med bstan pa'i phyir/gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad stong nyid du gsungs pa de rtogs pa la tshogs gnyis rdzogs dgos par gsungs pas/ rang gi lus phung po 'khor 'das kyi mgron la mchod sbyin byas pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs/bdag lta'i dmigs yul gyi phung po sbyin par btang bas yul med na yul can gyi bdag lta mi 'byung bas bdag med btsan thabs su rtogs pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te/ des na gcod byed pa thams cad kyang gnyan sa ri khrod sogs su ma rig pa dang / 'khrul snang thams cad kyi rtsa ba gces 'dzin nyag gcig po 'di rtsad nas gcod cing / ma rig pa 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal kho na la gnas pa pha mar gyur pa'i lha 'dres gtso byas pa'i 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad snying rjes rjes su bzung nas rang gi sha khrag dron mo zas su byin nas/ byams snying rje byang chub sems kyis bskyang dgos te/rje btsun gyi zhal nas kyang / gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim pa phyi yi gcod/ /phung po gzan du bskyur ba nang gi gcod//nyag gcig rtsad nas gcod pa don gyi gcod//gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa//zhes gsungs/ /ma gcig gis kyang / thog med kyi dus nas las ngan gyis rgyu byas rkyen ngan gyi rlung gis ded/ 'khrul snang dang sdug bsngal kho na la khor mo yug tu spyod/ shi tsa na ngan song gi gting rdo las 337

'gro sa med pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can de dag snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung ste rang gi sha khrag dron mo kha zas su byin nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyis snang ba bsgyur te rang gi 'khor du bsdus pa yin la/ zhes gsungs/ de'ang phyi 'khrul snang lha 'dre'i gzugs su snang ba de thams cad kyang nang du nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i snyems kyi rtsa ba ma chod pa las byung ba yin te/ma gcig gis/thogs bcas bdud dang thogs med bdud/ /dga' brod bdud dang snyems byed bdud//de yang snyems byed bdud la thug /ces gsungs pas/ thogs bcas thogs med sogs kyi bdud kyang bdag 'dzin snyems byed kyi bdud yin pas de gcod dgos la/ gzhan yang ji skad du/ nad pa 'dre la gtad pa yin//skyel ma dgra la bcol ba yin//srungs shig skyobs shig brgya bas kyang / /zo zhig khyer cig gcig gis dga'//a ma jo mo'i chos lugs yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos la//de ltar ma yin pa/ dpal sprul rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ lar da lta'i dus na gcod byed par rlom pa rnams nas/ gcod zer rgyu de lha 'dre ma rungs pa dag bsad bcad gtub brdungs bskrad nas rlag par byed pa'i drag shul gyi las shig yin par bzung / des na gcod pa zer ba de yang dus thams cad du khro 'khrug rngams te zhi sdang dang nga rgyal kho nas dpa' bskyed de gshin rje'i las mkhan lta bu zhig yod dgos snyam zhing /nad pa sogs la gcod byed pa'i tshe yang /khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i drag shul gyis dpa 'a bskyed de mis sdang mig phor pa tsam re bgrad/ khu chur dang la pho mnyam ldeg byed cing / rdung rdos spar mo btab nas nang pa'i rgyab la rgyan pa 'i bos hrul yan chang brtsed nge/ nges lha 'dre 'dul bar 338

rloms kyang de 'dra ba'i chos lugs de nor ba yin/ zhes gsungs la/ ma gcig gi zhal nas/ ma 'ongs pa na gcod pa dag gis nga yis snying rje'i lcags kyus bzung ba'i nor lha 'dre ma rungs pa de dag bsad pa dang / bskrad pa dang /brdung bar rlom pa ni gcod log bdud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags yin zhes gsungs la/ gcod mkhan ngag dbang brtan rdor gyis/ byams dang snying rje'i dmigs pa yis//lha 'dre pha mar ma shes na//brdungs kyang lha 'dre brdung ba min//rang gis rang nyid brdung ba yin/ /tshe 'dir na tsha rkyen ngan bslang / /phyi mar dmyal ba yang sos skye//sogs gsungs pa ltar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang bral zhing / lha 'dre rang sems su ma rtogs phyi rol du bzung nas 'dul bar rlom pa la 'byung po phra mo nus pa chung ba re zung 'dul nus rung lha 'dre ma rungs pa gdug pa can dag dang phrad na slar rang gi srog la rgol ba du ma zhig mthong chos su gyur pa'ang yod la/ dpal sprul rin po ches khyad par chos rnam dag sgrub pa'i gang zag gcig la 'dre 'dul nus kyi byin rlabs la sogs skyes pa'ang lam rtags kyi yon tan yin nam/bdud kyi bar chad yin shes dka' ste/lha 'dre ma rungs pa dag gis rgyud brlams pa phal mo cher mngon shes dang nus pa sogs yod pa ltar snang yang / phugs yang dag pa'i chos dang je 'gal la 'gro zhing mthar dge sems til 'bru tsam yang med par dkor nag thi rnam smin ri bo tsam gyi khur gyis non pa dang / zhes dang / yang da lta gcod byed par rloms pa rnams nas lha 'dre phyi na yod par bsam sa te/ rtag tu 'dre 'dzin gyi snang ba dang ma bral bar bsnang nga sa snang ba thams cad 'dre dang rgyal 'bong du 339

shar te/ rang nyid kyang blo sos mi dal zhing / gzhan la yang phu ya ki na 'dre/ /mda' ma ki na 'dre/ 'dre de red/bdud de red/btsan de red/ ngas rig yod/ngas bzung yod/ngas bsad yod/ khyod la 'jab kyin 'dug ngas bskrad yod/phyi mig gcig bltas byung zer ba la sogs rdzun gyis mgo bskor kho na gtong zhing pho byas byas mo'i dpa' skad 'don/ de tsa na lha 'dre dang yi dwags rnams kyis kyang de'i rgyus lon te/de gar song du 'gro zhing /bud med bla yang ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rgyud la brlams te/nga lha yin/ nga 'dre yin/nga shi bo yin/nga khyod kyi pha rgan yin/ ma rgan yin bya ba la sogs pa bden bden dang / yin yin mo du ma bshad/ kha cig tu nga lha yin/ nga chos skyong yin/ nga dam can yin la sogs pa zer zhing rdzun lung dang mngon shes du ma sgrogs par byed de/ 'dres bla ma mgo g.yogs/ bla mas yon bdag mgo g.yogs pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i kha skad du/ pha maso bus g.yogs bu mgo dgras g.yogs zer ba ltar/ snyigs ma'i rang rtags mngon du gyur nas rgyal khams bdud kyis dbang byed pa yin te/ o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan las/snyigs ma'i dus na/skyes pa'i snying la pho 'dre 'jug /bud med snying la mo 'dre 'jug /byis pa'i snying la the'u rang 'jug /btsun pa'i snying la dam sri 'jug/bod mi re'i snying la 'dre re 'jug/ces pa ltar dang /the'u rang lha ru mthong ba'i dus bod sdug pa'i dus la babs pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i lung bstan thog tu bab pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ des na nang 'dre 'dzin gyi rtsa ba bcad na snang ba dag par shar nas bdud rigs chos skyong du gnas bsgyur/chos skyong sprul skur zhal bsgyur zhes bya ba de 'byung bar gsungs la/ des na lha 340

'dre dang nad pa gnyis ka yang las ngan dang 'khrul snang gi rgyu las gnod bya gnod byed du 'brel ba yin pas nye ring dang chags snang mi bya bar thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub sems bsgom/ rang sems spros bral dang ma bral bar rang gces 'dzin dang bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas bcad de lus srog phangs med lha 'dre'i gzan du ster nas/ lha 'dre de dag gi zhe snang dang gdug rtsub zhi ste shes rgyud chos la 'khod pa'i chos bshad chos sbyin dang / smon lam sogs snying thag pa nas byed dgos so/ /zhes 'phros don cung zad smos nas/ sngar gyi ku su lu'i mjug thod pa bdud rtsi sogs mi dmigs par bsam/khrid dang bsnyen pa'i dus/skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/sngar spyi chos kye rdor gyi maṇ+ḍal bzhin yin la/de nas dbang blang ba la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis mos gus drag pos gsol ba lan gsum btab/ de'i dmigs pa lan dang pos rang gis rtsa ba'i bla mar/ gnyis pas rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma la/gsum pas brgyud pa'i bla mas gnang ste rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba btab par bsam par gsungs/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i gnang ba zhu ba'i spyan gyis gzigs pa dang / brgyud pa'i bla mas gnang ba sbyin pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa rnams g.yas bskor gyis rim bzhin thim rdo rje 'chang yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim/ de nas bla ma'i dpral ba'i o las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob pa sogs dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa ngag 'don bzhin dang /de nas bla ma bstim pa la/dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol 341

ba shugs drag pos btab/ de nas bla ma 'od du zhu tshul dang / rang la thim tshul ngag 'don bzhin byas te/ bla ma dang rang sems bsres te mnyam par bzhaga'adi dag gi go don kye rdor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhin shes par bya la/ de nas bsngo smon sogs bya'o//gnyis pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngon 'gro/gnyis pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rwa khrid mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi sngon 'gro'i sgos chos bstan pa la skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi/ 'di dag rnams kyi go don rgyas pa ni khyi chos su bstan pa bzhin la/ 'dir sgos chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams bshad par bya ba la/dang po skyabs 'gro la/skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gyi khyad par/rang gi gnas khang 'di nyid dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drwa ba/ gur bla bre/ me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su tshud pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang gi gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su rin po che las grub pa'i dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal galo ma/ me tog phun sum tshogs pa dran pa tsam gyis dgos 'dod thams cad yid bzhin du stsol nus pa'i rtse mor/ pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa kha bye ba'i lte bar/seṅge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng du/drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lnga bu 'al gcig 342

phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri me 'bar ba dpung pa'i thad kyi nam malar 'phyar ba/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs dar bzung ba snyan g.yon pa'i thad du kha gyes pa'i steng na stong phrag brgya pa'i pu ti 'dzin pa/dbu skra mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud can/ snyan gong ut+pa la'i gdengs ka/dar dpyang gi 'phyang 'phrul gyis brgyan pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od can/ de'i steng gi cha la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje ro langs ma/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad sprin 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa/ mdun gyi pad+ma la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhal dgu/ phyag so bzhi pa lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi pad+ma la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan rang gi tshul bzung ba dpag tu med pas bskor ba/g.yon gyi pad+ma dang seṅge'i khri la dbus su mi bskyod pa/ shar du rnam snang / lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa rnams la nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha lugs can gyi sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor ba/rgyab kyi pad+ma la de dag gi thugs rgyud kyi bde chen gyi ye shes gzugs kyi spur bzhings pa'i rnam pa gsu nga rab brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu lha rdzas pañtsa li na'i na bzas bklubs nga/ 'al bdag la rgyasas pa mtha' skor gyi pad+ma'i yal ga /lo 'dab 'bras bu sogs la 'chi bdag gshin 343

rje'i rgyal po la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs sprin 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul lo//de nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu/ skyabs su 'gro tshul/ dus dang bcas pa sngar skyabs 'gro'i khyi chos bzhin shes par byas la/ ngag 'don bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa brgya tshar stong tshar sogs lus sems la 'gyur ba ma byung gi bar du byas pa'i mthar/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma sogs lag len ltar brgya stong sogs ci rigs phul nas/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos lam du longs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lam 'khrul ba sel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bdag gi blo la chos ma yin pa'i snang ba skad cig kyang mi 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu 344

gsol/ rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs yul rnams kyi gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/sems rtog med chos sku dang /lus zag med bde chen gyi skur sangs rgyas/bya'i khyu 'phur ba bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du gang la gang 'dul gyi sems can gyi don la byon par bsam/ slar gus 'dud byas pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'od zer mthing kha'i rnam par zhu/ rang gi snying gar thim pas bdag gi sems dang dbyer med du gyur/ chos dkon mchog thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu/ mgrin par thim pas ngag dang dbyer med du gyur/ dge 'dun dkon mchog thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par zhu/dpral bar thim pas lus dang dbyer med du gyur/mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par zhu/ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams te/don gyi dkon mchog gi ngo bo bskyang ba spyi chos bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang ldan pas bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs brjod cing / don dam sems bskyed bsgom pa dag sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog zla ba zhum ma ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 345
