'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa dbu spa ral pa'i cod pan can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/de'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku rked yan chad khebs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing / pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ yab kyi thugs gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du r+ghaṃ dkar po de las 'od 'phros sogs nas sdig sgrib nad gdon 'don pa'i thun mong gi dmigs pa gsum dang / thun min dbang — bzhi'i dmigs pa rnams kyang 'dra la/ oṃ shrī ya man+ta ka sogs gshin rje'i gshed kyi yig brgya bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal bstod de sogs kyis bshags sdom bya ba rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim ste stong nyid la blo bzhag pa rnams kyang khyi chos bzhin no//bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su gzhal — yas khang bsgom pa nas/ nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs sprin 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam gyi bar skyabs 'gro bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs su bskyed pa nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od can/ de'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bla ma nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bar gyi bla ma dam pa rnams 'jam dbyangs gzhin nu'i rnam pa can reg la ma 'byar ba'i rnam pas tho brtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/mdun gyi pad+ma la sogs gong bzhin bsgom/de rnams kyi dpral bar o/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kur r+ghaṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ sangs 4 sa byang sems dpa' bo mala' 'go thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim 346

pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsams te gdung shugs drag pos/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje ro langs ma la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra la gsol ba 'debasu so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas re re bzhin brjod de gsol ba 'debs/ bsdu na rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma gong ma gong ma rnams 'od du zhu/ 'og ma 'og ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du thim pas/ de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur/ de nas bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba las grub pa'i mchod lha sprul nas phyi mchod/nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams 'bul/ de nas rang gi rig pa snying ga'i dbus su 'jam dpal gzhon nu mthe bong tsam zhig tu gnas pa de tshangs bug nas thogs med du thon nas/ ral gris thod pa bcad de rang gi sha khrag der bskur bas oṃ tso sogs kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa grangs med spros pas rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ rigs drug ba ra do'i bar thams cad la bdud rtsi phul bas yas mgron rnams mnyes/mas mgron rnams so so'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dag nas 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skur gyur te snang ba thams cad 'jam dpal du lam me ba la sems gtad/ 'di yi sngar bstan pa'i 347

pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus su bsams te gdung shugs drag pos/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje ro langs ma la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra la gsol ba 'debasu so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sogs nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi mtshan nas re re bzhin brjod de gsol ba 'debs/ bsdu na rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma gong ma gong ma rnams 'od du zhu/ 'og ma 'og ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du thim pas/ de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus su gyur/ de nas bdag gi lus longs spyod dge ba las grub pa'i mchod lha sprul nas phyi mchod/nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rnams 'bul/ de nas rang gi rig pa snying ga'i dbus su 'jam dpal gzhon nu mthe bong tsam zhig tu gnas pa de tshangs bug nas thogs med du thon nas/ ral gris thod pa bcad de rang gi sha khrag der bskur bas oṃ tso sogs kyis bdud rtsir bsgyur nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa grangs med spros pas rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ rigs drug ba ra do'i bar thams cad la bdud rtsi phul bas yas mgron rnams mnyes/mas mgron rnams so so'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dag nas 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i skur gyur te snang ba thams cad 'jam dpal du lam me ba la sems gtad/ 'di yi sngar bstan pa'i 347

dmigs bsal rnams ma gtogs mkha' spyod ma'i ku sā li ji lta ba bzhin yin la/bdud ji'i snod sogs mi dmigs par bsam/ de nas gsol ba btab nas dbang bzhi blang ba ni/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo shel dkar dwangs pa'i kha dog can de las 'od zer dkar po oṃ yig gi tshogs dang bcas pa 'phros/rang gi dpral bar zhugs bum pa'i dbang thob sku'i byin rlabs zhugs byung snyam du sems ma yengs par bzhag /de bzhin du mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsang dbang dang gsung gi byin rlabs/ /thugs na'i ju las sher dbang dang thugs kyi byin rlabs/ gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dang 'bru gsum bcas pa 'dres spyi bo la sogs pa ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas zhugs pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsams te re re'i mthar yang ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /de nas dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi gsol ba ched du btab pas/skyabs yul thams cad 'od du zhu bla ma la thim/dpag bsam shing yar thim ste bla ma de dgyes bzhin du tshur byon rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/bde khri li li byon te rang gi snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'od lnga'i gur khang du zla ba'i gdan la 'dzum bag dang bcas te bzhugs pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la rig pa brjod med du cham mer bzhag /mthar bsngo ba smon lam gang 'grub byed pa ni mnyam bzhag gi nyams len yin la/ rjes thob thams cad du snying ga'i bla k+ṣe la ma ye ngas pa'i gdung shugs dung nge ba yang yang du gsal gdab bza' btung bī+od mi zi dus 348

de dag gis snying ga'i bla ma mchod par bsam pa dang / 'jigs skrag nyams mi dga' ba sogs byung dus snying ga'i bla ma dran par byas la gsol ba btab cing brjod med du bzhag nyal dus bla ma la sems gtad de gnyid log pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro gsungs/ de dag gis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sngon 'gro rnams bstan zin to//gsum pa/ spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi sngon 'gro/gsum pa spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi dmar khrid kyi sngon 'gro la bzhi las sngar gyi spyi chos su bstan pa rnams de bzhin las/ 'dir sgos chos rnams bstan pa la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul gyi khyad par ni/ kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom ste de la rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs gzhal yas khang sogs snga ma rnams dang mthun par gsal ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ngo bo rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog gangs ri'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang ldan pa/phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs skar thal mo sbyar ba/g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang / g.yon 'og mas me tog pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba nas 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs dang stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs dang lngan zhing / 'al 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba 'od 349

dang 'od zer du ma 'phro ba'i bdag nyid can gyi sku can du gyur pa'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad kun 'dus nor bu ltar gyur par bsam pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul lo/ /de nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag /skyabs 'gro'i rgyu/ tshul/ dus rnams spyi chos bzhin dang / skyabs 'gro'i ngag 'don yang sgrub thabs so so las 'byung ba bzhin brgya stong nas 'bum gyi bar bya/ thun mthar bla ma dang sogs skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pa'i tshe skyabs yul gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po'i tshogs 'phros sems can rnams sdig sgrib dag nas sangs rgyas pa dang / skyabs yul rang la thim nas mnyam par 'jog tshul yang spyi chos bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed la smon 'jug semasabaskyed kyi don dran bzhin pasasems bskyed kyi ngag 'don lan gsum sogs brjod de don dam sems bskyed bsgogabazhi pa/ nyin zhag drug gcig gi nyams len 'bring po/de'i zhar byung tshad med bzhi bsgom pa yang / sems can thams cad dmigs yul du byas te bde ba rgyu 'bras dang ldan 'dod kyi byams pa/ sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa bral 'dod kyi snying rje/ sdug bsngal dang bral nas bde ba dang ldan na snyam pa'i dga' ba/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms bsgom pa ste 'di dag gi go don rgyas pa sngar byams snying rje sgom pa'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin no//gsum pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/rang 350

gi spyi bor pad dkar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gyis 'khyud pa/ gnyis ku'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs nar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rgyu dkar po sogs dkyus bzhin/ sdig sgrib nad gdon don pa'i dmigs pa gsum dang /dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa bcas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs rdor sems yig brgya nyer gcig nas brgya stong 'bum gyi bar bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni sogs brjod de stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom dang / rdor sems rang la thims pa'i dmigs med kyi ngang la bzhag pa sogs sngar bzhin no/ bzhi pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan lnga brtsegs kyi steng du ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rigs thams cad kyi bdag po drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog in+d+ra rī la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar sngo zhing dwangs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa'i g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu thugs kur bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing / lhag ma lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang 351

smad g.yogs gsol ba/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dgyes pa'i nyams can du gyur pa'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po//mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs nar nyi ma'i steng du : sngon po/ de las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas bla ma kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du yi dam lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs bla ma'i sku la thim pas yi dam kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/dkon mchog gsum spyan drangs thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ chos skyong srung ma spyan drangs zhabs la thim pas chos skyong kun 'dus su gyur te/bla ma de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo bdag la sku bzhi ye shes lnga stsol ba'i bdag nyid du mos gus dung dung ba dang bcas pa'i ngang nas tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ sngar spyi chos kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin so bdun ma dang / bdun ma/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs la grangs brgya rtsa nas 'bum sogs 'bul/gang gi mchod rdzas sogs bya/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/yid mig rlung gsum nam mkha'i bla mar gtad de/ thal mo sbyar bas/gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid//sogs bla ma'i spyi bstod dang /bde chen mchog brnyes rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /sogs brgyud 'debs dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs brgya stong 'bum sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/352

smad g.yogs gsol ba/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dgyes pa'i nyams can du gyur pa'i spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po//mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs nar nyi ma'i steng du : sngon po/ de las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim pas bla ma kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du yi dam lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs bla ma'i sku la thim pas yi dam kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/dkon mchog gsum spyan drangs thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus su gyur par bsam/ chos skyong srung ma spyan drangs zhabs la thim pas chos skyong kun 'dus su gyur te/bla ma de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/sku dge 'dun/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo bdag la sku bzhi ye shes lnga stsol ba'i bdag nyid du mos gus dung dung ba dang bcas pa'i ngang nas tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ sngar spyi chos kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin so bdun ma dang / bdun ma/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs la grangs brgya rtsa nas 'bum sogs 'bul/gang gi mchod rdzas sogs bya/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/yid mig rlung gsum nam mkha'i bla mar gtad de/ thal mo sbyar bas/gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid//sogs bla ma'i spyi bstod dang /bde chen mchog brnyes rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /sogs brgyud 'debs dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs brgya stong 'bum sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs/352

mthar skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs//mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs//'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs//bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos lam du longs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos min rnam rtog 'gag par byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byang chub sems nyid 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi yi grur zhugs nas/ /shin tu brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis//bde chen thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gcong rong nang zhugs nas//skye ba'i chu bo zlog par dka' ba la/ /las kyi dbang gis dmyal ba myong na yang //dam pa khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus phyi yi bla ma dang / /sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang //rang bzhin spros bral don gyi bla ma gsum//dbyer med snying po'i bla mar rtogs par shog /ces lan gsum sogs kyis rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma des rang nyid la mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs/ mdzad pa'i phrin las kyi nus mthus srung ba dang skyabs pa la sogs mdzad pa yin snyam mos pa yid la byed pa'i tshe/ bla ma de nyid gdan seng khri nas yar dang dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar zhu/ thugs ku'i thad du 'od zer sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du ltem gyis zhu ste rang gi spyi gtsug nas sib kyis 353

thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsams la rig pa brjod med kyi ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhagamathar bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing / spyod lam gyi bya ba sogs kyang sbyi chos bzhin shes par bya'o/ /des ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sngon 'gro rnams bstan zin to/ /'di yan gyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi sngon 'gro'i nyams len thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams bstan zin nas/ de'i zhar byung du/ dpal sa skya pa 'khrul zad rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/so byang sngags gsum gyi sdom pa rim gyis blang ba'am/ gcig char bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i sum ldan rig pa 'dzin pa las dang po pas brtson 'grus kyi bye brag gis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la bya ba'i cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du gsungs pa'i 'bring po'i dbang du byas te/ de la rig pa 'dzin pa nam gyi sum cha'am bzhi cha'am brgyad cha'i tho rangs kyi cha nas gnyid sad pa de'i tshe/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dang dkon mchog gsum dran pa'i tshul gyis de dag la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshig lan gsum la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa paṇa gyis/gsang sngags pa yi bla ma mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med yin//des na de la gsol btab pas/ /dkon mchog gsum po tshe 'dir 'grub//ces gsungs pa ltar bla ma ni lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba/dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa dang / lhag par gsang sngags kyi rigs lnga'i dam tshig mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig bsgrag tshig las/ slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /zhes dang / rtsa sang bcu 354

bzhi'i dang por/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis//dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gzung zhing skyong ba dang / rtsa snang mi 'byung ba'i phyir du/'dir thog mar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang /'og tshogs zhing bskyed pa yang bla ma dang dbyer med du bskyed pa yin te/lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad rnams las/ 'dod yon lngas bla ma mnyes par bya zhing sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyis bla ma spyi bo sogs su bsgoms te mos gus dang ma bral na nyes sang byang zhing mi 'byung ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin par gsungs so//de nas 'bru gsum gyis srung ba bya ba/ mi lam ngan pa byung na zhi ba'i sngags bzla ba dang bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya ba'i man ngag ni/ rang gi thugs na'i 'od zer gyis gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang lha mdun mkhar spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa dbang len pa'i skabs ltar byas/ de nas dbang lha rigs lngas zag med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum dbang sogs dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi dag par bsam zhing /lha ru ga'i yig brgya bzla zhing khrus byas pas/nyin zhag gcig gi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa thams cad 'dag par gsungs/ de nas bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud ji lngar mos te bdud rtsi ril bu myang ste rang yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas pa mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rdo rje dang dril bu 'chang ba ni/mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ste/rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang //blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig /355

dril bu gsung gi dam tshig /phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig gsum gyi rdo dril mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rab gnas can ma bral ba 'chang dgos pas byin rlabs bya zhing rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil ba sogs tshul bzhin bya/yi dam yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa ni phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig go /de nas bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas/ /bla ma'i rjes su 'jug pa ni/zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir thog mar skyabs 'gro byed pa/ 'og skyabs sdom gzung ba sogs ni/spyir theg chen so thar gzung zhing yar ldan du byed pa dang /gsang sngags kyi rnam snang gi dam tshig yin te/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o//zhes gsungs so/ /smon 'jug gi sems bskyed byed pa ni/ thege chen byang sems kyi nyams len gyi gtso bo dang /gsang sngags rigs lnga spyi yi dam tshig dang / rtsa ltung lnga pa bsrung ba yin te/ chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems//de spong ba ni lnga pa yin//zhes gsungs/byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ rtsa ltung bzhi pa bsrung ba yin te/ sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang /rin 'byung gi dam tshig mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa yang tshang ngo //de nas tshogs zhing bskyed pa 'dir 'bring po'i dbang du byas pas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal mi dgos par dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa ci 'byor bshams la/ mdun mkhar mi bskyod pa gtso bor bzhugs pa'i rigs lnga yum bzhi bskyed par gsungs nas/ dmigs bsal yi dam gyi lha mchod par 'dod na rigs pas shes par bya ste/ de'ang phyag rdor lta bu mi bskyod pa'i rigs 356

yin na dbus su bzhugs su bcug la/ de'i dbu la mi bskyod pa bsam paraba'o gsungs pas/ 'dir lhag pa'i lha yi dam kye rdo rje dbus su bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rigs bdag mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa byas/de'ang sdig nyung bshags yul rten gyi stobs dang sdom pa gsum gzung zhing blang ba'i yul la shis pas bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i dam tshig pa bskyed ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstims/ de nas byon legs khrus gsol/sku phyis/rgyan phreng 'bul ba sogs gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag mngon sum lta bur dmigs la tshigs su bcad pa rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba dag gis de dag gi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs par bsam zhing phyag bya'o gsungs pa bzhin phyag 'tshal/de nas bzang spyod nas byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya bar gsungs pas dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag sngon du btang nas/ de nas mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bsangs sbyangs nas byin rlabs bya bar gsungs pa sngar ram 'dir bya/ de nas nyer spyod kyi mchod pa rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dam sngags tsam gyis 'bul/gzhan yang spros pa la dga' na gzhung gzhan nas 'byung bas kyang mchod gsungs pa bzhin rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid rdzas rtags 'dod yon sogs kyis kyang mchod/yan lag bdun pa'i mchod pa'i yan lag kyang grub nas/ yid sprul gyi mchod pa sngags bcas gsungs pa bzhin dang / de nas mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar gsungs pa bzhin maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang gi mchod rdzas dang bcas pa bya/ de lta bu'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni rin 'byung gi dam tshig zang zing gi sbyin pa dang /don grub kyi dam tshig mchodapa'i las ci nus su bsgrub pa rnams yin no//357

de nas sngar byas kyi sdig nyung rnams stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa la phung po gsum pa'i mdo brjod par gsungs pa bzhin dang / spyi bshags sogs dang / bshags pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa rnams kyis ni mthun rkyen tshogs gsog cing 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib stong ba rnams sngon du song nas skyabs 'gros sor sdom gzung / smon 'jug gis byang sdom gzung slar yang rgyun bshags bya bas byang chub kyi sems gzung / rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag sogs kyis sngags sdom gzung zhing blang ba ni/ las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yod grub pa'i dam tshig yin rna/ /de nas gsol 'debs sogs ji ltar rigs par byas te gzhung nas tshogs zhing gshegs gsol bya bar gsungs kyang /man ngag gi dbang du byas nas dbang bzhi blangs nas rang la bstim pa ste/ de'ang 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi gsung 'di/ lam 'bras kyi sa lam bgrod tshul dang mthun pas de ltar byas te/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya ba dang / de ltar ma grub na 'bring dang bsdus pa bya tshul rnams dang / phyis sdig sung mi 'byung zhing rtsa cing gnyis pa bde gshegs bka' 'das bsrung ba'i phyir/ rang rgyud la sdom pa gang ldan gyi bsrung bya rnams shes shing mkhas par byas te bsngo bgrang gis rang rgyud la bag yod dang dran shes kyis yang yang ma brtags na/ spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i chom rkun des/ /dran pa nyams pa'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /bsod nams dag kyang nyer bsags kyang / /rkun pos phrogs bzhin ngan 'gror 'gro/ /zhes gsungs/des na bslab pa srung bar 'dod pas sems bsrung bar bya ste/de 358

nyid las/ bslab pa srung bar 'dod pa yis/ /rab tu bsgrims nas sems 'di bsrung / /zhes dang / sems srung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag/srog la babs kyang srungs shig ces//bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor//zhes gsungs pa bzhin no//de ltar sngar bstan pa de rnams/rje btsun rin po ches/gzhung 'di las nyin mtshan dus drug tu nyams su blang bar gsungs pa bzhin dgos pas/'di'i nyams len ngag 'don ni kho bos byas pa'i gong ma'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba logs su yod pa las shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'od dpag med pa'i dam tshig dam chos gzung ba ni/ pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la//phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum//dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyi bya spyod kyi rgyud/ nang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud de rgyud sde bzhi dang /nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa gsum gyi sde snod gsum de dag gi yan lag rig gnas dang bcas pa 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas gzung zhing 'dzin pa yin la/de lta bu'i rgyud sde dang sde snodarnams la 'chad nyan gyis gzung ba'i phan yon ji ltar yod ce na/ dang po 'chad pa'i phan yon ni/dbyig gnyen gyis/chos sbyin nyon mongs can min pas//mdo sogs yang dag ji bzhin bshad/ /ces pa ltar/nyon mongs dang ma 'dres shing phan par 'dod pas tshul bzhin bshad pa'i phan yon ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la me tog dang / dri bzang po'ikhyag pa dang / mar me la sogs pa'i mchod ba kun gyi nang nas chos bshad pa'i mchod pa de mchog tu 'gyur te/mdo las/gang la phan phyir nga yi chos//tshul bzhin bstan pas mchod 'gyur gyi/ /me tog byug pa mar me yis/ /rgyal ba 359

yang dag mchod ma yin/ /zhes dang / yang gser dngul sogs rin po che sna bdun gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkang ste sangs rgyas la phul pa las/ chos bshad pa phan yon che ste/mdo las/gang gis ji snyed sangs rgyas zhing dag na//rin chen bdun gyis yongs su bkang byas nas/ /rab dga'i sems kyis rgyal la phul pa dang //gang gis sems can gcig la tshigs bcad byin/ /rin chen sbyin pa shin tu rgya chen des//tshigs bcad sbyin pa snying rjes bsgrubs de la/ /char yang mi phod grangs su'ang mthan na//gnyis dang gsum la bsam du ga la yod/ /ces dang /gaṅgā'i bye snyed rin chen bdun dag gis//bkang ste gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas//dus ngan tshe na tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa/ /de yi phan yon de ltar mnyam ma yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ gzhan yang chos bshad pas skye ba dran zhing zag zad kyi mngon shes thob pa'i phan yon yang yod de/mdo las/chos kyi sbyin pas skye ba dran//zhes dang /klu rgya mtshos zhus pa las/ chos kyi sbyin pas ni zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes rnam par dag par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs so//yang chos rnams nyan zhing thos pa byed pa'i phan yon yang / thos pas phyi dang gi grub mtha' shes pas chos kyi blang dor la mkhas shing bslab gsum rgyud la ldan pas myang 'das thob pa'i phan yon dang ldan te/ mdo las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur//thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur//thos pas don med spong bar 'gyur//thos pas byu ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ mthar thug myang 'das thob cing / /de'i sa bon shes rab rgyas par byed pa ma zad/ /gnas skabs mtho ris lha mi'i bde ba thams cad kyang chos nyan te thos pa byed pa las 'byung dargos te/ rnam 360

bshad rig pa las/ dad pas nyan pa gang gis ni/ /mtho ris dga' ba'i bsod nams dang / /gang gis mya ngan 'das thob pa'i//shes rab sa bon brtas par 'gyur//zhes gsungs la//gzhan yang /sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /bsam gtan bsgom pa ste bsod nams gsog pa'i gzhi gsum gyis bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags pa las kyang /dam pa'i chos tha na tshig gcig tsam zhig dad mos kyis nyan zhing thos na de nyid phan yon ches grangs med pas lhag par 'gyur te/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bus spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin rer chos rgyal rnams la rtag 'bul la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis//sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur//blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang //lus ngag yid ni 'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med srung byed la//gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis/ tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan gi/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgoms la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ de ltar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / nyon shes kyi sgrib pa spong byed ni shes rab kho na yin la/shes rab kyi rgyu ni thos pa yin pas na/de las gang phyir sbyin pas longs 361

bshad rig pa las/ dad pas nyan pa gang gis ni/ /mtho ris dga' ba'i bsod nams dang / /gang gis mya ngan 'das thob pa'i//shes rab sa bon brtas par 'gyur//zhes gsungs la//gzhan yang /sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /bsam gtan bsgom pa ste bsod nams gsog pa'i gzhi gsum gyis bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags pa las kyang /dam pa'i chos tha na tshig gcig tsam zhig dad mos kyis nyan zhing thos na de nyid phan yon ches grangs med pas lhag par 'gyur te/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ gang zhig byang chub don du gnyer bas gser zhing nor bus spras pa ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing rdul mnyam pa nyin rer chos rgyal rnams la rtag 'bul la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis//sbyin pa las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur//blo ldan gang zhig bla med byang chub 'dod pas bskal pa du mar yang //lus ngag yid ni 'bad pa med par tshul khrims dri med srung byed la//gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis/ tshul khrims las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di na srid pa gsum gyi nyon mongs me 'jil bsam gtan gi/ /lha dang tshangs gnas mthar son rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'pho med thabs bsgoms la/ /gzhan gang 'di las tshig tsam thos shing thos nas kyang ni mos na 'dis/ /bsam gtan las byung dge ba de las bsod nams ches mang 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ de ltar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / nyon shes kyi sgrib pa spong byed ni shes rab kho na yin la/shes rab kyi rgyu ni thos pa yin pas na/de las gang phyir sbyin pas longs 361

spyod dag ni sgrub byed cing / khrims kyis mtho ris sgom pas nyon mongs spong byed la//shes rab nyon mongs zhes bya kun spong de yi phyir//'di mchog nyid de 'di yi rgyu ni 'di thos yin//zhes dang / der ma zad bsam pa dang sgom pa gnyis kyi rgyu yang thos pa kho na yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa ste/ /de dang bsam pa gnyis po yod gyur na/ /de las sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor//des ni dngos grub bla na med pa 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /'chad pa dang nyan pa gnyis char gyis chos 'dzin pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i mdo las/dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni//sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du//bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang //mthar phyin par ni 'gyur ma lags//zhes gsungs so/ /yang mdo rgyud la thos bsam gyis sbyangs pa ma byas pa'i nyes dmigs dang skyon gyi dbang du byas na/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung la thos pa med na blang dor gyi gnad mi shes pas long ba lta bur 'gyur te/ mdo las/ dge ba dang ni sdig pa'i chos ma thos pas ni shes mi 'gyur//zhes dang /thos pa'i nor med sa steng 'dir//long ba yin snyam bsam ste bya//zhes gsungs la/ klu sgrub kyis/rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gro//zhes gsungs/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis//skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pas//tshe 'dir blun por mthong nas ni//phyi ma blun por skye dogs pas//tshe 'dir dka' yang 'bad de mnyan/ /zhes gsungs/ yang mtshams bsnyen byas te sgom pa nyams len byas na/de lhag thos pa byed mi dgos so snyam na/de yang ma yin te sa paṇa gyis/sgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes//blun po blo rgya chung ngu smra//thos pa med par sgom pa tsam/ /'ab na kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /rgyu 'bras bslu ba 362

med pa 'di//thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin//ma bslabs pa la kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /zhes gsungs/ ye shes grub pa las kyang /smongs pas sgom pa gang yin pa//rmongs pas zongs pa thob par 'gyur//zhes dang /byams pas/ gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur//zhes gsungs/ yang nga rang da ni na so rgas shi ran pas gzhung lugs thos bsam byas pas shes par ni mi 'gyur/ des na kha ton dang mchod 'bul sbyin gtong phyag bskor sogs bya ba bzang ngo snyam na/ de yang ma yin te/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ shin tu rgas par gyur tshe yang //thos pa mang du bsags par bya//phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam//sbyin pa yis kyang ga la phan//zhes dang / rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab//tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang //skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi//nor la rang nyid len dang 'dra//zhes dang / yang thos bsam ma byas pa'i skyon gzhan yang / phan dang mi phan mi dpyod cing / /blo dang thos pa mi sgrub par/ /lto 'grangs 'ba' zhig don gnyer ba//spu med pa yi phag pa yin/ /zhes dang / blun po'i dbus na dga' zhing rtse/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar zhum zhing 'dzur//nog dang lkog shal med na yang //ya so can gyi ba glang yin//zhes dang /tsa na ka las kyang / rkang gnyis pa la mngon sum phyugs/ /blun po yongs su spang bar bya//zhes gsungs so//yang 'ga' zhig gis sde snod la thos bsam dang / nyan bshad byed pa la ma mos shing ma dad pas 'di dgos pa med zer zhing 'gog pa'am dngos su de ltar ma smras kyang sems kyis de ltar bsam pa sogs byed pa rmi nyes pa shin tu che ste/ 'jam mabon sa par+ṇa gyis/ chos nyan bshad byed pa la ma 363

gus shing 'gog pa ni mkhas pa rgyun chad/ chos shes pa med na pu ti mang po yod kyang sangs rgyas bstan pa zhig pa yin/zhes sogs gsungs la/mdo las/ dam ba'i chos spangs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la skur pa 'debs pa yin/ dge 'dun la ngan du brjod pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang mtshams med lnga byas pa yang bshags na dag rung la/ chos thos bsam la ma mos shing sdang bar byas pa'i nyes pa bshags pas mi 'dag cing thar pa med de/ byams pa mgon pos/gang zhig yang yang sdig grogs bsten pas sangs rgyas ngan sems ldan gyur dang / /pha ma dgra bcom gsod pa bya ba min byed mchog tshogs 'byed pa'i mi/ /de yang chos nyid nges par bsam na myur du de las thar 'gyur gyi/ /gang zhig yid ni chos la sdang ba de la thar pa ga la yod/ces gsungs la/sngar bstan pa'i 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ba dang chos la smod pa'i rtsa thong drug pa'ang phog pas bag yod par bya'o//des na mdo sde rgyan las/rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te//de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su gzung phyir dang / bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed//ces dang /sa paṇa gyis/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring //de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis/ /rang blo shes bya kun la sbyangs zhes thos/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo las kyang /byang chub sems dpa' bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par bya'o/ /de la mkhas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa 364

ltar bya dgos pa las/ de yang / sdud pa las/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la brten to zhes/yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyong zhing /lhag par nang don rgyud sde bzhi dang /sde snod gsum la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par byas te/ snyigs ma'i dus ngan pa 'di lta bu la bya ba gzhan thams cad cam gyis bzhag ste/ byin rlabs che zhing 'grub thag nye ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la 'jug par bya ste/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ rdo rje theg pa spyad pa'i dus ni snyigs ma'i dus da lta nyid yin pas na gsang sngags kyi tshul 'di la mchog tu dad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ lha ru ka dpal gzung byas na/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na mngon rtogs dang lam bsdus bshar sbyang tsam ma yin par sngar bstan pa'i sngon 'gro bud mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/smin byed sngon du 'gro bas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams ga bzhin srung / lta ba rnam par dag pas gzhi gzung nas tha mal snang zhen dang lus kyi dri ma spyong ba'i bskyed rim phyi nang la reg mthong gi mtshan ma mthong ba dang / gya rnam lhar zhen dang rtsa yig khams rlung gi dri ma dag nas mchog la sbyor ba'i dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam rtsa rlung thig le 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa de dag gi gegs sel bogs 'don srung ba dang bcas pa rang byan chud par byas te rim gyis lta ba rnam bzhi rtogs te/grub mtha' rnam bzhi snyogs nas rten brten pa gnas gyur te che ba gsum ldan sku lnga 365

ye shes lnga mngon gyur bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'gyur ba de lta bu la brtson par bya ste/de dag ni 'phros don yin la/ de nas theg pa chen po'i mdo lnga 'don par bya bar gsungs te/ji skad du/sa bcu zla ba'i sgron ma lang ga'i grong //sdong pos brgyan pa dag dang rgyal ba'i yum/ /'di dag bklag cing mchod pa byas pa yis/ /bstod pa gar gyis khyod la ci byar yod//ces gsungs pas de dag gam bsdu na mtshan brjod sogs 'don par bya la/ mdo 'don pa'i man ngag ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa sngon du song nas mdo de nyid kyi don shes shing dran pas 'don no/ /yang na byang chub kyi sems dang chos thams can rang bzhin med par dran par byas la/de'i ngang las 'don par bya ste/rgyas par 'dod na logs su btsal bar bya'o//de nas dza la la chu sbyin pa/ mgron bzhi la gtor ma/ yi dwags la chu sbyin pa sogs gsungs pa bzhin byas pas rin 'byung gi dam tshig sbyin pa rnam bzhi yang tshang ngo / gzhan yang las sgrib sbyong phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya ba ba dang /byang sems kyi lhung ba nam mkha'i snying po'i mdun du bshags par gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang / phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pas bshags tshul sogs sdom gsum so so'i gzhung las gsungs pa rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /phyis sdom gsum gyi nyes lhung mi 'byung ba'i phyir du sdom gsum so so'i bslab bya dang nyung ba rnams shes shing mkhas pa dang / de yang de dag gi sdom tshig lta bu sogs dus rtag tu klog pa dang / blo la 'dzin te byang ba'i thabs la nan tan byas te dran shes bzhin gyis rang rgyud la byung ma byung brtag dpyad byed dgos te/ sa chen kun dga' snying pos lam 366

'bras sras don ma las/ dam tshig thams cad la rang gi 'bad rtsol dang gnyen po khyad par can gyis bsrung zhing bskyangs la/ de yang ma nus na/ thun bzhi la sogs kyi mgor bum dbang gi mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig ma nyams sam snyam pa nas/ bzhi pa'i mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ma nyams sam snyam pa'i bar du/ rnam grangs nas rjes su dran par bya bas mi brjed de bsrung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bya'o/ /gzhan yang kha zas dang 'brel ba'i cho ga gsungs pa rnams kyang yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris kyang gzhung bzhin bya la/ zas kyi bya ba rdzogs nas yi dam gyi rnal 'byor yod na brtson par bya/ yang na chos spyod bcu gang rung ngam thams cad spyad par bya ste/ de yang mgon po byams pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang don bsgom pa/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni//bsod nams phung po dpag tu med//ces dang //spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas/ rten gsum bzhings dang srog 'don zam pa 'dzugs/ /mchod sbyin khrus dang bskor ba tshul khrims rnams//'gro ba'i don du brtson pa nga yi sras//lus de bor nas bde ba can du 'gro//zhes khyad par gyi chos spyod bcu dang / 'dul ba lung las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal bstan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang / /yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ste/ /rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun//gsungs pa rnams skabs su babs pa dag ci nus su spyad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / mchod rten 'debs tshul gsungs pa 'dir ma bris la/rten la bskor ba byed par 'dod na/mchod rten nam/ /gtsug 367

'bras sras don ma las/ dam tshig thams cad la rang gi 'bad rtsol dang gnyen po khyad par can gyis bsrung zhing bskyangs la/ de yang ma nus na/ thun bzhi la sogs kyi mgor bum dbang gi mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig ma nyams sam snyam pa nas/ bzhi pa'i mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig ma nyams sam snyam pa'i bar du/ rnam grangs nas rjes su dran par bya bas mi brjed de bsrung ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin bya'o/ /gzhan yang kha zas dang 'brel ba'i cho ga gsungs pa rnams kyang yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris kyang gzhung bzhin bya la/ zas kyi bya ba rdzogs nas yi dam gyi rnal 'byor yod na brtson par bya/ yang na chos spyod bcu gang rung ngam thams cad spyad par bya ste/ de yang mgon po byams pas/ yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang don bsgom pa/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid ni//bsod nams phung po dpag tu med//ces dang //spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas/ rten gsum bzhings dang srog 'don zam pa 'dzugs/ /mchod sbyin khrus dang bskor ba tshul khrims rnams//'gro ba'i don du brtson pa nga yi sras//lus de bor nas bde ba can du 'gro//zhes khyad par gyi chos spyod bcu dang / 'dul ba lung las/ kun dga' ra ba gtsug lag khang / /mal bstan 'tsho ba nar ma dang / /glo bur nad pa nad g.yog dang / /yul ngan tshe na sbyin pa ste/ /rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun//gsungs pa rnams skabs su babs pa dag ci nus su spyad do/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / mchod rten 'debs tshul gsungs pa 'dir ma bris la/rten la bskor ba byed par 'dod na/mchod rten nam/ /gtsug 367

lag khang sogs sam/ sa phyogs stong par yang rung ste/ sa gzhi gser gyi bye ma brdal bar bsam/ de'i steng du chu yan lag brgyad kyis gang bar bsam/de'i dbus na pad+ma'i sdong po chen po/ /de'i steng du bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang chos la sogs pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems skyabs gnas thams cad spyan drangs la stim mo/ /de nas de dag la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i tshul gyis rang gi gzhogs g.yas pa bstan nas/ spyod lam mdzes pas dal brel snyom par bskor zhing / rang gis gtso byas ma gyur sems can thams cad kyis kyang bskor ba byed par bsam/lha tshogs de dag las 'od zer dpag med 'phros rang dang sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo//oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te samyakle bud+dha ya/ tabyathā/oṃ ra rasnemahā rasner bi dzā ye swāhā/zhes bzlas nas bskor ba gcig byas pas bye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di bzlas nas phyag byas na'ang bye bar 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /bskor ba'i tshe rten gyi grib ma dang gzhan yang sku gzugs dang / gang zag mchog la sogs pa'i grib ma lta bu'am/ rten gyi rdul lam/ mchod rdzas dman pa sogs 'gom dgos na/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥzhes brjod cing nam mkhar bteg ste de dag gi 'og nas 'gro bar bsam na nyes pa mi 'byung ngo / /de nas srod kyi thun la/ klu sgrub kyis/ rigs pa'i bdag nyid nyin par mtha' dag dang / /mtshan mo thun gyi stod smad bzlas nas ni/ /mnal tshe'ang 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar//dran dang ldan pas de 368

dag rab tu mnol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bzlas brjod dang bsam gtan gyis dus 'da' bar byas la de nas nyal ba'i tshe bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsgoms la phyag byas la/bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/bla na med pa'i dngos grub mchog kyang stsol cig gnod pa thams cad kyang nyams nas zhi bar mdzod cig /ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o//de nas rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas nyal ba'am/ yang na rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ oṃ sirnyi si bud+dha bud+dha bod+dha ya bo ya ba la ba la tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sgyuḥ kai pa kai pa pa ra gats+tsha gats+tsha bha ga wa ti ma bi lo ba a le swāhā/gzungs 'di lag pa g.yas par lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas la/ de'i steng du mgo bo bzhag ste seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal/ sang nangs par snga bar ldang ste dge sbyor la 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pa dang /rang dang snang ba thams cad nyi ma shar ba lta bu gsal lam me ba'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar byas na/nangs par ldang ba yang zhing khams dwangs/ dge sbyor la spro bar 'gyur zhing /'dis ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myur du rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas nam gyi cha smad la gnyid sad nas langs te cho ga thams cad snga ma bzhin du spyad par bya zhing / khyad par slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul gnas thos bsam dang ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /ces pa rnams gtso bor bya ba dang / dus thams cad du so thar gyi nges 'byung dang tshul khrims/ byang sems kyi sems bskyed dang byams snying rje/gsang sngags bla med kyi bla ma'i mos gus dang rim gnyis rnams dang ldan pas 369

chos spyod bcu gang 'grub kyi sgo nas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /de ltar kun tu spyod pa'i skyes bu gang zag de ni ring por mi thogs par/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur ro//de ma thob kyi bar du yang bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub cing chos dang mthun par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar las dang po pas nyin zhag phrugs gcig la nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di ni/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos spyod rin chen phreng ba las nyung bsdus su bkod pa'o//

mjug byang /slar smras pa/ mdo rgyud man ngag dza hu'i kha chu las//bshes gnyen dam pa'i mtshan nyid bsten tshul rnams//ma dros mtsho 'dra'i rdzing chen bskyil ba las mdo rgyud las btus thun mong sngon 'gro bzhi/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan yur ba nas/ /thun mong ma yin sngon 'gro rnam pa bzhi//bshes gnyen gdams ngag dal 'gro'i rgyun gyis drangs//gang zag so so'i rgyud kyi zhing sa la//dkyus pas las nyon dri ma'i thal ba sbyang / /bsod nams ye shes tshogs kyi gsher gyis brlan/ /dngos gzhi rim gnyis myu gu skye rung las//'bras bu sku bzhi'i lo tog phun tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun rnam mkhyen bgrod pa'i gsos 'di zad//'khrul bral gong ma'i gsung zab 'o mtsho las//nyin zhag phrugs gcig nyams len snying po'i mar//sngon chad phal gyis ma myong btang snyoms las/ /bdag blos bsrubs las thon pa'i snying po'i bcud//skal ldan thar 'dod gang zag thams cad la//phan bde'i lus zungs brtas pa'i skyes su 'bul/ /'di rnams mdo rgyud bka' bstan tshad ldan dang //dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi ji bzhin la//nyes 'gal med snyam 'on kyang bdag nyid ni/ /skyes sbyangs blo gros shin tu na phra bas/ /nor 'khrul 'gal nyams dug chus bslad mchis na/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro srung ma dang / /mkhas grub rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar 'od brgya pas//rgyal bstan mdo sngags bshad sgrub pad tshal rgyas/ /ma gyur 'gro ba'i 371

las nyon rgud mun sangs/ /tshogs zung snang ba dkar po'i lam bzang nas/ /sku bzhi'i grong khyer nyams dgar bgrod byas te//rang gzhan don gnyis phun tshogs lhun grub shog /ces bla med rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rim thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yongs 'dzin mkhan kun chos lags dang / lde snod 'dzin pa chen po dpal mchog don grub dang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rnams nas lha ras rin gnyis kyi gnang skyes bzang po dang bcas snga phyi mang por yang yang bskul ma nan cher gnang ba'i bka' nan rtsi ba ldog ma spobs pas sngon 'gro snang gsum gyi khrid yig rnams dang / dngos gzhi yi dam so so'i rnam bshad dang khrid yig rnams kyi thun min sngon 'gro'i khrid rnams rtsa bar bzung / mkhas grub tshad ldan gzhan rnams kyi gsung gis kyang brgyan te/ khrid de dag kyang mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal nas nyams khrid lan grangs du mar thob cing / rang gis kyang brtson pas 'dris par byas te mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rdo rje 'chang dngos byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / byams pa rin chen ma' brtse dbang po dang / ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po/ 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po//ngag dbang thub bstan rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma bcu phrag gnyis lhag tsam gyi gsung gi bdud ji mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa myong zhing 'tsho ba'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan ming byams pa ngag dbang blo gros rin chen nam/ tha snyad rig pa'i btags ming 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i sadan sa shrī nā len+d+ra'i yang dben rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi brag chen rnams kyi ya gyal brag dkar gyi dben khrod du maso brtsams te rngog chos sku rdo rje sku lus ma spangs par 'ja' lus mkha' spyod du dngos su phebs pa'i gnas chen dben gnas su yongs su rdzogs par bgyis pagam gyur sems can thams cang 'ja' lus ma 'a spyod 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ masgo /372

par byang smon tshigasmras pa/ na mo gu ru/ spangs rtogs yon tan rgyal dang gnyis su med/ /mtshungs med bka' drin rgyal ba kun las lhag/nyam thag 'gro ba'i mgon gcig ma ti'i mtshan//byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs//mkhas dang grub pa'i rang rtags dngos su gsal/ /'khor lo gsum gyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel/ /mgon po mchog des snyigs ma'i mtha' 'dir yang / /thub pa'i mdzad pa mngon sum bzhin du mdzad/ /sngon byon rgyal dang mkhas grub skyes chen tshogs/ /grangs med byon pa'i gdul byar ma gyur pa/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur dmu rgod bdag 'dra yang //blo sna chos la phyogs pa bla ma'i drin//kye ma 'jig rten mang po'i 'gro khams tshogs/ /mun nas mun par thog med nas 'khor ba/ /chos la mos pa dman las byung bas na/ /chos tshul rin chen sgron me bsten par rigs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten/ khungs ldan chos la thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ /thos don bsam zhing sgom pas nyams len pa/ /dam pa'i gshegs shul bstan pa spyi lugs yin/ /ltar snang chos la yun ring 'bad rloms kyang / /snying po'i gdams pa nyams su ma lon na/ /thabs mkhas bral bas ngan 'gror 'khyams srid pas//yang zab chos la nyams len chig dril 'os/ kha lta mthon pos rang snang 'degs pa'i chos/ /rgyud la mi 'drongs rdo la chu dang mtshungs/ /sngon 'gro'i blo sbyong zhing la chu bzhin du/ /gdul dka'i rgyud kyang yang dag chos kyis brlan//sngon la sngon 'gro'i myong ba ma thon par//dngos gzhi'i dngos grub sgrub la 373

rings pa yi//chos gzugs chos min lam du 'phyan nges pas//yang nas yang du sngon 'gros rang blo sbyongs//tshang la ma nor nyams len zab khrid 'dir//mtshan du sngon 'gror btags kyang don gyi char//gang zag gcig gis yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i don/ /nyams su len pa'i sbyor dngos rjes kun tshang / /nyin byed 'bum gyis gsal bar mi nus pa'i//thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang lam mchog /snang byed dpal gyi sgron me 'di yin pas/ /sgro btags bral ba'i mtshan snyan don dang mthun/ /thar pa'i sa mkhan bla ma dge ba'i bshes/ /brtag cing bsten nas dgongs spyod slob pa'i tshul/ /mdo sngags lam gyi rtsa bar bstan pa 'dis//srid zhi'i legs tshogs lag pa'i rtse na byin/ /'khor ba'i gnas 'dir bde ba'i skabs med de//rigs drug sems can sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdung //tshul 'di legs par mthong na skyo shas kyis//yid 'byung bskyed de thar lam chos la 'jug/dal ba'i rten bzang 'byor pa'i khyad par can/ /rnyed dka' don che yid bzhin nor las lhag /de ltar shes pas tshe 'di'i blo sna snang / /tshe lhag don ldan chos la brtson par nges//'dus byas thams cad mi rtag mtha' bzhis bsdus//nges par 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med cing //'chi tshe chos min phan med blo sbyong 'dis//long med shes nas 'chi chos rgyud la sbyor//bde sdug ma lus rang byas las kyis bskyed//rgyu chung na yang 'bras bu cher smin pa//bslu med yid ches dge sdig blang dor la//dran shes brtan pas dam chos lam du 'gro /bslu med skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum la/ /skyabs su 'gro des lam log kun spangs nas//'jigs dang sdug bsngal kun las nges grol te/ /tshe rabs gtan du bde ba'i 'dun ma 374

'grub/ /byams dang snying rje rin chen byang chub sems/ /man ngag ji bzhin legs par bsgom pa'i tshul//shes de theg mchog bde ba'i lam bzang nas//rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob la mi ring nye//rdor sems sgom bzlas stobs bzhi tshang ba yi//man ngag zab mos lam gyi mi mthun phyogs/ /thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib nyes sang tshogs/ /lhag med sbyangs nas dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur//rang lus longs spyod dge tshogs rgyur byas pa'i//yid sprul phyi nang gsang ba'i zhing rgya mtsho//'bul tshul thabs mkhas tshogs gsog maṇ+ḍal gyis/ /sangs rgyas zhing sbyong bskal mang tshogs chen 'dum//bla ma'i lam gyis smin byed dbang bzhi thob/ /grol byed lam bzhi'i nyams len 'di la tshang //'bras bu sku bzhi lhun grub 'di yis thob//rnal 'byor mchog 'di zab lam kun gyi bcud/ /thun min sngon 'gro'i spyi chos gcig nyid las/ /bye brag rang rang yi dam gang mos kyi/ /lha sngags dmigs pa'i kha sgyur so sor snang / /dgos 'dod kun 'byung legs bshad 'di 'dra med/ /sngags sdom rgyud ldan dang po'i las can gyi/ /nyid zhag phrugs gcig nyams len chos spyod kyis//mnyam gzhag ye shes rjes thob bsod nams tshogs/ /zung 'jug mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin sar sbyor//e ma 'di bzhin bsgrub pa'i skal bzang des//gang du sgo gsum bya ba ci spyod kyang / /rnam grol byang chub rgyu ru sgyur byed pas/ /legs bshad 'di ni rin chen gser 'gyur ji/ /gsag sbyang rgyab bskyur chos pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / /thos bsam dgra ru lta ba'i sgom chen dang / /gzhung lugs 'gal 'dur mthong ba'i ston chen rnams/ /chos 'di mthong na rgyal ba'i lam bzang shes//ji ltar shin tu mtho ba'i ri rtse nas/ /dma' ba'i ljongs su ltad 375

mo lta ba bzhin/ /nyams len spyi sdom legs bshad 'di rtogs na/ /mdo sngags lam gyi gnad gsang dus gcig mthong / /sdeb sbyor ma nyams mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog cing //gsal zhing gzung sla rnar snyan brjod pa bde//gang 'dul mos pa'i rjes 'gro 'di thos na//yid la dga' skyed 'chi med lha rnga'i sgra/ /stong bshad tshig gi spun pa 'phyar min par/ /mdo don nyams len snying po bcud du dril/ /tshad ldan lung gis grub par legs bsam na/ /myang bzhin bda' ba'i ro ldan bdud rtsi'i zas/ /mgon des mkhas grub bshes gnyen du ma yi//zhal lung bdud rtsir rol ba'i nyams myong gi /thugs bcud gsang mdzod rjes 'jug bu la byin//'di goms dpal 'phel nor bu'i gter rnyed mtshungs/ /bskal mang legs byas byang chub mchog gi rgyur/ /ma nyams yongs su bsngos pa kho na las/ /skal ldan tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i chos//lam bzang 'di rnyed skal pa ji ltar thob/ /kun la nye ring spangs shing khro ba med//blang dor dus su 'doms la sun pa bral//rtag tu phan pa kur mdzad rgyal tshab 'di/ /mgon du bzhag pa'i bka' drin bsam bzhin dad//dus 'gyur gshin rje khros pa'i mche phrag nas//'byung 'dus lnga phung sgyu lus ma zhig par/ /chos 'di 'dzad med spel ba'i spar gyi 'phrul/ /bsgrub pa'i go skabs thob 'di sngon smon mthu/ /kye ho grogs dag dal 'byor mi lus thob/ /rgyal bstan mjal zhing dam pa'i mgon gyis zin/ /phyin ci ma log gdams zab 'di 'dra thos/ /tshe 'dir btsan sa gzung na mi legs sam/ /tshig don ye shes mchog gis byin gyis brlabs//'brel tshad don ldan bden tshig smon lam mdzad//tshul khrims ldan pa smon pas 'grub gsungs phyir/ /ngaga' bar byos thig 'brel 376

thogs dad ldan rnams/ /'dis mtshon rnam dkar legs byas mchis so cog /skyabs kun 'dus zhal drin chen bla ma la/ /bka' drin gsob phyir sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal bgyid//tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin par shog /gnas skabs su yang dngos nyams zi lam du/ /gang gi zhal mthong chos kyi dga' ston thob/ /thugs rje byin rlabs snying la legs zhugs nas/ khyed gsung sgrub pa tshe dang mnyam par shog /thub pa'i chos tshul 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/rgyal blon 'bangs bcas dge bcu'i khrims kyis 'tsho//phan tshun byams skyong zhi bde'i dpal la spyod//bde skyid rdzogs ldan dga' ston dar bar shog /rigs gsum rnam 'phrul rgyal blon byang sems kyi/ /phrin las bzang pos gdul zhing gangs ljongs 'dir/ /thub bstan rin chen bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogs/ /mi nyams phyogs dus kun tu khyab par shog khyad par sngon smon thugs bskyed kyis bskul bas//gangs can bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i mgon//mkhas grub dbang po bstan 'dzin skyes mchog de'i//rgya chen phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /chos kyi rgyal po 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /chos tshul ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel ba'i gnas//chos grwa chen po dpal ldan nā len+d+rar/ /chos bzhin spyod pa'i 'dus tshogs 'phel bar shog /ji srid 'gro khams gnas pa de srid du/ /chos 'di'i 'gro don nyi zla ltar gsal bas//ris med sems can kun la brtse ba'i mgon//mtshungs med bla ma'i thugs dargongs yongs rdzogs thog /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs sems can kun//nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /skye ba gzhan gyis bar du ma chod par/ /rje btsun bla ma'i drung du 'gro bar shos /der rmi gsung bi bdud rtsir 377

longs spyod cing //sa lam yon tan ma lus mthar phyin te//rnam mkhyen sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon gyur nas//mkha' mnyam 'gro la legs bshad sgrogs par shog /phyogs ris gcam bu ma yin par/ /nges pa don gyi mkhas grub dbang //ris med bstan 'gro'i gnyen mchog de//slar yang dran pas phyag bgyid do//zhes sngon khrid 'di nyid mgon po gang la mos gus kyi bsam pa thang lhod med pas sku tshe'i ring la mnyes pa gsum gyis zhabs tog tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i nye gnas bzang po ngag dbang mkhyen rab 'phags mchog gis gtso 'gan bzhes thog bdag sogs slob bu dang dad sbyin 'ga' zhig nas spar du bskrun pa'i skabs rang gi mos gus kyi gsos dang skal ldan rnams dwang ba 'dren pa'i ched du chos 'di'i che ba mdo tsam brjod pa dang sprags spar byang smon tshig 'di nyid tshe rabs las smon gyis 'brel ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhas mchog grub pa'i dbang po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang blo gros rin chen dpal bzang po de nyid kyis chung ngu'i dus nas thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho zhing gsung gi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa'i slob 'bangs tshul khrims rgyal mtshan pas gus pas sbyar ba skye ba kun tu drin chen bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ /mgon po gang gi thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun bstan 'gro'i nyi gzhon gsar pa 'tsho 'dzad tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog nas yod dgu bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du spros te gya nom pa'i dngos rdzas dang / shog dngul bgrang dka' ba rnams kyis gzhi byas/mthu nus phul phyin bstan 'gror sman pa'i go cha rab bgos lho kha ba shākya'i dge slong rdo rje rgyal 378

mtshan mchog nas shog dngul sgor chig stong brgal ba dang / lhag par du'ang spar shing tshang ma bzo bkun sogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar te spar du bsgrubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang dpal 'byor ye shes kyis bris pa'o/ /oṃ ye dharmā ho tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dri mahā shā ma ṇaḥye swāhā/ spar 'di nā len+d+ra'i spar khang du bzhugs//mad lo//kha skong tshogs gnyis ban chen/bla ma thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol/'dir ston pa thugs rje can gyis bsod nams gsog cing dge rtsa spel ba'i thabs mdo rgyud nas mang du gsungs pa las sbyin pas bsod nams spel ba la/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni mchog yin la/ de yi phan yon bcas sngon khrid du bstan rin la/gzhan nad pa la sman dang /dgra yis 'jigs pa la skyel ma dang /dud 'gro sogs gsod par brtsams pa'i srog blu ba dang / gdon bgegs kyis nyen pa la srung 'khor bya ba sogs mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / zang zing gi snyen pa la sbyin yul gyi khyad par/ mchod pa'i yul gyi gtso bo bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / dam pa'i chos dang chos smra ba dang / rten gsum byin rlabs can sogs kyi spyan sngar mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba dang / phan 'dogs kyi zhing pha ma dang / nad pa dang /dbul zhing nyam thag pa sogs la sbyin pa byin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs lhag par 'phel bar gsungs te/ mdzod las/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang //skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpal 379

mtshan mchog nas shog dngul sgor chig stong brgal ba dang / lhag par du'ang spar shing tshang ma bzo bkun sogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar te spar du bsgrubs pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang dpal 'byor ye shes kyis bris pa'o/ /oṃ ye dharmā ho tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dri mahā shā ma ṇaḥye swāhā/ spar 'di nā len+d+ra'i spar khang du bzhugs//mad lo//kha skong tshogs gnyis ban chen/bla ma thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol/'dir ston pa thugs rje can gyis bsod nams gsog cing dge rtsa spel ba'i thabs mdo rgyud nas mang du gsungs pa las sbyin pas bsod nams spel ba la/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni mchog yin la/ de yi phan yon bcas sngon khrid du bstan rin la/gzhan nad pa la sman dang /dgra yis 'jigs pa la skyel ma dang /dud 'gro sogs gsod par brtsams pa'i srog blu ba dang / gdon bgegs kyis nyen pa la srung 'khor bya ba sogs mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / zang zing gi snyen pa la sbyin yul gyi khyad par/ mchod pa'i yul gyi gtso bo bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang / dam pa'i chos dang chos smra ba dang / rten gsum byin rlabs can sogs kyi spyan sngar mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba dang / phan 'dogs kyi zhing pha ma dang / nad pa dang /dbul zhing nyam thag pa sogs la sbyin pa byin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs lhag par 'phel bar gsungs te/ mdzod las/ 'phags pa min yang pha ma dang / /nad pa dang ni chos smra dang //skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpal 379

la//yon ni gzhal du med pa yin//zhes so//sbyin tshul gyi khyad par/ rang gis gus pas byin na phyis rang la bkur ste thob pa dang / rang gi lag pas byin na longs spyod rgya chen thob pa dang / sbyin yul la dgos pa'i dus su byin na rang la longs spyod dus las mi yol ba dang / gzhan la mi gnod pa byin pas rang gi longs spyod la dgra rkun me chu sogs bar chad med pa 'byung ste/ mdzod las/ gus la sogs pas sbyin par byed//de phyir bkur ste rgya chen dang / /dus dang bar chad med par rnyed//ces gsungs la/ sbyin rgyu'i dngos po'i khyad par yang //kha dog phun tshogs pa byin na phyis rang nyid gzugs bzang po thob pa dang /de bzhin du dri phun tshogs byin pas snyan grags phyogs su rgyas pa dang / ro phun tshogs byin pas sems dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / reg bya phun tshogs byin pas shin tu gzhon sha can reg na bde ba'i lus su 'gyur te/ mdzod las/ kha dog la sogs phun sum tshogs dngos//de las gzugs bzang grags ldan dang / /dga' dang shin tu gzhon sha dang //dus su reg na bde lus 'gyur//zhes gsungs la/bye brag tu mdo rgyud rnams las srog chags la kha zas ster ba'i tshul mang du gsungs pa las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang du byas te mgron rigs lnga'i gtor ma sbyin tshul khyad par can la/bya la zas ster ba ni/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/rang nyid khu gdong ma'i nga rgyal gyis/ /bya rnams rgyu las khā gdong ma drag mo zhal gcig /phyag bzhi/ thod pa/kha ṭ+wāṃ/gri gug mgo bo bsnams pa/spyan gsum smin ma kham zhing /rol pas bzhugs pa rnams su gyur par bsams la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas//dpal ldan thugs kyi 'khor lo nas//mkha' spyod ma yi tshosas ji snyed//'ol 380

ba bya rog gzugs nyid du//de dag thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ na maḥ shrī badz+ra ḍā tī ya/oṃ badz+ra kā kā gye rgyu rdu phaṭa ces spyan drangs la/ bza' ba rnams/oṃ āḥ ha ho hriḥs byin gyis brlabs te/ me tog la sogs pa yang byin la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki sbyi khe tsa ri rū pa kā kā gye tsi la la ka rū pa i me ba lo gro 7skyo/ sa ma ya rak+ṣa /ya the// sarba si pra yats+tshan+tu rgyu phaṭa swāhā/zhes pas sbyin/dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma//mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur//ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes//'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes bstod/lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des chos gsungs kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas//bden pa de dag gis ni lha mo rnams//bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab/ su zhes ci bder gtong ngo / mkha' la spyod pa'i gzugs can bya'i gtor ma'i rim pa'o/ khyi la zas ster ba ni/ bdag nyid khyi gdong ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ khyi rnams rgyu las khyi gdong ma drag mo sogs snga ma ltar la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas/oṃ āḥ yan+t+ra spre gi sbyi shwa na kra ma ho/ a gha rnyi ma la pu ṣe i de ba lo muñtsa dzi mi ba gre nyi na lhas kai puṣ+ṭi ku ru sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ya phaṭa gā hā/ zhes spyan drangs/bza' ba snga ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas me tog sogs dang / oṃ shwa nā sri bhā tsa ri yi/i de ba lo/grib grirno rgyu phaṭa/ces pas sbyin/bstod cing smon lam gdab/muḥzhes gtong ngo //sa la spyod pa'i gzugs can khyi'i gtor ma'i cho ga'o//'di gnyis zas kyi sngon du bya bar gsungs so//nya la zas sbyin pa ni/rang nyid gi las go rī nag mo/spyan gsum/gri gug ro gyi ta'i nya bsnams shing /nya gsol ba/nya'i gdan dang rgyab yol can no/ /zhes bsam la/ nya rnams kha las khyab 'jug 381

gi gzugs su gyur/oṃ e gyi hi/mahā ba la bī r+ya pa ra kra/ mahā yo dza nas ha sra pra ma ba su sha ba ti li mi gi li pra gyi pra lha ta ya mahā sī na a snyi pa ti ya a tra sa nyi to bha wa /ma ma a gi bre ta ra si ma gi sta ra swāhā/ zhes pas bos la nga ma gtogs pa'i zas sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/me tog sogs dang /cham lha i :sgosku u/ṛ dzā/lo lī/e ma/mo /gi.i a swāhā/zhes pas sbyin/lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos rnams klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can//skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /ces smon lam gdab/muḥzhes gtong ngo //sa 'og na gnas pa'i nya'i gtor ma'i rim pa'o//ba lang la zas sbyin pa ni/rang nyid sgrol ma dkar mo bgrang phreng dang / rtse gsum bsnams pa/ khyu mchog bcibs pa'o//mdun du khyu mchog rgyu las rdo rje sems dpa'/ba rnams phyogs su mkha' 'gro ma/ drag mo/ro langs ma/gtum mo/mtshams su seṅge mo/stag mo/ce spyang mo/lug pa mo rnams kyi rang bzhin no//bza' btung rnams/oṃ ma lhanas aḥswā hā/ ma kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāṇi skyadun sprun na tā ta oṃ lha phaṭa suhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs la/ matā re tu re tu re su hā/ zhes pas zar gzhugasems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyi grol 'gyur ba/ /de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces smon lam gdab/muḥzhes gtong ngo //thang la spyod pa ba glang gi gtor ma'i cho ga'o//grog mo la zas ster ba ni/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can du gyur/ mdun gyi grogs mo rnams 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang /g.yon gser gyi pad+ma 'chang ba/ 382

ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa grangs med pa'i skur gyur pa la/ bza' ba oṃ āX sne gis bdud rtsir gyur pa phul bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang bar bsams la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa re i me ba lo gros kha kha khā gyi khā gyi zhes dbul/ gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang mdzes pa'i sku//pad+ma gsar pas phyag brgyan pa/ /snying rje'i gter chen 'jig rten dbang //mgon po mchog la bdag 'dud do//zhes dang /byang chub sems mchog rin po che//ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang //gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam gdab cing / /muḥ zhes pas rang gnas su song bar blta'o/ /klung na spyod pa grog mo'i gtor ma'o//de bzhin du srog chags kyi rigs gang dang gang la zas sbyin pa na'ang rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i thugs ta'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis reg pas de dag skad cig gis 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i skur bsgoms te/ bza' ba rnams oṃ āḥ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la phul bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba mchog gis tshims par bsams la sbyin zhing /mthar bsngo ba yang bya'o//gzhan yang mchil ma dor ba na/ oṃ lha na ā ha re rgya swāhā/ zas su mchil ma za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig /ces brjod cing se gol brdab bo//de bzhin du lud pa la/ oṃ āḥkhri ra ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/lud pa za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig/snabs la/oṃ āḥshi snya ni kā ā ha re rgya swāhā/lus kyi dri ma spyi la/oṃ āX ma la ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/dri chen la/oṃ lha'i ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/ dri chu la/oṃ 0mu tra ā tra ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/ de rnams de dag za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig /ces 383

ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa grangs med pa'i skur gyur pa la/ bza' ba oṃ āX sne gis bdud rtsir gyur pa phul bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang bar bsams la/ oṃ ār+ya lo ke shwa re i me ba lo gros kha kha khā gyi khā gyi zhes dbul/ gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang mdzes pa'i sku//pad+ma gsar pas phyag brgyan pa/ /snying rje'i gter chen 'jig rten dbang //mgon po mchog la bdag 'dud do//zhes dang /byang chub sems mchog rin po che//ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang //gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam gdab cing / /muḥ zhes pas rang gnas su song bar blta'o/ /klung na spyod pa grog mo'i gtor ma'o//de bzhin du srog chags kyi rigs gang dang gang la zas sbyin pa na'ang rang nyid lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i thugs ta'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis reg pas de dag skad cig gis 'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i skur bsgoms te/ bza' ba rnams oṃ āḥ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la phul bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba mchog gis tshims par bsams la sbyin zhing /mthar bsngo ba yang bya'o//gzhan yang mchil ma dor ba na/ oṃ lha na ā ha re rgya swāhā/ zas su mchil ma za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig /ces brjod cing se gol brdab bo//de bzhin du lud pa la/ oṃ āḥkhri ra ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/lud pa za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig/snabs la/oṃ āḥshi snya ni kā ā ha re rgya swāhā/lus kyi dri ma spyi la/oṃ āX ma la ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/dri chen la/oṃ lha'i ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/ dri chu la/oṃ 0mu tra ā tra ā ha re bh+yaḥswāhā/ de rnams de dag za ba rnams kyis thob par gyur cig /ces 383

brjod la se gol brdab bo/ /de rnams de ltar byin pa'i bsod nams ci bsags pa yang / sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ zag pa rgyun gyi gtor ma zhes phan yon chen po thob par gsungs so//sbyin pa'i phan yon ni/ sbyin pas 'byung po dbang du 'gyur/ /sbyin pas 'khon rnams nyams par 'gyur//sbyin pas pha rol gnyen du 'gyur//de phyir sbyin pa gtso bor brjod//sbyin pa 'jig rten rgyan yin te//sbyin pas ngan 'gro zlog par byed//sbyin pa mtho ris them skas te//sbyin pa zhi byed dge ba'o//byang chub sems dpa'i longs spyod rnams//mi zad nam mkha' lta bu gang //longs spyod de ni thob bya'i phyir/ /sbyin pa de ni yang dag spel//zhes gsungs so/ gzhan yang bsod nams gsog cing sgrib pa 'dag pa'i thabs khyad par can/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi rdul phyi zhing /gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gyi gnas dang dge 'dun yar mar phebs bzhugs kyi khyams sogs gad dang phyags dar legs po byas te gtsang sbra byas pas phan yon lnga sogs 'thob par 'gyur te/ de yang 'dul ba las/mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun spyod kyis snga bar song ste ston pa la phyag byas nas gtsug lag khang 'phyag go/dus re zhig na brel nas ma 'ongs pa dang rgyal byed kyi tshal phyags mar lus pa ston pas gzigs te/ brgya byin gyis ri spos kyi ngad ldang nas phyags ma khyer 'ongs na bla snyam pa dang / brgya byin gyis de shes nas shing bal ltar reg na 'jam pa'i phyags ma lnga brgya khyer 'ongs so/ /ston pas phyags ma bsnams nas rgyal byed kyi tshal 'phyag par zhugs so/ /de'i tshe shā ri'i bu la sogs pas kyang phyags so/ /ston pas phyags dar byas pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ rang gi sems 384

dang ba dang /gzhan gyi sems dang ba dang /lha rnams dga' ba dang /mdzes pa'i las gsog pa dang / lus zhig nas lha'i nang du skye ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so//der ma zad phyags dar byed pa ni cing ba 'dag pa'i las su yang 'gyur te/'dul ba las/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i cing ba bshags pa'i spo 'gu spyod pa'i las nangs par snga bar langs te gtsug lag khang gi sgo dbye/ mar me'i kong bu bsal la/gtsug lag khang du chag chag dang phyags dar bya ba sogs dgos par gsungs shing /yang 'dul ba las/lam pa zhes pa tshig sh+lau ka gcig zla ba gsum du'ang mi shes pa zhig yod pa la/ston pas/rdul spong ngo / dri ma spong ngo //zhes tshig gnyis bslabs pas kyang ma shes nas/ston pas/'di yi las kyi sdig sgrib sbyang bar bya'o zhes dgongs te/ dge slong dge 'dun rnams kyi mchil lham dang / lham sgro gu can rnams kyi rdul phyis shig gsungs pas/des kyang rdul phyis shing / tshig gnyis kyi kha tog bslabs pas/des las sgrib dag nas kha ton gnyis po yang lobs so//lam pas bsam pa/ston pas/ rdul spong ngo //dri ma spong ngo //zhes pa de nang gi rdul la dgongs sam/ phyi yi rdul la dgongs snyam pa na/ sngon ma thos pa'i tshigs bcad gsum po 'di blo la snang ste/ rdul 'di 'dod chags de ni sa rdul min/ /rdul ni 'dod chags ming ste rdul gyi min//mkhas pa dag gis rdul de rnam spangs pa//de dag bde gshegs bstan la bag yod 'gyur//zhe snang dang gti mug la'ang 'gre'o//de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas dgra bcom pa thob ste/rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pas/ston pas/ lam pa 'di ni nga'i nyan thos sems bsgyur ba la mkhas pa'i mchog yin no zhes lung bstan to//de bzhin du/gtsug lag lang dang mchod 385

rten sogs la btsag bzang po dang /dkar rtsi bzang po'i nang du dri bzang dang /dug rigs spangs pa'i bzang sman/ rin chen phye ma bcas bsres la sku dkar gsol na/ tshe ring nad med cing longs spyod 'phel zhing bde skyid phun sum tshogs par 'gyur te/ mdo las/ thub dbang mchod rten rdo thal byugs pa yis/ /lha mi'i 'jig rten dag na tshe ring zhing / /lus sems nad dang mya ngan byed spangs te//rtag tu skyid cing nor gyis phyug par 'gyur//zhes dang / rten la phyag bskor byas pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag sangs rgyas mchod rten nam/ /sku gzugs dag la mgos btud gus phyag 'tshal//de dag lha rnams dang ni mi rnams kyis//cher yang che bar bkur ba'i gnas su 'gyur//su zhig dad pas thub pa'i mchod rten nam//sku gzugs dag lo bskor ba byed pa de/ /phyi ma'i tshe na dgra chen rnams kyis btud/ /bzang po'i snod 'gyur yon tan rnams dang ldan//sogs phan yon mang du gsungs so//gzhan la 'brel ba bzhag pa ni//dud 'gro dang skye bo mang po tshogs pa'am re re las mi 'dug kyang rna lam du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang gzungs byin rlabs can bsgrag /'og tu 'dzul sa dang mig gis mthong ba'i nye 'khor du sku dang gzungs byin rlabs can 'bri ba'am/ bzhugs su gsol/ chu dang rlung la sogs pa phog pa'i sa thams cad du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhugs su gsol/ de rnams mthong thos dran reg dang / der phog pa'i chu rlung 'thung ba dang lus la reg pa'i sems can thams cad sdig sgrib dag pa sogs phan yon tshad med par gsungs so/ /dus kyi dge ba'i 'gyur khyad ni/lo gcig la mtshon na/hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco 386

lnga'i bar bdag cag gi ston pas cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa dang /bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la sku bltams//bco lnga la mya ngan las 'das shing mngon par byang chub pa dang / drug pa'i tshes bzhi la chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /dgu pa'i nyer gnyis la lha las babs pa/ gzhan dgu ba'i bco lnga la lha babs dang cho 'phrul chung bar bzhed pa sogs dang / zla ba gcig la mtshon na spyir btang nya stong brgyad gsum dang /khyad par bde mchog las/tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod//ces pas yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis dang / kye rdor las/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /de bzhin du ni brgyad pa nyid/ /ces yar ngo'i tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi/mar ngo'i nyer gsum dang /nyer dgu ste dus bzhi dang /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/tshes brgyad dang ni khyad par du//bco lnga dang ni tshes bcu bzhir/ /grub 'dod rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni//'bad pas gtor ma sbyin par bya//zhes dus gsum la yar ngo dang mar ngo'i dbye bas drug ste de rnams dang / gzhan yang rang rang gi bla ma gong ma khyad par can rnams sku bltams pa dang / zhi bar gshegs pa sogs kyi dus chen rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa mtha' dag 'bum du 'gyur bar gsungs shing /de yang / grub pa'i dbang phyug birlu pa ni/zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyer gsum la bdag med lha mo bco lngas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas mthong lam ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/de nas nyer dgu'i bar sgom lam sa drug gi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i dus chen/ phyis sku lus de nyid kyis bcu gsum rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad do/ /sa chen kun dga' snying po zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku'i bkod pa bzhi dang bcas 387

bde ba can du gshegs so//slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo zla ba bcu gcig pa'itshes bcu gcig la 'ja' lus mkha' spyod chen por gshegs/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la lha dang lha mo mang pos bde ba can du spyan drangs/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'ja' 'od rol mo'i sgra dang / gnas gtsang lha'i bsu ba dang bcas bde bar gshegs/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la mkha' las sgra 'od me tog gi char dang bcas bde bar gshegs/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po zla ba bzhi pa'i nyer lnga la byang chen du gshegs/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan ni zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la bar dor byang chen mngon du mdzad/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan ni zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bzhi la gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/ rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma ni zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga la chos sku mngon du mdzad/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer gcig la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ kun mkhyen rong ston zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la dga' ldan du gshegs/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge zla ba dang po'i tshes nyer gcig la zhi bar gshegs/ sding ma ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la mchog gi go 'phang brnyes/ bsod nams chos 'phel zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la bde bar gshegs/ paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ dbang phyug rab 388

brtan ni zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gnyis la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan ni zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la bde bar gshegs/ mkhyen rab byams pa zla ba lnga pa'i gnam gang la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la mkha' spyod chen por zangs thal du gshegs/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs 'byung zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu drug la zhi bar gshegs/ sa skya pa kun blo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gnyis la chos dbyings su gshegs/ bod 'brug pa ngag dbang blo gsal phun tshogs zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ khri chen ngag dbang kun mkhyen ni zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la pad+ma 'od du gshegs/ gzims 'og bstan 'dzin phrin las zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la o rgyan chen po thugs ker thim/ rig 'dzin phyogs las rnam rgyal ni zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyer bdun la mkha' spyod du gshegs/ gzims 'og bstan 'dzin snyan grags ni zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun la gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus/ khri chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa rin chen mkhyen brtse'i dbang po ni zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu la mkha' spyod chen por gshegs/ 'jam dbyangs blo gter dbang po zla ba gnyis pa'i gnam gang la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas zhi bar gshegs/mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo gros gzhan phan snying po ni zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la ngo mtshar ba'i bkod pa du ma bcas mkha' spyod chen por gshegs/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos ngag dbang thub bstan rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ni zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu la sa bstan bshad sgrub kyis phyogs 389

thams cad du dkar 'jam gyis khyab pa'i byang chen du gshegs/ gzims 'og rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bstan 'dzin zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs/ /mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa ngag dbang blo gros rin chen zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu la skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i rtags bcas zhing gzhan du gshegs so/ /bye brag tu rgyud las gsungs pa'i dus de rnams su phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro rnams tshogs dang gtor mas mnyes par bya ba la mchog tu bsngags pa yin no/ /de bzhin du nyi ma gzas bzung ba'i dus su bye ba 'bum dang / zla ba gzas bzung ba'i dus su bye ba bdun 'gyur du gsungs pa sogs te/mdor na spyi rgyud las/ nyi zla gza' yis zin pa dang / /ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya/ /zhes pas mtshon rgyud sde rnams las dus kyi 'gyur ba la bsngags pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dus chen rnams su dge ba'i bya ba la lhag par brtson par bya'o/ /'di ni mchog dman thams cad dge bar bskul zhing bsod nams spel phyir rang brtsams sngon khrid kyi kha skong gi tshul du bla ma gong ma tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung las btus nas ngag dbang blo gros rin chen gyis bris pa'o//dge'o//bkra shis//

sngags sdom rgyud ldan las dang po pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len gong ma'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄7ོ//oṃ suste sirnyi/sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma dges mdzad la/ /gus pas btud de nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi/ /nyams len 'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /legs par bstan gyis skal ldan gus pas longs/ de la dpal sa skya pa chen po 'khrul bral rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ rig pa 'dzin pa las dang po pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gsungs pa'i 'bring po'i ngag 'don ni/ tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te/ sbyi bor bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum dbyer med du bsgoms la dad mos drag pos/ bla ma mkhyen no//zhes pa gang mang dang /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po cher/ /skyabs su mchi'o gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag dang ma gyur sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam 391

gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos min rnam rtog 'gags par byin gyis rlobs//'phrog med dad pa skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs//byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs//tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes ci nus kyis gsol ba btab nas bla ma 'od du zhu/rang la thim pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag/de nas smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis kun slong bcos/ rlung ro dgu phrugs bus pas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad phyir thon par bsam/ de nas rdor bzlas gang mang gis rlung byin gyis brlabs/ de nas rang gi lce pad+ma 'dab ma gcig pa'i steng du āḥyig gi mthar dbyangs gsal gyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus te thim pas ngag gi sgrib pa dag par bsams te/ oṃ a ā/i zhi/u u/ṛ rī/t+pa lī/e i/o skyoni.i aḥka kha ga gha nga /tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ṇa/da tha da dha na/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣas ha k+ṣa swāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he turnye ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dri mahā shā ma ṇa/ zhes lan gsum brjod la lhasayin dbyangs gsal rtse la thim pas nus ldan du bsams la/bdag gi lce yi dbang po la/ /bde gshegs spobs pa ldan par shog /tshig gi gzi brjid mthu des ni/ /sems can thams cad 'dul bar shog/bdag gis tshig ni ci smras pa'i/ /don de thams cad 'grub par 392
