shog /ces brjod/'gyur sngags ni/ oṃ sa ra sa ra bi ma na sā ra mahā dza wa ci/ zhes dang / oṃ rnya re dha re bharnya re swā hā/zhes dge ba gang byas grangs med 'gro bar gsungs/de nas rang gi gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum bsams te/oṃ 59rdu/lan gsum brjod pas bdag gnas rnal 'byor bsrung /yang mi lam ngan pa byung na de zlog pa'i sngags 'di bzla ste/ oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/tabya thā/oṃ kha kha/khā hi khā gyi/ rtsa rgyu/dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na zi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan bar gcod thams cad zlog par 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs so//yang khrus bya na/ oṃ pra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dha sarba dharmā pra kṛ ti pa ri shu lharta/ sngags 'dis bdag dang chu byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a sbo te r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ dang /lha ru na'i yig brgya bzlas te man ngag bzhin khrus bya/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par bya ba'i phyir du/ dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa'i 'byor bkod mdzis su bshams la/ rang gdan la 'khod la/bdag nyid kye rdo rje yab yum du gsal bas/ rdor dril mi dmigs pa las/ r+ghaṃ las rdo rje dang aḥlas dril bur bskyed/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yas pa : las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la r+ghaṃ dang / lag pa g.yon pa a las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a bskyed la/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par gyur/ de nas rnam lnga 'dod bskor gyi phyag rgyas g.yas pas rdo rje blang 393

shog /ces brjod/'gyur sngags ni/ oṃ sa ra sa ra bi ma na sā ra mahā dza wa ci/ zhes dang / oṃ rnya re dha re bharnya re swā hā/zhes dge ba gang byas grangs med 'gro bar gsungs/de nas rang gi gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum bsams te/oṃ 59rdu/lan gsum brjod pas bdag gnas rnal 'byor bsrung /yang mi lam ngan pa byung na de zlog pa'i sngags 'di bzla ste/ oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ sarba bud+dha a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā ṭ+wāṃ/tabya thā/oṃ kha kha/khā hi khā gyi/ rtsa rgyu/dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na zi lam ngan pa/ ltas ngan bar gcod thams cad zlog par 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs so//yang khrus bya na/ oṃ pra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dha sarba dharmā pra kṛ ti pa ri shu lharta/ sngags 'dis bdag dang chu byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a sbo te r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ dang /lha ru na'i yig brgya bzlas te man ngag bzhin khrus bya/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par bya ba'i phyir du/ dkon mchog gi rten gyi drung du mchod pa'i 'byor bkod mdzis su bshams la/ rang gdan la 'khod la/bdag nyid kye rdo rje yab yum du gsal bas/ rdor dril mi dmigs pa las/ r+ghaṃ las rdo rje dang aḥlas dril bur bskyed/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yas pa : las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la r+ghaṃ dang / lag pa g.yon pa a las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a bskyed la/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par gyur/ de nas rnam lnga 'dod bskor gyi phyag rgyas g.yas pas rdo rje blang 393

zhing / o mahā badz+ra rdu/zhes brjod la/ rdu zhes smin mtshams su lan gsum gsor zhing thugs nar bzung la/thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no//zhes dran par bya'o/yang lag pa g.yon pas dril bu blangs la/oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi āḥzhes brjod cing lan gsum dkrol la dkur kha gyen du bstan te bzung la/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa ston par byed pa'i gsung / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no/ /zhes dran par bya'o/ /de nas dril bu phyogs mtshams brgyad du dkrol zhing /ngag tu/oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta/pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li te pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharma tho da ya sasto ṣa ni rdu rdu rdu ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/zhes brjod cing dkrol bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du grags pas bla ma dang yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs la byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /rang nyid kye rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba ni rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo phyag rgya sku rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no//zhes dran par bya'o/ /'di ni rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung bzhin yin la/rje btsun grags pa'i rdor dril rnam bshad las kyang 'byung la/'phags pa'i gsung las kyang 'byung ba yin no//de nas gnas khang dang mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ ci phaṭa kyis bsangs/ o swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā snya bha wa shu 394

sgonyarta/gis sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bde chen zhing //thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul lha rdzas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgyun chad med par gyur//oṃ badz+ra a sogs nas shasta āḥrdu gi bar dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza me gha sa mu draspa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ rdu/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/de nas skyabs yul rnams gsal btab la/bdag dang ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes ji ltar mang ba dang / mas bskyed ni smon 'jug gi don dran bzhin pas/ma gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir//bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /zhes pa blo'i rgyud la 'dres nges lan gsum brjod/ tshad med bzhi yid kyis dmigs pa rnams gsal btab la/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas/ /bde ba dam pa'i dpal dang mi 'bral bar//btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la gnas par shog/de nas tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa ni/ tha mal mtshan 'dzin dri ma dag pa'i dbyings/ /rdo rje'i ra gur me ris bskor ba'i nang / /ye shes rang 395

snang las grub dag pa'i zhing / /bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhal yas dbus//mi 'jigs seṅges bteg pa'i rin chen khrir//pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng / /thugs srog r+ghaṃ yig sngon po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /rgyal kun rang gzugs rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dges pa rdo rje'i sku/ /dbang sngon mdog can rnam thar brgyad ldan zhal/ /rtsa zhal sngo la g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba//steng zhal dud kha lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag /de nyid spyan gsum zhal rnams thams cad mdzes/ /stong nyid bcu drug phyag rnams thod pas zel/ /nad brgyad len phyir glang chen rta bong glang //rnga mong mi dang sha ra byi la g.yas//dbang phyug brgyad stsol sa chu me rlung lha/ /zla nyi gshin rje nor 'dzin phyag g.yon bsnams/ /rtsa phyag gnyis bsnol lhag ma mdzes par brkyangs/ /bsdu dngos rang bzhin zhabs bzhi g.yon gnyis bskums/ /g.yas gnyis brkyangs pas bdud bzhi'i steng du brjid//shes rab bdag med dga' ma gri thod 'dzin//de dang mnyam sbyor zag med bde chen rgyas/ /thabs shes gnyis gar thod skam dbu rgyan dang //thod phreng do shal rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rtsa zhal mtshog mar sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan ye shes byin za'i klong / /bdag la dgyes 'dzum brtse ba'i ngang tshul can/ /mthong 396

snang las grub dag pa'i zhing / /bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhal yas dbus//mi 'jigs seṅges bteg pa'i rin chen khrir//pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng / /thugs srog r+ghaṃ yig sngon po'i 'phro 'du yis/ /rgyal kun rang gzugs rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i dges pa rdo rje'i sku/ /dbang sngon mdog can rnam thar brgyad ldan zhal/ /rtsa zhal sngo la g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba//steng zhal dud kha lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag /de nyid spyan gsum zhal rnams thams cad mdzes/ /stong nyid bcu drug phyag rnams thod pas zel/ /nad brgyad len phyir glang chen rta bong glang //rnga mong mi dang sha ra byi la g.yas//dbang phyug brgyad stsol sa chu me rlung lha/ /zla nyi gshin rje nor 'dzin phyag g.yon bsnams/ /rtsa phyag gnyis bsnol lhag ma mdzes par brkyangs/ /bsdu dngos rang bzhin zhabs bzhi g.yon gnyis bskums/ /g.yas gnyis brkyangs pas bdud bzhi'i steng du brjid//shes rab bdag med dga' ma gri thod 'dzin//de dang mnyam sbyor zag med bde chen rgyas/ /thabs shes gnyis gar thod skam dbu rgyan dang //thod phreng do shal rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rtsa zhal mtshog mar sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan ye shes byin za'i klong / /bdag la dgyes 'dzum brtse ba'i ngang tshul can/ /mthong 396

thos dran pas gdung sel lham mer bzhugs/ /spyi bor pad zlar rgyu las mi bskyod pa/ /sku mdog sngon po sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad/ /gtso bo'i shar du glang chen khri steng du/ /pad zlar oṃ las rnam snang sku mdog dkar//phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /lho ru rta mchog khri la pad zla'i steng / /ṭ+wāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser/ /phyag gnyis mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can/ /nub tu rma bya'i khri la pad zla'i steng //hrīḥlas 'od dpag med pa sku mdog dmar//phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ /byang du mkha' lding khri la pad zla'i steng / khaṃ las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang //phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can//de rnams zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs//shar lhor pad zlar lo las spyan ma dkar/ /phyag g.yas spyan gyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin/ /lho nub pad zlar mi las mā ma tī /sku mdog sngon mo phyag g.yas rdo rje 'dzin/ /nub byang pad zlar be+e las gos dkar mo/ /sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas pad dmar 'dzin//lha mo de gsum phyag g.yon gdan la brten//byang shar pad zlar tā las sgrol ma ljang / /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas ut+pal 'dzin/ /lha mo de rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /lha rnams thams cad zla ba'i rgyab yol dang / /rin chen rgyan dang dar 397

sham sna tshogs can//sku mdog mthun pa'i dar gyi stod g.yogs gsol//steng phyogs thub dbang nye sras brgyad dang bcas/ /de steng sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor/ /'og gi khyams la 'dod yon lha mo drug /mchod rdzas dpag med thogs nas mchod pa 'bul//steng 'og phyogs mtshams khro bo bcu rnams bzhugs/ /mtha' skor gur zhal lha mo 'dod khams ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu ṭa lcam sring sogs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs de dag kyang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsang gsum rol gar las/ /logs na med pas chu zla ji bzhin gsal/ /lha rnams gnas gsum oṃ āḥrdu gis mtshan/ /de las 'od 'phros 'og min zhing sogs nas/ /bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkha' gang bar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥde nas rdor dril spos bcas dad mos drag pos/ /ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bha ga lhan mahā kā ru ni kā sa pa ri wā ra eh+ye hi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥ rba hoḥ mdun gyi lha tshogs dam tshig pa rnams dang gnyis su med par thim par bsam/bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa 398

legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang //thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod//bar gyis byon legs bya//de nas sku khrus gsol ba la spro na/khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa//shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni//rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol//zhes khrus khang bskyed/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol//oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a gisogs dang /oṃ a ma le bi ma le nirma le swābha wa shudhe swāhā/ zhes brjod la dri zhim sgos chus sku khrus gsol//de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos//gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ kā ya bi sho rnya ni swāhā/ zhes brjod de ras dkar pos sku phyi'o//de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi//o āḥbadz+ra wan+t+ra r+ghaṃ/ 399

oṃ badz+ra a laṅgā ra mai/ zhes brjod pas rab byung dang /khyim pa'i cha lugs can rnams la rang rtags dang mthun pa'i na bza' dang rgyan rnams 'bul/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi//oṃ badz+ra garnye āḥ / /zhes pas dri zhim pa'i chus byug pa 'bul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol//oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya sta/ gyis gdan phul/'di dag bsdu na sngags tsam gyis kyang chog de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char rka'i pad+ma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ /lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal//zhes phyag 'tshal ba'i dmigs rnam gsal btab la/gang gi drin gyis bde chenasogs dang / sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang / 'khor ba'i 'dam tshogs nang gnas pa//thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren mdzad de/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshims mdzad pa//bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud//thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal/ /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du 400

dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang //rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa//lha mo spyan dang mā ma tī/ /dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phyag byar 'os pa sogs phyag rabs rgyas bsdus gang rung gis phyag bya/de nas yan lag bdun pa bya ba ni/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas/ bdag gis bstod par bgyi/ / de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams pa yod na byin rlabs bya/ gang ltar kro na/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing / /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu dgram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /bsdu na/ oṃ gu ru budha bo dhe satwa sa pa ri wā ra a pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra na sa ma ye rdu nas rol mo'i bar bya/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi sogs kyis mchod/ kro na rgyal srid 'dod yon sogs kyis mchod/ me tog dam pa phreng ba sogs nas/mchod par bgyi bar bya/ de nas yid kyis mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul la/ na mas man+ta bud+dha bo snyi satwa ṭ+wāṃ sarba ta /'o ga tā uṅga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swāhā/zhes pas dbul bar de nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma dang / bdun ma dang / zhing khams rnam par 401

dag pa sogs dang / sa gzhi spos chus sogs gang mang mthar/ gang gi mchod rdzas sogs bya/ de nas bshags pa bya ba la/ skyabs gnas dam pa'i yon tan rjes su dran pa dang //rang gi sngar byas kyi sdig pa yid la gsal ba rnams kyis gtso byas/ bdag gzhan kun gyi dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i sdig sang thams cad dang /khyad par sngags kyi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad rtse gcig tu bshags pa'i mos pa dang bcas dngos su phyag 'tshal ba'am thal mo sbyar la/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang / /dran pas snying gi gdung sel pha bla ma/ /'khor 'das mnyam par gzigs pa'i he ru āḥ /las ngan blun rmongs bdag la dar gcig son/ /bdag sogs mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba 'di/ /bdag med bdag tu rtog pa'i lcags sgrog gis//gzhan gyis ma bcings rang gis rang nyid bcings//gnas lugs don ma rtogs pa mthol lo bshags//kun rdzob rgyu rkyen 'gog med rten 'byung gi /'bras bur ma sems kun 'byung nyon mongs las//phyin ci log pa'i rgyu ni mang du bsags//mi mkhas bgyi ba mtha' dag mthol lo bshags/ /lus kyi gsum dang ngag gi rnam pa bzhi/yid las gsum ste mi dge bcu dang ni//mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga/ /sdig pa'i las su gtogs kun mthol lo bshags/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sdom pa mnos te nyams pa gang mchis pa'i/ /ltung dang ltung med gzugs 402

brnyan bcas pa yang / /de ring gnongs shing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ /lhag par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /dbang bzhi so so'i mnyam bzhag rjes spyod dang / /bza' ba srung ba cimi 'bral rnam pa lnga'i//dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags/ /de yi nang nas bum dbang gnas skabs su/ /nyer thob nyams pa'i rtsa nyung bcu bzhi dang / /yan lag ltung ba brgyad las gang gos pa/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mthol lo bshags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig sogs//bsten bya bsten pa'i ngos nas phongs pa yis//sdom pa'i bye brag rnam pa bcu bdun la/ /dri mas sbags pa ma lus mthol lo bshags/ /bka' drin gsum ldan dpal ldan bla ma mchog /gtsug gi nor bur bsten nas sgo gsum gyi/ /srog gi bar gyis khyed mnyes bya ba'i las/ /rnyed bkur sgrub pas ma mchod mthol lo bshags/ /mi mnyes pa yi las ni gang mchis pa/ /srog dang bsdos nas srung sdom bya dgos las/ /ma shes pa'am bag med dbang gyur te/ /thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis mthol lo bshags//snang grag dran rtog thams cad bla ma yi/ /gsang gsum rol par ma rtogs tha dad bzung / /rang sems lhan skyes gsal stong phyag rgya che/ /don gyi bla mar ma rtogs mthol lo bshags//mdor na bdag sogs nongs pa bgyis zin nam// 403

bgyis bzhin bgyid 'gyur ma lus mthol bshags na/ /bzod par bzhes la 'phral yun sgrib pa'i rgyur/ /nam yang 'gro ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye 'phags dge ba kun la bdag yi rang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog skyabs su 'dzin/ /don dam byang chub sems mchog rin po che/ /rgyal rnams gshegs pa'i lam de ngas bsgom mo/ /bdag ni zhi bde don du mi gnyer yang //'gro ba sgrol phyir sangs rgyas sa la smon//de phyir rgyal sras spyod pa yongs rdzogs spyad//bsod nams gang yod gzhan bde'i don du bsngo/ /zhes pa 'di ni 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi gsung la snon phri cung zad bcas tshig don bzang zhing byin rlabs che bas bzhag go /de nas lung bshags dang /spyi bshags bya ba ni/u hu lags/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/tshe thog ma med pa nas da lta la thug gi bar du/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe snang dang gti mug gi dbang gis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang / de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba bgyis pa 404

dang / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang /dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang / pha dang ma la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang /mkhan po dang slob dpon la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang /grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la ma gus pa bgyis pa dang /dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang /gsung rab kyi glud zos pa dang /'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skur pa btab pa dang / sems can la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa la sogs pa/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i sdig pa dang /nyes pa dang /ltung ba'i tshogs ci bgyis pa dang /bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba bgyis pa de dag thams cad/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /slan chad bsdam par bgyid lags so//zhes lan gsum dang /de nas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas phyir bsngo'o bar bya/de dag gis ni sngar byas kyi sdom gsum gyi nyes snang rnams bshags pa dang / slar len pa'i sngon 'gro rnams song nas/ dngos gzhi sdom pa blang zhing gzung ba la/ thog mar skyabs 'gros sor sdom gzung ba ni/ bus btsugs thal sbyar gyis/ phyogs bcu na 405

bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dang / sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi//tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi//zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro dang sor sdom gzung /de nas byang sdom blang zhing gzung ba ni/phyogs bcu na sogs nas ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis//byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la//de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar//de bzhin 'gro la phan don du//byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang //rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi//zhes lan gsum gyis smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas thob dus thob shes kyi bsam pa brtan por bya//de nas rang gzhan dga' ba sgom pa ni/deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod//mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to//da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te//skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la//rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes rang dga' ba sgom pa dang / bdag gis 406

de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar byos/ /zhes gzhan dga' ba bsgom pa dang / /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /ma skyes pa rnams skye gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang //gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing / /byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang //sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing / /bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ /'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa//sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa/ /de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog/ces dang /slar yang rig pa bshags shing byang chub kyi soms bzung ba sogs kyi phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la//byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi//rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir//byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed 407

bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid thong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ de nas gsang /pas kyi sdom pa'i rtsa ba rigs lnga gyi dang so so'i dam tshig rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi snyam sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams//byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te//bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum//sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i//sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung //rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la//rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi//dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la//nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// 408

sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung //las kyi rigs mchog chen po la//sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi//byang chub sems ni bla med mchog/dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing //sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod//ces chon gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / khyad par gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang bzhi'i dam tshig rnams kyang / dbang thob don po dbang bzhi re re bzhin//mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' sung mi 'bral rnams/ /ting 'dzin rgyu dngos bsten spang grogs su shes//bsrung tshul bzhin las mi 'dar byin gyis rlobs//de yi nang nas bum dbang gnas skabs su//nye bar thob pa'i rtsa nyung bcu bzhi dang //yan lag nyung ba brgyad du gsungs pa rnams//tshul bzhin srung sdom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bsngo bgrang byed pa'i tshul gyis spung nus par gsol ba lan gsum 'debs/ /slar yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim thams cad rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs te/ ma dag snang bas khams gsum 409

zhen pa ldog/nyams kyi snang bas lam la nges shes skyes//dag pa'i snang bas 'bras bu mchog la spro/ /lam bzang mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs//phyi nang gsang ba de nyid slob dpon bzhis/ /bum gsang sher nas rtsa yig khams rlung smin/ /sgo gsum sgrib dag lam bzhi sgom rung gis//sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs//rgyu rgyud lta bas phyag chen rang ngo 'phrod/ /lam rgyud sgom pas bskyed rdzogs ye shes 'char/ /'bras rgyud sku dang ye shes rang gnas gyur/ /tshe 'dir mchog dngos 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang gong ma lnga bstod rgyas /// gang rung dang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sogs kyis gsol ba drag tu de nas dbang bzhi blang zhing bla ma rang la ba ma pa ni/ de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis//'khor rnams dgyes pas 'od zhu bla mar thim//sku bzhi lhun grub dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang //sku drin mtshungs med bla ma he ru gaḥ /rgyu lam 'bras bu'i a gi ṣe ka ta/ /ji snyed khyed kyi drin la stos dgos na//bdag kyang glo bur dri ma rnams sbyangs nas//lam dang lta ba grub mtha' 'bras bur bcas/ /bzhi tshan rnam bzhi bde blag bgrod pa'i phyir/ /dbang gi chu bo'i thugs rjes brlan du gsol/ /de skad gsol bas bla ma chos kyi rje/ /dgyes mdzum thugs brtse'i sgo 410

'phar rab phye ste//dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar oṃ gyi gzugs//byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros/ /dpral ba nas zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs//lus kyi sgrib sbyangs bum pa'i dbang mchog thob/ /lus kyi bskyed rim phyi nang bsgom la dbang / /ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rgyud la skyes/ /gnas skabs srid zhi ro snyoms grub mtha' dang / /mthar thug sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar uyi gzugs//byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros//mgrin pa nas zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs/ /ngag gi sgrib sbyangs gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob/ /rang byin rlabs pa'i rim pa bsgom la dbang / /rang byung ye shes rnam bzhi rgyud la skyes/ /gnas skabs grub mtha' ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /mthar thug longs sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /thugs ga'i rgyu las 'od sngon rdu gi gzugs/ /byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros/ /snying ga'i nang zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs//yid kyi sgrib sbyangs gsum pa'i dbang mchog thob/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rim pa bsgom la dbang / /yas babs dga' ba bcu drug rgyud la skyes//gnas skabs grub mtha' bde stong chung ngu dang / /mthar thug chos sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /slar yang gsang gsum byin rlabs sngar bzhin du/ / 411

'phar rab phye ste//dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar oṃ gyi gzugs//byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros/ /dpral ba nas zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs//lus kyi sgrib sbyangs bum pa'i dbang mchog thob/ /lus kyi bskyed rim phyi nang bsgom la dbang / /ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rgyud la skyes/ /gnas skabs srid zhi ro snyoms grub mtha' dang / /mthar thug sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar uyi gzugs//byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros//mgrin pa nas zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs/ /ngag gi sgrib sbyangs gsang ba'i dbang mchog thob/ /rang byin rlabs pa'i rim pa bsgom la dbang / /rang byung ye shes rnam bzhi rgyud la skyes/ /gnas skabs grub mtha' ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs/ /mthar thug longs sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /thugs ga'i rgyu las 'od sngon rdu gi gzugs/ /byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros/ /snying ga'i nang zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs//yid kyi sgrib sbyangs gsum pa'i dbang mchog thob/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rim pa bsgom la dbang / /yas babs dga' ba bcu drug rgyud la skyes//gnas skabs grub mtha' bde stong chung ngu dang / /mthar thug chos sku 'grub pa'i skal bzang ldan/ /slar yang gsang gsum byin rlabs sngar bzhin du/ / 411

byang sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin dpag med spros/ /gnas gsum nas zhugs lus kun mer gyis khengs//sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs bzhi pa'i dbang mchog thob//rdo rje rba rlabs lam bzang bsgom la dbang //mas brtan dga' ba rnam bzhi rgyud la skyes//gnas skabs grub mtha' bde stong chen po dang //mthar thug ngo bo nyid sku'i skal par ldan//bla ma rje btsun 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ /spyi bo nas thim gsang ba rab 'byams dang / /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi ro gcig 'dres /'bras bu rnams kyang deng 'dir mngon du gyur//ces brjod bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang la ci gnas bzhag dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che//bdag gi snying gar sogs dang / thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil//yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdud spos sprin/ /shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho//ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang //bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing / /kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi//gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dag bsgreng ba yis//bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan nas//snying gi chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la//brtan par bzhugs pa'i bla ma mchod bgyid cing //nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla'i dang / /'bral 412

med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod de/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas//rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang //las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas//tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson te/ /thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol//bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di bgyis pas/ /'jig rten ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun 'gro la phan phyir dam chos kyis/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang gdungs grol gyur cig /ces dang /'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs brjo smon rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ 'jam dpal dpa' bos sogs dang / dus gsum gshegs pa'i sogs dang / bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yis ni/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa 'phel 'gyur zhing //sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas//srid pa'i rgya mtsho myur du skem par shog /bsod nams rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs byed cing / /ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par dag gyur te//smon lam rgya mtsho ma lus yongs rdzogs nas/ /lus can kun las khyad par 'phags par shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ / 413

phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med/ /skal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gcig pu/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//yang de tsam ma grub na skyabs sems nas tshogs rten bskyed pa yan sngar bzhin la/ spyan 'dren sogs kyi tshigs bcad rnams dor la sngags tsam gyis 'thus/ yan lag bdun pa'i bar gyi bshags tshig dang /maṇ+ḍal rnams las gang 'os re las thams cad ma byas kyang chog gzhan rnams sngar bzhin dang /de tsam yang mi rtsogs na skyabs sems tshad med sngon du 'gro bas/ skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum spyan drangs la phyag mchod sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par byas te de nas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs mas bzung ba ni theg chen gyi sdom pa thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas brjo smon bya ba ni shin tu bsdus pa yin par gsungs/ yang rje btsun rin po che grags pas bra ston zhus lan las/ bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems/ don dam byang chub sems kyang bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang sems/bdag la de dag sdig smin cing //bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces yang yang brjod cing don sgom/ don dam byang sems stong nyid thos bral sgom pa ni/ dbang bzhi'i mnyam rjes kyi dam tshig lta sgom tshad du bskyal ba zhes dus thams cad na bsgom par bya dgas la/ gzhan yang sgrib spyong gi rigs gsungs pa rnams kyang shes par bya la/ gyis sdom 414

gsum gyi nyes sang mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gzhung 'di nyid du gzhan yang so sor thar pa'i bslab par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par bya ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i bslab par bya ba rnams ni gzhung gzhan nyid du btsal bar bya'o//zhes gsungs pas/ rang rgyud du sdom pa gang blang ba so so'i bslab bya dang sang ba rnams shes shing mkhas par bya dgos te/dang po so thar la/rin chen phreng bar/ de nas rab tu byung ba yis//dang por bslab la rab gus bya//so sor thar pa 'dul bcas pa//mang thos don gtan dbab la sgrim//zhes gsungs pa ltar/blo la byang shing nges par bya ba'i phyir//dang po skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen yin na bslab bya mdor bsdus/ mdo myang 'das las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba//de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te//nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs song bas/ /'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs song bas/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gnyis pa yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab bya ni/ sdom brgyad las/ ji srid 'tsho bar gsod dang rku//log par g.yem dang rdzun dang ni//chang gi btung ba rnams las ldog /ces rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga/ dge tshul la/sum brgya pa las/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang / /mi tshangs spyod rdzun bcos pa'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang / /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spang //zhes rags pa bcu dang /de'i phyogs mthun blang 'das so gsum dang /dbe slong la/pham pa bzhi ni/so 415

thar las/ mi tshangs spyod dang rku ba dang / /mi la bsad pa bya ba dang / /rdzun du smra dang bcas pa yi//chos bzhi 'dir ni gsungs pa yin//zhes dang / dge 'dun lhag ma bcu gsum ni/khu ba 'dzin dang 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur sbyan/ /khang pa khang chen dang ni gzhi med dang / /bag tsam dge 'dun dbyed dang de rjes phyogs/ /khyim sun 'byin dang bka' blo mi bde ba'o//zhes dang / spang nyung sum cu ni/ 'chang dang 'bral ba 'jog pa dang //'khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang / /slong dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bcas/ /rin thang so sor bskur ba'o/ /srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang //drug dang mtho gang lam dang ni//'khru ba dang ni gser dngul dang / /mngon tshan can dang nyo tshong ngo / /lhu bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis//byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang / /dgon pa ba dang ras chen dang / /bsngos pa dang ni gsog 'jog go /zhes dang /lcang byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu ni/ rdzun skyon dge slong phra ma dang //skyo sngogs byed dang ston pa dang //'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos//bshes ngor byed dang khyad du gsod/ /sa bon 'phya ba bsgo ba dang / /khri dang 'ding dang skyod pa dang / /phyis non 'byung ba 'debs pa dang / /rim pa gnyis su rtsig pa'o/ /ma bskos nyi ma nub pa dang / /zas dang chos gos gnyis dag dang //don mthun gru dang dben pa gnyis//dge slong 416

ma yis sbyor bcug pa'o//yang yang dang ni 'dug gnas gcig /phye dang bca' dang stob pa dang / /'dus dang dus min gsog 'jog dang / /kha nas mid dang bsod pa nyid/ /srog chags dang bcas nyal sar 'dug /'greng dang gcer bu dmag dang ni//zhag gnyis bsham dkrug 'gro ba dang / bdeg dang gzas dang gnas ngan len//bde dang me dang 'dun pa dang / /bsnyen pa ma rdzogs chos dang smra/ /dge tshul kha dog bsgyur ba dang / /rin po che dang tsha ba'i dus//dud 'gro 'gyod pa sor mo dang / /rtse dang lhan cig dngangs byed dang / /sbed dang gdeng med gzhi med dang / /skyes pa med par lam 'gro ba'o/ /rku dang nyi shu ma lon dang //rko dang mgron dang bslab pa dang / /'thab dang mi smra 'gro ba dang / /mi gus chang 'thung dus min pa'o/ /zas bcas skya rengs da sdod dang / khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang / /gdal dang 'ding dang g.yan pa dang //ras chen bde gshegs chos gos so//zhes dang /sor bshags bzhi ni/grong dang khyim gzhan nyid dang ni//bslab pa rnams dang dgon pa ni/ /sangs rgyas phan par gsungs pa yis so sor bshags par bya bar gsungs//zhes dang /nyes byas brgya rtsa bcu gnyis ni/sham thabs la ni rnam bdun dang //stod g.yogs la ni rnam pa gsum//shin tu bsdam la sogs pa lnga/ /mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ / 417

mchong la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /lus la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ /'dug par bya ba dgu dag dang / /byin len bya ba brgyad rnams so/ /zas la legs par bya ba drug /tsug tsug la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /'bru nas tha dad byed pa lnga//lag pa ldag la sogs pa lnga//'phya la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi//lhung bzed la yang rnam pa bcu//'greng la sogs pa rnam pa lnga//mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /do ker can la sogs pa lnga/ /glang chen la sogs zhon pa lnga//lag na 'khar ba la sogs drug /na ba la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi sdom tshig 'di rnams kyi don shes shing byang bar bya ba dang / yang mdo rtsar/bslab pa thams cad la dus dag yod kyang byin gyis ma brlabs pa la ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nyin zhag gcig gi dus dran bya tshul ni/ rten gyi drung du phyag gsum byas nas tsog pur 'dug la/ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ de ring gi gnas skabs su/ chos ldan gyi bya ba dang gzhan gyi don du/ glu gar dang rol mo la sogs pa byed dam byed du gzhug pa dang / me la reg pa dang /reg tu gzhug pa dang /rin po che la reg pa dang / reg tu gzhug pa dang / sa bon bcom pa dang /bcom du gzhug pa dang /skyes pa gcod pa dang / gcod du gzhug pa dang / lag nya dang /mtshams btsos dang /zhag lon dang /rjen btsos dang /gsog 'jog 418

byas pa za ba dang / byin len ma byas par za ba dang / bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu 'don pa la sogs pa mdor na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum las/ dus dran bsten du rung ba rnams la/ ston pa thugs rje can gyis gnang ba mdzad du gsol/zhes lan gsum bya/de nas/khrims kyi tshul khrims sogs brjod do//de lta bu'i dus dran bsten pa sogs cing ba mi 'byung ba'i thabs la 'bad la/ de bzhin du byang sdom dbu ma pa'ilugs la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa/ /phas pham pa yi ltung bar 'dod//dam pa'i chos ni spong byed pa//gnyis par thub pas gsungs pa yin/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dge slong la'ang //ngur smrig 'phrog dang brdeg pa dang / /btson rar 'jug par byed pa dang / /rab tu byung las 'bebs pa dang //mtshams med lnga po byed pa dang //log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang / /grong la sogs pa 'jig pa yang rtsa ba'i nyung bar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes rgyal blon byang sems las dang po pa la 'byung nye'i rtsa snang drug dang / blo sbyong ma byas sems can la//stong pa nyid ni brjod pa dang / /sangs rgyas nyid la zhugs pa dag /rdzogs pa'i byang chub zlog pa dang //so sor thar pa yongs spangs te//theg pa che la sbyor ba dang / /slob pa'i theg pas chags la sogs//spong bar 'gyur ba min zhes 'dzin/ /pha rol dag kyang 'dzin 'jug dang / /rang gi yon 419

tan brjod pa dang //rnyed pa dang ni bkur sti dang / /tshigs bcad rgyu yis gzhan smod dang / /bdag ni zab mo bzod pa'o zhes/ /log pa nyid ni smra ba dang / /dge sbyong chad pas gcod 'jug dang //dkon mchog gsum gyi sbyin byed dang //sbyin pa len par byed pa dang / /zhi gnas 'dor bar byed pa dang / /yang dag 'jog gi longs spyod rnams/ kha ton byed la sbyin pa rnams/ /de dag rtsa ba'i ltung ba ste/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po'i rgyu//mi lam 'phags pa mkha' snying po'i//mdun du 'dug ste bshags par bya//zhes byang sems las dang po la 'byung nye'i rtsa sang brgyad de bcu bzhi ni nam snying mdo'i dgongs pa bslab btus su gsungs pa'o/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dor dang / /chags dang ser sna mi bzod pas//slong la sbyin pa mi byed dang //bsgrims te dga' bar byed pa ni//sems can la ni mi bzod par/khros pas sems can bdeg pa dang //nyon mongs pa dang gnas mthun par//chos ltar bcos pa brjod pa'o//zhes thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo'i dgongs pa bslab btus su gsungs pa'i rtsa cing bzhi'o/ /sems tsam lugs kyi pham 'dra bzhi po yang / sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ nyon mongs drag las byung ba yis//sdom pa zhig par gang gyur pa//de yi nyes pa bzhi po ni//pham pa 'dra bar dgongs pa yin//rnyed dang bkur ster chags pa yis//bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang / /sdug bsngal mgon med 420

gyur pa la//ser snas chos nor mi ster dang / /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ khros pas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang / theg pa chen po spong byed cing //dam chos 'drar snang ston pa'o//zhes dang / de nas lugs gnyis na'i nyes byas rnams kyang shes shing spong ba dang / gsang sngags bla med la/ dbang bzhi re re la'ang mnyam rjes bza' srung mi 'bral ba ste nyi shur gsungs pa rnams lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad las gsungs pa tshigs bcad du byas pa ni/bum dbang mnyam bzhag dam tshig bskyed rim bsgom/ /rjes spyod dam tshig ngo bo nyid gsum bskyang / /bza' ba'i dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /bsrung bya rtsa ltung yan lag nyi shu gnyis//mi 'bral dam tshig rdo rje dril bu 'chang //gsang dbang mnyam bzhag dam tshig rtsa rlung bsgom/ /rjes spyod dam tshig rang byung ye shes bskyang / /bza' ba'i dam tshig gsal stong ting 'dzin dang //bsrung ba'i dam tshig rlung 'gal zas spyod spang / /mi 'bral dam tshig srog rtsol bum can no/ /sher dbang mnyam gzhag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom/ /rjes spyod dam tshig lhan skyes ye shes bskyang / /bza' ba'i dam tshig bde stong ting nge 'dzin//bsrung ba'i dam tshig thig le 'dzag pa spang / /mi 'bral dam tshig dngos ye'i phyag rgya'o/ /dbang bzhi'i mnyam gzhag rdo rje rba rlabs bsgom/ /rjes spyod dam tshig mas brtan dga' ba bzhi/ /bza' ba'i dam tshig bde stong 421

ting 'dzin mchog /bsrung bya sgrib pa gnyis las shes sgrib dang //mi 'bral dngos le'i phyag rgya pad can no//zhes dang /bla med bum dbang gi bsrung ba'i dam tshig rtsa ba'i nyung ba bcu bzhi ni/ /kun nas dwangs pas bla ma yi/ /zhabs kyi pad mo la btud de/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi ni//rgyud las gsungs pa bshad par bya//gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis//dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brangs gsungs//de bas de la brnyas pa ni//rtsa ba'i lhung ba dang po bshad//bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni//ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad/ /rdo rje'i spun la khros pa ni/ /nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ /sems can rnams la byams pa spong / /bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems/ /de spong ba ni lnga pa yin/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /chos la smod pa drug pa yin/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba sgrog pa bdun pa yin/ /phung po sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ /de la smod pa brgyad pa yin//rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la//som nyi za ba dgu pa yin//gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par//byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod//ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la//der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa//sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa/ /dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed/ /mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /shes rab 422

rang bzhin bud med la/ /smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa/ /sngags pas 'di dag spangs nas ni/ /dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan du dam tshig las nyams na/ /nyams pa bdud kyis gzung bar 'gyur//de nas sdug bsngal myong 'gyur te/ /thur du bltas nas dmyal bar 'gro//de bas nga rgyal bcom nas ni/ /bdag nyid ma 'khrul shes par bya/ /mnyam par gzhag pas bla ma la/ /ci 'byor pas ni mchod byas te/ /gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni//gal te bdag la phan 'dod na//sngags pas 'bad de bzung bar bya//yan lag gi cing ba brgyad ni/ yan lag dam tshig ces bya ba/ /dam tshig dag dang mi ldan pa'i/ /rig ma bsten par dga' ba dang //tshogs kyi 'khor lor rtsod pa dang //gsang ba'i chos ni ston pa dang //sems can dad dang ldan pa la/ /dam chos gzhan du ston pa dang / /nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i//nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang //sbyor ba nges par ma byas par//skal min gsang ba ston pa dang //gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la/ /lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa dang / /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ / dkyil 'khor las la 'jug pa dang / /sdom pa gnyis kyi bcas pa las//dgos pa med par 'da' ba dang /la na ma tho bcas gyur te/ /sngags pa de yi dam tshig zad/ /zad pas 423

'grub par mi 'gyur zhing / /bdud dang sdug bsngal mang du 'phel/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du//nyin re bzhin du bzla bar bya//'di rnams kyang ba pas gsungs la/yang bsten bya bsten pa'i bslab bya/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa ni/ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya//rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya//rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya//gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya//rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya//rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya//'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing / /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /mi lam du yang mi bya'o//slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma rgan rabs phyag bgyi'o/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzlas shing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya//rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya//dzam+bha la la chu sbyin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang //mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya//zhes pa las ji srid sogs tshig rkang dgu'i mthar rtag par rgyun du sogs tshig rkang bcu sprel bas las dang po ba'i bsgrub bya'i chos bcu bdun dang / phyag rgya bcings pa rnam spang sogs tshig rkang bdun 424

gyis drod thob pa'i bslab bya rnam pa lnga rnams 'khrugs can du gsungs pa de bzhin du shes par bya la/ de lta bu'i gzhung dang sdom tshig rnams dus rtag tu klog pa dang / blo la 'dzin te byang ba'i thabs la nan tan byas te dran shes kyis rang rgyud la brtanadagos te/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/rtsa ba'i snang ba bcu bzhi ni/ /klog dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya//zhes dang / rje btsun grags pa'i zhal nas kyang / de nas rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa yi//dam tshig rnams la byang bas nan tan bya//zhes gsungs/ de ltar sngar bstan pa de rnams rgyas bsdus ji ltar yang tho rangs dang snga dro dang /nyi ma'i gung dang / phyim red dang / srod kyi dus dang nyal kha dang drug du nyams su blang bar gzhung 'di las gsungs la/ bya rgyud legs grub las//nyin par bag med byas pa dag /mtshan mor so sor bshags par bya//nub mor byas pa dngas par bshags//legs par byas la mngon dga' bya//zhes dang /rdo rje rtse mo las/nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du//nyin re bzhin nas 'da' bar bya//zhes dang /rtsa sang gi gzhung las//nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du//nyid re bzhin yang bzla bar bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar bya la/ /thun mtshams rnams su/ /mdo glog pa/gzungs sngags bzla ba/ dza la la chu sbyin pa/'byung po sogs la gtor ma dang /yi dwags sogs la chu sbyin pa/kha zas dang 'brel ba'i cho ga /zas kyi bya ba rdzogs nas chos spyod bcu gang 'grub bya ba/ sku dang mchod rten gyi su 'debs pa/ sku rten sogs la phyag dang bskor ba bya ba gsungs pa rnams ni/ gzhung nyid las rtogs par bya la/de nas srod thun la/klu sgrub kyis/rigs pa'i bdag nyid nyin par mtha' dag dang / mtshan mo thun gyi stod smad bzlas nas ni//mnal tshe'ang 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur bar//dran dang ldan pa de dag rab tu mnol/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bzlas brjod bsam gtan gyis dus 'da'/ de nas nyal tshe bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs shing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal la nam gyi cha smad la langs te sngar bzhin spyad par bya zhing / mdor na/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu spyor// 425

zhes pa rnams gtso bor byas te dus kun tu so thar gyi nges 'byung dang tshul khrims/ byang sems kyi sems bskyed dang byams snying / gsang sngags kyi bla ma'i mos gus dang rim gnyis kyi nyams len rnams kyis dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /'di ltar kun tu spyod pa'i gang zag de ni ring por mi thogs par bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ma thob kyi bar du yang bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub cing chos dang mthun par 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs so//slar smras pa/gsung mchog sa 'og rin chen gter gyur de//blo gros lha mig gis gsal dga' bas longs/ /dge bas sa bstan bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas//mar gyur 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la smon//zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i chos spyod rin chen phreng ba ji lta ba la rang blos dpyad pa'i zhabs tog phran bu bcas dpal nā len+d+ra'i mkhan ming ma ti'i ming can gyis rngog chos rdor 'ja' lus grub pa'i dben gnas su sug bris bgyis pa'o//dge'o/nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len mdor bsdus/r+yā//bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba dges mdzad dbyer med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/'dir nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len bsdus pa spro na/tho rangs/ bla ma mkhyen/ /zhes gang mang dang / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po cher/ /skyabs su mchi'o gus pas gsol ba 'debs//bdag dang mar gyur sems can thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag yig gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ / 426

dam chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs/ /lam gyi 'khrul pa zhi bar byin gyis rlobs//'khrul snang dbyings su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs//chos min rnam rtog 'gags par byin gyis rlobs/ /'phrog med dad pa skye bar byin gyi rlobs//byams dang snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs/byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes ci nus gsol ba btab/de nas rlung ro bsal ba/ rdor bzlas bya ba/ngag byin rlabs/ 'gyur sngags bzla ba rnams tho rangs bya ba yin ying thun mgor byas kyang chog de nas lag pa dang rdor dril byin rlabs bya ste/ bdag nyid kye rdo rje yab yum du gsal bas/rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs pa las/: las rdo rje dang / āḥlas dril bur gyur/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yas pa rdu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rgyu dang / /lag pa g.yon pa a las pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a bskyed la/ de rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par gyur/ /de nas pad kor gyis rdo rje blang zhing / oṃ mahā badz+ra rdu zhes brjod la r+ghaṃ zhes smin mtshams su lan gsum gsor zhing thugs nar bzung la/thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi sems thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no//zhes dran par bya'o//lag g.yon pas dril bu blangs la/ o badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi āḥzhes brjod cing dril bu 427

lan gsum dkrol nas dkur kha gyen du bstan te bzung la/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa ston par byed pa'i gsung / /chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no/ /zhes dran par bya'o//de nas dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ta sogs brjod cing rdor dril zugs dkar bsnom bas/ rang nyid kye rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo phyag rgya sku'i rdo rje'i dam tshig yin no/ /zhes dran par bya'o/ /thun dang po las thun phyi ma rnams la 'di yan ma byas kyang chog de nas gnas khang dang / dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod pa bcas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta sogs kyis bsang / oṃ su bha wa sogs kyis sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bde chen zhing / /thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul lha rdzas mchod pa'i tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgyun chad med par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a sogs nas shasta āḥ gi bar dang /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā gu dza me gha sa mu draspa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ rgyu lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ de nas skyabs yul gsal btab la/ /bdag dang ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa//dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes ji mang dang / sems bskyed ni/ ma gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i 428

sangs rgyas thob par bya/ /de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi ni/sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun 'byung ma lus rab spangs nas/ /bde ba dam pa'i dpal dang mi 'bral bar//btang snyoms chen po'i ngang la gnas par shog /de nas tshogs zhing bam pa ni//tha mal mtshan 'dzin dri ma dag pa'i dbyings//rdo rje'i ra gur me ris bskor ba'i nang / /ye shes las grub gzhal yas bkod legs dbus/ /seng khri pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dges pa rdo rje ni/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag /zhabs bzhi bdag med yum 'khyud gar dgu'i nyams//phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs/ /de yi spyi bor rigs bdag mi bskyod pa/ /phyogs bzhir glang chen rta mchog rma bya dang / /mkha' lding khri la so sor pad zla'i steng / /shar du rnam snang lho ru rin 'byung dang / /nub tu snang mtha' byang du don grub dang / /mtshams bzhir pad zlar shar lhor spyan ma dang / /lho nub ma tī nub byang gos dkar mo/ /byang shar sgrol ma steng 'og phyogs mtshams su/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang //'dod yon lha mo drug dang khro bo bcu//mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /lha rnams gnas 429

gsum 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs sa mā dzaḥ.i bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi kā sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya gyi sa mā ya sta dzaḥ be hoḥdam tshig pa la thim/de nas sku khrus gsol te//ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā sogs dang / oṃ a ma le bi ma le nirma le su bhā wa shudhe swāhā/ /zhes pas sku khrus gsol/oṃ kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/zhes pas sku phyi/oṃ āḥbadz+ra wan+t+ra rgyu gis na bza' dbul//oṃ badz+ra a lo kā ra rdu gis rgyan dbul/de nas phyag bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sogs dang / 'khor ba'i 'dam tshogs nang gnas pa/ /thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren mdzad de/ /ye shes bdud rtsis tshims mdzad pa//bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mar 'dud//thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas//thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa//kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal//chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang //gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal//thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang / /rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa//lha mo spyan dang mā ma tī//dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal//phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ / 430

lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu//mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo//phyag bya ba'i gzungs ni/o na mo bha ga wa te/ rat+na ke tu rā dza ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te simyakle burta ya/ tabya thā/oṃ rasnerasne mahā rasne resnab dza ya swāhā/gzungs 'dis mchod yul la phyag byas na mchod yul gye ba la phyag byas par 'gyur ro/ /yan lag bdun pa'i/ /ji snyed su dag sogs kyis phyag bya//de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā ra a sogs nas rol mo'i bar byas la/ na masarba bu bo snyi satwa bh+yaḥ.o sarba bta gu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya swāhā/ /zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur ba dang zhabs la khyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas me tog lag tu blangs te/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ put+pa ke tu ra dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bu ya/ tabya thā/ yo pu pu bu bha we pu bha we pu ba smin swāhā/ zhes me tog phul na me tog bye ba phul bar 'gyur ro//de nas/ me tog dam pa sogs dang /yid sprul gyi mchod pa ni/ na masma man+ta budhe bo rnyi sa tā ṭ+wāṃ sarba ta thā ga tā uṅga te spa ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swāhās phul/ /lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs 431

sems can phan par bgyi/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do//zhes pas phul/de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung dang /rjo na sdig pa bshags pa/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang / /dran pas snying gi gdung sel pha bla ma/ /'khor 'das mnyam par gzigs pa'i he ru naḥ /las ngan blun rmongs bdag la dar cig gson/ /bdag sogs mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba 'di/ /bdag med bdag tu rtog pa'i lcags sgrog gis/ /gzhan gyis ma bcings rang gis rang nyid bcings/ /gnas lugs don ma rtogs pa mthol lo bshags/ /kun rdzob rgyu rkyen 'gog med rten 'byung gi /'bras bur ma sems kun 'byung nyon mongs las /phyin ci log pa'i rgyu ni mang du bsags//mi mkhas bgyi ba mtha' dag mthol lo bshags//lus kyi gsum dang ngag gi rnam pa bzhi//yid las gsum ste mi dge bcu dang ni//mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga//sdig pa'i las su gtogs kun mthol lo bshags/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems dpa' yi//sdom pa mnos te nyams pa gang mchis pa'i//ltung dang ltung med gzugs brnyan bcas pa yang / /de ring gnongs shing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ /lhag par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas//dbang bzhi so so'i mnyam bzhag rjes spyod dang //bza' 432

sems can phan par bgyi/ /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do//zhes pas phul/de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung dang /rjo na sdig pa bshags pa/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang / /dran pas snying gi gdung sel pha bla ma/ /'khor 'das mnyam par gzigs pa'i he ru naḥ /las ngan blun rmongs bdag la dar cig gson/ /bdag sogs mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba 'di/ /bdag med bdag tu rtog pa'i lcags sgrog gis/ /gzhan gyis ma bcings rang gis rang nyid bcings/ /gnas lugs don ma rtogs pa mthol lo bshags/ /kun rdzob rgyu rkyen 'gog med rten 'byung gi /'bras bur ma sems kun 'byung nyon mongs las /phyin ci log pa'i rgyu ni mang du bsags//mi mkhas bgyi ba mtha' dag mthol lo bshags//lus kyi gsum dang ngag gi rnam pa bzhi//yid las gsum ste mi dge bcu dang ni//mtshams med lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga//sdig pa'i las su gtogs kun mthol lo bshags/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems dpa' yi//sdom pa mnos te nyams pa gang mchis pa'i//ltung dang ltung med gzugs brnyan bcas pa yang / /de ring gnongs shing 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags/ /lhag par rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas//dbang bzhi so so'i mnyam bzhag rjes spyod dang //bza' 432

ba srung ba mi 'bral rnam pa lnga'i/ /dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags//de yi nang nas bum dbang gnas skabs su//nyer thob nyams pa'i rtsa nyung bcu bzhi dang / /yan lag nyung ba brgyad las gang gos pa/ /snying khong rus pa'i gting nas mthol lo bshags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dam tshig sogs/ /bsten bya bsten pa'i ngos nas phongs pa yis/ /sdom pa'i bye brag rnam pa bcu bdun la/ /dri mas sbags pa ma lus mthol lo bshags/ /bka' drin gsum ldan dpal ldan bla ma mchog /gtsug gi nor bu bsten nas sgo gsum gyi//srog gi bar gyis khyed mnyes bya ba'i las/ /rnyed bkur sgrub pas ma mchod mthol lo bshags//mi mnyes pa yi las ni gang mchis pa//srog dang bsdos nas srung sdom bya dgos las/ /ma shes pa'am bag med dbang gyur te/ /thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /snang grag dran rtog thams cad bla ma yi/ /gsang gsum rol par ma rtogs tha dad bzung / /rang sems lhan skyes gsal stong phyag rgya che/ /don gyi bla mar ma rtogs mthol lo bshags/ /mdor na bdag sogs nongs pa bgyis zin nam/ /bgyis bzhin bgyid 'gyur ma lus mtho la bshags na/ /bzod par bzhes la 'phral yun sgrib pa'i rgyur/ /nam yang 'gro ba med par byin gyis rlobs/ /skye 'phags dge ba kun la 433

bdag yi rang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog skyabs su 'dzin/ /don dam byang chub sems mchog rin po che//rgyal rnams gshegs pa'i lam de ngas bsgom mo/ /bdag ni zhi bde'i don du mi gnyer yang / /'gro ba sgrol phyir sangs rgyas sa la smon/ /de phyir rgyal sras spyod pa yongs rdzogs spyad/ /bsod nams gang yod gzhan bde don du bsngo/ /gyi bshags sogs dang / 'dod chags zhe snang sogs dang / de nas skyabs 'gro dang byang sdom len pa ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs bya/ byang chub snying por sogs dang / yang phyogs bcu sogs dang / ji ltar sngon gyi sogs deng dus sogs bya'o//shin tu bsdu na/sngar phyag byar 'os pa'i mjug nas 'dir 'jug chogadakon mchog gsum la sogs dang /shin tu bsdus tshe rigs lnga'i sdom bzung 'di ma byas kyang chog rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs so//de nas dbang bzhi'i dam tshig ni/ dbang thob don po dbang bzhi re re bzhin/ /mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bza' srung mi 'bral rnams/ /ting 'dzin rgyu dngos bsten spang grogs su shes/ /bsrung tshul bzhi las mi 'dar byin gyis rlobs//de yi nang nas bum dbang gnas skabs su//nye bar thob pa'i rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / /yan lag ltung ba brgyad du gsungs pa rnams/ tshul bzhin bsrung sdom nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig gi /bsten bya bcu bdun dang po'i las 434

can gyis//bsten bya bcu bdun gong ma'i bsten bya rnams/ /gnas skabs so sor bsten nus byin rlobs//'di rnams lan gsum gsum dang /ma dag snang bas khams gsum zhen pa ldog /nyams kyi snang bas lam la nges shes skyes//dag pa'i snang bas 'bras bu mchog la spro/lam bzang mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid slob dpon bzhis/ /bum gsang sher yes rtsa yig khams rlung smin/ /sgo gsum sgrib dag lam bzhi sgom rung gis/ /sku bzhi'i rten 'brel 'grigs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyu rgyud lta bas phyag chen rang ngo 'phrod/ /lam rgyud sgom pas bskyed rdzogs ye shes 'char/ /'bras rgyud sku dang ye shes rang gnas 'gyur/ /tshe 'dir mchog dngos 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//'di grangs bsags na legs/ de nas tha pa dang gong ma lnga'i gsol 'debs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs gang mang / skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ drin can chos kyi rje la sogs brjod/mthar dbang bzhi blang zhing bla ma rang la bstem pa ni/de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab pa yis/ /'khor rnams dgyes pas 'od zhu bla mar thim/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po//oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim//bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po/ /〉yi 435

gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs sga'i rdu las 'od sngon po/ /r+ghaṃ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim/ /gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs/ /'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim/ /bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur/ /bla ma rje btsun 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ spyi bo nas thim gsang ba rab 'byams dang / /bdag gi dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi ro gcig 'dres/ /'bras bu rnams kyang deng 'dir mngon du gyur/ /bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang la ci gnas bzhag mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/thos pa rgya ma61re sogs/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ skye zhing sogs/bdag sogs gdul byar sogs/ bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di bgyis pas//'jig rten ring por mi thogs sangs rgyas nas/ /de kun 'gro la phan phyir dam chos kyis/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang gdung grol gyur cig /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sogs bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya'o//zhes pa 'di'ang rang gi kha 'don du ngag dbang blo gros kyis bris pa'o/ /par 'di nā len+d+ra ru bzhugs so/ /da 'o/4//3/6

zhal gdams slob bu'i re skong mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so//༄༄ོ//na mo gu ru/ skyabs mchog gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus pa'i//rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /snang gnas pa'i shes bya kun rtogs nas//bstan 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub byin rlobs/ /blo gsal zhing dad pa ldan pa khyed//chos tshul bzhin sgrub na 'di ltar mdzod//gnas ngan pa khams gsum 'khor ba 'dir//bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdungs//da ngan song gsum gyi gnas de na//tsha grang sogs sdug bsngal drag po yod/ /sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bya ba yin/ /dpe rma la rgya tshwa ji bzhin rna/ /lha lha min mir bcas mtho ris na/ /zag bcas la bde bar rlom na yang / /'du byed dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin/ /zas dug dang 'dres pa za ba bzhin/ /de lta bu'i sdug bsngal yang yang dran/ /'khor ba nas thar 'dod nges 'byung blos/ /chos thos bsam sgom la brtson mdzod kyi//rten dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i lus bzang 'di//rnyed dka' la don che nor bu 'dra//de tshul bzhin bsams la 'di snang la//zhen che bas chud zos mi gtong bar/ /brtson drag pos dam chos sgrub pa yis/ /tshe 'di la snying po lon par mdzod//'dus byas pa'i phyi snod nang bcud 'gro/ /de mi rtag myur du 'jig cing 'chi//rlung drag pos btab pa'i mar me bzhin/ /de rtogs nas dam pa'i lha chos 437

de/ /dus myur du sgrub mdzod dad ldan khyed//las dge dang mi dge mi g.yo ba'i//rgyu gang bsags rnam smin rgyu mthun sogs/ /rdul tsam yang chud zos med pa yi/ /bde sdug gi 'bras bu thog tu smin//de bsams la las 'bras phra zhib la//tshul bzhin du blang dor mdzad par zhu//de yan chad thun mong sdon 'gro yin//ma 'gro kun phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi//rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung rtogs gnyis//bshad sgrub pa gnyis kyis 'dzin dgos gsungs//lung sde snod rgyud sde rig gnas bcas//de bla ma mkhas pas tshul bzhin bshad/ /blo gsal bas nyan cing bsam byung bcug /gzhung tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i lag rjes la//dgra dug gsum nga rgyal phrag dog dang / /gnod sems sogs nyon mongs mgo non dgos/ /de med na mkhas kyang don med yin/ /dpe gser bum dug chus gang dang mtshungs//de lung gi bstan pa 'dzin tshul yin//da rtogs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la//dus gsum gyi rgyal bas bsngags pa yi//gnas dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' bar//gzhi tshul khrims dag pas rgyud gtsang zhing //skyabs bslu med dkon mchog rnam gsum la//ma 'gro drug don du skyabs 'gro dang / /smon 'jug pa'i byang chub sems mchog bskyed//byams snying rje bdag gzhan mnyam brje'i sems//ma mkha' mnyam 'gro la yang yang bsgom//da man ngag lung rigs ji bzhin du//sems rtse gcig gnas pa'i zhi gnas dang //bsam gzugs sogs ting 'dzin du ma yod//bdag gnyis med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong de/ /spros kun dang bral ba'i sher phyin yum//don de rnams brtson 'grus chen pos bsgom//rang smin byed sbyin sogs phar phyin drug /gzhan don byed bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs/ /tshul bzhin du nyams len mdzad pa 438

na/ /bskal chen po grangs med gsum sogs mthar/ /sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhes mdo las gsungs//de mdo yi rtogs pa'i bstan pa ni//tshul ji ltar 'dzin tshul mdor bsdus yin//rgyud gsang chen rdo rje theg pa ni//sngar bstan pa'i nyams len gzhir bzung ste//khong bla ma mkhas pa tshad ldan gyis//rgyud smin byed dbang bzhi zab mo de//rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la legs par bskur//dbang brda don 'phrod pa shin tu gnad//sems zab don rtogs nas grol ba'i thabs/ /khrid man ngag slob bshad ngo sprod 'phrod/ /lung tshad ma rtsa bshad cha lag bcas//tshul bzhin du rtogs nas tshad ma bzhi /de snyan brgyud rnam bzhis legs brgyan nas//da nyams su len par byed pa la//gzhi gsang sngags rtsa ba dam tshig yin//dbang bzhi la mnyam bzhag rjes spyod dang / /bza' bsrung dang mi 'bral lnga lnga ste/ /grangs bcu phrag gnyis ldan de dag rnams/ /phra zhib mor shes nas bsrung ba gces/ /dbang gdams ngag thob nas dam tshig rnams//ming tsam yang mi shes mi bsrung ba/ /de mnar med me yi bud shing yin//dbang bzhi yi lam bzhi bum dbang lam//lus rtsa yi dkyil 'khor sbyang gzhi la//de stong byed bskyed rim phyi dang gnyis//dgung nub mo nyal ba'i rnal 'byor nas//sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor bar//de sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba yis//sbyang gzhi dang stong byed ngo 'phrod cing / /de lam byed rnam bzhi'i rgyas btab cing / /'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtsis zin par//tshul de rnams brtson 'grus drag pos bsgom//bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa zhes//reg mthong gi mtshan ma mthong bar gsungs//tha mal gyi snang zhen spong byed yin//da gya rnam lhar zhen spong byed ni//thabs rdzogs rim zab mo yin de 489

yang / /dbang gong ma gsum gyi lam yin de/ /rtsa yi ge thig le rlung khams la/ /gnad bsnun pa'i nyams len sbyor dngos rjes/ /gzhung man ngag bla ma'i zhal shes brgyan/ /gegs sel dang bogs 'byin srung ba bcas//tshul bzhin du nyams su blang ba na//tshogs drod sogs drod gsum rim gyis 'byung //de ji bzhin spyod pa rnam gsum spyad/ /rtags gsum po rim 'byung ji lta bar//sa lam yang rim bgrod 'gros bzhi jim//rten brten pa gnas 'gyur sku lnga thob//de che ba gsum ldan rdo rje'i sa/ /rgyud man ngag bkral ba'i dgongs pa yin//des gsang chen rgyud sde man ngag gi /tshul bstan pa 'dzin tshul mdo tsam yin//mdo sngags kyi lung rtogs bstan pa de//bshad sgrub pa zung 'jug nyams blangs na/ /de rgyal bstan rnam dag yin no zhes/ /rgyal sras bcas mkhas rnams mgrin gcig tu/ /bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las gsungs/ /de zung 'jug ma gyur ya bral na/ /sgom nyams len med pa'i thos rtsod de/ kho mu stegs chos lugs yin no zhes//rje byams pa thogs med sogs kyis gsungs//thos bsam pa med pa'i sgom pa de//mi lag rdum brag la 'jogs pa 'dra//'dre dud 'gro la sogs 'grub par gsungs//khyed mdo rgyud gzhung lugs du ma la//thos bsam pa mthar phyin mkhas pa rnams/ /blo gsal ba'i snod ldan 'dus pa dang / /rgyu mthun rkyen tshang zhing 'gal rkyen bral//de 'dzom na dpe mkhyud bral ba yis//snod gang la gang 'tshams de dang der//chos sde snod rgyud sde man ngag bcas//las sla chos le lo rnam g.yeng spang / /tshul bzhin du bshad pas rgyal bstan skyongs/ /de lta bu'i mthun rkyen ma tshang na//phyi chom rkun ca cos dben pa dang //nang chags snang dug lnga'i yul gyis 440

dben//lus rgyugs mchong smra brjod 'du 'dzis dben//de lta bu'i dben pa'i ri khrod du//sngar bshad pa'i mdo sngags nyams len rnams//rtse gcig tu brtson pa'i nyams len dang / /gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug 'khor 'das chos//dbyer med par rtogs pa'i lhan skyes de/ /sems sgyu ma brjod bral gtan phab nas//rgyud gsum yang de yi rang bzhin rtogs/ /de lta bu'i spros bral gshis lugs ngang / /ngang de la ma bcos lhug par zhog /gzhan chos spyod bcu yi nyams len sogs/ /rang rgyud tshod bstun pa'i dge la 'bad/ /de lta bu'i dge ba gang bsags pa/ /chud mi 'dza' rdzogs byang rgyur byed pa'i/ /thabs bsngo ba zab mo'i rgyas 'debs dgos//mdor bsdus na tshe lhag gang yod de/ /chos bshad sgrub gnyis kyis dus 'da' mdzod//gzhung mkhas pa'i don go de yin zhes/ khong 'jam mgon sa paṇa de skad gsungs//gzhung mkhas kyang de dang mi ldan par//bdud nag po'i bslu brid khas drag dang //'dod yon la zhin pa ches drags pas//dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas shi gson gyi/ /dkor nag por 'dzem med hab thob byed/ /de thar srog gcod pa'i spu gri dang / /thar med kyi dmyal ba'i sa bon zhes/ khong rgyal ba sras bcas mgrin gcig gsungs//sems bag med nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi//chung 'thung dang sho sbag rtse ba dang / /thar 'pho gegs rdzas ngan sna tha sogs//gzhan 'thab rtsod slong dang de'i grogs byed//khrims ma dag dag tshul ma rtogs bzhin//don rtogs tshul gnyis phung g.yo sgyu sogs/ /da mig ldan g.yang mchong ji bzhin de/ /khyed gzhung mang sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams/ /shi srog la babs kyang las de 'dra/ /bya mi rung de rnams ma mdzad ces//bdag gus pas gsol ba lan brgyar 441

'debs/ /bu dad ldan tshul khrims rgyal mtshan des//tshig zhal gdams dgos zhes nan cher bskul//mdo sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i don/ /tshig don bcas phra zhib snyan sgron phul//khyod blo gros gsal bas tshul bzhin rtogs//da de lhag zhal gdams med mi dgos//de ltar yang bskul nan che drags pas//sems gang dran cal col tshig 'di smras/ /'dir smras bzhin nyams len mdzad gyur na/ /bka' mdo rgyud dgongs pa yin par sems//bdag skyes sbyangs shes rab dman pa yis//don 'gal 'khrul dongs pa mkhas la bshags/ /'di bgyis la rnam dkar mchis srid na//bstan mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas//mkhas grub pas 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab//ma 'gro rnams sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di ni slob bu tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis ma yig rang byon dang / byu ru'i sdong po rin gnyis kyi 'khor lo sa bcu gsum gyi grangs ldan : ti'i phyag tsha lha ras bcas kyi skyes bcas sdu/ // // // // ༵༵ bskul bas shrīḥnā leṇ+ḍa'i mkhan zur ngag dbang blo gros rin

rtsom sgrig 'gan khur pa/ mkhan po rdo rje/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ marma gu ru/ sngags 'chang gu ru/mkhan 'chi med byedro dbang /mtsho sngon snardo /sdu/zhi dīpe tshogs/sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thar lam gsal sgron/nga kha gā sbrinardo po rje pas ba sdu/sdus/zhang nang then mā dpe skrun khang nas bsgrun te bkram/ldan kru'u dmag khul dpar khang gis par //shā ༈ r+sha// /0lo1/dhigrang1zlo rnyi2)par :ga 15nyis stong gcig lo'i zla bcu gnyis par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/nyis stong gcig lo'i zla ba bcu gnyis par dpar thengs dang po dpar/tāswā /sdus/ 152〉/6rdo /50—953—072 /2793
